SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_available_qty AS supplier_available_qty, ss.total_supply_value AS supplier_total_value, ro.total_order_value AS recent_order_value, ro.number_of_items AS items_in_recent_order FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acct_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss LEFT OUTER JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS number_of_items, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) ro ON s.s_suppkey = ro.o_custkey WHERE ss.avg_acct_balance IS NOT NULL AND (ss.total_available_qty > 0 OR ro.total_order_value IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ss.total_supply_value DESC, ro.total_order_value DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_name, c.total_spent, COALESCE(o.order_rank, 0) AS order_rank, l.net_revenue, l.distinct_parts, CASE WHEN c.total_spent IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE CASE WHEN c.total_spent > 10000 THEN 'High Roller' WHEN c.total_spent BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Mid Tier' ELSE 'Budget' END END AS customer_segment FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') o ON c.order_count = o.order_rank LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-12-01' AND DATE '1997-09-30' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.total_spent IS NOT NULL OR l.net_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, l.net_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, AVG(rs.total_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE (co.o_orderstatus = 'F' OR co.o_orderstatus IS NULL) AND (rs.rank_within_nation <= 3 OR rs.rank_within_nation IS NULL) GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(co.o_totalprice) > 10000.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT fr.c_name, fr.total_order_value, COALESCE(fr.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, fr.supplier_count, CASE WHEN fr.order_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top Customer' ELSE 'Regular Customer' END AS customer_category FROM (SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_order_value, ss.total_sales, ns.supplier_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_order_value DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.c_custkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON cs.c_custkey = ns.n_nationkey) fr WHERE fr.total_order_value > 10000 OR fr.total_sales > 50000 ORDER BY fr.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT no.n_name, no.order_count, no.total_value, si.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN no.total_value IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' WHEN si.total_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'No Supplies' ELSE 'Has Orders and Supplies' END AS order_supply_status FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(od.total_order_value) AS total_value FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) no FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si ON no.order_count > 0 AND si.total_supply_cost > 0 WHERE (no.order_count IS NOT NULL OR si.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY no.n_name, si.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.ps_partkey) AS part_count, COALESCE(SUM(ap.total_available_quantity), 0) AS available_quantity, MAX(od.total_price) AS max_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.rnk = 1 THEN rs.s_acctbal ELSE 0 END) AS top_nation_supplier_balance FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ap ON s.s_suppkey = ap.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON s.s_suppkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL AND (s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL OR rs.rnk IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.rnk HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ap.ps_partkey) > 5 ORDER BY available_quantity DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(sp.total_available_qty, 0) AS total_available_qty, COALESCE(cp.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(cp.total_spent) OVER () AS avg_customer_spending FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON p.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000) cp ON o.o_custkey = cp.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND (sp.avg_supply_cost > 10 OR p.p_retailprice < 50) AND (o.o_orderstatus = 'O' OR o.o_orderstatus IS NULL) GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, sp.total_available_qty, cp.total_spent ORDER BY total_spent DESC, p.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON r.o_orderkey = cs.order_count WHERE (r.rn <= 10 OR cs.total_spent IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, COALESCE(c.total_spent, 0) AS customer_total, COALESCE(s.total_supply_cost, 0) AS supplier_cost, CASE WHEN r.OrderRank = 1 THEN 'Highest' ELSE 'Other' END AS order_priority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY r.o_orderdate ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC) AS daily_order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON r.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON r.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders) ORDER BY r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.customer_name, p.p_name, p.total_supplycost, CASE WHEN h.total_value IS NULL THEN 'No Value' ELSE CAST(h.total_value AS VARCHAR) END AS order_value_text FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name AS customer_name, p.p_partkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= (CAST('1998-10-01' AS DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year')) r JOIN lineitem li ON r.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(SC.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) SC ON p.p_partkey = SC.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50.00) p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, p.p_partkey HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) > 2000) h JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(SC.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) SC ON p.p_partkey = SC.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50.00) p ON h.p_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY h.o_orderdate DESC, h.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(AVG(sa.total_supplycost), 0) AS avg_supplycost, COALESCE(SUM(os.total_order_value), 0) AS total_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN cr.acctbal_rank <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_customers_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa ON s.s_suppkey = sa.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS acctbal_rank FROM customer c) cr ON cr.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT COALESCE(sw.nation_name, z.nation_name) AS nation_name, COALESCE(sw.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(sw.order_count, 0) AS order_count, CASE WHEN sw.sales_rank IS NOT NULL THEN 'Ranked' ELSE 'No Sales' END AS sales_status FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RegionalSales) sw FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RegionalSales) s ON n.n_name = s.nation_name WHERE s.nation_name IS NULL) z ON sw.nation_name = z.nation_name ORDER BY nation_name;

SELECT cs.c_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_cost, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) fs ON cs.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'Germany') LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p.p_retailprice > 100.00 ORDER BY ps.ps_availqty DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE cs.rank_in_nation <= 5 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, COALESCE(f.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(s.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost, CASE WHEN r.o_totalprice > 1000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Standard Value' END AS order_value_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) f ON r.o_orderkey = f.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) s ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey AND l.l_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50) ) WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_name) AS customer_count, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT hvs.s_suppkey) AS high_value_supplier_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT vrp.p_name, ', ') AS top_products FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvs ON n.n_nationkey = hvs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) vrp ON vrp.price_rank <= 5 WHERE co.total_orders IS NOT NULL OR hvs.total_supply_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(co.total_spent) > 50000 ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT tc.region_name, tc.c_name, COALESCE(tc.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN tc.total_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Orders Present' END AS order_status FROM (SELECT region_name, c_name, total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.r_name, c.c_nationkey) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5) tc FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT r.r_name FROM region r) r ON tc.region_name = r.r_name ORDER BY tc.region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sd.s_name, d.r_name, COALESCE(os.total_sales, 0) AS order_sales, COALESCE(hvo.total_sales, 0) AS high_value_sales, sd.rank, CASE WHEN os.total_sales IS NOT NULL THEN 'Order Exists' ELSE 'No Order' END AS order_status FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0) sd LEFT JOIN region d ON sd.nation_name = d.r_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS parts_count, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON sd.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_totalprice > 1000 GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) hvo ON os.o_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey WHERE sd.rank <= 5 ORDER BY d.r_name, sd.rank;

SELECT cn.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns, AVG(a.avg_order_price) AS customer_avg_order_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(s.s_name, ' (', sp.total_cost, ')'), ', ') AS suppliers_costs FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cn ON o.o_custkey = cn.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey, ps_suppkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o_custkey, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o_custkey) a ON o.o_custkey = a.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY cn.nation_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_returns ASC;

SELECT d.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey), 0) AS customer_count, COALESCE(SUM(ro.o_totalprice), 0) AS total_order_value, COALESCE(SUM(sd.total_available), 0) AS total_supplier_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, AVG(sd.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM nation d LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') ro ON ro.o_orderkey IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) < 100.00) sd ON sd.total_available IS NOT NULL WHERE d.n_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_comment LIKE '%friendly%' ) GROUP BY d.n_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT sr.c_name, sr.total_sales, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.total_supply_cost, (CASE WHEN sr.total_sales > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN sr.total_sales BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END) AS customer_value_category FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_nationkey) sr LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sr.c_custkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE (sr.sales_rank <= 5 OR sd.total_supply_cost IS NULL) ORDER BY sr.total_sales DESC, customer_value_category;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(nos.total_orders, 0) AS nation_order_count, COALESCE(nos.avg_order_value, 0) AS avg_order_value, COALESCE(rs.total_cost, 0) AS supplier_total_cost FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nos ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = r.r_name) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, COALESCE(s.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, o.o_orderkey AS order_id, hv.total_price, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) hv JOIN orders o ON hv.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s ON s.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE (c.c_acctbal IS NULL OR c.c_acctbal >= 5000) AND o.o_orderkey NOT IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'R') ORDER BY hv.total_price DESC, c.c_name ASC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, cs.TotalSpent, cs.TotalOrders, ss.TotalSupplierCost, r.o_orderpriority FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON r.o_orderkey = (SELECT MAX(o1.o_orderkey) FROM orders o1 WHERE o1.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplierCost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey AND l.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0)) WHERE r.OrderRank = 1 AND (cs.TotalSpent > 1000 OR cs.TotalOrders > 10) ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_orderpriority;

SELECT r.s_name, r.s_acctbal, h.c_name, COALESCE(t.total_value, 0) AS total_order_value, CASE WHEN h.customer_rank <= 10 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_status FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) h ON r.s_suppkey = h.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) t ON h.c_custkey = t.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank = 1 AND r.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.s_acctbal DESC, h.c_name;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, psi.p_partkey, psi.p_name, psi.total_supply_cost, psi.supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) psi ON psi.p_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' ) WHERE ro.rank <= 10 AND (ro.o_totalprice - COALESCE(psi.total_supply_cost, 0)) > 100 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS num_customers, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN cs.order_rank = 1 THEN od.total_order_value END), 0) AS highest_order_value, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 MONTH') cs ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON od.o_orderkey = cs.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey) rs ON rs.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY num_customers DESC, highest_order_value DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, sa.total_availqty, fc.c_name, fc.order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.p_brand ORDER BY sa.total_availqty DESC) AS rank_avail FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, p.p_size, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rn FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 500) rp LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sa ON rp.p_partkey = sa.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COALESCE(orders.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(orders.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) orders ON c.c_custkey = orders.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 OR orders.total_spent > 10000) fc ON sa.total_availqty IS NOT NULL WHERE (rp.p_size > 10 AND fc.order_count > 5) OR fc.total_spent > 5000 ORDER BY rp.p_brand, sa.total_availqty DESC;

SELECT HVC.c_custkey, HVC.c_name, HVC.total_spent, TS.total_parts_supplied, TS.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000.00) HVC LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_parts_supplied, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 500.00 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sp.total_parts_supplied > 10) TS ON TS.total_supply_cost > HVC.total_spent ORDER BY HVC.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, COALESCE(ns.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(ns.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, CASE WHEN ns.sales_rank IS NULL THEN 'Not Ranked' ELSE CAST(ns.sales_rank AS VARCHAR) END AS sales_rank FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.c_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name LIKE 'E%') ORDER BY total_sales DESC, n.n_name ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_discount > 0.1 THEN l.l_extendedprice * l.l_quantity * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS DiscountedSales, COALESCE(SUM(st.TotalAvailableQuantity), 0) AS TotalAvailableQuantitySupplied, AVG(st.AverageSupplyCost) AS AverageCostPerPart FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQuantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS AverageSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st ON s.s_suppkey = st.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31') o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE p.p_size > 20 AND p.p_retailprice IS NOT NULL AND n.n_name IN (SELECT n2.n_name FROM nation n2 WHERE n2.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC, Region;

SELECT r.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_account_balance, SUM(COALESCE(sp.total_supply_cost, 0)) AS total_cost, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_name, ', ') AS top_parts FROM nation r LEFT JOIN supplier s ON r.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_size FROM part WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100)) p ON s.s_suppkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON p.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 500) h ON h.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.n_name LIKE 'N%' GROUP BY r.n_name, s.s_acctbal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) > 10 ORDER BY average_account_balance DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(spc.supplier_count, 0) AS supplier_count, COALESCE(rs.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS top_supplier, COALESCE(rs.s_acctbal, 0) AS top_supplier_acctbal, hvo.total_order_value FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) > 3) spc ON p.p_partkey = spc.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL) rs ON p.p_partkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) hvo ON hvo.o_orderkey = (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LIMIT 1) WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50 ORDER BY hvo.total_order_value DESC NULLS LAST, p.p_partkey;

SELECT r.r_name, sp.p_name, sp.p_brand, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container, ps.ps_availqty FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS RNK FROM supplier s) s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND s.RNK <= 3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts ON sp.ps_partkey = ts.l_partkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND (s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL OR s.s_acctbal < 5000) GROUP BY r.r_name, sp.p_name, sp.p_brand HAVING SUM(ts.total_sales) > 10000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, average_account_balance ASC;

SELECT sp.s_name, sp.part_count, sp.total_supply_cost, sp.avg_cost_per_part, os.total_spent AS customer_total_spent, os.order_count FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.part_count, ss.total_supply_cost, ROUND(ss.total_supply_cost / NULLIF(ss.part_count, 0), 2) AS avg_cost_per_part, (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus IN ('O', 'F', 'P') GROUP BY o.o_custkey) as OrderSummary) AS avg_order_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss WHERE ss.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) sp FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus IN ('O', 'F', 'P') GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON sp.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey WHERE (sp.avg_cost_per_part IS NOT NULL OR os.total_spent IS NOT NULL) AND (sp.part_count > 5 OR os.order_count > 2) ORDER BY sp.s_name ASC, os.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.p_name AS part_name, sp.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) as rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON n.n_nationkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost > (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) hc ON sp.s_suppkey = hc.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders) WHERE sp.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, hc.total_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ods.o_orderkey, ods.o_totalprice, ods.SupplierName, SUM(ods.l_extendedprice * (1 - ods.l_discount)) AS AdjustedPrice, COUNT(DISTINCT s.TotalPartsSupplied) AS DistinctSuppliers, HVL.DiscountCategory FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, s.s_name AS SupplierName, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.OrderRank <= 10 AND (l.l_discount IS NOT NULL OR l.l_tax IS NOT NULL)) ods LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS TotalPartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON ods.SupplierName = s.s_name JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, CASE WHEN l.l_discount > 0.2 THEN 'High' ELSE 'Regular' END AS DiscountCategory FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') HVL ON ods.o_orderkey = HVL.l_orderkey GROUP BY ods.o_orderkey, ods.o_totalprice, ods.SupplierName, HVL.DiscountCategory HAVING SUM(ods.l_extendedprice * (1 - ods.l_discount)) > 1000 ORDER BY AdjustedPrice DESC;

SELECT rd.o_orderkey, rd.o_orderdate, rd.o_totalprice, pd.p_partkey, pd.p_name, pd.p_brand, pd.max_supply_cost, CASE WHEN pd.max_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'NO SUPPLY' WHEN pd.max_supply_cost < 100 THEN 'LOW SUPPLY' ELSE 'HIGH SUPPLY' END AS supply_status FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') rd JOIN lineitem li ON rd.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, COALESCE(MAX(supply.total_supply_cost), 0) AS max_supply_cost FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey) supply ON p.p_partkey = supply.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) pd ON li.l_partkey = pd.p_partkey WHERE rd.rn <= 10 ORDER BY rd.o_orderdate DESC, rd.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, ss.s_name, cs.total_spent, ss.total_available, ss.avg_supply_cost, tp.total_parts AS total_parts_inventory, CASE WHEN cs.order_count > 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS customer_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.c_custkey ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS spend_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supply FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.c_custkey = ss.s_suppkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM part p) tp WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000 OR ss.total_available IS NULL ORDER BY cs.c_name, ss.avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.p_brand, sp.p_type, AVG(sp.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_lineitem_value), 0) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) co ON sp.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE sp.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_type = sp.p_type) GROUP BY sp.s_name, sp.p_brand, sp.p_type HAVING COUNT(sp.ps_partkey) > 2 ORDER BY avg_supply_cost DESC, total_order_value DESC;

SELECT fr.c_custkey, fr.c_name, fr.status, fr.s_suppkey, fr.supplier_name, fr.total_supplycost, fr.unique_parts FROM (SELECT es.c_custkey, es.c_name, es.status, hvs.s_suppkey, hvs.s_name AS supplier_name, hvs.total_supplycost, hvs.unique_parts FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_orders, CASE WHEN co.total_orders > 10000 THEN 'EXCEEDS' ELSE 'WITHIN' END AS status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS distinct_orderlines, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_orders IS NOT NULL) es CROSS JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supplycost, ss.unique_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplyrank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.supplyrank <= 10) hvs) fr WHERE fr.status = 'EXCEEDS' ORDER BY fr.total_supplycost DESC, fr.c_name ASC;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.orders_count, hvc.total_spent, ag.r_name AS region_name, ag.revenue, ag.order_count, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.order_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COALESCE(o.orders_count, 0) AS orders_count, COALESCE(o.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) o ON c.c_custkey = o.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) hvc LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) ag ON hvc.total_spent > 50000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro ON hvc.orders_count > 0 WHERE (ag.revenue IS NOT NULL OR hvc.total_spent > 0) ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC, ag.revenue DESC;

SELECT ps.p_partkey, ps.p_name, ps.total_revenue, ps.order_count, ps.avg_quantity, COALESCE(psw.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS top_supplier_name, CASE WHEN psw.ps_supplycost IS NULL THEN 'Insufficient Data' WHEN psw.ps_supplycost < 100 THEN 'Low Cost' ELSE 'High Cost' END AS cost_category FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost, rs.s_name, ps.ps_availqty FROM partsupp ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank, ps.ps_partkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) rs ON ps.ps_partkey = rs.ps_partkey AND rs.supplier_rank = 1) psw ON ps.p_partkey = psw.ps_partkey WHERE ps.total_revenue > 1000 AND ps.avg_quantity IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC, ps.order_count ASC;

SELECT nc.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT fp.p_name) AS products, MAX(psi.avg_sales_price) AS max_avg_sales_price FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation nc ON c.c_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_size FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) fp ON l.l_partkey = fp.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, (SELECT AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) AS avg_sales_price FROM partsupp ps) psi ON psi.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND nc.n_name IN (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = 1) AND (fp.p_size IS NULL OR fp.p_size > 20) GROUP BY nc.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT T.nation_name, T.total_sales, S.s_name, S.total_supplycost, CASE WHEN T.total_sales > 10000 THEN 'High' WHEN T.total_sales BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) WHERE sales_rank <= 3) T LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, sum(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) S ON S.total_supplycost >= T.total_sales ORDER BY T.total_sales DESC, S.total_supplycost ASC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.avg_supplycost, CASE WHEN ts.total_spent IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE CONCAT('Total Spent: $', ts.total_spent) END AS order_summary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n_summary.n_name ORDER BY p.p_retailprice) AS region_rank FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM nation n INNER JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) n_summary ON n_summary.n_name = p.p_mfgr LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.c_custkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > COALESCE(ps.avg_supplycost, 0) * 1.1 AND (p.p_comment IS NULL OR p.p_comment LIKE '%special%') ORDER BY region_rank, p.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT ts.r_name AS region_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(os.total_sales) AS total_sales, AVG(ts.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rn = 1 JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON ts.s_name = CAST(os.o_orderkey AS VARCHAR) GROUP BY ts.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal HAVING COUNT(os.o_orderkey) > 0 AND SUM(os.total_sales) > 10000.00 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, ts.r_name;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.nation_revenue, ns.customer_count, COALESCE(RS.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, RS.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(co.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue, COUNT(co.order_count) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate <= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 AND s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL) RS ON ns.nation_revenue > 10000 AND RS.rank = 1 WHERE ns.nation_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ns.nation_revenue DESC, ns.n_name;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, ac.c_name, ss.s_name, li.revenue, li.item_count, COALESCE(ss.part_count, 0) AS part_count, CASE WHEN r.total_price_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Order' ELSE 'Regular Order' END AS order_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS total_price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ac ON r.o_orderkey = ac.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON r.o_orderkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) li ON r.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE r.total_price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC, ac.total_spent DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name, lis.total_revenue, lis.item_count, CASE WHEN o.o_totalprice > 50000 THEN 'High Value Order' ELSE 'Regular Order' END AS order_type FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') o JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON o.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_value, RANK() OVER(ORDER BY ss.total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.total_supply_value > 10000) ts ON ts.supplier_rank = 1 WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey AND l.l_shipdate > '1997-01-01' ) ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT f.customer_name, f.supplier_name, f.total_revenue, f.o_orderdate, f.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT h.c_name AS customer_name, hs.s_name AS supplier_name, os.total_revenue, os.o_orderdate, os.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) hs ON h.c_custkey = hs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) os ON os.o_orderkey = h.c_custkey WHERE os.total_revenue > 10000 AND hs.supplier_rank <= 5) f ORDER BY f.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT cs.c_name, ss.s_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, od.total_amount, COALESCE(ls.late_count, 0) AS late_shipments_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.c_custkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON cs.total_orders = od.rn LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate > l.l_commitdate GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ls.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE cs.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as Customer_Order_Summary) AND ss.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as Supplier_Summary) ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ss.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT rc.c_name AS customer_name, rc.total_spent AS total_spent, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, fli.l_orderkey AS order_key, SUM(fli.net_price) AS total_net_price, COUNT(DISTINCT fli.l_partkey) AS unique_parts, MAX(fli.return_status) AS max_return_status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) rc LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_discount, l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) AS net_price, CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 'Returned' ELSE 'Not Returned' END AS return_status FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31') fli ON fli.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = rc.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) > 10000) ts ON fli.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE rc.rank <= 5 GROUP BY rc.c_name, rc.total_spent, ts.s_name, fli.l_orderkey ORDER BY rc.total_spent DESC, unique_parts DESC;

SELECT coalesce(r.n_name, 'Unknown') AS nation_name, SUM(COALESCE(lp.total_spent, 0)) AS total_revenue, AVG(CASE WHEN lp.total_orders > 0 THEN lp.total_orders ELSE NULL END) AS avg_orders_per_customer, MAX(sps.total_supply_value) AS max_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders_with_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) lp ON ro.o_orderkey = lp.total_orders LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = lp.c_custkey LEFT JOIN nation r ON r.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sps ON sps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 AND (ro.o_orderstatus = 'F' OR ro.o_orderstatus = 'P') GROUP BY r.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.o_orderkey, rs.o_orderdate, rs.rank, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, ss.total_parts, ss.total_value, COALESCE(MAX(l.l_discount), 0) AS max_discount, CASE WHEN rs.o_totalprice > 1000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS order_value_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') rs JOIN lineitem l ON rs.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_size > 10 ) GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice) p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 10 GROUP BY rs.o_orderkey, rs.o_orderdate, rs.rank, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, ss.total_parts, ss.total_value, rs.o_totalprice ORDER BY rs.o_orderdate DESC, rs.rank;

SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS DistinctOrderCount, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(CASE WHEN r.OrderRank <= 10 THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE NULL END) AS AvgTopOrderPrice, s.TotalSupplyCost FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.ps_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND p.p_retailprice < 500.00 LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r ON o.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 100.00 GROUP BY c.c_name, s.TotalSupplyCost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC, DistinctOrderCount ASC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.r_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, SUM(COALESCE(ls.total_line_item_value, 0)) AS total_line_item_value, SUM(COALESCE(ps.ps_supplycost, 0) * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, MAX(rop.o_totalprice) AS max_order_price FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(COALESCE(ps.ps_availqty, 0)) AS total_avail_qty FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ns.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_item_value, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON cs.c_custkey = ls.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS supply_rank FROM partsupp ps) ps ON ns.n_nationkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o) rop ON cs.order_count = rop.o_orderkey WHERE ns.supplier_count > 5 GROUP BY ns.n_name, ns.r_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count HAVING MAX(ps.ps_supplycost) < 1000 ORDER BY ns.n_name, total_spent DESC;

SELECT nr.n_name AS nation_name, nr.region_name, COALESCE(sr.total_revenue, 0) AS supplier_revenue, nr.supplier_count, CASE WHEN sr.total_revenue IS NOT NULL AND nr.supplier_count > 0 THEN sr.total_revenue / nr.supplier_count ELSE NULL END AS avg_revenue_per_supplier FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) nr LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON nr.n_nationkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE nr.supplier_count > 0 OR sr.total_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY nr.region_name, avg_revenue_per_supplier DESC;

SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, co.order_count, COALESCE(hvs.total_available_qty, 0) AS supplier_total_available_qty, hvs.avg_supply_cost AS supplier_avg_supply_cost, CASE WHEN co.total_spent > 10000 THEN 'High Spender' WHEN co.total_spent BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Spender' ELSE 'Low Spender' END AS spending_category FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_available_qty, sp.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp INNER JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sp.avg_supply_cost < (SELECT AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps)) hvs ON co.c_custkey = hvs.s_suppkey WHERE co.order_count > 0 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, co.c_name;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, COALESCE(h.c_name, 'No High Value Customer') AS customer_name, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN r.price_rank = 1 THEN 'Highest Price' ELSE 'Other' END AS price_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) h ON r.o_orderkey = h.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, ss.total_available, ss.total_supplycost, cs.order_count, cs.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON ss.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.c_custkey = (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA')) WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT region_name, customer_count, total_sales, total_supplier_cost, supplier_orders FROM (SELECT rs.region_name, rs.customer_count, rs.total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(ss.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supplier_cost, STRING_AGG(CONCAT(ss.s_name, ': ', ss.total_orders), '; ') AS supplier_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(CASE WHEN ps.ps_availqty < 100 THEN ps.ps_supplycost ELSE NULL END) AS avg_cost_low_supply, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.total_orders > 0 GROUP BY rs.region_name, rs.customer_count, rs.total_sales) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as RegionSales) AND customer_count > ( SELECT AVG(customer_count) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) WHERE region_name IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY total_sales DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, COALESCE(rs.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, CASE WHEN rs.sales_rank = 1 THEN 'Highest Sales' ELSE 'Regular Sales' END AS order_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus IN ('F', 'P')) o LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) rs ON o.o_orderkey = rs.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders) ORDER BY total_sales DESC, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT ns.n_name AS supplier_nation, ns.region_name, COALESCE(ss.part_count, 0) AS total_parts, COALESCE(os.total_order_value, 0) AS total_order_value, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ss.part_count, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(os.total_order_value, 0) / NULLIF(ss.total_value, 0)) ELSE NULL END AS efficiency_ratio FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON ss.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ns ON ss.s_suppkey = ns.n_nationkey OR os.o_custkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE (ns.region_name IS NOT NULL OR ss.s_suppkey IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY efficiency_ratio DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, COALESCE(hvs.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(hvs.s_acctbal, 0) AS supplier_acctbal, rs.total_sales, ns.nation_sales, CASE WHEN rs.sales_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Seller' ELSE 'Normal Seller' END AS sales_status FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) rs ON p.p_partkey = rs.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) hvs ON hvs.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ns.n_nationkey = ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = hvs.s_suppkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 ORDER BY p.p_partkey;

SELECT c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, AVG(CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal > 1000 THEN l.l_discount ELSE NULL END) AS avg_discount_high_value_customers, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) DESC) AS region_rank FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0) c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON c.nation_name = n.n_name LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON sc.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, r.r_name, r.r_regionkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, region_rank;
