SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, r.r_name, COALESCE(HS.total_cost, 0) AS high_supplier_cost FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(sc.total_cost), 0) AS total_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(sc.total_cost), 0) > 5000) HS ON c.c_custkey = HS.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro ON ro.o_orderkey = ( SELECT MAX(o.o_orderkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey ) WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY high_supplier_cost DESC, c.c_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, s.calculated_sales, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN li.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_count FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, ts.total_sales, COALESCE(ts.total_sales, 0) AS calculated_sales, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ts.total_sales, 0) = 0 THEN 'No Sales' ELSE 'Has Sales' END AS sales_status FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey )) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) ts ON rs.s_suppkey = ts.l_suppkey WHERE rs.rnk <= 5) s JOIN lineitem li ON s.s_suppkey = li.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON sp.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_name, s.calculated_sales, r.r_name HAVING SUM(li.l_quantity) > 100 ORDER BY s.calculated_sales DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, p.p_name, COALESCE(s.s_name, 'N/A') AS supplier_name, tp.total_spent, ap.avg_price, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS returned_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ap ON p.p_partkey = ap.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) tp ON s.s_suppkey = tp.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'E%' GROUP BY r.r_name, p.p_name, s.s_name, tp.total_spent, ap.avg_price HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, p.p_name;

SELECT s.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(oss.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenues, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM (SELECT ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.s_name ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.n_nationkey ) WHERE s.rnk <= 5) ts LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_quantity > 0) oss RIGHT JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.n_nationkey ) WHERE s.rnk <= 5) s ON oss.s_name = s.s_name GROUP BY s.s_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(oss.total_revenue), 0) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenues DESC;

SELECT cr.n_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(sd.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_regionkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cr LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) od ON cr.c_custkey = od.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sd ON cr.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = (SELECT DISTINCT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = cr.n_regionkey)) WHERE (sd.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL OR sd.total_supply_cost > 10000) GROUP BY cr.n_regionkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, avg_account_balance DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, COALESCE(sp.total_avail_qty, 0) AS available_quantity, COALESCE(sp.avg_supply_cost, 0) AS average_supply_cost, hp.p_name, hp.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT li.l_partkey FROM lineitem li WHERE li.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 500) hp ON hp.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COALESCE(co.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0.00) AS total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierSales) ts ON co.total_spent > 5000 AND ts.sales_rank <= 10 WHERE co.c_custkey IS NOT NULL OR ts.s_suppkey IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_spent DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal, COALESCE(SUM(fl.l_extendedprice * (1 - fl.l_discount)), 0) AS total_lineitem_value, COUNT(DISTINCT h.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, l.l_linestatus, LAG(l.l_extendedprice) OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_linenumber) AS previous_price FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31') fl ON r.o_orderkey = fl.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > (SELECT AVG(ps_availqty) FROM partsupp)) h ON fl.l_partkey = h.ps_partkey WHERE r.rn = 1 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal HAVING COALESCE(SUM(fl.l_extendedprice * (1 - fl.l_discount)), 0) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lineitem_value DESC, r.o_orderdate;

SELECT hcp.p_partkey, hcp.p_name, hcp.p_retailprice, hcp.total_supply_cost, os.total_order_value, os.line_count, COALESCE(r.r_name, 'Unknown') AS region_name FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, sc.total_supply_cost, (sc.total_supply_cost / p.p_retailprice) * 100 AS cost_percentage FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON p.p_partkey = sc.ps_partkey WHERE sc.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) as Supplier_Costs)) hcp LEFT JOIN supplier s ON hcp.p_partkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_count, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON hcp.p_partkey = os.o_orderkey WHERE hcp.cost_percentage > 75 AND os.total_order_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hcp.total_supply_cost DESC, os.line_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count, rs.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierOrders) rs LEFT JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE (rs.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierOrders) OR rs.order_count > 5) AND r.r_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.total_parts, COALESCE(hvo.total_order_value, 0) AS high_value_order, sd.total_supply_cost, sd.s_acctbal / NULLIF(sd.total_parts, 0) AS average_supply_cost_per_part FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(p.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(p.ps_supplycost * p.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp p ON s.s_suppkey = p.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) sd LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.total_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_dist FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) o WHERE o.total_order_value > (SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_dist FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) as OrderDetails)) hvo ON sd.total_parts = hvo.o_orderkey WHERE sd.s_acctbal > 5000 ORDER BY sd.total_supply_cost DESC, sd.nation_name ASC;

SELECT fo.c_name AS customer_name, fo.total_revenue AS total_revenue, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.total_available, sd.max_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_custkey, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) fo JOIN lineitem l ON fo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, MAX(ps.ps_supplycost) AS max_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON l.l_partkey = sd.ps_partkey WHERE fo.total_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_custkey, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) as FilteredOrders ) ORDER BY fo.total_revenue DESC, sd.max_cost ASC;

SELECT r.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.o_orderkey) AS completed_orders, SUM(fo.total_order_value) AS total_order_value, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rs.s_name, ', ') AS top_suppliers FROM nation r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON r.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey AND rs.rn <= 3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) fo ON rs.s_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = fo.o_orderkey) GROUP BY r.n_name HAVING SUM(fo.total_order_value) > (SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as FilteredOrders) ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, COALESCE(ss.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(os.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ROUND(COALESCE(ss.total_supply_cost, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(os.total_revenue, 0), 0), 2) AS cost_to_revenue_ratio FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_suppkey FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON n.n_nationkey = os.o_orderkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE '%South%' ORDER BY cost_to_revenue_ratio DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rh.o_orderkey, rh.o_orderdate, rh.o_orderstatus, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.region_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_acctbal AS customer_balance, COALESCE(rh.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) rh FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name) s ON rh.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2 )) c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = rh.o_orderkey) WHERE rh.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_balance DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(lp.total_availqty) AS avg_available_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_regionkey) AS regions_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, MAX(avg_supplycost) AS max_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey) GROUP BY ps_partkey) mps ON ps.ps_partkey = mps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost = mps.max_cost GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) lp ON l.l_partkey = lp.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN region r ON c.c_nationkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY c.c_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, hvl.total_value, sd.s_name, rs.r_name, rs.nation_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND c.c_acctbal > 1000.00) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000.00) hvl ON ro.o_orderkey = hvl.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON hvl.l_orderkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < 20) JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ON ro.o_orderkey % 5 = 0 WHERE ro.order_rank = 1 AND (hvl.total_value IS NOT NULL OR sd.total_avail_qty > 100) ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, ro.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_orders, rs.avg_order_value, rs.total_returns, COALESCE(NULLIF(rs.total_returns, 0), NULL) AS normalized_return_rate FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.total_orders ORDER BY s.avg_order_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs ON r.supplier_count = rs.total_orders WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ORDER BY region_name, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COALESCE(SUM(si.sales), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(MAX(t.rank), 0) AS max_rank, COALESCE(SUM(sn.total_cost), 0) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) si ON o.o_orderkey = si.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) sn ON n.n_name = sn.n_name WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT cs.c_name, COALESCE(cs.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(cs.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, CASE WHEN cs.last_order_date IS NOT NULL AND cs.total_orders > 0 THEN 'Active' ELSE 'Inactive' END AS customer_status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT p_partkey, total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) WHERE sales_rank = 1) s ON cs.c_custkey = s.p_partkey WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000 OR s.total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, cs.c_name;

SELECT r.region_name, rc.c_name, rc.total_order_value, rc.order_count, CASE WHEN rc.total_order_value IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Has Orders' END AS order_status FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) r FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_order_value, co.order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_order_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) rc ON r.region_name = (SELECT r_name FROM region WHERE r_regionkey = (SELECT n_regionkey FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = rc.c_custkey)) WHERE r.total_sales > 10000 OR rc.order_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.region_name, rc.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(ps.ps_availqty), 0) AS total_available_qty, CASE WHEN t.order_count = 0 THEN 'No Orders' ELSE CONCAT('Orders:', t.order_count) END AS order_info FROM (SELECT rss.s_suppkey, rss.s_name, rss.total_sales, rss.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rss WHERE rss.sales_rank <= 10) t LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON t.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.order_count ORDER BY t.s_suppkey;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.average_supply_cost, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, CASE WHEN ro.o_totalprice > 1000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Standard Value' END AS order_value_category, COALESCE(MAX(l.l_discount), 0) AS max_discount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss LEFT OUTER JOIN lineitem l ON ss.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro ON ro.o_custkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON ss.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.total_available_quantity IS NOT NULL AND (ss.average_supply_cost BETWEEN 50 AND 200 OR ss.total_available_quantity > 500) GROUP BY n.n_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.average_supply_cost, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) > 1 ORDER BY n.n_name, ss.s_name;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, ns.region_name, ns.supplier_count, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, COALESCE(ss.unique_parts, 0) AS unique_parts_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n INNER JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) ns ON ns.supplier_count > 5 WHERE o.rn = 1 AND o.o_totalprice > ( SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.o_orderstatus = o.o_orderstatus ) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, ns.region_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COALESCE(SUM(ct.total_orders), 0) AS total_orders_by_customers, COALESCE(SUM(st.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ct.total_spent) AS avg_spent_per_customer, MAX(ol.total_line_item_value) AS max_order_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ct ON ct.c_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st ON st.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 20 ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_item_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON ol.o_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE r.r_name LIKE '%West%' AND n.n_comment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders_by_customers DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT hs.s_name AS Supplier_Name, hs.total_sales AS Total_Sales, COALESCE(co.total_order_value, 0) AS Customer_Order_Value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ss.total_sales FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND (ss.total_sales IS NULL OR ss.total_sales > 50000)) hs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON hs.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey WHERE LOWER(hs.s_name) LIKE '%corp%' ORDER BY hs.total_sales DESC, co.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, COALESCE(ls.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ss.s_name, ss.total_available, ss.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.total_available > 100 WHERE ro.rn = 1 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, o.o_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, CASE WHEN l.l_discount > 0 THEN 'Discounted' ELSE 'Regular' END AS pricing_type, COALESCE(sTotal.total_supply_cost, 0) AS supplier_total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS recent_order_number FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sTotal ON ts.s_suppkey = sTotal.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > '1996-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE total_spent > 1000) h WHERE h.c_custkey = c.c_custkey AND h.customer_rank <= 10 ) ORDER BY c.c_name, supplier_total_cost DESC, o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(t.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(t.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(t.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(t.avg_quantity, 0) AS avg_quantity FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sos.total_revenue, sos.order_count, sos.avg_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos ON s.s_suppkey = sos.s_suppkey WHERE sos.revenue_rank <= 5) t ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT s_nationkey FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey = t.s_suppkey ) WHERE n.n_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT t.s_name, COALESCE(co.order_count, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, CASE WHEN COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS customer_value FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.sales_rank <= 10) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON t.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COALESCE(la.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(sd.total_cost, 0) AS supplier_cost, CASE WHEN la.total_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No revenue' ELSE 'Revenue recorded' END AS revenue_status FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') o LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_items, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) la ON o.o_orderkey = la.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sd.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE o.rank <= 5 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(rs.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(rs.total_sales, 0.00) AS total_sales, COALESCE(rs.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, CASE WHEN rs.sales_rank IS NULL THEN 'Not Ranked' ELSE CAST(rs.sales_rank AS VARCHAR) END AS sales_rank FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'N%' ORDER BY total_sales DESC, region_name, nation_name;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_sales, tc.order_count, sp.total_available, sp.avg_supply_cost, CASE WHEN sp.avg_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'No Supplier' ELSE 'Available' END AS supplier_status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cs.total_sales, cs.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE cs.total_sales > 10000) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey) sp ON tc.c_custkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE sp.total_available > 100 OR sp.total_available IS NULL ORDER BY tc.sales_rank, tc.c_name;

SELECT hc.c_custkey, hc.c_name, fo.o_orderkey, fo.total_value, COALESCE(rs.s_name, 'N/A') AS supplier_name, rs.s_acctbal, fo.item_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, CUME_DIST() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS cust_dist FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL) hc LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) fo ON hc.c_custkey = fo.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) rs ON hc.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rn = 1 WHERE hc.cust_dist < 0.1 OR fo.total_value IS NULL ORDER BY total_value DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS supplier_sales, c.order_count, c.average_order_value, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) s ON s.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000.00 GROUP BY c.c_custkey HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) >= 5) c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Asia%')) n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = c.c_custkey LIMIT 1) WHERE r.order_rank <= 100;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(ss.total_avail_qty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(cs.total_spent) AS avg_customer_spending FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey) cs ON s.s_nationkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE ss.total_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) > 0 ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, cs.TotalOrders, cs.TotalSpent, cs.FinalizedSales, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(hvc.c_name, 'No High Value Customer') AS HighValueCustomer, CASE WHEN r.SupplierRank = 1 THEN 'Top Supplier' ELSE 'Other Supplier' END AS SupplierType FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) r JOIN part p ON r.s_suppkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS FinalizedSales FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON r.s_suppkey = cs.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS AccountRank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 5000) hvc ON cs.c_custkey = hvc.c_custkey WHERE r.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND p.p_retailprice > 20.00 ORDER BY p.p_partkey, r.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT cu.c_name, cu.order_count, cu.total_spent, sp.s_name, sp.avg_avail_qty, sp.part_names, CASE WHEN cu.total_spent IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' WHEN cu.total_spent > 10000 THEN 'High Value Customer' ELSE 'Standard Customer' END AS customer_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cu.c_custkey ORDER BY cu.last_order_date DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ps.ps_availqty) AS avg_avail_qty, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_name, ', ') AS part_names FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sp.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ps.ps_availqty) AS avg_avail_qty, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_name, ', ') AS part_names FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierPerformance)) hs ON cu.c_custkey = hs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ps.ps_availqty) AS avg_avail_qty, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.p_name, ', ') AS part_names FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON hs.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey WHERE cu.order_count > 0 OR hs.s_suppkey IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cu.total_spent DESC, sp.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ts.c_name AS top_customer, ts.total_spending, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_supply_cost, np.n_name AS nation, np.part_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 MONTH' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spending DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.num_parts > 5 JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) np ON np.part_count < 50 WHERE ts.total_spending > 1000 ORDER BY ts.total_spending DESC, ss.total_supply_cost ASC OFFSET 0 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, COALESCE(ts.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(ts.order_count, 0) AS order_count, CASE WHEN ts.sales_rank IS NULL THEN 'Not Ranked' ELSE CONCAT('Rank ', ts.sales_rank) END AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts FULL OUTER JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Germany', 'Japan')) ORDER BY total_sales DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pc.p_partkey, pc.p_name, pcs.s_suppkey, pcs.s_name, pcs.ps_availqty, pcs.ps_supplycost, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent FROM part pc JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100) pcs ON pc.p_partkey = pcs.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey) tc ON pcs.s_suppkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE pcs.ps_supplycost < ( SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = pc.p_partkey AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' ) ORDER BY pc.p_partkey, pcs.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT hvs.r_name, hvs.n_name, hvs.s_name, hvs.total_sales, COALESCE(hvs.total_sales * 0.1, 0) AS estimated_profit, CASE WHEN hvs.total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS value_category FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ss.total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) as RankedSales)) hvs LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM supplier) sp ON 1=1 WHERE hvs.total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY hvs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(ss.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(SUM(od.total_price), 0) AS total_order_value FROM nation ns LEFT JOIN customer c ON ns.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#27' ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY ns.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) > 0 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(SUM(ts.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fc.c_custkey) AS num_frequent_customers, STRING_AGG(rs.s_name, ', ') AS top_suppliers FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND s.s_acctbal > 1000) rs ON p.p_partkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 500 GROUP BY c.c_custkey HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) fc ON p.p_partkey = fc.c_custkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, num_frequent_customers DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(ls.TotalLines, 0) AS TotalLines, COALESCE(ps.TotalSupplyCost, 0) AS TotalSupplyCost, CASE WHEN ps.TotalSupplyCost IS NULL THEN 'No suppliers available' ELSE 'Available' END AS SupplyStatus FROM part p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.l_partkey, COUNT(*) AS TotalLines FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_custkey, CONCAT(c.c_name, ' from ', c.c_address) AS CustomerInfo FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate = (SELECT MAX(o2.o_orderdate) FROM orders o2)) lo ON l.l_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) ls ON p.p_partkey = ls.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 WHERE p2.p_container = 'BOX') AND p.p_size BETWEEN 5 AND 20 ORDER BY p.p_partkey DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, n.r_name, COALESCE(os.total_value, 0) AS order_total_value, ss.total_available, ss.avg_supply_cost, CASE WHEN os.line_count IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' WHEN os.line_count > 5 THEN 'High Volume' ELSE 'Regular Volume' END AS order_category FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) os ON ss.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM nation n LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.total_available > 1000 ORDER BY order_category DESC, order_total_value DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, COALESCE(c.c_name, 'Unknown Customer') AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, l.l_quantity * l.l_extendedprice AS total_line_value, rc.spending_rank, CASE WHEN l.l_discount > 0.10 THEN 'High Discount' ELSE 'Standard Discount' END AS discount_category FROM lineitem l JOIN orders r ON l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON r.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, CASE WHEN ss.total_available_qty > (SELECT AVG(total_available_qty) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS number_of_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS availability_category FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS number_of_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) rc ON c.c_custkey = rc.c_custkey WHERE r.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND (r.o_orderstatus = 'O' OR r.o_orderstatus IS NULL) ORDER BY total_line_value DESC, rc.spending_rank;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, s.s_name AS supplier_name, cu.total_spent, cu.total_orders, CASE WHEN r.o_orderstatus = 'O' THEN 'Open' WHEN r.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN 'Filled' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS order_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.o_orderstatus ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_position FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey), 0) AS supply_count FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s ON r.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cu ON r.o_orderkey = cu.c_custkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 AND (s.s_acctbal IS NULL OR s.s_acctbal > 5000) ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_name, COALESCE(ss.total_supply_cost, 0) AS supplier_cost, COALESCE(co.total_orders, 0) AS customer_orders, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS customer_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_part_price, MAX(p.p_size) AS max_part_size FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, co.total_orders, co.total_spent HAVING AVG(p.p_retailprice) > (SELECT AVG(p.p_retailprice) FROM part) AND COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) > 10 ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC, customer_orders ASC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey AS Order_ID, r.o_orderdate AS Order_Date, r.o_totalprice AS Total_Price, r.o_orderstatus AS Order_Status, cs.c_name AS Customer_Name, ss.s_name AS Supplier_Name, ls.revenue AS Total_Revenue, ss.total_avail_qty AS Total_Available_Quantity, cs.total_spent AS Total_Spent_By_Customer FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON r.o_orderkey = cs.order_count LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON r.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.total_avail_qty = ls.unique_parts WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT a.o_orderkey, a.p_partkey, a.p_name, a.supply_cost, COALESCE(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.o_orderkey ORDER BY a.supply_cost DESC), 0) AS supply_cost_rank FROM (SELECT rp.o_orderkey, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, COALESCE(SUM(sp.ps_supplycost), 0) AS supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.o_orderkey ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.ps_supplycost), 0) DESC) AS part_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) rp LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON rp.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY rp.o_orderkey, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name) a WHERE a.supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(supply_cost) FROM (SELECT rp.o_orderkey, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, COALESCE(SUM(sp.ps_supplycost), 0) AS supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.o_orderkey ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(sp.ps_supplycost), 0) DESC) AS part_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' - INTERVAL '90 days' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) rp LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON rp.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY rp.o_orderkey, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name) WHERE p_partkey IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY a.o_orderkey, a.supply_cost DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(c.country, 'Unknown Country') AS country, SUM(coalesce(l.total_revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue, AVG(sd.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, n.n_name AS country, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, n.n_name) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_lines FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON c.c_custkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sd.total_available_quantity > 1000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.total_spent > 1000 GROUP BY c.country HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, COALESCE(r.nation_name, 'Unknown') AS nation_name, r.total_sales, r.order_count, CASE WHEN r.sales_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Seller' ELSE 'Regular Seller' END AS seller_status FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as RegionalSales) r WHERE r.total_sales > ( SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as RegionalSales) as RankedSales ) ORDER BY r.region_name, r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_orders, COALESCE(rs.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS primary_supplier, pp.p_name AS popular_part, pp.total_quantity FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS ranking FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs ON cs.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 100) pp ON pp.l_partkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE cs.order_count > 0 AND rs.ranking = 1 ORDER BY cs.total_orders DESC, pp.total_quantity DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date, CASE WHEN SUM(l.l_tax) IS NULL THEN 'No Tax' ELSE 'Tax Applied' END AS tax_status, ts.supplier_rank AS top_supplier_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.parts_supplied, ss.total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND (o.o_orderstatus = 'F' OR o.o_orderstatus = 'P') GROUP BY c.c_name, ts.supplier_rank HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT n.n_name, n.total_sales, n.total_returns, AVG(cb.avg_balance) AS avg_cust_balance, CASE WHEN n.total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High sales' WHEN n.total_sales BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium sales' ELSE 'Low sales' END AS sales_category, SUM(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN ps_supplycost END) AS highest_supplycost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_returns FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) n JOIN (SELECT c_nationkey, AVG(c_acctbal) AS avg_balance FROM customer GROUP BY c_nationkey) cb ON n.n_nationkey = cb.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey ORDER BY ps_supplycost DESC) AS rnk FROM partsupp) ps ON n.n_nationkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE n.total_sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.n_name, n.total_sales, n.total_returns HAVING SUM(n.total_sales) > 0 ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.r_name, f.p_name, f.total_sold_qty, f.avg_selling_price, f.total_avail_qty, f.order_count, f.total_revenue, CASE WHEN f.total_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Orders Exist' END AS order_status FROM (SELECT r.r_name, pd.p_name, pd.total_sold_qty, pd.avg_selling_price, sa.total_avail_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sa JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_quantity), 0) AS total_sold_qty, COALESCE(AVG(l.l_extendedprice), 0) AS avg_selling_price FROM part p LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice) pd ON sa.ps_partkey = pd.p_partkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON pd.p_brand = n.n_name LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON pd.p_name = ro.o_orderstatus WHERE sa.total_avail_qty > 0 GROUP BY r.r_name, pd.p_name, pd.total_sold_qty, pd.avg_selling_price, sa.total_avail_qty) f WHERE f.total_sold_qty > 100 ORDER BY f.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_available, os.total_amount, os.customer_count, CASE WHEN ts.avg_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'No Data' WHEN ts.avg_supply_cost > 100 THEN 'High Cost' ELSE 'Normal Cost' END AS cost_category FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_available, ss.avg_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_available DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%') LIMIT 1) WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_available DESC, os.total_amount DESC;

SELECT rp.r_name, rp.supplier_count, rp.total_supply_cost_region, rp.avg_customer_spending, COALESCE(sp.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders_supplier, COALESCE(sp.total_available_quantity, 0) AS total_available_quantity, COALESCE(sp.avg_order_value, 0) AS avg_order_value_supplier FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_region, AVG(cp.total_spent) AS avg_customer_spending FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp ON n.n_nationkey = cp.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 0 AND AVG(cp.total_spent) IS NOT NULL) rp LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON sp.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = rp.n_regionkey) ORDER BY rp.total_supply_cost_region DESC, rp.avg_customer_spending DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.s_acctbal, t.total_sales, t.supplier_rank, COALESCE(r.r_name, 'Unknown') AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) t LEFT JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = t.s_suppkey LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE t.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.lineitem_count, o.total_value, s.supplier_name, (CASE WHEN o.lineitem_count IS NULL THEN 'No Line Items' ELSE 'Has Line Items' END) AS LineItem_Status, ci.c_name AS customer_name, ci.nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey) o LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) s ON o.o_orderkey = s.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS ranking FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) ci ON ci.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 AND (o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND cast('1998-10-01' as date)) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.supplier_count, ss.avg_supply_cost, od.total_revenue, nv.n_name, nv.total_quantity FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON p.p_partkey = ss.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON od.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) IS NOT NULL) nv ON nv.n_nationkey = ( SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.p_retailprice IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, p.p_partkey LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, s.supplier_count, COALESCE(c.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(c.order_count, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(p.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN c.order_count > 0 THEN 'High Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS customer_value_level FROM (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n_regionkey ORDER BY n_nationkey) AS region_row FROM nation) n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_orders, order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) WHERE total_orders > (SELECT AVG(total_orders) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) c ON c.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) p ON p.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = s.supplier_count LIMIT 1) WHERE n.region_row = 1 ORDER BY n.n_name, s.supplier_count DESC;
