SELECT p.p_name, ps.total_available, ps.total_supply_cost, COALESCE(s.suppliers_count, 0) AS suppliers_count, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.l_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS suppliers_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) s ON p.p_partkey = s.l_partkey INNER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31') o ON o.o_orderkey = ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 100.00 AND 200.00 AND p.p_size IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ps.total_supply_cost DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, cs.avg_order_value, COALESCE(rk.s_name, 'No Suppliers') AS top_supplier, tls.total_quantity, tls.total_lines FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rk ON n.n_nationkey = rk.s_nationkey AND rk.rank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_lines FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) tls ON cs.c_custkey = tls.l_orderkey WHERE cs.avg_order_value > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus = 'O') AND r.r_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_spent DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT coalesce(hvs.s_name, 'Unknown Supplier') AS supplier_name, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM lineitem AS lo LEFT JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders AS o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') AS ro WHERE ro.rn = 1) AS ro ON lo.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN partsupp AS ps ON lo.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) AS sd WHERE sd.total_supply_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails )) AS hvs ON ps.ps_suppkey = hvs.s_suppkey WHERE lo.l_shipdate > cast('1998-10-01' as date) - interval '30 days' AND (lo.l_returnflag = 'R' OR lo.l_linestatus = 'F') GROUP BY hvs.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COALESCE(ss.total_parts, 0) AS supplier_parts_count, COALESCE(co.avg_order_value, 0) AS customer_avg_order_value, tn.total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'United States') LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON tn.n_name = 'United States' WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, ss.total_parts, co.avg_order_value, tn.total_revenue ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(MAX(rs.s_name), 'No Supplier') AS top_supplier, COALESCE(SUM(tr.region_sales), 0) AS total_region_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.total_price) AS region_sales FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_lines FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) o ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = (SELECT o2.o_custkey FROM orders o2 WHERE o2.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey)) WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, r.r_name) tr LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs ON tr.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey FULL OUTER JOIN region r ON tr.n_nationkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rnk = 1 OR rs.rnk IS NULL GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_region_sales DESC;

SELECT tc.r_name, s.p_name, s.total_available, od.revenue, od.item_count, ro.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT r.r_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, c.c_nationkey) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name) s ON tc.c_nationkey = s.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) od ON s.ps_partkey = od.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro ON ro.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey WHERE tc.order_count > 5 AND (s.total_available IS NULL OR s.total_available > 100) ORDER BY tc.r_name, od.revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, COALESCE(SUM(sp.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(cs.total_spent) AS avg_spent, CASE WHEN AVG(cs.total_spent) > (SELECT avg_revenue FROM (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as OrderDetails) as AvgRevenue) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS spending_category FROM nation ns LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY part_count DESC, avg_spent DESC;

SELECT NF.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(SD.s_name, 'No Suppliers') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(CUST.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, COALESCE(CUST.order_count, 0) AS order_count, SUM(LI.l_extendedprice * (1 - LI.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation NF LEFT JOIN supplier S ON NF.n_nationkey = S.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, tp.total_available FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) rs JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) tp ON rs.s_suppkey = tp.ps_partkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank = 1) SD ON S.s_suppkey = SD.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem LI ON SD.s_suppkey = LI.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust.c_custkey, cust.order_count, cust.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cust WHERE cust.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) as CustomerOrders)) CUST ON CUST.c_custkey = LI.l_orderkey WHERE LI.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND (SD.s_acctbal IS NULL OR SD.s_acctbal > 100.00) GROUP BY NF.n_name, SD.s_name, CUST.total_spent, CUST.order_count ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ld.total_revenue, fs.s_name AS supplier_name, fs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ld ON o.o_orderkey = ld.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd WHERE sd.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails )) fs ON fs.total_supply_cost > o.o_totalprice JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL) c ON c.customer_rank <= 10 WHERE o.order_rank <= 5 OR o.o_orderstatus = 'F' ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, c.c_name ASC;

SELECT ad.nation, ad.region, ad.customer_count, ad.total_net_revenue, CASE WHEN ad.total_net_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No Revenue' WHEN ad.total_net_revenue < 1000000 THEN 'Low Revenue' ELSE 'High Revenue' END AS revenue_category, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_rank) FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank = 1) AS top_supplier_count FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(co.net_revenue) AS total_net_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) ad ORDER BY ad.total_net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.c_name, f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, f.o_totalprice, f.p_name, f.total_supply_value, f.high_value_supplier FROM (SELECT co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, hvs.p_name, hvs.total_supply_value, CASE WHEN hvs.p_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS high_value_supplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_returns FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.rn = 1 AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvs ON co.o_orderkey = hvs.ps_partkey) f WHERE f.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_returns FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.rn = 1 AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) WHERE o_totalprice IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY f.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, COALESCE(po.total_spent, 0) AS customer_total_spent, ps.total_available AS supplier_total_available, ps.average_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS number_of_sales, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_sale_price FROM part p LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) po ON po.c_custkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 ) WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND (p.p_container LIKE 'SMALL%' OR ps.average_cost IS NULL) GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, po.total_spent, ps.total_available, ps.average_cost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY customer_total_spent DESC, number_of_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.total_sales, sd.s_name, sd.total_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE total_sales > 10000) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sd.total_cost = ( SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE total_cost < (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails) ) WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(t.total_cost, 0) AS total_supplier_cost, cr.rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) t ON c.c_custkey = ( SELECT cs.c_custkey FROM customer cs JOIN orders o ON cs.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_partkey = t.ps_partkey LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ro.order_total) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON c.c_custkey = cr.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2) ORDER BY cr.rank, c.c_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(MAX(ss.total_avail_qty), 0) AS max_avail_qty, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_spent), 0) AS total_spent_by_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) > 0 THEN AVG(co.total_spent) ELSE NULL END AS avg_spent_per_customer FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY n.n_name;

SELECT p.p_name, COALESCE(r.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, cp.order_count, cp.total_spent, sp.total_value, sp.returned_value FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) r ON p.p_partkey = r.p_partkey AND r.rank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cp ON cp.c_custkey = (SELECT MIN(c.c_custkey) FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING') LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS returned_value, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, s.s_nationkey FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_nationkey) sp ON sp.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE') WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2) AND p.p_container IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.p_name ASC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, COALESCE(sp.total_available, 0) AS available_parts, ss.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(SUM(ps.ps_availqty), 0) AS total_available FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) ss ON ss.rank = 1 WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, ss.s_name, sp.total_available ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(ls.total_lineitem_value, 0)), 2) AS total_value, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(cs.avg_account_balance, 0)), 2) AS avg_customer_balance, SUM(s.total_parts) AS total_parts_provided, MAX(co.o_orderdate) AS latest_order_date FROM region AS r JOIN nation AS ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) AS cs ON ns.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) AS s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_ranking FROM orders AS o) AS co ON co.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value, COUNT(*) AS total_items, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM lineitem AS l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) AS ls ON co.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name HAVING AVG(COALESCE(cs.avg_account_balance, 0)) > 500 AND COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT cr.region_name, ts.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 10) ts LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cr ON o.o_custkey = cr.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY cr.region_name, ts.s_name ORDER BY cr.region_name, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ns.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.total_supply_value) AS avg_supply_value FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100) LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.l_shipmode, ', ') AS ship_modes FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.c_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' ) WHERE ns.n_comment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ns.n_nationkey) > 1 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT cr.region_name, cr.nation_name, SUM(ls.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, MIN(lo.o_totalprice) AS min_order_price, MAX(lo.o_totalprice) AS max_order_price, SUM(sc.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) cr LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') lo ON cr.c_custkey = lo.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ls.l_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sc ON sc.ps_partkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY cr.region_name, cr.nation_name HAVING SUM(ls.total_revenue) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, cr.region_name ASC;

SELECT coalesce(n.n_name, 'Unknown') AS nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, MAX(hi.total_line_item_value) AS max_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c) cu ON cu.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_item_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) hi ON hi.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000 AND COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, avg_supplier_acctbal ASC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(os.total_sales) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS complete_order_count, COALESCE(MAX(ts.s_acctbal), 0) AS top_supplier_acctbal, AVG(COALESCE(ts.s_acctbal, 0)) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) s WHERE rank = 1) ts ON c.c_nationkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus <> 'L' GROUP BY c.c_name HAVING SUM(os.total_sales) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, hvo.total_order_value, hvo.total_items FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.total_order_value, od.total_items FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od WHERE od.total_order_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as OrderDetails )) hvo ON hvo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE ss.total_avail_qty IS NOT NULL AND (hvo.total_order_value IS NULL OR hvo.total_order_value > 1000) ORDER BY n.n_name, ss.avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_revenue, t.order_count, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sd.total_revenue, sd.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd JOIN supplier s ON sd.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sd.rn <= 5) WHERE total_revenue < t.total_revenue), 0) AS avg_lower_revenue, CASE WHEN t.order_count > 10 THEN 'High' WHEN t.order_count BETWEEN 5 AND 10 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS order_category FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sd.total_revenue, sd.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd JOIN supplier s ON sd.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sd.rn <= 5) t LEFT JOIN region r ON t.s_suppkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL OR t.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, AVG(os.order_value) AS average_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN co.total_spent IS NOT NULL THEN co.total_spent ELSE 0 END) AS total_spent_by_customers FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_orderkey = co.order_count WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT cr.c_name, cr.r_name, COALESCE(ss.total_available, 0) AS total_supplier_avail, COALESCE(os.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, os.line_count, cr.total_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) cr LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cr.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND ss.total_available > 1000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON cr.c_custkey = os.o_custkey AND os.revenue_rank = 1 WHERE cr.total_orders > 1000 OR ss.avg_supply_cost < 500 ORDER BY cr.r_name, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ps.p_partkey, ps.p_name, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supply_cost, COALESCE(r.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(hc.c_name, 'No High-Value Customer') AS customer_name, CASE WHEN ps.avg_supply_cost > 100 THEN 'Expensive' WHEN ps.avg_supply_cost BETWEEN 50 AND 100 THEN 'Moderate' ELSE 'Cheap' END AS cost_category FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL) r ON ps.p_partkey = r.s_suppkey AND r.rnk = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 50000) hc ON r.s_suppkey = hc.c_custkey WHERE ps.total_available < (SELECT AVG(total_available) FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) as PartSupplierDetails) ORDER BY ps.p_partkey;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, co.avg_order_value, si.total_available, si.total_supply_cost, jj.total_lineitem_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') r INNER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON r.o_orderkey = co.c_custkey FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) si ON si.ps_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice), 0) AS total_lineitem_price FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) jj ON jj.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank_order <= 10 AND r.o_orderstatus IN ('F', 'P') ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_revenue, p.p_retailprice, CASE WHEN ts.total_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No Sales' ELSE 'Sold' END AS sales_status FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(ts.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(ts.total_revenue, 0) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0) s ON s.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = ts.p_partkey ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN part p ON ts.p_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ts.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(sa.total_avail_qty, 0) AS available_quantity, ra.o_orderdate, ra.o_shippriority FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) as supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sa ON p.p_partkey = sa.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_shippriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_shippriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ra ON l.l_orderkey = ra.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2 WHERE c2.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL )) hvc ON l.l_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1 ) WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY p.p_name, ra.o_orderdate, ra.o_shippriority, sa.total_avail_qty HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, ra.o_shippriority;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, COALESCE(AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS avg_discounted_price, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS fulfilled_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND lo.rn = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_open_orders FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_receiptdate DESC) AS rk FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_discount < 0.05) l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s_cost ON p.p_partkey = s_cost.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s_cost.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus IN ('O', 'F')) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l_orderkey ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey ) lo ON l.l_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) > 100 ORDER BY avg_discounted_price DESC;

SELECT n.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(rs.total_price) AS avg_order_value, SUM(su.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rs LEFT JOIN orders o ON rs.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey) su ON c.c_nationkey = su.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND (su.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL OR rs.total_price > 1000) GROUP BY n.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, avg_order_value ASC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(noc.order_count, 0) AS total_orders, ss.s_name, ss.part_count, ss.total_cost FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) noc ON n.n_name = noc.n_name JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50 ) ) ORDER BY total_orders DESC, ss.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.avg_supply_cost, hvs.s_name AS high_value_supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON sp.ps_partkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT hvs.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem lp JOIN supplier s ON lp.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) > 100000) hvs) ORDER BY ps.ps_availqty DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem lp JOIN supplier s ON lp.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) > 100000) hvs ON hvs.s_suppkey = ( SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem lp JOIN supplier s ON lp.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) > 100000) s ORDER BY s.total_value DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ro.order_rank = 1 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.total_available, ss.total_parts, ss.avg_supply_cost, tc.c_name AS top_customer_name, tc.total_spent AS top_customer_spent, lcd.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_orders, c.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' OR o.o_orderstatus IS NULL GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent IS NOT NULL) tc ON ss.total_parts > 1 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lcd ON lcd.l_orderkey = (SELECT MAX(l_orderkey) FROM lineitem) WHERE ss.avg_supply_cost > 500.00 ORDER BY ss.total_available DESC, tc.total_spent DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.s_name AS supp_name, r.total_sales, COALESCE(c.total_spent, 0) AS customer_spending, c.order_count AS customer_order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) IS NOT NULL) c ON r.order_count = c.order_count WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC, customer_spending DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, COALESCE(SUM(DISTINCT li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON li.l_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND c.c_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY c.c_name, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.avg_order_value HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, COALESCE(c.OrderCount, 0) AS CustomerOrders, CASE WHEN ts.SupplierRank <= 5 THEN 'Top Supplier' ELSE 'Other Supplier' END AS SupplierCategory FROM (SELECT sr.s_suppkey, sr.s_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sr.TotalRevenue DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) c ON ts.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ts.s_name LIKE 'Supplier%' ORDER BY ts.SupplierRank, ts.s_suppkey;

SELECT p.p_name, pa.total_revenue AS part_revenue, cs.total_spent AS customer_spending, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.s_acctbal AS supplier_balance FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) pa ON p.p_partkey = pa.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey )) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rank <= 3 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' OR o.o_orderstatus IS NULL GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.order_count > 0 WHERE p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 10 AND 100 AND (pa.order_count IS NOT NULL OR cs.order_count IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY part_revenue DESC, customer_spending DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.total_available) AS avg_available_qty, cs.customer_count, cs.total_acct_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acct_balance FROM customer c GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, cs.customer_count, cs.total_acct_balance HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT s.region_name, COALESCE(SUM(h.total_spent), 0) AS high_value_customers_total, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_sales), 0) AS regional_sales_total, COUNT(DISTINCT d.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT d.item_rank) AS unique_items_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) s FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) h ON s.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = h.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_discount, l.l_extendedprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_linenumber) AS item_rank FROM lineitem l) d ON d.l_orderkey = h.c_custkey GROUP BY s.region_name ORDER BY s.region_name;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, ts.part_count, os.revenue, os.item_count FROM (SELECT s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_cost > 10000) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON ts.rank = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_cost > 10000) ts2 WHERE ts2.total_cost > ts.total_cost) + 1 WHERE ts.part_count > 5 ORDER BY ts.rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_name, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, r.r_name AS region, COALESCE(AVG(dp.total_lineitem_value), 0) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, MAX(sp.s_acctbal) AS highest_supplier_balance FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier sp ON ps.ps_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON sp.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) dp ON dp.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o) o ON o.o_orderkey = dp.o_orderkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND sp.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) AND r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.p_name, sp.s_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 OR MAX(sp.s_acctbal) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.p_name, total_orders DESC;

SELECT RD.o_orderkey, RD.o_orderdate, RD.o_totalprice, RD.c_mktsegment, PD.p_name, PD.p_brand, PD.total_supplycost, (CASE WHEN PD.p_retailprice IS NULL THEN 'No Retail Price' ELSE CONCAT('Price: $', CAST(PD.p_retailprice AS varchar)) END) AS retail_price_info FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') RD FULL OUTER JOIN lineitem l ON RD.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(SA.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) SA ON p.p_partkey = SA.ps_partkey) PD ON l.l_partkey = PD.p_partkey WHERE RD.rn <= 5 AND (PD.total_supplycost > 1000 OR (PD.total_supplycost IS NULL AND l.l_discount > 0)) ORDER BY RD.o_orderdate DESC, PD.p_name;

SELECT f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, f.c_name, COALESCE(f.p_name, 'No High Value Part') AS part_name, COALESCE(f.p_retailprice, 0) AS retail_price FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, hvp.p_name, hvp.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.supplier_count, ps.total_supplycost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p_retailprice) FROM part) OR ps.total_supplycost > 1000) hvp ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = hvp.p_partkey ) WHERE ro.rn <= 5) f ORDER BY f.o_orderdate DESC, f.c_name;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.customer_count, ns.average_acctbal, ns.total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.order_rank <= 5 THEN ro.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS top_order_total FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_acctbal, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31') ro ON ns.customer_count > 0 GROUP BY ns.n_name, ns.customer_count, ns.average_acctbal, ns.total_quantity ORDER BY ns.average_acctbal DESC, ns.customer_count DESC;

SELECT rs.* FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.TotalSupplyCost, cs.TotalOrderValue, cs.LastOrderDate, rn.RegionName, rn.NationName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rn.RegionName ORDER BY ss.TotalSupplyCost DESC) AS Rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(p.p_partkey) AS TotalParts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS LastOrderDate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 100 GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON ss.TotalParts > 0 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, n.n_nationkey, r.r_name AS RegionName, n.n_name AS NationName FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rn ON ss.s_suppkey = cs.TotalOrders ) AS rs WHERE rs.LastOrderDate > cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND (rs.TotalSupplyCost IS NOT NULL OR rs.TotalOrderValue IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY rs.RegionName, Rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count, CASE WHEN ts.total_sales IS NULL THEN 'No Sales' ELSE 'Sales Made' END AS sales_status, COALESCE(REPLACE(ts.nation_name, ' ', '_'), 'Unknown') AS formatted_nation FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, TRIM(n.n_name) AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.sales_rank <= 5) ts ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rr.r_name, rr.total_region_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rr.total_region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank, CASE WHEN rr.total_region_revenue IS NULL THEN 'No Revenue' ELSE 'Revenue Generated' END AS revenue_status FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos JOIN supplier s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rr WHERE rr.total_region_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_region_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos JOIN supplier s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) as RegionRevenue) UNION ALL SELECT 'Total' AS r_name, SUM(total_region_revenue) AS total_region_revenue, NULL AS revenue_rank, 'Total Revenue' AS revenue_status FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos JOIN supplier s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) ORDER BY total_region_revenue DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, s.avg_supplycost, SUM(ld.l_extendedprice * (1 - ld.discount)) AS total_lineitem_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000.00) cs ON cs.total_orders > 2 LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.ps_suppkey = ANY(( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey )) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, COALESCE(l.l_discount, 0) AS discount FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-07-01') ld ON ld.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey WHERE r.rnk = 1 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, s.avg_supplycost ORDER BY total_spent DESC, r.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, CASE WHEN tc.total_customer_spend IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE tc.total_customer_spend END AS total_customer_spend, CASE WHEN ts.total_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'Low Supply' ELSE 'High Supply' END AS supply_status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_order_value), 0) AS total_customer_spend, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(co.total_order_value), 0) DESC) as customer_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_supply_cost DESC) as supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) sd ON s.s_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE sd.total_supply_cost > 10000) ts ON tc.customer_rank = ts.supplier_rank WHERE (tc.total_customer_spend > 5000 OR ts.total_supply_cost > 20000) ORDER BY total_customer_spend DESC NULLS LAST, supply_status;

SELECT pb.c_name, pb.c_acctbal, pb.supplier_part_count, pb.supplier_supply_value, pb.revenue_category FROM (SELECT tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, COALESCE(sd.part_count, 0) AS supplier_part_count, COALESCE(sd.supply_value, 0) AS supplier_supply_value, CASE WHEN tc.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN tc.total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, r.r_name, o.total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.rn = 1) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON tc.c_custkey = sd.s_suppkey) pb WHERE pb.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pb.supplier_supply_value DESC, pb.c_acctbal DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.order_count, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) as TopRegions), 0) AS avg_sales, CASE WHEN tr.total_sales > COALESCE((SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) as TopRegions), 0) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS sales_performance FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) tr ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COALESCE(AVG(cs.total_revenue), 0) AS avg_revenue, MAX(ns.avg_supplycost) AS max_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, sd.s_name, sd.avg_supplycost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) cs ON ns.s_name = cs.c_name WHERE ns.avg_supplycost > (SELECT AVG(avg_supplycost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierDetails) GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY avg_revenue DESC, max_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, MAX(rn) AS highest_priority_order, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2)) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_name, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supply_cost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 AND ps.total_available < 50 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.total_sales, (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) as SalesRanks) AS avg_sales, CASE WHEN t.total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) as SalesRanks) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS sales_performance, COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'BrandX'))), 0) AS orders_for_brand_x FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) t ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.cumulative_sales, CASE WHEN tr.total_sales >= 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN tr.total_sales >= 50000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, cumulative_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY region_name) AS cumulative_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE total_sales > ( SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, SUM(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY region_name) AS cumulative_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) as CumulativeSales )) tr LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c_nationkey, c_acctbal, c_mktsegment FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND c_mktsegment IS NOT NULL) AS cust ON cust.c_nationkey = ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'USA' LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC, tr.region_name;

SELECT td.o_orderkey, td.o_totalprice, td.net_revenue, td.order_status, ts.r_name, ts.n_name, ts.supplier_count, ts.total_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, o.o_orderdate, CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN 'Finalized' ELSE 'Pending' END AS order_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) td LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank, p.p_partkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name) ts ON td.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000)) WHERE td.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY td.o_orderdate DESC, ts.total_acctbal DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_supply_by_nation, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COALESCE(SUM(ss.total_supply_value), 0) AS total_supply_by_nation FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acct_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE (ns.total_supply_by_nation > 500000 OR co.total_spent IS NULL) AND (co.spending_rank IS NULL OR co.spending_rank <= 5) ORDER BY ns.n_name, co.total_spent DESC NULLS LAST;
