SELECT cs.c_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_spent, ss.s_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, lid.unique_parts, lid.total_price, lid.total_discount, lid.total_tax FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON (ss.part_count > 5 AND ss.total_available_qty IS NOT NULL) LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_price, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discount, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lid ON lid.l_orderkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE cs.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) WHERE order_count > 2) ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ss.avg_supply_cost ASC OFFSET 10 ROWS FETCH NEXT 5 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(ca.c_acctbal) FROM customer ca WHERE ca.c_mktsegment = c.c_mktsegment)) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 AND (l.l_discount > 0.05 OR l.l_returnflag = 'N') GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_quantity ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, p.p_name, p.total_quantity_sold, osc.total_spent AS customer_spending, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_quantity), 0) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) osc ON osc.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_totalprice > 1000) ro ON ro.o_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = osc.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate LIMIT 1) WHERE ps.avg_supply_cost IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, s.s_name, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, p.p_name, p.total_quantity_sold, osc.total_spent HAVING SUM(ps.total_avail_qty) > 100 ORDER BY region, nation, supplier_name;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, os.o_orderkey AS order_number, os.total_order_value, os.item_count, CASE WHEN os.item_count > 5 THEN 'Bulk Order' WHEN os.item_count IS NULL THEN 'No Items' ELSE 'Regular Order' END AS order_type, COALESCE(n.n_name, 'Unknown') AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.parts_supplied, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_cost > 10000) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, os.o_orderkey;

SELECT h.order_value, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, ss.total_acctbal, ss.total_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) h JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank, COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) AS suppliers_count FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice) rp ON rp.price_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM supplier s GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON ss.s_nationkey = ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1 ) ) WHERE h.order_value > 1000 ORDER BY h.order_value DESC, rp.p_retailprice ASC LIMIT 50

SELECT r.r_name, r.r_comment, COALESCE(SUM(tpsc.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_part_cost, COALESCE(SUM(cus.order_count), 0) AS total_orders_by_customers, COALESCE(SUM(ols.total_value), 0) AS total_line_item_value, SUM(rs.total_orders) AS total_orders_in_region, AVG(rs.avg_customer_balance) AS avg_balance_in_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) tpsc ON tpsc.ps_partkey = ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50 ORDER BY p.p_partkey FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cus ON cus.c_custkey = ( SELECT MIN(c.c_custkey) FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'AUTOMOBILE' ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ols ON ols.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' ) GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_comment ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.s_name) AS high_cost_supplier_count, SUM(COALESCE(h.total_cost, 0)) AS total_expenditure, AVG(h.total_cost) AS avg_expenditure_per_supplier FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, ss.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierStats )) h ON n.n_nationkey = h.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT h.s_name) > 0 ORDER BY total_expenditure DESC;

SELECT tc.s_name, hvc.c_name, os.total_order_value, os.total_items, CASE WHEN os.total_order_value > 5000 THEN 'High Value Order' ELSE 'Regular Order' END AS order_type, CASE WHEN os.total_items IS NULL THEN 'No Items' ELSE CAST(os.total_items AS VARCHAR) END AS item_count FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_available_qty, sp.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sp WHERE sp.rank_within_nation <= 3) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS ranking FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) hvc ON tc.s_suppkey = hvc.c_custkey FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_items, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON hvc.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE (tc.total_available_qty > 100 OR hvc.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY tc.total_available_qty DESC, hvc.c_acctbal DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.total_price AS order_total_price, fr.item_count, COALESCE(fr.return_count, 0) AS order_return_count, COALESCE(fr.supplier_name, 'Unknown Supplier') AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, oi.total_price, oi.item_count, oi.return_count, hs.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(*) AS item_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 END) AS return_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) oi ON ro.o_orderkey = oi.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.s_suppkey, si.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) si WHERE si.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) as SupplierInfo)) hs ON hs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey ) ) WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) fr ORDER BY fr.o_orderdate DESC, fr.total_price DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, p.p_name AS product_name, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN co.total_orders > 0 THEN co.total_spent / co.total_orders ELSE NULL END AS avg_spent_per_order, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN nation n ON co.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice) p ON co.c_custkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON p.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE (co.total_orders IS NULL OR co.total_orders > 5) ORDER BY avg_spent_per_order DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(cd.total_order_value, 0) AS total_order_value, COALESCE(sd.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supplier_cost, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cd.total_order_value, 0) > COALESCE(sd.total_supply_cost, 0) THEN 'High Demand' ELSE 'Low Demand' END AS demand_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY COALESCE(cd.total_order_value, 0) DESC) AS rank FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, cd.total_order_value, cd.c_custkey FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cd ON n.n_nationkey = cd.c_custkey) AS cd ON r.r_regionkey = cd.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_supplycost) AS num_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) sd JOIN supplier s ON sd.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) AS sd ON r.r_regionkey = sd.s_nationkey WHERE (cd.total_order_value IS NOT NULL OR sd.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY r.r_name, rank;

SELECT cu.c_name, su.s_name, su.region_name, co.total_revenue, s.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN co.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY co.c_custkey ORDER BY co.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co) co JOIN customer cu ON co.c_custkey = cu.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name) s) s ON s.cost_rank = 1 JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name) su ON s.s_suppkey = su.s_suppkey WHERE s.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL AND co.revenue_rank = 1 ORDER BY co.total_revenue DESC, su.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.total_orders, o.total_spent, COALESCE(hs.s_name, 'No Supply') AS supplier_name, hs.total_available AS supplier_available, hs.part_count AS unique_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) o LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.c_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_available, ss.part_count, ss.avg_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.avg_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(avg_acctbal) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats)) hs ON hs.total_available > o.total_spent WHERE o.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY o.total_spent DESC, hs.part_count DESC;

SELECT ns.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, ls.unique_parts_count, ls.total_revenue, nr.region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ns FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON ns.s_suppkey = cs.c_custkey FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON cs.total_orders > 0 AND ls.l_orderkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON ns.s_suppkey IS NOT NULL AND nr.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE (ns.total_available_qty IS NULL OR ns.avg_supply_cost > 100.00) OR (cs.total_orders > 5 AND ls.total_revenue > 5000.00) ORDER BY supplier_name, region_name DESC;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.part_count, COALESCE(os.total_order_value, 0) AS total_order_value, COALESCE(os.order_count, 0) AS order_count FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.part_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON rs.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey WHERE rs.part_count > 5 AND rs.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats) OR os.order_count < 2 ORDER BY rs.cost_rank, total_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_cost, co.total_spent, co.order_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE co.order_count > 5 AND ss.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.r_name, ss.total_cost DESC;

SELECT cp.c_name AS customer_name, cp.o_orderkey AS order_id, rp.p_name AS part_name, sd.nation_name AS supplier_nation, rp.total_available_quantity, sd.part_count, CASE WHEN rp.total_available_quantity IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE 'Available' END AS availability_status FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') cp LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON cp.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_brand FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp ON l.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey AND rp.rank_within_brand <= 5 LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sd ON l.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE cp.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY cp.o_orderkey, rp.p_name;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, tc.order_count, ss.s_name AS top_supplier, ss.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cos.total_spent, cos.order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cos.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(od.total_order_value) AS total_spent, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos JOIN customer c ON cos.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE cos.total_spent IS NOT NULL) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.total_supply_value = (SELECT MAX(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as supplier_summary) WHERE tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, AVG(ro.total_sales) AS avg_order_value FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lines.total_sales) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) AS lines ON o.o_orderkey = lines.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lines.total_sales) > 1000) tc ON c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 100) sp ON sp.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size >= 10 LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro ON tc.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE n.n_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY unique_customers DESC, total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(COALESCE(cd.total_revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue_by_region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS top_suppliers FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal IS NOT NULL) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) cd ON s.s_suppkey = cd.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey -- Added join to link customer correctly WHERE r.r_comment LIKE '%excellent%' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_by_region DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) AS HighValueCustomerCount, AVG(hvc.TotalOrderValue) AS AvgOrderValue, SUM(hvc.TotalDiscount) AS TotalDiscountGiven, ss.s_name AS SupplierName, MAX(rs.TotalSupplyCost) AS MaxSupplierCost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.TotalOrderValue, c.TotalDiscount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_discount * l.l_extendedprice), 0) AS TotalDiscount FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.TotalOrderValue > 100000 AND c.TotalDiscount <= 5000) hvc JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rn ON hvc.c_custkey = 1 OR rn.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = hvc.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplyRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON rs.SupplyRank <= 5 LEFT JOIN supplier ss ON ss.s_nationkey = rn.n_nationkey GROUP BY rn.r_name, ss.s_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) > 0 ORDER BY AvgOrderValue DESC, TotalDiscountGiven;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.total_sales, COALESCE(ac.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, CASE WHEN ac.total_spent IS NULL THEN 'No purchases' ELSE 'Active customer' END AS customer_status, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS recent_order_count FROM (SELECT s_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_name) as SupplierSales) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 YEAR' GROUP BY c.c_name) ac ON ac.total_spent > 1000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, CURRENT_DATE - o.o_orderdate AS days_since_order FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 MONTH') ro ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = ac.c_name ) ) GROUP BY rs.s_name, rs.total_sales, ac.total_spent, rs.sales_rank ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT co.c_name, SUM(l.total_quantity) AS order_quantity, SUM(l.max_price) AS total_value, s.s_name AS supplier_name, CASE WHEN co.total_orders IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE CAST(co.total_orders AS VARCHAR) END AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY co.c_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.max_price) DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_discount) AS avg_discount, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_price FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00)) LEFT JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE n.n_name LIKE 'A%' GROUP BY co.c_name, s.s_name, co.total_orders, co.c_custkey HAVING SUM(l.max_price) > 5000 ORDER BY order_quantity DESC, rn;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS suppliers_count, AVG(rs.total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING AVG(rs.total_sales) > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE total_sales IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY suppliers_count DESC;

SELECT r.RegionName, r.CustomerCount, p.p_name, p.Revenue, s.s_name, s.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS RegionName, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS CustomerCount FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'Europe' GROUP BY n.n_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) p ON p.Revenue > 1000 INNER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON s.TotalSupplyCost > (SELECT AVG(TotalSupplyCost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails) WHERE r.CustomerCount > 10 ORDER BY r.CustomerCount DESC, p.Revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT R.rn, R.o_orderkey, R.o_totalprice, T.c_name, COALESCE(H.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales_june, CASE WHEN T.total_spent IS NULL THEN 'New Customer' ELSE 'Returning Customer' END AS customer_status FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') R LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-06-01' AND DATE '1997-06-30' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) H ON R.o_orderkey = H.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000) T ON R.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = T.c_custkey) WHERE R.rn <= 10 ORDER BY R.o_totalprice DESC, T.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, COALESCE(SUM(rlo.total_revenue), 0) AS revenue, SUM(ss.total_available) AS total_available_parts, AVG(ss.avg_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT li.l_orderkey FROM lineitem li WHERE li.l_returnflag = 'R') LEFT JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem li WHERE li.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) rlo ON rlo.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING COALESCE(SUM(rlo.total_revenue), 0) > 0 OR AVG(ro.o_totalprice) > 100 ORDER BY revenue DESC, average_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, t.total_spent, o.order_count, CASE WHEN o.order_count > 5 THEN 'Frequent' WHEN o.order_count BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'Occasional' ELSE 'Rare' END AS customer_type FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) t ON t.c_custkey = r.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND o.o_orderdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 YEAR' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) o ON o.c_custkey = r.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank = 1 AND t.total_spent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.total_spent DESC NULLS LAST FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT cr.c_name, cr.total_spent, COALESCE(rs.total_avail_qty, 0) AS total_avail_qty, CASE WHEN cr.customer_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top Customer' ELSE 'Regular Customer' END AS customer_type FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.num_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey) cr LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON cr.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE cr.num_orders > 5 ORDER BY cr.total_spent DESC

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_suppliers, ns.total_supply_value, cs.c_name AS top_customer, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ss.total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_by_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, co.total_orders, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_by_spending FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) cs ON ns.n_name = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey ) WHERE ns.total_suppliers > 0 ORDER BY ns.total_supply_value DESC, cs.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT R.o_orderkey, R.o_orderdate, R.o_totalprice, P.p_name, P.total_supplycost, O.c_name, O.discount_value, (CASE WHEN O.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 'Returned' ELSE 'Not Returned' END) AS return_status FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o_orderdate ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate > '1996-01-01') R LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, pt.total_supplycost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey) pt ON p.p_partkey = pt.ps_partkey WHERE pt.total_supplycost > 1000.00) P ON R.o_orderkey = P.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_totalprice, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, (l.l_discount * l.l_extendedprice) AS discount_value, l.l_returnflag, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_linenumber) AS order_line FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') O ON R.o_orderkey = O.o_orderkey WHERE R.price_rank = 1 AND (R.o_totalprice > 500.00 OR O.discount_value > 100.00) ORDER BY R.o_orderdate DESC, R.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(s.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost, COALESCE(hu.total_spent, 0) AS top_customer_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) s ON p.p_partkey = s.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000) hu ON hu.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p.p_mfgr LIKE 'Manufacturer%' AND (s.total_supplycost IS NULL OR s.total_supplycost > 5000) ORDER BY p.p_type, p.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT co.c_name, COALESCE(rs.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(co.order_count, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, rs.rank_within_nation FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT sd.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.s_nationkey ORDER BY sd.total_supplycost DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sd) rs ON co.c_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE (co.total_spent > 10000 OR rs.total_supplycost IS NULL) AND co.c_custkey IS NOT NULL AND rs.rank_within_nation <= 5 ORDER BY co.c_name, rank_within_nation DESC;

SELECT o.OrderRank, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, sp.p_name, sp.s_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.Availability, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS TotalLineItemValue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank, c.c_name, n.n_name AS NationName FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, CASE WHEN ps.ps_availqty IS NULL THEN 'Unavailable' ELSE 'Available' END AS Availability FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp)) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE o.OrderRank <= 5 GROUP BY o.OrderRank, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, sp.p_name, sp.s_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.Availability ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT p.p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(s.total_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price, CASE WHEN AVG(o.o_totalprice) IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Orders Exist' END AS order_status, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON p.p_partkey = s.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN supplier sp ON s.ps_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON sp.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_after_discount FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) d ON l.l_orderkey = d.l_orderkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND (s.total_quantity IS NULL OR s.total_quantity >= 100) GROUP BY p.p_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT d.l_orderkey) > 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 0 ORDER BY region_name, total_orders DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue, rs.s_name, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN rs.total_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'Not Applicable' ELSE CONCAT('Total Supply Cost: $', CAST(ROUND(rs.total_supply_cost, 2) AS VARCHAR)) END AS supply_cost_info, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey AND l.l_linestatus = 'O') AS open_line_items, COALESCE(n.n_name, 'Unknown Nation') AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_avail_qty DESC) AS rank_based_on_availability FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) rs ON os.o_orderkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) LEFT JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE os.total_revenue > 1000 AND (rs.total_avail_qty IS NULL OR rs.total_avail_qty >= 500) ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, rs.rank_based_on_availability ASC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(SUM(ss.total_supplycost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(od.revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(cn.total_acctbal), 0) AS total_account_balance FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.l_partkey) AS line_count FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM customer c GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cn ON n.n_nationkey = cn.c_nationkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_sales, cs.order_count, CASE WHEN cs.total_sales >= 10000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN cs.total_sales >= 5000 THEN 'Gold' ELSE 'Silver' END AS customer_tier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(os.total_sales), 0) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_custkey) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs WHERE cs.order_count > ( SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS temp ) ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(r.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(ro.total_sales) AS avg_order_value, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) > 0 THEN SUM(r.total_supply_cost) / COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) ELSE NULL END AS cost_per_order FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nr.r_regionkey ORDER BY od.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, nr.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od JOIN customer c ON od.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON c.c_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey) ro RIGHT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) r ON ro.nation_name = CAST(r.s_suppkey AS VARCHAR) JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) n ON ro.nation_name = n.n_name GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(r.total_supply_cost) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, COALESCE(co.order_count, 0) AS order_count, spm.total_available_quantity, spm.avg_supply_cost, ord.total_revenue, ord.line_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) spm ON co.c_custkey = spm.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ord ON co.c_custkey = ord.o_orderkey WHERE COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) > 1000 OR (spm.avg_supply_cost IS NOT NULL AND spm.avg_supply_cost < 50) ORDER BY total_spent DESC, total_available_quantity DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, CASE WHEN r.PriceRank = 1 THEN 'Top Order' ELSE 'Regular Order' END AS OrderType, c.c_name, sp.total_available, sp.total_cost, COALESCE(co.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders_by_customer, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent_by_customer, COALESCE(SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, (SELECT MAX(l_quantity) FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey) AS max_line_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS PriceRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') r LEFT JOIN lineitem li ON r.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = r.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = c.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.PriceRank <= 10 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.PriceRank, c.c_name, sp.total_available, sp.total_cost, co.total_orders, co.total_spent ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, cos.total_spent, cos.order_type, spc.total_available_quantity AS supplier_capacity, tr.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5 THEN 'Frequent' ELSE 'Occasional' END AS order_type FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos JOIN customer c ON cos.c_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spc ON c.c_nationkey = spc.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) > 2) tr ON c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = tr.r_regionkey) WHERE cos.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, CASE WHEN COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5 THEN 'Frequent' ELSE 'Occasional' END AS order_type FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderSummary) ORDER BY cos.total_spent DESC OFFSET 5 ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, COALESCE(cod.order_count, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(cod.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.total_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cod ON n.n_nationkey = cod.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs ON rs.supplier_rank = 1 WHERE n.n_name LIKE '%land%' AND (cod.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderData) OR rs.total_cost IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY n.n_name ASC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT rs.r_name, rs.total_nations, rs.total_supplier_balance, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent, ca.p_name AS popular_part, ca.total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) tc ON rs.total_nations > 10 LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS part_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) popular_parts ON popular_parts.part_rank = 1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ca ON popular_parts.p_name = ca.p_name WHERE rs.total_supplier_balance IS NOT NULL OR tc.total_spent IS NOT NULL;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(s.s_name, 'Unknown Supplier') AS supplier_name, COALESCE(o.order_count, 0) AS customer_order_count, a.total_avail_qty, r.price_rank FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2)) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year') r ON p.p_partkey = r.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) o ON p.p_partkey = o.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) a ON p.p_partkey = a.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 20 AND (r.price_rank IS NULL OR r.price_rank <= 5) ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC, a.total_avail_qty ASC;

SELECT co.c_name AS CustomerName, co.OrderCount, co.TotalSpent, ts.s_name AS SupplierName, ts.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) ts ON co.TotalSpent > 5000 AND co.c_name LIKE '%Corp%' WHERE (ts.TotalSupplyCost IS NOT NULL OR co.OrderCount > 0) ORDER BY co.TotalSpent DESC, co.OrderCount ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS distinct_order_count, COALESCE(MAX(sl.total_quantity), 0) AS max_quantity_by_supplier, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS num_lineitems, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, o.o_orderkey) sl ON od.o_orderkey = sl.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank_by_balance FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) WHERE rank_by_balance <= 5) ss ON sl.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(od.total_revenue) > 50000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, nt.total_supply_cost, co.order_count, co.total_spent, old.total_extended_price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(old.total_extended_price) DESC) AS price_rank FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) nt ON n.n_nationkey = nt.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON nt.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_extended_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) old ON co.order_count > 0 WHERE nt.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL OR co.total_spent IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name, nt.total_supply_cost, co.order_count, co.total_spent, old.total_extended_price, r.r_regionkey HAVING AVG(co.total_spent) > 1000 ORDER BY r.r_name, price_rank;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, t.total_sales, sa.max_available, CASE WHEN rs.supplier_rank = 1 THEN 'Top Supplier' ELSE 'Other Supplier' END AS supplier_status FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) t ON p.p_partkey = t.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, COALESCE(MAX(ps.ps_availqty), 0) AS max_available FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) sa ON p.p_partkey = sa.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs ON p.p_partkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.supplier_rank = 1 WHERE (t.total_sales IS NOT NULL OR sa.max_available > 0) AND (p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 10.00 AND 100.00 OR p.p_comment IS NULL) ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC NULLS LAST, sa.max_available DESC;

SELECT rn.r_name AS region_name, rn.n_name AS nation_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.avg_acctbal, COUNT(od.total_order_value) AS order_count, COALESCE(SUM(od.total_order_value), 0) AS total_order_value_sum FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey) od ON ss.s_suppkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100)) JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rn ON ss.s_suppkey = rn.n_nationkey GROUP BY rn.r_name, rn.n_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.avg_acctbal HAVING SUM(od.total_order_value) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_order_value_sum DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT fo.o_orderkey, SUM(spp.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT spp.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, COALESCE(r.r_name, 'Unknown Region') AS supplier_region FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) fo LEFT JOIN lineitem li ON fo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) spp ON li.l_partkey = spp.p_partkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON spp.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE fo.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders) GROUP BY fo.o_orderkey, r.r_name HAVING SUM(spp.ps_supplycost) IS NOT NULL AND COUNT(DISTINCT spp.p_partkey) > 0 ORDER BY fo.o_orderkey;

SELECT tc.region, tc.nation, tc.customer_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, aop.average_price, CASE WHEN tc.o_totalprice > aop.average_price THEN 'Above Average' WHEN tc.o_totalprice < aop.average_price THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Average' END AS price_comparison FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, ro.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 3) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT nu.n_name, AVG(tco.o_totalprice) AS average_price FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, ro.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 3) tco JOIN nation nu ON tco.nation = nu.n_name GROUP BY nu.n_name) aop ON tc.nation = aop.n_name ORDER BY tc.region, tc.nation, tc.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent, p.p_name AS part_name, psi.s_name AS supplier_name, psi.ps_availqty AS available_quantity, psi.ps_supplycost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_name, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) cos JOIN customer c ON cos.c_name = c.c_name WHERE cos.spending_rank <= 10) tc JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_name = tc.c_name ) JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost) AS cost_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) psi ON l.l_partkey = psi.ps_partkey AND psi.cost_rank = 1 WHERE l.l_discount > 0.05 AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, p.p_name ASC;

SELECT cs.c_name AS Customer_Name, cs.total_spent AS Total_Spent, COALESCE(so.sub_total_orders, 0) AS Orders_Count, COALESCE(su.unique_parts_supplied, 0) AS Unique_Parts_Supplied, ROUND(su.total_supply_cost, 2) AS Total_Supply_Cost, r.r_name AS Region, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS Total_Spent_Rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) AS cs JOIN nation AS n ON cs.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS sub_total_orders FROM orders AS o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) AS so ON cs.c_custkey = so.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) AS su ON su.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp AS ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem AS l JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' ) ) WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY Total_Spent DESC, cs.c_name;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT nc.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(sc.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(rc.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(rc.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_customer FROM region r JOIN nation nc ON r.r_regionkey = nc.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON nc.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(od.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) od ON c.c_custkey = od.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc ON s.s_nationkey = rc.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name IS NOT NULL AND (rc.total_revenue > 0 OR rc.total_revenue IS NULL) GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(sc.total_supply_cost) > 0 ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_customer DESC;

SELECT c.p_partkey, c.p_name, c.total_supply_cost, c.total_revenue, c.profitability_ratio, NTILE(5) OVER (ORDER BY c.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.p_brand ORDER BY c.total_revenue DESC) AS brand_rank, CASE WHEN c.last_order_date IS NULL THEN 'No Orders' ELSE 'Has Orders' END AS order_status FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_mfgr, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(s.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(o.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, o.line_count, o.last_order_date, CASE WHEN o.total_revenue > 0 THEN (p.p_retailprice - COALESCE(s.total_supply_cost, 0)) / o.total_revenue ELSE NULL END AS profitability_ratio FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) s ON p.p_partkey = s.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_count, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) o ON p.p_partkey = o.o_orderkey) c WHERE (c.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) as cte_supplier_info) OR c.total_revenue IS NULL) AND c.line_count >= 1 ORDER BY c.p_partkey;

SELECT nc.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(rsu.s_acctbal), 0) AS total_supplier_balance, tc.c_name AS top_customer_name, tc.total_spent AS top_customer_spent FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) AS ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.p_partkey JOIN nation nc ON s.s_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rsu ON rsu.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND rsu.SupplierRank = 1 JOIN (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) WHERE order_count > 0) tc ON c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY nc.n_name, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, top_customer_spent DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, SUM(co.total_revenue) AS total_order_revenue, AVG(nr.total_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rs.s_name, ', ') AS supplier_names FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) rs ON co.o_orderkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10) GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) nr ON nr.nation_name IN (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey)) GROUP BY co.c_custkey HAVING SUM(co.total_revenue) > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey) as CustomerOrders) ORDER BY total_order_revenue DESC;

SELECT top_customers.c_name, top_customers.total_orders, top_customers.total_spent, r.r_name AS region_name, s.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT customer_orders.c_custkey, customer_orders.c_name, customer_orders.total_orders, customer_orders.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY customer_orders.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 0) as customer_orders) JOIN nation n ON top_customers.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey) s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE top_customers.rank <= 10 AND (s.total_supplycost IS NULL OR s.total_supplycost > 10000) ORDER BY top_customers.total_spent DESC;

SELECT f.c_name, f.customer_segment, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL AND c.c_acctbal > 1000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN c.c_acctbal IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' ELSE 'Regular' END AS customer_segment FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name IN (SELECT nation_name FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 3) as TopSales))) f LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_totalprice > 500 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) AS subquery ON f.c_custkey = subquery.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT nation_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 3) ts ON subquery.o_custkey IS NOT NULL WHERE ts.total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, f.customer_segment;

SELECT n.n_name, COALESCE(ns.nation_sales, 0) AS nation_sales, COALESCE(ns.supplier_count, 0) AS supplier_count, (ns.nation_sales / NULLIF(ts.grand_total_sales, 0)) * 100 AS nation_sales_percentage FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(total_sales) AS grand_total_sales, COUNT(s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierSales) ts ORDER BY nation_sales_percentage DESC;
