SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation, s.distinct_parts, s.total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.nation ORDER BY s.total_cost DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ts.rn <= 3 AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, o.o_orderkey ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, s_name, s_acctbal, total_customers, total_revenue, avg_order_value, total_orders, total_returns FROM (SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, stats.total_customers, stats.total_revenue, stats.avg_order_value, stats.total_orders, stats.total_returns FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey) stats) ORDER BY nation_name, s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'LAND') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.num_parts FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate ASC, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ts.unique_parts_supplied, ts.avg_supply_cost, ts.total_avail_qty FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.unique_parts_supplied, ss.avg_supply_cost, ss.total_avail_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_avail_qty DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss) ts ON ro.order_rank <= 5 WHERE ro.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, ts.avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT tb.p_brand, tb.brand_total_qty, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, ss.n_name, ss.supplier_count, ss.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT rp.p_brand, SUM(rp.total_available_qty) AS brand_total_qty FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp WHERE rp.rank <= 5 GROUP BY rp.p_brand) tb JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_orders > 100 JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ss ON ss.supplier_count > 10 ORDER BY tb.brand_total_qty DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation ORDER BY n_nationkey LIMIT 1) WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = ts.region_name) JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.TotalPartsSupplied, ss.TotalSupplyCost, os.c_name, os.TotalOrderValue, os.TotalLineItems FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS TotalPartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS TotalLineItems FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name) os ON ss.TotalPartsSupplied > 5 WHERE ss.TotalSupplyCost > 10000 ORDER BY ss.TotalSupplyCost DESC, os.TotalOrderValue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, r.r_name AS region FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(ps.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem lp ON o.o_orderkey = lp.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ps ON lp.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, p.p_name, tp.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT p_partkey, total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 10) tp JOIN part p ON tp.p_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY tp.p_partkey, p.p_name, tp.total_revenue ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, t.total_revenue, n.n_name AS customer_nation, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN orders o ON t.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_address, t.total_revenue, n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_name ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.total_sale) AS unique_sales_count, AVG(ss.total_sale) AS avg_sales, SUM(ss.total_sale) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, sd.total_sale FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sale FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) sd ON l.l_orderkey = sd.o_orderkey) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ts.s_name AS SupplierName, ts.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) as OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, a.avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) as avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) a ON s.s_suppkey = a.ps_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.c_mktsegment, r.total_revenue, t.segment_revenue, (r.total_revenue / NULLIF(t.segment_revenue, 0)) * 100 AS revenue_percentage FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(total_revenue) AS segment_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN customer c ON r.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) t ON r.c_mktsegment = t.c_mktsegment WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.c_mktsegment, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nr.r_name, nr.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_sales_value, SUM(nr.region_total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(st.total_supply_cost) AS region_total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st ON st.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type = 'PROMO') GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) nr ON co.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey) GROUP BY nr.r_name, nr.n_name ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC, total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.customer_name, SUM(od.ps_supplycost * od.o_totalprice) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT ts.s_name, ', ') AS supplier_names FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, ps.ps_supplycost, pp.p_name AS part_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part pp ON ps.ps_partkey = pp.p_partkey WHERE pp.p_partkey IN (SELECT p_partkey FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10) as PopularParts)) od JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON od.ps_supplycost < ts.s_acctbal GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.customer_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, pp.p_partkey, pp.p_name, pp.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10) pp ON pp.order_count > 0 WHERE pp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' ) ) ) ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ts.ps_suppkey, ol.total_revenue, ol.avg_quantity, ol.return_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ts ON ts.ps_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey % 10 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_count FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ol ON ro.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, ol.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS Customer_Name, c.order_count AS Total_Orders, c.total_spent AS Total_Spent, s.s_name AS Supplier_Name, s.total_supply_cost AS Supplier_Cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) s WHERE c.total_spent > ( SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders ) AND s.total_supply_cost < ( SELECT MAX(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) as TopSuppliers ) ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, s.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.order_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ORDER BY s.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY os.order_total DESC, ts.s_name ASC;

SELECT t.s_name, t.nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, MAX(o.o_totalprice) AS max_order_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation, total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE t.rank <= 10 GROUP BY t.s_name, t.nation ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sr.region_name, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) sr WHERE sr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(sc.ps_supplycost * os.TotalSales) AS SupplyChainCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, 0 AS Level FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 10 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, sc.Level + 1 FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, 0 AS Level FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 10 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, sc.Level + 1 FROM SupplyChain sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 10 AND sc.Level < 5) sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 10 AND sc.Level < 5) sc JOIN nation n ON sc.ps_partkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.o_orderkey = sc.ps_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(sc.ps_supplycost * os.TotalSales) > 50000 ORDER BY SupplyChainCost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tn.Nation, tn.TotalRevenue, tn.OrderCount, rd.TotalRevenue / SUM(rd.TotalRevenue) OVER () AS RevenueShare FROM (SELECT Nation, TotalRevenue, OrderCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueData) tn JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) rd ON tn.Nation = rd.Nation WHERE tn.RevenueRank <= 5 ORDER BY tn.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT supplier_rank, s_suppkey, s_name, nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ts.s_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT RegionName, NationName, SupplierName, TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, ns.n_name AS NationName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5) ORDER BY RegionName, NationName, TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT nr.n_nationkey) AS nations, SUM(nr.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS part_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN customer c ON os.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(os.total_revenue) > 1000000) nr ON n.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.region_name, r.nation_name, r.total_sales, r.unique_customers, r.total_orders, r.avg_order_value, r.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_sales, unique_customers, total_orders, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) as RegionalPerformance) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.region_name, r.sales_rank;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_sales, rs.total_quantity, rs.total_orders, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.total_quantity, ss.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_net_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, tr.total_revenue, sr.s_name, sr.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, n.n_name, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, n.n_name) tr ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate = ro.o_orderdate) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_cost FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON sr.total_cost = ( SELECT MAX(l.l_discount * l.l_extendedprice) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice ASC;

SELECT na.nation_name, p.p_name, p.ps_availqty, p.ps_supplycost, o.order_year, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS annual_revenue, na.supplier_count, na.total_account_balance FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_comment, n.n_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) p JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_year, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)) o ON p.p_partkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) na ON p.n_name = na.nation_name GROUP BY na.nation_name, p.p_name, p.ps_availqty, p.ps_supplycost, o.order_year, na.supplier_count, na.total_account_balance ORDER BY annual_revenue DESC, na.supplier_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rc.s_suppkey, rc.s_name, rc.total_supply_cost, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rc JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(co.total_spent) DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc ON rc.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey ) GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rc.supplier_rank <= 10 AND tc.customer_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.total_supply_cost DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.n_name, t.order_count, tr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN orders o ON ps.ps_partkey = o.o_orderkey -- corrected join condition JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) t, TotalRevenue tr ORDER BY t.order_count DESC, tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sop.p_partkey, sop.p_name, sop.p_brand, cos.c_custkey, cos.c_name, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_avail_qty, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp WHERE rp.rank <= 3) sop JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON sop.total_supply_cost < cos.total_spent ORDER BY sop.total_avail_qty DESC, cos.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, high_value_customers, total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hc.c_custkey) AS high_value_customers, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) hc ON rs.rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC, high_value_customers DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(SA.TotalSupplyCost, 0) AS TotalSupplyCost, COALESCE(CO.TotalOrders, 0) AS TotalOrders, COALESCE(CO.TotalSpent, 0) AS TotalSpent, (COALESCE(SA.TotalSupplyCost, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(CO.TotalOrders, 0), 0)) AS AvgCostPerOrder FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) SA ON r.r_regionkey = SA.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) CO ON r.r_regionkey = CO.c_nationkey WHERE r.r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') ORDER BY AvgCostPerOrder DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, tn.n_name, tn.nation_total_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT n_name, SUM(total_cost) AS nation_total_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_suppkey) GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY nation_total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON tn.n_name = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2) ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT rss.region_name, rss.nation_name, rss.supplier_count, rss.total_available_quantity, rss.total_supply_cost, os.order_count, os.total_order_value, os.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) rss LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON rss.nation_name = (SELECT n_name FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey) ORDER BY rss.region_name, rss.nation_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM nation n INNER JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey INNER JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey INNER JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey INNER JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, AVG(hvs.total_value) AS average_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_value, rs.n_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rnk <= 5 AND n.n_nationkey = rs.n_nationkey) hvs JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n2.n_regionkey FROM nation n2 WHERE n2.n_name = hvs.n_name LIMIT 1) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, average_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, hvl.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.num_parts AS supplier_part_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) hvl ON ro.o_orderkey = hvl.l_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON hvl.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.num_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd WHERE sd.num_parts > 5) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, hvl.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.s_name AS supplier_name, r.nation_name, co.order_count, oli.revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 10) co ON r.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) oli ON co.order_count = oli.o_orderkey ORDER BY r.total_cost DESC, co.order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority, p.p_name, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) c ON r.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_orderkey;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(f.l_extendedprice * (1 - f.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT rq.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) as supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rq ON s.s_suppkey = rq.s_suppkey AND rq.supplier_rank <= 5 JOIN partsupp ps ON rq.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, l.l_linestatus FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') f ON ps.ps_partkey = f.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) c ON f.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_line_quantity FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_name) tc JOIN supplier s ON tc.c_name = s.s_name JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tc.total_spent > 10000 GROUP BY tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, r.r_name ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rc.s_suppkey, rc.s_name, rc.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rc WHERE rc.rank <= 5) hs ON l.l_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, tc.c_name AS Customer_Name, ts.total_supply_value, tc.total_order_value, tc.total_orders, ts.unique_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_supply_value, unique_parts_supplied, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, total_orders, total_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_order_value DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) tc ON ts.unique_parts_supplied > 5 AND tc.total_orders > 10 WHERE ts.supply_rank <= 10 AND tc.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_value DESC, tc.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, hvc.c_name AS Customer_Name, hvc.total_spent AS Customer_Spending, ts.total_sales AS Supplier_Total_Sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT cu.c_custkey, cu.c_name, cu.order_count, cu.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu WHERE cu.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustOrders)) hvc ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_sales, r.total_orders, SUM(r.region_sales) OVER () AS grand_total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS region_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.total_orders) AS total_orders FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s_nationkey FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.region_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(lid.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_supply_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers)) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, lo.l_partkey, lo.l_quantity, lo.l_extendedprice FROM lineitem lo JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') co ON lo.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey) lid ON ps.ps_partkey = lid.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') co ON lid.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.p_name, ts.total_revenue, ss.supplier_revenue, cs.customer_expenditure FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts JOIN part p ON ts.p_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ts.p_partkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS customer_expenditure FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.customer_expenditure > 1000 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC, ss.supplier_revenue DESC, cs.customer_expenditure DESC;

SELECT fo.c_name, COUNT(fo.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(fo.total_amount) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.total_amount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_supply_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers)) ts ON co.total_amount > (SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as CustomerOrders)) fo GROUP BY fo.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.p_name, rs.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ts.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ts JOIN part p ON ts.p_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON rs.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.nation, t.region, t.total_available_qty, t.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation, s.region, s.total_available_qty, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) s) t WHERE t.rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.region, t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.c_nationkey ORDER BY r.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) r) o JOIN nation n ON o.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ps.p_name, ps.total_sales FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) ts JOIN partsupp psupp ON ts.s_suppkey = psupp.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON psupp.ps_partkey = ps.p_partkey WHERE ts.rnk <= 5 ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT od.l_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, MAX(od.l_quantity) AS max_quantity, AVG(od.l_extendedprice) AS average_price_per_part FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.region, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cu.c_custkey, cu.c_name, cu.o_orderkey, cu.o_totalprice, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_available_quantity, ts.total_supply_cost, cu.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) cu JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_available_quantity, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON cu.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) ORDER BY cu.o_totalprice DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, customer_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.r_name, sc.s_name AS top_supplier, sc.total_cost AS supplier_total_cost, ct.total_orders AS customer_total_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON s.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON ns.supplier_count > 0 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ct ON ct.total_orders > 0 WHERE sc.total_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierCost) ORDER BY ns.r_name, ns.n_name;

SELECT f.c_custkey, f.c_name, f.o_orderkey, f.o_totalprice, f.s_suppkey, f.s_name, f.p_partkey, f.p_name, SUM(f.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.o_orderkey, cs.o_totalprice, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.p_partkey, ts.p_name, ts.ps_availqty FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) cs JOIN (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps_supplycost) as row_num FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.ps_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.p_partkey ORDER BY sp.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp) r WHERE r.rank = 1) ts ON cs.o_orderkey = ts.p_partkey) f GROUP BY f.c_custkey, f.c_name, f.o_orderkey, f.o_totalprice, f.s_suppkey, f.s_name, f.p_partkey, f.p_name ORDER BY total_availqty DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, sr.s_name, sr.total_supply_cost, co.total_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ot.total_order_value) AS total_value FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) ot ON c.c_custkey = ot.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s) sr ON sr.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN customer cr ON cr.c_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE co.total_value > 100000 ORDER BY sr.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_revenue, ts.s_name, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_custkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON r.r_name = ( SELECT r2.r_name FROM region r2 JOIN nation n ON r2.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE c.c_custkey = (SELECT MIN(c2.c_custkey) FROM customer c2) LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY r.region_revenue DESC, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_account_balance, pp.p_name, pp.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns CROSS JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) pp ORDER BY ns.nation_name, pp.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT nation, ARRAY_AGG(c_name) AS top_customers FROM (SELECT nation, c_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, n.n_name AS nation FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) as TotalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 3 GROUP BY nation ORDER BY nation;

SELECT oo.o_orderkey, oo.o_orderdate, oo.o_totalprice, oo.c_name AS customer_name, oo.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(SUM(od.revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, n.n_name, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.rn <= 10) oo LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) od ON oo.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = oo.o_orderkey) GROUP BY oo.o_orderkey, oo.o_orderdate, oo.o_totalprice, oo.c_name, oo.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.p_partkey, r.total_quantity, r.total_revenue, r.total_taxed_revenue, r.order_count FROM (SELECT s.p_partkey, s.total_quantity, s.total_revenue, s.total_taxed_revenue, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) * (1 + l.l_tax)) AS total_taxed_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) s) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tod.o_orderkey, tod.o_totalprice, tod.o_orderdate, tod.o_orderpriority, COUNT(DISTINCT tod.p_name) AS distinct_parts, SUM(tod.total_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(tod.total_extended_price) AS total_extended_price, SUM(tod.total_discounted_price) AS total_discounted_price FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discounted_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, p.p_name) tod GROUP BY tod.o_orderkey, tod.o_totalprice, tod.o_orderdate, tod.o_orderpriority ORDER BY tod.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, cr.total_customer_revenue, rn.r_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(RO.total_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) RO ON o.o_orderkey = RO.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr JOIN supplier s ON cr.total_customer_revenue > s.s_acctbal JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_comment LIKE '%important%') rn ON r.r_regionkey = rn.r_regionkey WHERE cr.total_customer_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY cr.total_customer_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, s.s_name, SUM(cl.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(cl.l_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT cl.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.total_order_value, cs.total_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.total_order_value > ss.total_supply_cost) cs JOIN lineitem cl ON cs.total_order_value > cl.l_extendedprice JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON cs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE cl.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, s.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_value, rs.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' ORDER BY c.c_custkey, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_acctbal, od.total_revenue, od.num_items, od.avg_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10) hvo JOIN (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_partkey) AS num_items, AVG(li.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10) hvo JOIN lineitem li ON hvo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ORDER BY hvo.o_orderdate DESC, hvo.o_totalprice DESC;
