SELECT nation, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS total_high_value_orders, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value, MIN(order_value) AS min_order_value, MAX(order_value) AS max_order_value FROM (SELECT rs.nation, h.o_orderkey, h.order_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.nation ORDER BY h.order_value DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN lineitem l ON rs.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) h ON l.l_orderkey = h.o_orderkey) WHERE order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY nation ORDER BY nation;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers_ordered, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.rank <= 10) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, average_supplier_balance ASC;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.order_count, cr.total_spent, cs.total_supply_cost, sp.parts_supplied FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cr JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) cs ON cr.c_custkey = ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON n.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey) LIMIT 1 ) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sp ON sp.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE cr.total_spent > 10000 ORDER BY cr.total_spent DESC, cs.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent, rp.p_brand, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT cust.c_custkey, cust.c_name, cust.order_count, cust.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cust.total_spent DESC) AS rank_by_spending FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cust) tc JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_by_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp ON rp.rank_by_cost = 1 WHERE tc.rank_by_spending <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, bo.order_count, bo.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY bo.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM region r JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name) bo ON r.r_name = bo.r_name ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(total_value) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT cd.o_orderkey, cd.o_custkey, dp.p_partkey, dp.p_name, dp.profit_margin, sd.nation_name, cd.total_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000) cd JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_supplycost, (p.p_retailprice - ps.ps_supplycost) AS profit_margin FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE sd.s_acctbal > 1000) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) AND (p.p_retailprice - ps.ps_supplycost) > 0) dp ON cd.o_orderkey = dp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON dp.ps_supplycost < 100) GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT nation, nation_sales, nation_order_count FROM (SELECT nation, nation_sales, nation_order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY nation_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT nation, SUM(total_sales) AS nation_sales, SUM(total_orders) AS nation_order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) GROUP BY nation) as NationSummary) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY nation_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, ts.mktsegment, ts.TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT m.mktsegment, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS Rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') o JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT c_mktsegment AS mktsegment FROM customer) m ON o.c_mktsegment = m.mktsegment WHERE o.Rank <= 10 GROUP BY m.mktsegment) ts JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'Asia' LIMIT 1) JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY ts.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hs.c_custkey) AS high_value_customer_count, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_by_nation FROM nation ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs ON ns.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) hs ON hs.customer_rank <= 10 WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost_by_nation DESC, high_value_customer_count DESC;

SELECT r_name, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_by_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_suppkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY total_cost_by_region DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_lineitem_price, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name ORDER BY customer_total_spent DESC;

SELECT sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.total_supply_value, sp.part_count, cos.c_name AS customer_name, cos.total_order_value, cos.total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON sp.total_supply_value > 50000 ORDER BY sp.total_supply_value DESC, cos.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.rank_revenue <= 10) tro JOIN lineitem l ON tro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT asd.s_name, asd.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.r_name AS supplier_region, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT spd.s_suppkey, spd.s_name, SUM(spd.ps_supplycost * cod.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spd JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') cod ON spd.ps_partkey = cod.l_partkey GROUP BY spd.s_suppkey, spd.s_name) asd JOIN supplier s ON asd.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders co ON s.s_suppkey = co.o_custkey GROUP BY asd.s_name, asd.total_supply_cost, n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, asd.s_name ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, dli.p_name, dli.l_quantity, dli.l_extendedprice, dli.l_discount, dli.l_tax FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT li.*, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM lineitem li JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND li.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE li.l_shipdate > cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year') dli ON ro.o_orderkey = dli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) sd ON dli.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, sd.s_name;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT od.l_partkey) AS unique_parts_count, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * od.l_quantity) AS total_order_value, AVG(od.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_part, MAX(od.l_extendedprice) AS max_price_per_part FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, hcs.s_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE rank_in_nation <= 3) hcs ON l.l_suppkey = hcs.s_suppkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate ORDER BY total_order_value DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.order_count, pd.p_name, pd.p_mfgr, pd.p_brand, pd.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, soc.order_count FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) soc ON s.s_suppkey = soc.s_suppkey ORDER BY soc.order_count DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 )) pd ON l.l_partkey = pd.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'REG AIR' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.order_count DESC, pd.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.avg_supply_cost, CASE WHEN r.o_orderstatus = 'O' THEN 'Open' ELSE 'Closed' END AS order_status_desc FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) c ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON l.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE r.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC, r.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_value AS supplier_total_value, tc.total_spent AS customer_total_spent FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) tc JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON tc.total_spent > 10000 WHERE tc.customer_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT oh.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, oh.o_totalprice, oh.o_orderdate, oh.line_item_count FROM (SELECT oh.o_orderkey, oh.o_orderstatus, oh.o_totalprice, oh.o_orderdate, oh.o_orderpriority, oh.o_clerk, oh.line_item_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority) oh WHERE oh.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority) as order_hierarchy) ORDER BY oh.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10) oh JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = oh.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE oh.o_orderstatus = 'O' ORDER BY oh.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tco.o_orderkey, tco.o_orderdate, tco.o_totalprice, tco.c_name, tco.nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.rank = 1 AND n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = ro.c_name LIMIT 1)) tco JOIN lineitem l ON tco.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY tco.o_orderkey, tco.o_orderdate, tco.o_totalprice, tco.c_name, tco.nation_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY tco.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.r_name, ts.supplier_count, ts.total_acctbal, od.o_orderkey, od.revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, r.r_comment, COUNT(rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) rs ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey) WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_comment) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON ts.supplier_count > 10 ORDER BY ts.total_acctbal DESC, od.revenue DESC;

SELECT rc.n_name, rc.total_cost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') AS total_orders, (SELECT AVG(o.o_totalprice) FROM orders o) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COALESCE(ts.aggregated_supply_cost, 0) AS total_cost FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS aggregated_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5 GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey) rc ORDER BY rc.total_cost DESC, rc.n_name ASC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, t.total_revenue, t.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT ts.c_mktsegment, ts.segment_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT c_mktsegment, SUM(revenue) AS segment_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment) WHERE rk <= 5 GROUP BY c_mktsegment) ts JOIN customer c ON ts.c_mktsegment = c.c_mktsegment JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY ts.c_mktsegment, ts.segment_revenue, r.r_name ORDER BY ts.segment_revenue DESC;

SELECT i.o_orderkey, i.o_totalprice, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(i.l_quantity * (1 - i.l_discount)) AS net_sales, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_discount, l.l_shipdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') i JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) rs ON i.l_partkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON i.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank = 1 GROUP BY i.o_orderkey, i.o_totalprice, n.n_name, rs.s_name ORDER BY net_sales DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_name) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost_sum FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rn = 1) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY total_cost_sum DESC, region_name, nation_name;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal, h.c_custkey, h.c_name, h.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_sales, o.line_item_count, o.o_shippriority FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#33' AND s.s_acctbal > 100.00) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND c.c_acctbal > 500.00) h ON h.rn <= 10 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS line_item_count, o.o_shippriority FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_shippriority) o ON o.o_shippriority = 1 WHERE r.rank = 1 ORDER BY o.total_sales DESC, h.c_acctbal DESC;

SELECT r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_sum, SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost_sum FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey)) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ts ON ts.total_cost > 10000 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_sum DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) tr JOIN orders o ON tr.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_address, tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.total_revenue ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, lc.total_value, lc.distinct_parts, p.p_name, s.s_name, n.n_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 10) tc JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lc ON tc.o_orderkey = lc.l_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON tc.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE lc.total_value > 50000 ORDER BY tc.o_orderdate DESC, tc.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Canada') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.s_suppkey AS top_supplier_key FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_cost = ( SELECT MAX(rs2.total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs2 )) ts WHERE co.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, co.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT O.o_orderkey, O.o_orderdate, S.s_name, S.nation_name, S.region_name, HP.p_name, HP.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_lines FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate HAVING COUNT(l.l_orderkey) > 5) O JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) HP ON O.o_orderkey = ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = HP.p_partkey LIMIT 1 ) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) S ON S.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = HP.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY O.o_orderdate DESC, HP.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost, tc.total_order_value FROM (SELECT cot.c_custkey, cot.c_name, cot.total_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cot.total_order_value DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cot WHERE cot.total_order_value > 0) tc JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 10) ts ON tc.total_order_value > 10000 ORDER BY tc.total_order_value DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.nation_name, ls.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 5) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT lo.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem li JOIN orders lo ON li.l_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY lo.o_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.o_orderkey ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.region, COUNT(DISTINCT r.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(cs.customer_sales) AS total_sales, AVG(cs.customer_sales) AS avg_sales_per_customer FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem ol ON p.p_partkey = ol.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, cs.customer_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.customer_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS customer_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem ol ON o.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) r ON rs.total_sales = r.customer_sales JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS customer_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem ol ON o.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON r.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY rs.region ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(sr.supplier_revenue) AS total_supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) fo ON l.l_orderkey = fo.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_supplier_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, r.r_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE n.n_name IN (SELECT c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC) as segment_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment) GROUP BY c_mktsegment) WHERE segment_rank <= 3) ORDER BY r.r_name, s.s_name;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.sales_rank <= 10) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, tn.n_name AS nation_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, hp.p_name AS part_name, hp.avg_extended_price, ts.total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation tn ON r.r_regionkey = tn.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON tn.n_nationkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING AVG(l.l_extendedprice) > 100.00) hp ON ts.s_suppkey = hp.p_partkey WHERE ts.total_supply_cost > 50000 ORDER BY r.r_name, tn.n_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(sd.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sd JOIN partsupp ps ON sd.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, MAX(ps.ps_supplycost) AS max_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON ps.ps_partkey = os.o_orderkey WHERE p.max_supplycost > 100.00 GROUP BY sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, sli.TotalSales, ts.s_name AS TopSupplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) sli ON ro.o_orderkey = sli.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.PartCount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS PartCount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.PartCount > 10 ORDER BY s.PartCount DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100)) WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(sp.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, rr.total_region_revenue FROM part rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON rp.p_partkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(nd.nation_revenue) AS total_region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) od ON c.c_custkey = od.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nd ON n.n_nationkey = nd.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rr ON rr.total_region_revenue > 0 GROUP BY rp.p_name, rr.total_region_revenue ORDER BY rr.total_region_revenue DESC, supplier_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, o.total_revenue, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.supplier_rank <= 10 WHERE o.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r_name, total_orders, total_revenue, AVG(total_revenue) OVER () AS avg_revenue_per_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name IN (SELECT region_name FROM (SELECT region_name FROM (SELECT region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) as TopRegions) GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT T.o_orderkey, T.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts_sold, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_count, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax_collected FROM (SELECT RANKED.o_orderkey, RANKED.total_revenue, RANKED.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) RANKED WHERE RANKED.order_rank <= 10) T JOIN lineitem l ON T.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY T.o_orderkey, T.total_revenue, T.o_orderdate ORDER BY T.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT td.nation_name, td.region_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) td ON n.n_nationkey = td.n_nationkey ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, td.nation_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('Australia', 'Canada', 'France', 'Germany', 'United States') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT oo.rk AS order_rank, cd.c_name AS customer_name, cd.nation_name, si.s_name AS supplier_name, si.total_revenue, oo.o_totalprice AS order_total FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') oo JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) cd ON oo.o_orderkey = ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = cd.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, SUM(line.l_extendedprice * (1 - line.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem line ON p.p_partkey = line.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, ps.ps_availqty) si ON si.ps_availqty > 0 WHERE oo.rk <= 10 ORDER BY oo.o_orderdate DESC, si.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.total_revenue, fr.supplier_name, fr.nation_name, fr.region_name, fr.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) sd ON os.o_orderkey % 1000 = sd.s_suppkey % 1000) fr ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-12-31' AND n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.o_orderdate, tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_name, os.total_revenue, os.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY os.o_orderdate ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_items, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN customer c ON os.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey) tc WHERE tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.o_orderdate, tc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' AND s.s_acctbal > 100 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s_name, region_name, unique_customers_served, total_revenue_generated, total_cost_of_supplies FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, nr.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS unique_customers_served, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_revenue_generated, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_supplies FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON sd.s_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON sd.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' ) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, nr.r_name HAVING SUM(co.total_order_value) > 100000) ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT tr.Region, tr.TotalRevenue, ar.AvgRevenue, CASE WHEN tr.TotalRevenue > ar.AvgRevenue THEN 'Above Average' WHEN tr.TotalRevenue < ar.AvgRevenue THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Average' END AS RevenueComparison FROM (SELECT Region, TotalRevenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) tr, AverageRevenue ar WHERE tr.RevenueRank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_cost AS supplier_total_cost, ti.l_quantity, ti.l_extendedprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey) ss ON ro.o_custkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 100) ti ON ro.o_orderkey = ti.l_orderkey WHERE ss.supplier_rank = 1 ORDER BY ro.o_orderkey, ss.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(t.nation_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) t JOIN nation n ON t.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_nation_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.supp_name, r.p_name, r.p_retailprice, co.c_name, co.order_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name AS supp_name, pp.p_partkey, pp.p_name, pp.p_retailprice, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rnk FROM part p WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 5 AND 15) pp ON ps.ps_partkey = pp.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) > 10000) co ON r.p_partkey = co.o_orderkey ORDER BY r.p_retailprice DESC, co.order_total ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, supplier_name, part_count, total_cost FROM (SELECT rbn.nation_name, COALESCE(rbn.nation_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ss.supplier_name, ss.part_count, ss.total_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.order_rank = 1 GROUP BY n.n_name) rbn FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) ss ON rbn.nation_name = ss.supplier_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, part_count DESC;

SELECT scr.supplier_name, scr.customer_name, scr.total_spent, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name AS customer_name, hvc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size >= 10 AND p.p_retailprice < 500.00 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000.00) hvc ON hvc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) scr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size >= 10 AND p.p_retailprice < 500.00 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON scr.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 3 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, scr.total_spent DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, rs.s_name AS preferred_supplier, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE rank = 1) rs ON co.total_spent > 1000 WHERE co.order_count > 5 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.total_orders, rs.unique_customers, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT sos.s_name, sos.nation, sos.total_quantity, sos.total_revenue, rs.r_name AS region_name, rs.supplier_count, rs.total_account_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) sos JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ON sos.nation = rs.r_name WHERE sos.total_revenue > 1000000 AND rs.supplier_count > 5 ORDER BY sos.total_revenue DESC, rs.total_account_balance ASC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, ns.nation_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE ns.nation_sales > 1000000 ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.nation_sales DESC;

SELECT region, customer_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, c.c_name AS customer_name, rs.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MIN(o.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rs JOIN customer c ON rs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(pd.p_retailprice) AS avg_part_retail_price, SUM(pd.total_avail_qty) AS total_available_parts, AVG(pd.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost_per_part FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(pd.total_available_qty, 0) AS total_avail_qty, COALESCE(pd.avg_supply_cost, 0) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) pd ON p.p_partkey = pd.ps_partkey) pd ON co.o_orderkey = pd.p_partkey GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, number_of_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.total_sales_by_region, rs.supplier_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_sales_by_region DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS total_sales_by_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_lineitem_price FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rs JOIN region r ON rs.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_sales_by_region DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT fc.c_name, os.total_orders, os.total_spending, ld.total_value, ld.total_quantity, (os.total_spending + COALESCE(ld.total_value, 0)) AS grand_total FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 AND r.r_name = 'ASIA') fc LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spending FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 AND r.r_name = 'ASIA') fc ON o.o_custkey = fc.c_custkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON fc.c_custkey = os.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ls.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN orders ls ON l.l_orderkey = ls.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 AND r.r_name = 'ASIA') fc ON ls.o_custkey = fc.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ls.o_custkey) ld ON fc.c_custkey = ld.o_custkey ORDER BY grand_total DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hc.c_custkey) AS high_value_customer_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.rn <= 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_suppliers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.o_orderkey) AS frequent_order_count, AVG(fo.total_revenue) AS avg_frequent_order_revenue, SUM(sp.supplier_count) AS parts_count_by_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rn <= 3 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) hc ON hc.order_count > 0 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) fo ON fo.total_revenue > 1000 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON sp.ps_partkey = rs.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_name;

SELECT t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.total_available AS available_quantity, t.total_cost AS supply_cost, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_spent AS customer_spending FROM (SELECT spd.s_suppkey, spd.s_name, spd.total_available, spd.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) spd WHERE spd.rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co WHERE co.order_count > 5) tc ON tc.total_spent > t.total_cost ORDER BY t.total_cost DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT r_name AS region, n_name AS nation, o_orderdate, total_revenue FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue, n_name, r_name, o_orderdate FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ON l_partkey = ps_partkey JOIN supplier ON ps_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n_name, r_name, o_orderdate) as Revenue) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.region, r.nation_count, r.total_supplier_balance, c.c_name, c.order_count, c.total_spent, p.p_name, p.total_available_qty, p.average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON r.nation_count > 5 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) p ON p.total_available_qty > 1000 WHERE r.total_supplier_balance > 10000 ORDER BY r.region, c.total_spent DESC, p.average_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, l.l_suppkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey) ro JOIN supplier s ON ro.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.total_supply_value > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) as RankedSuppliers)) hvs ON s.s_suppkey = hvs.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fr.region_name, fr.nation_count, fr.total_supplier_balance, fr.total_orders, fr.total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN region r ON rs.r_name = r.r_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON rs.nation_count > 0 GROUP BY r.r_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance) fr ORDER BY fr.total_revenue_generated DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_totalprice, fr.o_orderdate, fr.c_name, fr.unique_parts, fr.avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts, AVG(ss.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) hvo LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON hvo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ps.ps_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name) fr ORDER BY fr.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 50;
