SELECT p_name, p_brand, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(total_order_quantity) AS total_ordered, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(net_revenue) AS total_net_revenue, SUM(total_tax) AS total_tax_collected, revenue_category FROM (SELECT sd.p_name, sd.p_brand, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.total_order_quantity, sd.total_available_quantity, sd.total_supply_cost, od.net_revenue, od.total_tax, CASE WHEN od.net_revenue > 100000 THEN 'High Revenue' WHEN od.net_revenue BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) sd JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_order_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) od ON sd.ps_partkey = od.o_orderkey) GROUP BY p_name, p_brand, revenue_category ORDER BY total_net_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.r_name AS Region, rs.SupplierCount, rs.TotalAccountBalance, cos.TotalOrders, cos.TotalSales, ps.ps_partkey AS PartKey, ps.TotalSales AS PartTotalSales FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS TotalAccountBalance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cos ON rs.r_name IN ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = cos.c_nationkey ) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.TotalSales > 10000 ORDER BY rs.TotalAccountBalance DESC, cos.TotalSales DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, os.total_revenue, os.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ts.supplier_cost = (SELECT MAX(supplier_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 5) as TopSuppliers) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.lineitem_count > 10 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, rp.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, os.total_price, os.line_items, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_items FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) os ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type = 'TYPE_A') WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_price DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_supplier_cost, co.total_spent, co.order_count AS customer_order_count, ns.avg_order_count FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(st.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, AVG(st.order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st ON s.s_suppkey = st.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON ns.supplier_count > 0 ORDER BY ns.total_supplier_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.r_name, cs.c_nationkey, cs.total_revenue, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_nationkey) cs JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rn ON cs.c_nationkey = rn.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON cs.o_custkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as RankedSuppliers) AND cs.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY rn.r_name, cs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('REG AIR', 'AIR') AND p.p_size > 20 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fo.o_orderkey, fo.o_totalprice, fo.customer_name, fo.supplier_name, fo.part_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.customer_name, ro.supplier_name, ro.part_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000) ro WHERE ro.rank = 1) fo JOIN lineitem l ON fo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY fo.o_orderkey, fo.o_totalprice, fo.customer_name, fo.supplier_name, fo.part_name ORDER BY fo.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.o_orderkey) AS order_count, rs.nation_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000) hvli ON hvli.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, l.l_partkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') fo ON fo.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, rs.nation_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, (CASE WHEN total_sales IS NOT NULL THEN total_sales * 0.1 ELSE 0 END) AS bonus FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT avg_sales FROM (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) as average_sales)) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_by_region FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) tcpn ON n.n_name = tcpn.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_supply_cost_by_region DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal IS NOT NULL THEN c.c_acctbal ELSE 0 END) AS average_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC, region_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_top_suppliers, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank_within_nation <= 5) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY number_of_top_suppliers DESC, avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, h.NationalSupplyCost FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(rs.TotalSupplyCost) AS NationalSupplyCost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 3 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) h ON n.n_nationkey = h.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, h.NationalSupplyCost ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC, h.NationalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count FROM (SELECT sr.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.s_nationkey ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sr) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY n.n_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue, tps.ps_partkey, tps.total_quantity, si.s_name, si.supplier_nation, hpo.o_orderstatus, hpo.o_orderpriority, hpo.c_name, hpo.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10) tps ON ro.o_orderkey = tps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) si ON si.s_suppkey = tps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderpriority, custom.c_name, custom.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer custom ON o.o_custkey = custom.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderpriority IN ('1-URGENT', '2-HIGH')) hpo ON ro.o_orderkey = hpo.o_orderkey ORDER BY ro.revenue DESC, tps.total_quantity DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.p_name, ts.ps_availqty, ts.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.p_name, rs.ps_availqty, rs.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) rs JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) avg ON rs.p_partkey = avg.p_partkey WHERE rs.rn <= 3 AND rs.ps_supplycost < avg.avg_supplycost) ts ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.p_name, ts.ps_supplycost DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, tc.total_spent, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(co.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc CROSS JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, h.nation_name, h.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.nation_name, r.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank = 1) h ON l.l_suppkey = h.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, h.nation_name, h.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, ts.part_count FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.part_count, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co ON li.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_name, co.c_name, ts.part_count ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, supplier_name ASC;

SELECT rs.region, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, rs.total_sales, (tc.total_spent / rs.total_sales) * 100 AS contribution_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent > ( SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders )) tc ON rs.total_sales > 0 ORDER BY rs.region, contribution_percentage DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.total_available_qty FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_supply_cost, sc.total_available_qty, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, r.total_supplier_cost, r.total_orders, r.total_revenue, (CASE WHEN r.total_orders > 0 THEN (r.total_revenue / r.total_orders) ELSE 0 END) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COALESCE(SUM(s.total_cost), 0) AS total_supplier_cost, COALESCE(SUM(cos.total_orders), 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(cos.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cos ON n.n_nationkey = cos.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.total_supplier_cost DESC, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, nation_name, region_name;

SELECT fr.region, fr.total_orders, fr.total_revenue, fr.avg_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(fs.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_price FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN region r ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey AND n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000.00) fs ON fs.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) fr ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ad.s_suppkey, ad.s_name, ad.total_quantity, ad.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ad.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, SUM(od.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') od ON sp.p_partkey = od.l_partkey GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name) ad WHERE ad.total_quantity > 100 ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1994-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT nation, o_orderdate, total_revenue_by_nation FROM (SELECT ts.nation, os.o_orderdate, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_by_nation FROM (SELECT r.nation, r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.rn <= 5) ts JOIN orders o ON ts.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.nation, os.o_orderdate) ORDER BY nation, o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT nation, part_name, part_brand, total_quantity, avg_price, total_sales, total_sales / NULLIF(total_quantity, 0) AS sales_per_quantity FROM (SELECT ns.nation, ps.part_name, ps.part_brand, ps.total_quantity, ps.avg_price, ns.total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, p.p_brand AS part_brand, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_brand) ps ON ns.nation = 'NETHERLANDS') ORDER BY total_sales DESC, total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rc.c_name, tn.n_name, ps.total_supply_value, ps.supplier_count, rc.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc JOIN customer c ON rc.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation tn ON c.c_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON c.c_custkey % 10 = ps.ps_partkey % 10 WHERE rc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.total_spent DESC, tn.n_name ASC;

SELECT nation, s_suppkey, s_name, order_count, total_revenue FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as SupplierOrders) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY nation, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.region, r.total_sales, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) r JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = r.region) JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.region, r.total_sales ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) tc JOIN lineitem l ON tc.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.c_name ORDER BY tc.o_orderdate, total_quantity DESC;

SELECT o.c_name AS customer_name, o.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.s_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, SUM(co.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name HAVING SUM(co.revenue) > 50000) o JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp WHERE sp.rn = 1 GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name HAVING SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) > 100000) sp ON o.c_custkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.c_name, o.total_revenue ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.r_name AS RegionName, COUNT(*) AS SupplierCount, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS AvgRetailPrice FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY ts.TotalCost DESC) AS Rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) t JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = t.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE t.Rank <= 5 AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY t.r_name ORDER BY SupplierCount DESC, AvgRetailPrice DESC;

SELECT h.Nation, h.TotalRevenue, ROUND(h.TotalRevenue / (SELECT SUM(TotalRevenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalSales) * 100, 2) AS RevenuePercentage FROM (SELECT Nation, TotalRevenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalSales) h WHERE h.RevenueRank <= 5 ORDER BY h.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, od.l_partkey, od.l_quantity, od.l_extendedprice, si.s_name AS supplier_name, si.s_acctbal AS supplier_balance, o.o_orderpriority FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 5) o JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, lo.l_partkey, lo.l_quantity, lo.l_extendedprice, si.s_name, si.s_acctbal FROM lineitem lo JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) si ON lo.l_suppkey = si.ps_suppkey WHERE lo.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 5) as TopOrders)) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) si ON od.l_partkey = si.ps_partkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as supplier_sales) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE t.sales_rank <= 10 AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_returns, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, total_customers DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-02-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, cp.order_count, cp.total_revenue, ps.p_name, ps.total_available FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp ON tc.c_custkey = cp.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) ps ON ps.total_available > 10000 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, cp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT AVG(os.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue, COUNT(os.o_orderdate) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT co.total_revenue, co.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ts.s_suppkey)) WHERE co.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND co.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') os WHERE os.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as CustomerOrders);

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.rank, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.p_name AS product_name, ps.total_sales AS product_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.order_count > 10) ts JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.p_partkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.rank, ps.total_sales DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, sc.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) FROM customer)) hvc JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') r ON hvc.c_custkey = r.o_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON r.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE sc.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierCosts)) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON ts.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey ORDER BY hvc.c_custkey, r.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderstatus, f.o_orderdate, f.total_line_item_price, rp.p_name, tr.r_name, ts.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, SUM(l.l_quantity * l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_item_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 10) f JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) rp ON f.o_orderkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(n.n_nationkey) > 5) tr ON rp.p_partkey = tr.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON f.o_orderkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE rp.price_rank = 1 ORDER BY f.o_orderdate DESC, f.total_line_item_price DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(os.total_price) AS total_order_value, SUM(s.total_supply_cost) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey), 0) AS avg_supply_cost_per_order FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' UNION ALL SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' UNION ALL SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN StateCTE s ON n.n_regionkey = s.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name <> 'AMERICA') s ON n.n_regionkey = s.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name <> 'AMERICA') cte ON s.s_nationkey = cte.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON s.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost ORDER BY avg_supply_cost_per_order DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cu.c_name AS customer_name, cu.total_order_value, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'Asia' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON cu.total_order_value > ts.total_cost WHERE cu.total_order_value > 10000 ORDER BY cu.total_order_value DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.total_sales AS sales, s.s_suppkey, s.total_supply_cost, spr.total_available, spr.distinct_parts FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) s ON s.total_supply_cost < (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) as TopSuppliers) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spr ON s.s_suppkey = spr.s_suppkey WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC, s.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT tor.o_orderkey, tor.o_orderdate, tor.revenue, sd.s_name, sd.nation FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) tor JOIN lineitem l ON tor.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON s.s_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey ORDER BY tor.revenue DESC, tor.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, rank FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY rank;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Supplier, tc.c_name AS Customer, tc.total_spent AS Customer_Spending, ts.total_cost AS Supplier_Cost FROM (SELECT s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.nation_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.nation_revenue DESC) as revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) as revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = ro.c_name) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) r ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT r.r_name, r.TotalSupplyCost, r.TotalRevenue, r.TotalOrderCount, (r.TotalRevenue / NULLIF(r.TotalOrderCount, 0)) AS AverageOrderValue FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sp.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalSupplyCost, SUM(sp.TotalRevenue) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(sp.TotalOrders) AS TotalOrderCount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND li.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT nation_name, unique_customers, total_sales_value, avg_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT rs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_sales_value, AVG(co.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON rs.rank = 1 GROUP BY rs.nation_name) WHERE unique_customers > 10 AND total_sales_value > 50000 ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS AverageAccountBalance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, nc.region_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS region_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) sc ON n.n_nationkey = sc.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) nc ON r.r_regionkey = nc.n_regionkey ORDER BY nc.region_cost DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON tr.r_name = (SELECT distinct r.r_name FROM region r WHERE r.r_regionkey = c.c_nationkey) GROUP BY tr.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000000 ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s_name) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_cost) AS overall_total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY overall_total_cost DESC;

SELECT si.s_name AS supplier_name, ni.n_name AS nation_name, ni.region_name, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, AVG(si.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ni ON si.s_nationkey = ni.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON si.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey WHERE ni.region_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY si.s_name, ni.n_name, ni.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, stc.total_cost, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) stc ON stc.ps_suppkey = (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 500.00 GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.order_count > 5 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND p.p_size > 30 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, s.s_name AS supplier, p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS average_retail_price, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'S%' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats)) h WHERE h.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_acctbal, ns.avg_acctbal, os.total_orders, os.total_order_value, os.avg_order_value, os.completed_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON ns.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey) ORDER BY ns.supplier_count DESC, os.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, r.r_name AS supplier_region, SUM(pr.profit) AS total_profit FROM (SELECT ts.p_partkey, ts.total_revenue, sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.total_cost, (ts.total_revenue - sd.total_cost) AS profit FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ps.ps_supplycost, (ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd ON ts.p_partkey = sd.ps_partkey) pr JOIN partsupp ps ON pr.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN part p ON pr.p_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, r.r_name ORDER BY total_profit DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(od.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.ps_partkey) AS num_parts, MAX(sp.supplier_name) AS main_supplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') co JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > co.o_orderdate) od ON co.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, MAX(s.s_name) AS supplier_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON od.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE co.c_custkey IN (SELECT ts.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(rs.total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs )) ts) GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name HAVING SUM(od.o_totalprice) > 10000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 500000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, CONCAT(sr.s_name, ' (Rank: ', sr.rank, ')') AS supplier_info, hvc.c_name AS customer_name, hvc.total_spent AS customer_total_spent, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS total_recent_orders, SUM(ro.order_value) AS total_recent_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON s.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 50000) hvc ON hvc.c_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = hvc.c_custkey ) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, sr.s_name, sr.rank, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_spent ORDER BY region, nation, supplier_info DESC;

SELECT f.c_custkey, f.c_name, f.total_orders, f.total_spent, COALESCE(f.top_supplier, 'No Supplier') AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_orders, c.total_spent, t.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank <= 3) t ON c.c_custkey = t.s_suppkey WHERE c.total_spent > 1000) f ORDER BY f.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.*, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) s) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ts.s_suppkey = ro.o_custkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, ts.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5) cs ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey ) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_orderkey;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' AND p.p_type LIKE 'SMALL BOUND%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rc.o_orderstatus, rc.order_count, rc.total_revenue, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) rc JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) tc ON rc.o_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON ns.n_name = ANY(SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey)) WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.c_custkey, t.c_name, COUNT(t.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(t.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(t.total_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, MAX(t.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT cod.c_custkey, cod.c_name, cod.o_orderkey, cod.o_totalprice, cod.o_orderdate, cod.p_brand, cod.total_quantity FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, p.p_brand, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, p.p_brand) cod JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01') ro ON cod.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10) t GROUP BY t.c_custkey, t.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;
