SELECT tr.nation_name, tr.total_nation_revenue, CASE WHEN tr.total_nation_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_nation_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as TopRegions) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) tr ORDER BY tr.total_nation_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.region_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_revenue, sps.total_available_qty, sps.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(COALESCE(c.total_spent, 0)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sps ON sps.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00)) ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC, ns.supplier_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_line_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.* FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name IN ('Europe', 'Asia')) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s WHERE s.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name ORDER BY o.o_orderdate, total_line_value DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, ca.customer_name, ca.total_spent, rs.total_sales, (ca.total_spent / rs.total_sales) * 100 AS spending_ratio FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) ca ON 1=1 ORDER BY rs.region_name, spending_ratio DESC;

SELECT f.s_name, f.p_name, f.order_count, f.total_revenue, f.s_acctbal, (f.total_revenue / NULLIF(f.order_count, 0)) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT spd.s_name, spd.p_name, AD.order_count, AD.total_revenue, spd.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) spd JOIN (SELECT oh.level, COUNT(oh.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(oh.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_clerk, 1 AS level FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' UNION ALL SELECT oh.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_clerk, oh.level + 1 FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_clerk, 1 AS level FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' UNION ALL SELECT oh.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_clerk, oh.level + 1 FROM orders o JOIN OrderHierarchy oh ON o.o_orderkey = oh.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'P') oh ON o.o_orderkey = oh.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'P') oh GROUP BY oh.level) AD ON AD.level = 1) f ORDER BY f.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_revenue, sr.supplier_total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM Region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr ON r.r_regionkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY r.region_revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') co JOIN lineitem li ON co.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rs.r_name, SUM(ss.total_value) AS total_supplier_value, SUM(os.total_spent) AS total_customer_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT os.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region rs JOIN nation n ON rs.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) os ON ss.total_value > 10000 GROUP BY rs.r_name ORDER BY total_supplier_value DESC, total_customer_spent DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.customer_revenue, tc.rank FROM (SELECT r.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ro.total_revenue) DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer r ON ro.c_name = r.c_name GROUP BY r.c_name) tc WHERE tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.customer_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.total_sales, s.supplier_name, s.part_name, s.supply_cost, s.available_qty FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost, ps.ps_availqty AS available_qty FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100) s ON r.sales_rank = 1 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC, s.supplier_name ASC;

SELECT t.RegionName, COUNT(*) AS SupplierCount, SUM(t.TotalCost) AS TotalRegionCost FROM (SELECT s.s_name, r.r_name AS RegionName, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5) t GROUP BY t.RegionName ORDER BY TotalRegionCost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.avg_supplier_cost, rs.max_customer_spent FROM region r JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, AVG(total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost, MAX(total_spent) AS max_customer_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.avg_supplier_cost DESC, rs.max_customer_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.s_name) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem lo ON ro.o_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supp_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd ON lo.l_partkey = sd.ps_partkey AND sd.supp_rank = 1 WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.region, tc.nation, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_totalprice, COUNT(DISTINCT psi.ps_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(psi.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(psi.ps_availqty) AS avg_avail_qty FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, o.order_rank, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 5) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) psi ON tc.o_orderkey = psi.ps_partkey GROUP BY tc.region, tc.nation, tc.c_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_totalprice ORDER BY tc.region, tc.nation, tc.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_orders, total_revenue FROM (SELECT sd.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ad.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_custkey, od.o_orderdate, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_custkey, od.o_orderdate) ad JOIN customer c ON ad.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON c.c_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY sd.nation_name) WHERE total_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT sd.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ad.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ad.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_custkey, od.o_orderdate, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_custkey, od.o_orderdate) ad JOIN customer c ON ad.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON c.c_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY sd.nation_name) as FinalSummary ) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.o_totalprice, od.c_name, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(tli.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) od JOIN (SELECT rl.l_orderkey, rl.l_partkey, rl.total_revenue FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey) rl WHERE rl.rank <= 10) tli ON od.o_orderkey = tli.l_orderkey JOIN part p ON tli.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE od.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.o_totalprice, od.c_name, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.ps_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(sp.total_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ho.c_custkey) AS high_value_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) ho ON ro.o_custkey = ho.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 500000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.region_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sd JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, pd.p_name, pd.p_brand, pd.p_type FROM partsupp ps JOIN part pd ON ps.ps_partkey = pd.p_partkey) ps ON sd.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, total_customers, total_sales / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS avg_sales_per_order, total_sales / NULLIF(total_customers, 0) AS avg_sales_per_customer FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT a.s_name, a.total_sales, a.avg_sales, a.total_sales - a.avg_sales AS sales_difference FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, ts.total_sales, AVG(ts.total_sales) OVER (PARTITION BY rs.s_suppkey) AS avg_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY', 'USA')) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) ts ON rs.s_suppkey = ts.l_suppkey) a WHERE a.total_sales > a.avg_sales ORDER BY sales_difference DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.o_totalprice, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * od.l_quantity * (1 - l.l_discount / 100)) AS finalized_price FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.o_totalprice ORDER BY ts.s_name, finalized_price DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, s.s_name AS supplier_name, t.p_name AS top_product, rd.region_name, rd.nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) s ON o.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.p_partkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rd WHERE o.rank <= 5 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, tc.revenue, r.r_name FROM (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, tr.revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) tr ON c.c_custkey = tr.c_custkey WHERE tr.revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) as TotalRevenue) ORDER BY tr.revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN region r ON p.p_container = r.r_name WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50.00 ORDER BY tc.revenue DESC, tc.c_name ASC;

SELECT ns.n_name, pd.p_name, SUM(ns.total_sales) AS total_sales, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS total_cost, MAX(pd.avg_price) AS max_avg_price FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON ns.n_nationkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_lines, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pd ON pd.p_partkey = sc.s_suppkey GROUP BY ns.n_name, pd.p_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ad.c_custkey, ad.c_name, ad.TotalSupplierCost, ad.OrderCount, ad.TotalOrderValue FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, SUM(sp.TotalCost) AS TotalSupplierCost, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderpriority FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_retailprice, (ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON co.o_orderkey = sp.ps_partkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name) ad WHERE ad.TotalSupplierCost > 1000000 ORDER BY ad.TotalOrderValue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, number_of_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_size FROM part WHERE p_retailprice > 100.00) GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 50000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name AS CustomerName, tp.TotalAvailableQuantity AS AvailablePartsQuantity, co.TotalSpent AS TotalSpent, c.c_acctbal AS AccountBalance FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQuantity FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS RegionalRank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA') rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) tp ON tp.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' ) ORDER BY co.TotalSpent DESC, tp.TotalAvailableQuantity DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ROUND(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 2) AS revenue, ts.nation, ts.supply_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ts.nation, ts.supply_rank ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON l.l_orderkey = tc.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_custkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT bc.Nation, bc.OrderCount, bc.TotalRevenue, CASE WHEN bc.TotalRevenue > 500000 THEN 'High' WHEN bc.TotalRevenue BETWEEN 250000 AND 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS RevenueCategory FROM (SELECT nation.n_name AS Nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_by_price FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') o JOIN nation ON o.c_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey WHERE o.rank_by_price <= 10 GROUP BY nation.n_name) bc ORDER BY bc.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(ts.total_cost) AS aggregate_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rank = 1 AND r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = rs.nation_name)) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY aggregate_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN supplier s ON ro.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(ro.total_revenue) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS NationName, SUM(ss.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalSupplierCost, AVG(co.TotalOrderValue) AS AvgCustomerOrderValue, SUM(pv.ProjectedRevenues) AS TotalProjectedRevenues FROM nation ns JOIN supplier s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS AverageAccountBalance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS ProjectedRevenues FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) pv ON pv.o_orderkey = co.TotalOrders GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY TotalProjectedRevenues DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.c_mktsegment, tc.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, ra.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) ra JOIN customer c ON ra.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = c.c_custkey) WHERE ra.revenue_rank <= 10) tc JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey GROUP BY tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.c_mktsegment, tc.total_revenue ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rr.nation_name, rr.total_revenue, rr.revenue_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_percentile FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as revenue_data) rr WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rr.revenue_rank;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT nm.n_nationkey, nm.n_name, nm.total_orders, nm.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(co.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT c_custkey FROM customer) LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps) LIMIT 1) GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nm WHERE nm.total_orders > 0 AND nm.total_supply_cost > 0 ORDER BY nm.total_orders DESC, nm.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT co.c_name, SUM(co.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, t.total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 10) co GROUP BY co.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT region, nation, customer_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, c.c_name AS customer_name, ro.total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.sales_rank <= 10) ORDER BY region, nation, total_sales DESC;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, h.c_name, tp.p_name, tp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) h JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ps.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 1000 ORDER BY ps.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON h.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = tp.p_partkey) ORDER BY h.o_totalprice DESC, h.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total, shr.s_name AS supplier_name, shr.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10) t ON l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) shr ON l.l_suppkey = shr.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, shr.s_name, shr.total_cost ORDER BY o.o_orderdate, order_total DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, COALESCE(p.p_name, 'N/A') AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) o WHERE o.order_rank <= 10) t LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, part_name, ps.ps_supplycost ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC;

SELECT nation_name, revenue FROM (SELECT nation_name, revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE revenue > (SELECT avg_revenue FROM (SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalRevenue) as AverageRevenue)) ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS active_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON o.o_custkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND ts.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(average_spent) FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, AVG(c.total_spent) AS average_spent FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) as nation_average) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment, pd.p_name, pd.p_mfgr, pd.p_brand, pd.p_retailprice, pd.total_available FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, sp.total_available FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) sp ON p.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey) pd ON l.l_partkey = pd.p_partkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, l.total_sales, l.total_quantity, c.c_name, c.c_address, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.rn <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON t.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY l.total_sales DESC, l.total_quantity DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, d.total_revenue, d.total_quantity, d.unique_suppliers, ROUND(d.total_revenue * 0.15, 2) AS estimated_profit_margin FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) o JOIN (SELECT h.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY h.o_orderkey) d ON o.o_orderkey = d.o_orderkey ORDER BY d.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, o.total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, p.p_brand, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) o WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, o.total_revenue, s.s_name, p.p_name, p.p_brand ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT fr.c_custkey, fr.c_name, fr.top_supplier, fr.total_spent, fr.order_count FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s_nationkey ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank, s_suppkey, s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as RankedSuppliers) ts ON cs.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND ts.rank = 1 LIMIT 1)) fr WHERE fr.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerStats) AND fr.order_count > (SELECT AVG(order_count) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerStats) ORDER BY fr.total_spent DESC, fr.order_count DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.rank = 1 AND c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2) ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fs.total_orders, fs.total_revenue, fs.average_order_value, fs.first_order_date, fs.last_order_date, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, MIN(o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') WHERE rn = 1) fs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY fs.total_orders, fs.total_revenue, fs.average_order_value, fs.first_order_date, fs.last_order_date, r.r_name;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.total_cost, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS total_spent, tr.region_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON rp.p_partkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS region_sales FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY region_sales DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON tr.n_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey LIMIT 1) WHERE rp.rank = 1 ORDER BY tr.region_sales DESC, rp.total_cost DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.total_acctbal, r.supplier_count, p.part_name, p.supplier_count AS part_supplier_count, p.avg_supplycost, o.o_orderkey, o.order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC LIMIT 5) p ON r.supplier_count > p.supplier_count JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON o.order_value > r.total_acctbal ORDER BY r.region_name, p.avg_supplycost DESC, o.order_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, pp.total_available, ro.total_revenue, si.nation_name FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2)) si ON ps.ps_suppkey = si.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 100) pp ON p.p_partkey = pp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 MONTH' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ro.total_revenue > 1000 JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2)) si ON si.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = pp.ps_partkey) ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, pp.total_available DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, region_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.supplier_count, rs.avg_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ss.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.n_regionkey WHERE rs.avg_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats) ORDER BY rs.avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tp.nation_name, tp.s_name, tp.total_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank <= 3 AND n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n2.n_nationkey FROM nation n2 WHERE n2.n_name = n.n_name)) tp JOIN part p ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey AND l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ) WHERE p.p_type = 'COMPONENT' ORDER BY tp.nation_name, tp.total_cost DESC;

SELECT rn.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.part_count, ts.total_supply_cost, rn.nation_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.part_count, sp.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rn ON n.n_regionkey = rn.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, rn.r_name ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rr.region_name, rr.total_revenue, rr.total_orders, rr.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, total_orders, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as region_summary) rr WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rr.revenue_rank;

SELECT region_name, p_partkey, p_name, supplier_name, ps_supplycost, ps_availqty, total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, n.n_name, r.r_name) as SupplyChain) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT np.n_nationkey, np.n_name, np.NationTotalSpent, np.NationOrdersCount, np.NationSupplierPartsCount, np.NationTotalSupplyCost, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS HighPriorityOrders FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COALESCE(cs.TotalSpent, 0) AS NationTotalSpent, COALESCE(cs.OrdersCount, 0) AS NationOrdersCount, COALESCE(ss.SupplierPartsCount, 0) AS NationSupplierPartsCount, COALESCE(ss.TotalSupplyCost, 0) AS NationTotalSupplyCost FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrdersCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS SupplierPartsCount, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey) np LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON np.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 GROUP BY np.n_nationkey, np.n_name, np.NationTotalSpent, np.NationOrdersCount, np.NationSupplierPartsCount, np.NationTotalSupplyCost ORDER BY np.NationTotalSpent DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderdate, cr.c_name AS top_customer, cr.customer_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON r.o_orderkey = cr.c_custkey WHERE r.revenue_rank = 1 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lia.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(spd.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lia ON ro.o_orderkey = lia.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spd ON spd.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.c_custkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ss.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, ss.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.r_comment, tn.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON n.n_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON tn.n_nationkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_comment, tn.total_revenue ORDER BY tn.total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT hs.r_name AS region, hs.n_name AS nation, COUNT(hs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(hs.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 10) hs GROUP BY hs.r_name, hs.n_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC, supplier_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, rs.s_name AS Supplier, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey ORDER BY TotalCost DESC LIMIT 10) rs ON l.l_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') co ON l.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.s_name ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, s.p_name, s.s_name, s.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, n.n_name AS nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC, s.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue_returned, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'A' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue_accepted, AVG(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE NULL END) AS avg_quantity_returned, AVG(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'A' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE NULL END) AS avg_quantity_accepted FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue_returned DESC, total_revenue_accepted DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cs.c_name AS customer_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.total_spent, ss.total_availability, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.order_count, s.n_name AS nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availability, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN nation s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.total_order_value) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts_ordered FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.total_spent > ss.total_supply_cost WHERE ss.total_availability > 1000 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ss.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.supplier_count, rs.total_available_quantity, rs.average_supply_cost, tc.customer_id, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT customer_id, total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) as CustomerOrders) tc ON tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.region_name, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT so.o_orderkey, so.o_orderdate, ps.total_cost AS supplier_total_cost, ps.total_parts AS supplier_part_count, pd.total_sold AS part_total_sold, pd.avg_sold_price AS part_avg_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') so JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ps ON ps.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp ORDER BY ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_type, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_sold, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_sold_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_type) pd ON pd.p_partkey = ( SELECT l_partkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey = so.o_orderkey ORDER BY l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE so.order_rank = 1 ORDER BY so.o_orderdate DESC, supplier_total_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND r.r_name IN ('AMERICA', 'EUROPE', 'ASIA') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_supply_cost_by_nation, co.order_count, co.total_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_by_nation FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE ns.total_supply_cost_by_nation > 1000000 ORDER BY ns.total_supply_cost_by_nation DESC, co.total_order_value DESC;
