SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, AVG(cs.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.revenue_rank <= 10 THEN ro.total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top_10_revenue_total FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.c_custkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro ON ro.o_orderkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sr.nation, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank, r.r_comment FROM (SELECT nation, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as RegionalSales) sr JOIN region r ON (sr.nation = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = r.r_regionkey)) WHERE sr.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT fs.s_suppkey, fs.s_name, fs.total_cost, fs.n_name FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, n.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) fs WHERE fs.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) as RankedSuppliers);

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS number_of_customers, SUM(tr.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) tr JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = tr.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_order_value, co.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_container = 'SM BOX') ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT customer_name, total_part_available, total_order_value FROM (SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, COALESCE(spd.total_available, 0) AS total_part_available, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice FROM customer c INNER JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_price FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rank_price <= 10) hvo ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey)) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM supplier s INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name, p.p_name) spd ON co.o_orderkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_name = spd.s_name)) GROUP BY co.c_name, spd.total_available) WHERE total_order_value > 10000 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT t.r_name AS region_name, t.n_name AS nation_name, t.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(c.total_order_value) AS aggregate_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) c ON t.s_name = c.c_name GROUP BY t.r_name, t.n_name, t.s_name ORDER BY aggregate_order_value DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.line_item_count, od.total_revenue, sr.s_name, sr.nation_name, sr.region_name, ps.total_available_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, COUNT(li.l_linenumber) AS line_item_count, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey) od JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sr ON sr.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ) ) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC, od.o_orderkey;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_totalprice, COALESCE(SUM(lia.revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(sd.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, MAX(ro.order_rank) AS max_order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lia ON ro.o_orderkey = lia.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name) sd ON sd.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_totalprice, ro.order_rank ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, revenue, o_orderkey, o_orderdate FROM (SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name, o.o_orderdate) as SalesData) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY region_name, revenue DESC;

SELECT d.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(d.revenue) AS total_revenue, MAX(r.order_rank) AS latest_order_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) d JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') r ON d.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey GROUP BY d.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, number_of_orders DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT rt.r_name, rt.total_cost_by_region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_by_region FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.supplier_rank = 1 JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rt JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = rt.r_name) GROUP BY rt.r_name, rt.total_cost_by_region ORDER BY rt.total_cost_by_region DESC, total_customers DESC;

SELECT tcp.p_name, tcp.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(tcp.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_top_parts FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN lineitem l ON rp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rp.rank_cost = 1 GROUP BY rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, r.r_name) tcp JOIN lineitem l ON tcp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY tcp.p_name, tcp.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue_from_top_parts DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC LIMIT 5) tc ON rs.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps);

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.nation_name, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.ps_supplycost, t.o_totalprice, (sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.rank_order, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_totalprice, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rank_order <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sp ON t.o_orderkey % 5 = sp.p_partkey % 5 WHERE t.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT RN.p_partkey, RN.p_name, RN.p_brand, SN.nation_name, CS.order_count, CS.total_spent, RN.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) RN JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA')) SN ON RN.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty = RN.total_supply_cost ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) CS ON CS.order_count > 5 WHERE CS.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY RN.total_supply_cost DESC, CS.order_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COALESCE(suppliers.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS supplier_name, suppliers.total_supply_cost, customers.c_name AS customer_name, customers.total_orders, customers.total_spent FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) suppliers ON r.r_regionkey = suppliers.n_regionkey AND suppliers.rank <= 3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) customers ON TRUE WHERE customers.total_spent > 50000 ORDER BY r.r_name, suppliers.total_supply_cost DESC, customers.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.total_orders, cs.market_segment, cs.segment_sales, cs.segment_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS segment_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS segment_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON rs.total_sales > cs.segment_sales ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, cs.segment_sales DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, tp.total_revenue, spc.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) spc ON p.p_partkey = spc.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(roi.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) roi ON n.n_nationkey = roi.c_nationkey WHERE roi.rank_order <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) tp ON tp.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(roi.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) roi ON n.n_nationkey = roi.c_nationkey WHERE roi.rank_order <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) as TopNations) WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p_retailprice) FROM part) ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC, spc.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.s_suppkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') hvo ON hvo.order_rank <= 10 WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_supply_cost DESC, hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT s.nation_name, s.s_name, o.o_orderkey, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, nation_name FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rn <= 5) s JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o) o ON s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, nation_name FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rn <= 5) as HighBalanceSuppliers) WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY s.nation_name, o.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_acctbal, ps.total_supplycost, co.total_ordervalue, ol.total_lines FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ps ON ns.n_name = 'USA' JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_ordervalue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.total_ordervalue > 100000 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_lines FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON ol.total_lines > 5 ORDER BY ns.total_acctbal DESC, ps.total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(tr.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) tr ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) GROUP BY tr.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.c_mktsegment, ps.supplier_count, ps.total_revenue, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) o JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ps ON o.o_orderkey = ps.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ps.supplier_count > 0 ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, ps.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rc.r_name, rc.region_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(nc.nation_cost) AS region_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sd.total_cost) AS nation_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN nation n ON sd.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc JOIN nation n ON nc.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rc JOIN ( SELECT r_regionkey, MAX(region_cost) AS max_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(nc.nation_cost) AS region_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sd.total_cost) AS nation_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN nation n ON sd.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc JOIN nation n ON nc.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) GROUP BY r_regionkey ) max_rc ON rc.r_regionkey = max_rc.r_regionkey AND rc.region_cost = max_rc.max_cost ORDER BY rc.r_name;

SELECT r.s_name, r.nation, COUNT(DISTINCT h.o_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count, SUM(l.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.item_count) AS average_items_per_order FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 10000) h ON r.s_suppkey = h.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.s_name, r.nation ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, high_value_order_count DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue, r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT si.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(si.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2)) si JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) ps ON si.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 5000) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey) ol ON ps.ps_partkey = ol.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 5000) hvo ON ol.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY si.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.p_partkey, rs.p_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE') GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, pd.p_name, pd.avg_supply_cost, hvo.total_order_value, rs.r_name, rs.nation_count FROM (SELECT n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_suppkey) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) pd ON ns.s_suppkey = pd.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) hvo ON hvo.total_order_value > ns.total_supply_cost JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ON ns.n_name IN (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = ns.s_suppkey)) ORDER BY hvo.total_order_value DESC, pd.avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT tr.p_name, tr.total_revenue, sp.s_name, sp.supplier_account_balance, ro.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT sp.p_name, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 100) ol JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_type FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON ol.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey GROUP BY sp.p_name) tr JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_type FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON tr.p_name = sp.p_name JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro ON sp.ps_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE tr.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC, sp.supplier_account_balance ASC;

SELECT n.n_name as nation_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as total_revenue, avg(s.s_acctbal) as avg_supplier_balance, count(distinct o.o_orderkey) as total_orders FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, p.p_name, p.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, soc.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) soc JOIN supplier s ON soc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY soc.order_count DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY p.total_revenue DESC, ts.s_name ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.supplier_nation, s.total_supply_cost, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.total_spent, c.spending_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS monthly_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) WHERE r.monthly_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.p_name, sp.p_brand, sp.p_container, tr.r_name, tr.region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rw.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, o.o_orderkey) rw ON r.r_regionkey = rw.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON sp.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) ORDER BY tr.region_revenue DESC, sp.s_suppkey;

SELECT ts.supplier_nation, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.customer_nation, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_supply_cost, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT supplier_nation, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_nation ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as supplier_summary) ts JOIN (SELECT customer_nation, c_custkey, c_name, total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_nation ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS customer_nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) as customer_summary) tc ON ts.supplier_nation = tc.customer_nation WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5 AND tc.customer_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.supplier_nation, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name AS Customer_Name, s.s_name AS Supplier_Name, sp.total_purchases AS Total_Purchase_Amount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_quantity * l.l_extendedprice) AS total_purchases FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000) c JOIN lineitem l ON c.c_custkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 10) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, s.s_suppkey) sp JOIN customer c ON sp.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY c.c_name, s.s_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, r.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS AverageAccountBalance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC, TotalOrders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(ro.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value, MIN(ro.o_totalprice) AS min_order_value, STRING_AGG(CONCAT(ro.c_name, ' (', ro.o_orderkey, ')'), ', ') AS customer_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT rc.c_custkey, rc.c_name, rc.total_sales FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ts.sales) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ts ON o.o_orderkey = ts.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs) rc WHERE rc.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.total_sales DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipdate, p.p_brand, p.p_type, s.s_nationkey FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) li JOIN nation n ON li.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F') fo ON li.l_orderkey = fo.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'MAIL') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.r_name ASC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC, region_name, nation_name;

SELECT rd.o_orderkey, rd.o_orderdate, SUM(rd.total_revenue) AS order_revenue, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, sd.total_quantity, ps.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rd JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON rd.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey GROUP BY rd.o_orderkey, rd.o_orderdate, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, sd.total_quantity, ps.total_supplycost HAVING SUM(rd.total_revenue) > 10000 ORDER BY order_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderpriority, t.o_clerk, t.c_name AS customer_name, t.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_items_count FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank, c.c_name, s.s_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') WHERE order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderpriority, t.o_clerk, t.c_name, t.s_name ORDER BY t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, COUNT(*) AS order_count, AVG(t.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price, SUM(t.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) o WHERE o.rank_in_region <= 5) t GROUP BY t.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rr.r_name, rr.region_revenue, rr.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, tr.region_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tr.region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) tr JOIN region r ON tr.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rr WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rr.region_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_sales FROM (SELECT r_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue, COALESCE(c.c_name, 'N/A') AS customer_name, COALESCE(s.s_name, 'N/A') AS supplier_name, CASE WHEN o.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN o.total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r) o LEFT JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM orders WHERE o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hp.p_name, hp.p_brand, hp.total_available_qty, hp.total_supply_cost, co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_available_qty, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment) rp WHERE rp.brand_rank <= 5) hp JOIN lineitem l ON hp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' ORDER BY hp.total_available_qty DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avail_qty DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) WHERE avg_supply_cost < 100) hsp ON l.l_partkey = hsp.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.nation_name, rp.region_name, rp.total_orders, rp.avg_order_value, rp.total_net_sales, scd.s_name, scd.p_name, scd.ps_availqty, scd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(COALESCE(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount), 0)) AS total_net_sales FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, (ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) scd ON rp.total_orders > 1000 ORDER BY rp.total_net_sales DESC, scd.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.region, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT region, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RegionSuppliers) ts WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.region, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(COALESCE(ss.total_available, 0)) AS total_parts_available, SUM(COALESCE(lis.revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sum(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, avg(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.c_custkey = ss.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON cs.c_custkey = lis.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts LEFT JOIN orders o ON ts.s_name = o.o_clerk LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost ORDER BY ts.region_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_acctbal, od.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rnk <= 10) hvo JOIN (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, SUM(ROUND(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount), 2)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rnk <= 10) hvo JOIN lineitem l ON hvo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.nation_name, t.customer_name, SUM(t.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(t.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, cu.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN customer cu ON cu.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON cu.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t GROUP BY t.region_name, t.nation_name, t.customer_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_top_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT nation_name, s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ON n.n_name = ts.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_top_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT hr.c_name, tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, hr.total_spend FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cs.total_spend FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spend FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE cs.total_spend > (SELECT AVG(total_spend) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spend FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerSpend)) hr JOIN (SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs) tr ON tr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY hr.total_spend DESC, tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.n_name, rs.customer_count, rs.total_acctbal, ss.total_supplycost, ss.product_count, od.total_revenue, od.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS product_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss ON ss.total_supplycost > 100000.00 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) od ON od.lineitem_count > 10 ORDER BY rs.customer_count DESC, ss.product_count DESC, od.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT supplier_name, part_name, total_quantity, total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name, p.p_name, p.p_partkey) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY part_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT tso.region_name, tso.nation_name, tso.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) tso JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON tso.total_cost > co.total_spent ORDER BY tso.region_name, tso.nation_name, tso.total_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.r_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.total_supply_costs, (rs.total_revenue - rs.total_supply_costs) AS profit FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_revenue, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_costs FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs WHERE rs.total_revenue > 1000000 ORDER BY profit DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, hvi.p_name AS high_value_item, hvi.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent > 10000) tc JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 50000) hvi ON tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY hvi.total_supply_value DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(sos.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(sos.total_items) AS avg_items_per_order FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, os.total_revenue, os.total_items, os.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS total_items, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, c.c_mktsegment) os ON l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) sos JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON sos.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, total_orders, unique_customers, sales_rank, order_rank, customer_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, total_orders, unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_orders DESC) AS order_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY unique_customers DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 OR order_rank <= 5 OR customer_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, r.r_comment, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_quantity, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count, rs.avg_order_value, rs.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_quantity, total_revenue, order_count, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvl.l_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count, SUM(hvl.value) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS value FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) hvl JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, n.n_regionkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cr ON cr.c_custkey = hvl.l_orderkey JOIN region r ON cr.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, lis.total_line_items, lis.total_amount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_mfgr = 'ManufacturerA' ) ) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_line_items, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON cs.total_spent > 10000 AND lis.total_line_items > 5 WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ss.total_avail_qty ASC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT sod.s_suppkey, sod.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sod.o_orderdate) AS order_dates_count, SUM(sod.total_price) AS total_revenue, AVG(sod.parts_count) AS avg_parts_per_order FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, os.total_price, os.o_orderdate, os.parts_count FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS parts_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) sod GROUP BY sod.s_suppkey, sod.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts_sold FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND n.n_name IN ('Germany', 'France', 'USA') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count ASC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY sc.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, (ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = sc.ps_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) r WHERE r.rank <= 10) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ts.s_name, sos.order_count, sos.total_order_value FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE total_cost > 10000) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31') ro ON rs.s_suppkey = ro.l_suppkey GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey) sos JOIN (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE total_cost > 10000) ts ON sos.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey ORDER BY sos.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ORDER BY region_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ps.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.nation_name, pm.p_name AS part_name, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(li.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(li.l_discount) AS average_discount, AVG(li.l_tax) AS average_tax FROM lineitem li JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ps ON li.l_suppkey = ps.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pm ON li.l_partkey = pm.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY ps.s_name, ps.nation_name, pm.p_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, AVG(ld.l_extendedprice) AS AvgLineItemPrice, ts.s_name AS TopSupplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') co LEFT JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, lo.l_partkey, lo.l_quantity, lo.l_extendedprice, lo.l_discount FROM lineitem lo WHERE lo.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01') ld ON co.o_orderkey = ld.l_orderkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey ORDER BY rs.TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) ts GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name, ts.s_name HAVING COUNT(co.o_orderkey) > 5 AND SUM(co.o_totalprice) > 1000.00 ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC, TotalOrders DESC;

SELECT fc.c_name AS CustomerName, fc.c_acctbal AS CustomerAccountBalance, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost AS SupplierTotalCost, od.o_orderkey AS OrderNumber, od.o_orderdate AS OrderDate, od.o_totalprice AS OrderTotalPrice FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) FROM customer)) fc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs ON fc.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') od ON od.l_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < 100.00 ) WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 ORDER BY fc.c_name, rs.TotalCost DESC;
