SELECT f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, f.c_nationkey, f.s_name, CASE WHEN f.total_cost > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN f.total_cost > 5000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS order_value_category, SUM(f.total_cost) OVER (PARTITION BY f.o_orderkey) AS cumulative_order_cost FROM (SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_nationkey, s.s_name, s.total_quantity, ROUND(s.p_retailprice * s.total_quantity, 2) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_nationkey, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_retailprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_retailprice) s ON t.o_orderkey = s.ps_partkey) f ORDER BY f.o_orderdate DESC, f.c_nationkey, order_value_category;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(s.s_nationkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(s.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) s JOIN region r ON s.s_nationkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.rank <= 3) s JOIN region r ON s.s_nationkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.total_revenue > 0) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY n.n_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.o_orderpriority, COALESCE(od.revenue, 0) AS order_revenue, si.s_name, si.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo LEFT JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem li GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) si ON si.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY hvo.o_orderdate DESC, hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ss.s_suppkey, ss.part_count, ss.total_supply_cost, od.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ss.part_count > 5 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) od ON od.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, od.revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(lp.l_discount) AS average_discount, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT rp.p_name, ', ') AS high_value_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem lp ON ps.ps_partkey = lp.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2)) rp ON lp.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey WHERE rp.price_rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND n.n_name IN ('France', 'Germany', 'UK', 'USA') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r_name, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) ts JOIN region r ON ts.rank <= 3 WHERE ts.rank IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY r_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, tp.p_name AS part_name, tp.total_cost, rs.total_supply_value AS supplier_total_value, tr.total_sales AS region_total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS region_rank FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON tr.n_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS part_supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name) tp ON tp.supplier_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = tp.ps_partkey) WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 AND tr.region_rank <= 5 AND tp.part_supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC, rs.total_supply_value DESC, tp.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT RankedOrders.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(RankedOrders.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') JOIN nation n ON RankedOrders.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE RankedOrders.rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cr.revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cr.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rnk = 1 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr JOIN customer c ON cr.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) tc WHERE tc.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.revenue DESC;

SELECT sos.s_suppkey, sos.s_name, sos.total_order_value, COALESCE(spc.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, (sos.total_order_value - COALESCE(spc.total_supply_cost, 0)) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT tsl.s_suppkey, tsl.s_name, SUM(ol.l_quantity * ol.l_extendedprice) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, spc.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) spc JOIN supplier s ON spc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY spc.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tsl JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') ol ON tsl.s_suppkey = ol.l_suppkey GROUP BY tsl.s_suppkey, tsl.s_name) sos LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) spc ON sos.s_suppkey = spc.s_suppkey ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cos.c_custkey, cos.c_name, tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, tp.p_retailprice, tp.total_available_quantity, cos.total_spent, cos.total_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) cos JOIN (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, rp.total_available_quantity, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice) rp WHERE rp.rank <= 5) tp ON tp.total_available_quantity > 100 ORDER BY cos.total_spent DESC, tp.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, nr.nation_name, nr.total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as Revenue) nr ON n.n_name = nr.nation_name WHERE nr.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, nr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(usd.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(usd.total_revenue) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT usd.o_orderkey) AS unique_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) usd ON c.c_custkey = usd.c_custkey AND o.o_orderkey = usd.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs ON l.l_partkey = rs.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nations_count, SUM(A.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(A.total_sales) AS total_sales, SUM(S.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) A ON n.n_nationkey = A.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) S ON n.n_nationkey = S.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, COUNT(DISTINCT h.p_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(h.p_retailprice) AS total_retail_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, sc.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON p.p_partkey = sc.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2)) h ON l.l_partkey = h.p_partkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 100 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, total_retail_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, AVG(co.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer, SUM(dli.net_price) AS total_discounted_revenue, s.s_name AS top_supplier FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rank = 1 JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) * (1 + l.l_tax)) AS net_price FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) dli ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = dli.l_orderkey) GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.c_name, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderpriority, COUNT(lp.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, SUM(lp.total_extended_price) AS total_line_item_value, sp.total_available_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discount, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity) lp ON ro.o_orderkey = lp.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON lp.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10 GROUP BY ro.c_name, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderpriority, sp.total_available_qty, sp.total_supply_cost ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(ro.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value, MIN(ro.o_totalprice) AS min_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND (l.l_discount > 0.05 AND l.l_discount < 0.15)) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, c.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) ho JOIN orders o ON ho.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderpriority, t.o_clerk, t.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.o_clerk, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_clerk) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderpriority, t.o_clerk, t.total_revenue ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.total_supply_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ORDER BY s.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_value > 50000 WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND cast('1998-10-01' as date)) co GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name HAVING COUNT(co.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, tp.p_name, tp.part_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) r JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, pr.part_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS part_revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) pr JOIN part p ON pr.p_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY pr.part_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON r.nation_name = 'FRANCE' ORDER BY tp.part_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation, total_revenue, order_count, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT nation, total_revenue, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueData) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, total_supply_cost, total_parts_supplied, total_orders, total_spent, avg_order_value, r_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT sp.s_name, sp.s_acctbal, sp.total_supply_cost, sp.total_parts_supplied, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value, tr.r_name, tr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_name, s_acctbal) sp JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) cos ON sp.total_parts_supplied > 10 JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) tr ON sp.total_supply_cost > 1000) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.region_name, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS NationName, r.r_name AS RegionName, AVG(cs.TotalSpent) AS AvgCustomerSpending, AVG(ss.TotalCost) AS AvgSupplierCost, SUM(s.Revenue) AS TotalSalesRevenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS PartCount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s_nationkey FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue, o.o_orderpriority FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, o.o_orderpriority) s ON s.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY TotalSalesRevenue DESC, AvgCustomerSpending DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_customer_spending, r.nation_count, SUM(so.order_count) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_custkey IS NOT NULL THEN cs.total_spent ELSE 0 END) AS total_customer_spending, COUNT(DISTINCT ns.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON ns.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) so ON so.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE CAST(s.s_comment AS TEXT) LIKE '%special%' ) GROUP BY r.r_name, r.total_customer_spending, r.nation_count ORDER BY r.total_customer_spending DESC, r.nation_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.supplier_name, r.p_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 AND l.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.1) r WHERE r.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_ordered_quantity, AVG(o.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_order DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, ro.part_count, ro.c_mktsegment, sr.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, os.part_count, os.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY os.c_mktsegment ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS part_count, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment) os) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sr ON ro.part_count > 10 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.c_mktsegment, ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_revenue, t.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, a.total_revenue, a.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t ON l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) a ON s.s_suppkey = a.ps_suppkey) t WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co WHERE co.total_revenue > 10000) tc JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey) rs WHERE rs.rank = 1) ts ON tc.c_custkey = ts.s_suppkey ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC, ts.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ra.region_name, AVG(sd.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost, SUM(ra.total_customer_revenue) AS total_revenue_by_region, COUNT(DISTINCT ra.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM (SELECT os.o_custkey, cd.c_name, cd.region_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, c.c_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) cd ON os.o_custkey = cd.c_custkey GROUP BY os.o_custkey, cd.c_name, cd.region_name) ra JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON ra.o_custkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY ra.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue_by_region DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.customer_name, hvo.o_totalprice, od.total_revenue, od.item_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.customer_name, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) hvo JOIN (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.customer_name, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) hvo JOIN lineitem l ON hvo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC, od.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, f.c_name, f.total_revenue, f.avg_quantity, f.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, l.total_revenue, l.avg_quantity, l.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') r JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS lineitem_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.rn <= 5) f ORDER BY f.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.c_name, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, sc.total_supply_cost, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) - COALESCE(sc.total_supply_cost, 0) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON ro.o_orderkey = (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#44') LIMIT 1) WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.c_name, sc.total_supply_cost ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN orders o ON t.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, s.s_name ORDER BY o.o_orderdate, total_extended_price DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT nation_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, SUM(s.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_costs FROM (SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderpriority, t.c_name, t.nation_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') WHERE order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey )) o JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ) GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY orders_count DESC, average_order_value DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS TopSupplierName, ts.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS PriceRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.TotalSupplyCost, ss.UniquePartsSupplied, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.TotalSupplyCost DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.UniquePartsSupplied > 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ro.PriceRank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate, ts.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_sales_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) sd LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) os ON sd.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey WHERE sd.total_supply_cost > 10000 GROUP BY sd.nation_name, sd.region_name ORDER BY total_sales_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent, co.order_count, oli.total_revenue, oli.item_count, psi.total_available, psi.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(li.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM lineitem li WHERE li.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) oli ON co.c_custkey = oli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) psi ON oli.l_orderkey = psi.ps_partkey WHERE co.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, co.order_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.n_name, t.n_regionkey, ol.total_revenue, ol.line_item_count FROM (SELECT t.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey) ol JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t ON ol.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, line_item_count DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.total_revenue, s.s_name AS top_supplier, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueByNation) t JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size < 20) JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE t.rank <= 5 GROUP BY t.nation_name, t.total_revenue, s.s_name ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.avg_supply_cost, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_available_qty DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) ts JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) tc ON ts.rn = tc.rn WHERE ts.rn <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_available_qty DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size BETWEEN 1 AND 20 GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, ps.total_supply_cost, rs.nation_count, rs.average_account_balance FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ps JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(distinct n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs ON ps.p_partkey = rs.nation_count JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey WHERE ps.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) as PartSupplierCosts) ORDER BY rs.average_account_balance DESC, ps.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ss.nation_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, os.c_name AS customer_name, os.order_total, os.item_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) os ON ss.part_count > os.item_count ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC, os.order_total DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.nation_name, r.total_revenue, r.order_count, r.revenue_rank, p.p_brand, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as revenue_summary) r JOIN partsupp ps ON r.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.nation_name, r.total_revenue, r.order_count, r.revenue_rank, p.p_brand ORDER BY r.revenue_rank;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.Region, t.Nation, COUNT(DISTINCT t.Supplier) AS TopSupplierCount, SUM(t.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalTopSupplierCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, rs.s_name AS Supplier, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 3) t GROUP BY t.Region, t.Nation ORDER BY TotalTopSupplierCost DESC, t.Region, t.Nation;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.nation_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.unique_parts_count, cos.c_name AS customer_name, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON ss.total_supply_cost > cos.total_spent ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC, cos.avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.revenue, si.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ts.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si ON n.n_nationkey = si.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT l_partkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey) ts ON ts.l_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = si.s_suppkey LIMIT 1) GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si ON ns.n_nationkey = si.s_nationkey ORDER BY ns.revenue DESC, si.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.total_orders, t.total_revenue, t.avg_order_value, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation r ON ro.c_nationkey = r.n_nationkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.n_name) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON ss.ps_partkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = t.nation_name)) ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, t.nation_name ASC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.total_orders, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT r.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, o.o_orderkey AS order_key, o.o_totalprice AS order_total, o.o_orderdate AS order_date, o.line_item_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.s_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_totalprice > 5000 GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate) o ON r.rnk <= 5 JOIN nation n ON r.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY n.n_name, r.s_name, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_name) AS number_of_top_suppliers, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank = 1) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY total_cost_of_top_suppliers DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.ps_supplycost, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, sn.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) as rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 20.00) rp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON rp.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost = rp.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sn ON rp.ps_supplycost = (SELECT min(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2 WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey) WHERE rp.rnk = 1 GROUP BY rp.p_name, rp.ps_supplycost, sn.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rr.r_name, rr.region_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rr.region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rb.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rb ON s.s_suppkey = rb.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rr WHERE rr.region_revenue > 1000000 ORDER BY rr.region_revenue DESC;

SELECT f.c_name, f.total_spent, f.p_name, f.total_order_value FROM (SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, ps.p_name, SUM(owi.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey AS custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) owi ON tc.custkey = owi.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ps ON owi.o_orderkey = ps.p_partkey WHERE tc.rank <= 5 GROUP BY tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, ps.p_name) f ORDER BY f.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, COALESCE(SUM(od.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_order_value), 0) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON co.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey) od ON co.c_custkey = od.c_custkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON co.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE co.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND co.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cn.n_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_revenue, cs.customer_value, rp.p_name, rp.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_acctbal DESC LIMIT 5) cn JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, coalesce(ro.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN ro.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN ro.total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS customer_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey) cs ON cn.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.avg_supplycost, ps.supplier_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.avg_supplycost DESC) as cost_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.p_partkey) rp ON rp.cost_rank <= 10 WHERE cs.total_revenue > 5000 ORDER BY cs.total_revenue DESC, rp.avg_supplycost ASC;

SELECT rp.p_name, tr.r_name, tr.supplier_count, tr.total_supplier_balance, rp.total_inventory_value FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_inventory_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 5) tr ON tr.total_supplier_balance > 10000 JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE rp.rank <= 10 ORDER BY tr.total_supplier_balance DESC, rp.total_inventory_value DESC;

SELECT t.revenue_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT t.o_orderkey) AS count_of_orders, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated, AVG(t.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.rank_order <= 5) t GROUP BY t.revenue_rank ORDER BY t.revenue_rank;

SELECT ns.n_name, sd.s_name, sd.total_value, co.total_spending FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON ns.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE sd.total_value > (SELECT AVG(total_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierDetails) ORDER BY ns.n_name, sd.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, sp.p_name, sp.total_available_quantity, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) WHERE r.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, COUNT(t.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(t.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(p.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') WHERE rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem li ON t.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp p ON li.l_partkey = p.ps_partkey GROUP BY t.nation_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT ts.c_mktsegment, ts.avg_revenue, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT c_mktsegment, AVG(total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c_mktsegment) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.c_mktsegment = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY ts.c_mktsegment, ts.avg_revenue, r.r_name ORDER BY ts.avg_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE rp.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rc.c_name, rc.total_spent, hvs.s_name AS high_value_supplier, pbr.r_name, pbr.product_count, pbr.avg_retail_price FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvs ON rc.rank <= 10 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS product_count, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_retail_price FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) pbr ON pbr.product_count > 5 ORDER BY rc.total_spent DESC, hvs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Asia%' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sc.NationName, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.c_custkey) AS CustomerCount, SUM(sc.TotalSpent) AS TotalCustomerSpent, SUM(sc.TotalCost) AS TotalSupplierCost FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, cd.c_custkey, cd.TotalSpent, sd.TotalCost, nd.n_name AS NationName FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cd ON sd.TotalCost > cd.TotalSpent JOIN nation na ON sd.s_nationkey = na.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nd ON na.n_nationkey = nd.n_nationkey) sc GROUP BY sc.NationName ORDER BY CustomerCount DESC, TotalCustomerSpent DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_value) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, nation.n_name AS nation_name, ranked.s_name AS supplier_name, ranked.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ranked JOIN nation ON ranked.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON nation.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ranked.rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY ts.region_name, total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS latest_order_date FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT so.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT so.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(so.total_order_value) AS total_order_value, AVG(so.total_order_value) AS avg_order_value, SUM(so.distinct_parts) AS total_distinct_parts, SO.order_status_description FROM (SELECT sc.s_suppkey, od.o_orderkey, od.total_order_value, od.distinct_parts, od.order_status_description FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts, o.o_orderstatus, CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN 'Finalized' ELSE 'Pending' END AS order_status_description FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey) so GROUP BY so.s_suppkey, so.order_status_description ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, number_of_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.s_name, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_orderstatus, t.total_revenue, s.s_name AS top_supplier, s.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_status FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o WHERE rank_status <= 10) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON t.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_status FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o WHERE rank_status <= 10) as TopStatusOrders) ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(rs.total_orders) AS avg_orders_per_supplier, SUM(rs.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_by_region FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_revenue, s.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_by_region DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, tc.c_name, tc.customer_sales, tc.sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, cs.customer_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.customer_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) tc ON tc.customer_sales > 10000 ORDER BY rs.region_name, tc.sales_rank;
