SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_value, SUM(tp.total_cost) AS total_part_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) ns ON ro.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_nationkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON tp.ps_partkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name ORDER BY total_value DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, nc.nation_total_cost, CASE WHEN nc.nation_total_cost > (SELECT AVG(nation_total_cost) FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS nation_total_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) as NationCosts) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS cost_comparison FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS nation_total_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc JOIN nation n ON nc.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE nc.nation_total_cost > 10000 ORDER BY nc.nation_total_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.r_name AS region_name, ts.n_name AS nation_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey ORDER BY ts.r_name, ts.n_name, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT h.region_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, AVG(h.total_supply_cost) AS avg_total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.supply_rank <= 3) h GROUP BY h.region_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(tc.total_sale) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, ro.total_sale FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sale, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.rank <= 5) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ts.total_parts, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_parts, ss.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_parts > 10 ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON co.order_count > 5 WHERE ts.total_cost > 5000 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, ts.total_parts DESC;

SELECT h.s_name, h.s_address, h.s_phone, co.c_name, co.order_count FROM (SELECT s_total.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s_total.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) s_total JOIN supplier s ON s_total.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s_total.total_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierTotals )) h JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON h.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' ) ) ORDER BY h.total_cost DESC, co.order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.r_name, h.n_name, h.c_custkey, h.c_name, sr.s_name AS top_supplier, sr.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) h JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs) sr ON sr.rank = 1 WHERE h.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as HighAccountBalance);

SELECT fb.p_name, fb.avg_price, fb.s_name, fb.total_sales FROM (SELECT rp.p_name, rp.avg_price, ss.s_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) ss ON rp.p_partkey = ss.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) rs ON ss.s_suppkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey)) fb ORDER BY fb.total_sales DESC, fb.avg_price ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, CASE WHEN sales_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top 5 Region' ELSE 'Other Region' END AS sales_category FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.total_quantity, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.total_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, s.s_name, p.p_name, r.r_name, t.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN orders o ON t.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_supply_value, nc.customer_count, nc.total_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_order_value FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nc ON ns.n_name = nc.n_name ORDER BY ns.n_name, nc.customer_count DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT si.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(si.total_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(p.ps_supplycost * h.l_extendedprice * (1 - h.l_discount)) AS total_cost FROM partsupp p JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10) h ON p.ps_partkey = h.l_partkey JOIN supplier s ON p.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si JOIN nation n ON si.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.nation_total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts_count, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * l.l_discount) AS total_discounted_amount FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) tro JOIN orders o ON tro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, o.o_orderstatus, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sd.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 ) GROUP BY r.r_name, o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY r.r_name, o.o_orderstatus;

SELECT cd.c_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lis.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_custkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Germany', 'Japan')) cd ON ro.o_custkey = cd.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON ro.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ro.o_totalprice > 1000 GROUP BY cd.c_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_orders_value, r.total_orders, r.sales_rank, r.supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, cs.total_orders_value, cs.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_orders_value DESC) AS sales_rank, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_available_qty DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS distinct_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS total_fulfilled_orders_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON s.s_suppkey = cs.c_custkey) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10 OR r.supply_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.sales_rank, r.supply_rank;

SELECT nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_quantity, total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as SupplierOrderSummary) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, AVG(total_order_value) AS average_order_value, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_sum FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.total_order_value, nr.region_name, nr.nation_name, sc.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, n.n_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, n.n_nationkey) co JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON co.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON co.n_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey LIMIT 1) WHERE co.total_order_value > 10000) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, ro.c_name, ro.total_amount, sp.total_qty, sp.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey)) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ro ON rs.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON rs.s_suppkey = sp.ps_suppkey WHERE rs.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY rs.nation_name, rs.s_acctbal DESC, ro.total_amount DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(pc.adjusted_price) AS total_adjusted_revenue, AVG(rs.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT od.o_orderkey, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS adjusted_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey) pc ON rs.s_suppkey = pc.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') od ON pc.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY rs.region_name, rs.nation_name ORDER BY total_adjusted_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.rank AS supplier_rank, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.rank AS customer_rank, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_cost AS supplier_total_cost, tc.total_spent AS customer_total_spent, ts.avg_supplycost AS supplier_avg_supplycost, ts.total_parts AS supplier_total_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.total_parts, ss.avg_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_parts > 0) ts JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co WHERE co.total_spent > 0) tc ON ts.rank <= 10 AND tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.rank, tc.rank;

SELECT ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, MAX(ts.total_supply_cost) AS max_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) AS overall_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_regionkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, sp.p_name, sp.s_name, sp.s_acctbal, sp.ps_supplycost, o.net_revenue, o.line_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') r JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_name LIKE '%Supplier%')) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) o ON r.o_orderkey = o.l_orderkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_orderkey;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ts.n_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(sp.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, s.s_nationkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey) sp JOIN nation n ON sp.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = ts.n_name ) WHERE ro.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t.c_mktsegment, t.segment_revenue, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(total_revenue) AS segment_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN customer c ON r.c_name = c.c_name WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) t JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = t.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#123') JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY t.c_mktsegment, t.segment_revenue, r.r_name ORDER BY t.segment_revenue DESC;

SELECT d.o_orderkey, d.o_totalprice, d.c_name, d.c_acctbal, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, p.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, l.l_quantity, l.l_discount, l.l_extendedprice FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') d JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) s ON d.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) as TopSuppliers) JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ld.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem ld ON p.p_partkey = ld.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand HAVING SUM(ld.l_extendedprice) > 1000) p ON d.l_quantity > 10 ORDER BY d.o_orderkey, p.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_line_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND p.p_size >= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, tor.o_orderkey, tor.o_orderdate, tor.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT rank.o_orderkey, rank.o_orderdate, rank.o_totalprice, rank.o_orderstatus, rank.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus) rank WHERE rank.revenue_rank <= 10) tor JOIN customer c ON tor.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 50000 ORDER BY tor.o_orderdate DESC, tor.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal, r.c_mktsegment, ts.total_revenue, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal AS supplier_acctbal, sd.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') r INNER JOIN (SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, p.p_brand FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_brand) ts ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) sd ON r.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND sd.s_acctbal > r.c_acctbal WHERE r.rn <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.total_available_qty, rp.avg_supply_cost, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, tr.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_orders > 10 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(n.n_nationkey) > 5) tr ON co.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = tr.r_regionkey)) WHERE rp.rnk <= 5 ORDER BY rp.total_available_qty DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.c_name, od.total_revenue, psd.p_name, psd.supply_cost, (od.total_revenue - psd.supply_cost) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) od JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name) psd ON psd.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey IN ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey IN ( SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'Asia' ) ) ) ) ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.total_revenue, tp.supplier_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, rb.total_revenue, ps.supplier_count FROM part p JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) rb ON rb.total_revenue > 1000000 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY rb.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tp ORDER BY tp.supplier_count DESC, tp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_account_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, average_supplier_account_balance DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, os.total_orders, os.order_count, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, rs.total_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON os.c_nationkey = rs.nation_count LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE rs.total_supplier_balance > 10000 ORDER BY rs.total_supplier_balance DESC, os.total_orders DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalTotals) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS num_customers, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_revenue, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey % (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM nation) WHERE rs.rn <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.c_name, sp.s_name, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, os.total_price, os.item_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_regionkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'Europe')) cr JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON cr.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00) sp ON os.item_count > 0 AND sp.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 50 ) ORDER BY os.total_price DESC, cr.c_name ASC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.supplier_count, ps.avg_supplycost, os.total_revenue FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM nation_suppliers ns JOIN nation n ON ns.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ns.s_acctbal * 1.1) ns JOIN nation n ON ns.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ns.s_acctbal * 1.1) ns ON ps.ps_suppkey = ns.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.total_revenue > ps.avg_supplycost * 1000 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT sh.supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers, SUM(oss.total_spent) AS total_customer_spending, SUM(lis.number_of_items) AS total_items_ordered, SUM(lis.total_value) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) AND ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 500)) sh JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) oss ON sh.supplier_nation = oss.c_name JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS number_of_items, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON oss.c_custkey = lis.l_orderkey GROUP BY sh.supplier_nation ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT f.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, SUM(f.l_extendedprice * (1 - f.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS mkt_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.*, p.p_name, s.s_name FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate <= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '30 days' AND l.l_discount > 0.05) f ON r.o_orderkey = f.l_orderkey WHERE r.mkt_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_mktsegment ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(sd.total_sales) AS total_sales, SUM(sd.order_count) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) sd ON n.n_name = sd.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rs WHERE rs.total_sales > 1000000 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT od.customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(od.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(od.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name AS customer_name, l.l_partkey, p.p_name, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.s_acctbal FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rn <= 5) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31') od GROUP BY od.customer_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_sales, os.unique_suppliers, os.unique_parts, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-02-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN lineitem l ON os.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sd ON l.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey ORDER BY os.total_sales DESC, os.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT fr.s_suppkey, fr.s_name, fr.total_sales_by_supplier FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, SUM(os.total_sales) AS total_sales_by_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers )) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) os ON os.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name) fr ORDER BY fr.total_sales_by_supplier DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, s.total_supply_revenue, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_supply_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.rank <= 10) hro ON l.l_orderkey = hro.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s JOIN supplier sup ON s.s_suppkey = sup.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON sup.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.total_supply_revenue > 1000000 ORDER BY s.total_supply_revenue DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, ts.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(rl.total_revenue) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey) rl ON s.s_suppkey = rl.l_suppkey WHERE rl.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON ts.supplier_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY cs.total_orders DESC, cs.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(ro.total_revenue) AS avg_order_revenue, MAX(ts.total_supply_cost) AS max_supplier_cost, SUM(hv.total_account_balance) AS national_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost = (SELECT MAX(ts2.total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts2) JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) hv ON n.n_nationkey = hv.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT rp.p_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, co.c_name AS top_customer, rp.total_cost, ts.total_available, co.total_orders, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON ts.supplier_rank = 1 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_orders = (SELECT MAX(total_orders) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders) WHERE rp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.total_cost DESC, ts.total_available DESC;

SELECT a.nation_name, a.customer_count, a.total_spending, a.total_supplier_costs, ROUND(a.total_spending / NULLIF(a.customer_count, 0), 2) AS avg_spending_per_customer FROM (SELECT ns.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.customer_key) AS customer_count, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_spending, SUM(ns.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_costs FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_suppkey AS supplier_key, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey AS customer_key, c.c_name AS customer_name, count(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ns.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = cs.customer_key)) GROUP BY ns.nation_name) a ORDER BY a.total_spending DESC;

SELECT spd.s_suppkey, spd.s_name, spd.total_supply_cost, spd.part_count, spd.region_name, cod.c_custkey, cod.c_name, cod.total_order_value, cod.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name) spd JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cod ON spd.part_count >= 5 ORDER BY spd.total_supply_cost DESC, cod.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.net_order_value) AS total_net_value, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, MAX(s.total_supply_cost) AS max_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.supplier_nation = n.n_name JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_order_value, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) o ON n.n_nationkey = o.o_custkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_net_value DESC;

SELECT tc.n_name, tc.c_mktsegment, SUM(tc.total_revenue) AS sum_total_revenue FROM (SELECT rc.c_nationkey AS n_name, rc.c_mktsegment, rc.total_revenue, rc.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment) rc WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 10) tc GROUP BY tc.n_name, tc.c_mktsegment ORDER BY sum_total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ts.s_name, ts.total_available, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS priority_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_available, ss.total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank_by_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.total_available > 0) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ts.rank_by_cost <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supplycost, co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) WHERE part_count > 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON ts.part_count > 10 WHERE ts.total_supplycost > 50000 ORDER BY ts.rank, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON r.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey = ts.s_suppkey) ) WHERE r.rn <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.region_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_regionkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT nation_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2) ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, sa.s_name AS supplier_name, ca.c_name AS customer_name, COALESCE(SUM(sd.revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(MAX(ca.total_spent), 0) AS max_customer_spent, COALESCE(SUM(sa.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa ON s.s_suppkey = sa.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ca ON sa.s_suppkey = ca.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderdate FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) sd ON ca.c_custkey = sd.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, sa.s_name, ca.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, max_customer_spent DESC, total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT o.order_rank, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.total_spent, s.s_name AS supplier_name, t.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') o JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON o.o_orderkey = c.order_count JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) t ON t.total_cost > 10000 JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = t.s_suppkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, t.total_cost ASC;

SELECT os.c_name, os.total_spent, os.order_count, t.s_name AS top_supplier, t.s_acctbal AS supplier_balance, ps.p_name AS product_name, ps.total_available, ps.total_value FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) os JOIN (SELECT rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s_name, s_acctbal, n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) t ON os.total_spent > t.s_acctbal JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) ps ON t.s_name LIKE CONCAT('%', ps.p_name, '%') WHERE os.order_count > 10 ORDER BY os.total_spent DESC, t.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC, average_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_available_qty, rs.total_supply_cost, cos.total_orders_value, cos.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F'))) WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'O' THEN o.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS total_open_order_value, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS total_air_shipping, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM customer AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, nation_name;

SELECT r.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.s_suppkey) AS suppliers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS parts_count, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_last_year FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) p ON p.total_value > 100000 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey) GROUP BY r.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue_last_year DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-02-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT region, nation, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, rs.nation, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) GROUP BY region, nation ORDER BY region, total_cost DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, s.s_name, T.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, r.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) T JOIN lineitem l ON T.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 ORDER BY T.total_revenue DESC, s.s_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(nr.total_nation_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sos ON n.n_nationkey = sos.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nr ON n.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sp.s_name, sp.p_name, tr.r_name, tr.region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os JOIN customer c ON os.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON sp.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' ) ORDER BY tr.region_revenue DESC, sp.ps_supplycost ASC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT hvc.c_name AS customer_name, hvc.order_count, hvc.total_revenue, sr.s_name AS supplier_name, sr.total_spend FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_revenue > 10000) hvc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_spend FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_spend FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_spend > 50000) sr ON hvc.total_revenue > sr.total_spend) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_spend DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.c_mktsegment, o.revenue, o.total_supply_cost, o.net_profit FROM (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.c_mktsegment, os.revenue, sp.total_supply_cost, (os.revenue - sp.total_supply_cost) AS net_profit FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) os LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON os.supplier_count = sp.ps_suppkey ORDER BY net_profit DESC) o WHERE o.net_profit > 0 LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, p.p_brand AS part_brand, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) AS high_value_customers FROM lineitem lp JOIN orders o ON lp.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) p ON lp.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ct.customer_total FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS customer_total FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) ct ON c.c_custkey = ct.c_custkey WHERE ct.customer_total > 10000) hvc ON c.c_custkey = hvc.c_custkey WHERE lp.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, p.p_brand ORDER BY region_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, oc.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RevenueBySupplier)) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) oc ON ts.s_suppkey = oc.c_custkey ORDER BY oc.order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.part_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_ordered_value FROM (SELECT sps.s_suppkey, sps.s_name, sps.total_supply_cost, sps.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sps.total_supply_cost DESC) as supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sps) ts JOIN orders o ON ts.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.part_count ORDER BY total_ordered_value DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count, r.r_name AS supplier_region, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) as sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;
