SELECT h.s_suppkey, h.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, h.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region_name ORDER BY s.total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) s) h JOIN region r ON h.region_name = r.r_name WHERE h.cost_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, h.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN r.r_regionkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_regions, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_spent), 0) AS total_revenue_from_top_customers, s.total_parts_supplied FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) t ON c.c_custkey = t.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps) GROUP BY r.r_name, s.total_parts_supplied ORDER BY total_revenue_from_top_customers DESC, region;

SELECT nation, region, total_cost, order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) WHERE total_cost > 0 ORDER BY region, total_cost DESC;

SELECT nation_name, s_name, total_revenue, total_items FROM (SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(od.total_items) AS total_items FROM (SELECT rn, s_suppkey, s_name, nation_name, s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rn <= 3) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON od.total_items > 0 GROUP BY ts.nation_name, ts.s_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_items DESC;

SELECT hr.Nation, hr.Revenue, hr.RevenueCategory, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.p_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied, SUM(sc.SuppCount) AS TotalSuppliers FROM (SELECT tr.Nation, tr.Revenue, CASE WHEN tr.Revenue > 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN tr.Revenue BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS RevenueCategory FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) tr) hr LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SuppCount FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) sc ON hr.Nation = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY hr.Nation, hr.Revenue, hr.RevenueCategory ORDER BY hr.Revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ts.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_regionkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, ts.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, region_name, c.c_name LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, unique_customers, order_count, total_sales / NULLIF(unique_customers, 0) AS avg_sales_per_customer, total_sales / NULLIF(order_count, 0) AS avg_sales_per_order FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice, sp.s_name, sp.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON c.c_custkey = ( SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey )) co JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON co.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-05-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-05-01' ) ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, sp.TotalSupplyCost ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_acctbal ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, hv.nation_total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS nation_total_spent FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) hv ON hv.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, hv.nation_total_spent ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, s.s_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, cs.customer_sales, (rs.total_sales - COALESCE(cs.customer_sales, 0)) AS sales_difference FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS customer_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON rs.region_name = ( SELECT r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey ) ORDER BY rs.region_name;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT avg_sales FROM (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) as AvgSales)) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') co JOIN lineitem li ON co.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers) ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_shipdate > co.o_orderdate ORDER BY co.o_orderdate, co.c_custkey;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(total_supply_value) AS region_total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ON o.o_custkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, tn.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(tn.total_account_balance) AS avg_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(s.s_acctbal) > 100000) tn ON n.n_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro ON tn.n_nationkey = (SELECT n2.n_nationkey FROM nation n2 JOIN supplier s2 ON n2.n_nationkey = s2.s_nationkey WHERE s2.s_acctbal > 100000) GROUP BY r.r_name, tn.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_lineitem_price, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Eastern%' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND l.l_discount > 0.05 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, nation_name;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_available_quantity, ts.unique_parts_supplied, ts.avg_supply_cost, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.unique_parts_supplied, ss.avg_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_available_quantity DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN (SELECT cus.c_custkey, cus.c_name, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cos.total_spent DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos JOIN customer cus ON cos.c_custkey = cus.c_custkey) tc ON ts.rnk = 1 AND tc.rnk <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_available_quantity DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(oo.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) oo JOIN customer c ON oo.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE oo.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(SC.total_supply_cost) AS regional_total_supply_cost, COC.order_count, LBS.lineitem_count, LBS.total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) SC ON s.s_suppkey = SC.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) COC ON COC.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_returnflag, COUNT(*) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_returnflag) LBS ON l.l_returnflag = LBS.l_returnflag WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY r.r_name, COC.order_count, LBS.lineitem_count, LBS.total_revenue ORDER BY regional_total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.RegionName, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS UniqueCustomerCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrdersValue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalSupplyValue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyValue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS RankInRegion FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey)) WHERE rs.RankInRegion <= 3) ts JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = (SELECT rs.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyValue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS RankInRegion FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE ts.SupplierName = rs.s_name LIMIT 1)) JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY ts.RegionName ORDER BY TotalOrdersValue DESC;

SELECT lo.o_orderkey, lo.total_order_value, ts.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) lo JOIN lineitem l ON lo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier WHERE s_acctbal IS NOT NULL)) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey ORDER BY lo.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_lineitem_price, MAX(l.l_quantity) AS max_lineitem_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE n.n_name LIKE 'N%' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, orders_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rn.rank, rn.n_name, rn.nation_total_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, nc.nation_total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY nc.nation_total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS nation_total_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sc ON n.n_nationkey = sc.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc ON n.n_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey) rn WHERE rn.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rn.rank;

SELECT R.s_name AS supplier_name, R.total_supply_cost, T.n_name AS nation_name, P.p_name AS part_name, P.supplier_count, P.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) R JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000) T ON R.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = T.n_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COUNT(ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) P ON P.supplier_count > 5 WHERE R.total_supply_cost > 50000 ORDER BY R.total_supply_cost DESC, T.total_revenue DESC, P.avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT s.s_name, o.o_orderpriority, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank_within_priority FROM (SELECT ts.s_name, os.o_orderpriority, SUM(os.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderpriority FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderpriority) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_name, os.o_orderpriority) s JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderpriority FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderpriority) o ON s.o_orderpriority = o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_orderpriority, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.total_supply_quantity, cs.total_customer_spending, (cs.total_customer_spending / NULLIF(cs.total_supply_quantity, 0)) AS avg_spending_per_supply FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(sd.total_availqty) AS total_supply_quantity, SUM(cd.total_order_value) AS total_customer_spending FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) cd JOIN customer c ON cd.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sd ON c.c_custkey = sd.ps_partkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs WHERE cs.total_supply_quantity > 0 ORDER BY avg_spending_per_supply DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT si.s_name, si.nation_name, pi.p_name, pi.p_brand, os.total_sales, os.items_count, os.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_address, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) si JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice < 100) pi ON si.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = pi.p_partkey LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS items_count, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON si.s_suppkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) ORDER BY os.total_sales DESC, si.nation_name, pi.p_retailprice LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.nation_name, COUNT(rs.c_custkey) AS num_top_customers, SUM(rs.total_sales) AS total_sales_sum, AVG(rs.total_sales) AS avg_sales_per_top_customer FROM (SELECT sd.c_custkey, sd.c_name, sd.nation_name, sd.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.nation_name ORDER BY sd.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) sd) rs JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT nation_name FROM (SELECT sd.c_custkey, sd.c_name, sd.nation_name, sd.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.nation_name ORDER BY sd.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) sd) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) r ON rs.nation_name = r.nation_name GROUP BY r.nation_name ORDER BY total_sales_sum DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_revenue) AS total_national_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rb.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rb.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rb JOIN supplier s ON rb.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name ORDER BY total_national_revenue DESC;

SELECT tso.o_orderkey, tso.o_orderdate, tso.o_totalprice, tso.o_orderstatus, tso.c_name, tso.c_mktsegment, lis.total_revenue, lis.total_items FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_name, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') ro WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) tso JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(lo.l_orderkey) AS total_items FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) lis ON tso.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey ORDER BY tso.o_orderdate DESC, tso.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, co.order_count, co.total_order_value, ps.total_available_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON rs.nation_count > 5 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.total_available_qty > 100 ORDER BY rs.region_name, co.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.customer_count, SUM(sp.total_available_qty) AS total_parts_available, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_value, SUM(co.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sp ON ns.n_nationkey = sp.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY ns.n_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.customer_count ORDER BY ns.n_name;

SELECT t.r_name AS region_name, t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_brand FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_brand) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank_within_brand <= 5) t ORDER BY t.r_name, t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity_per_order FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT mo.o_orderkey, mo.o_orderdate, mo.o_totalprice, mo.c_name AS customer_name, hs.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o WHERE o.rnk <= 5) mo JOIN lineitem l ON mo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.ps_suppkey WHERE ss.total_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) as SupplierSummary )) hs ON ps.ps_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON mo.c_name = cs.c_name ORDER BY mo.o_orderdate DESC, mo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rr.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(rr.total_sales) AS avg_sales, MAX(rr.order_count) AS max_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rr JOIN supplier s ON rr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_revenue FROM (SELECT sr.s_suppkey, sr.s_name, sr.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, os.total_order_value, os.o_orderkey FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, os.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, MAX(rs.total_cost) AS max_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') co ON s.s_nationkey = co.o_orderkey WHERE rs.rnk = 1 AND co.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.o_orderkey, rn.o_orderdate, rn.o_totalprice, tn.n_name AS nation_name, rn.c_name AS customer_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') rn JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 100) tn ON rn.o_orderkey = rn.o_orderkey WHERE rn.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tn.order_count DESC, rn.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders_value, ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS top_suppliers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_orders_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('MAIL', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, nt.n_name AS nation_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, COALESCE(SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation nt ON r.r_regionkey = nt.n_regionkey JOIN supplier ts ON nt.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, nt.n_name, cs.c_name, ts.s_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_size, p.p_mfgr, AVG(rc.total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) rc ON p.p_partkey = rc.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey HAVING COUNT(l.l_orderkey) > 100) pp ON pp.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 5 GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_size, p.p_mfgr ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT m.c_mktsegment, m.order_count, m.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.s_name) as supplier_count, AVG(sp.ps_supplycost) as avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT h.c_mktsegment, h.order_count, h.total_revenue, sp.p_name, sp.ps_supplycost, sp.s_name FROM (SELECT r.c_mktsegment, COUNT(*) as order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) as total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.rn <= 10 GROUP BY r.c_mktsegment) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp ON h.c_mktsegment = sp.p_name) m LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp ON m.p_name = sp.p_name GROUP BY m.c_mktsegment, m.order_count, m.total_revenue ORDER BY m.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nh.region_name, nh.n_name AS nation_name, si.s_name AS supplier_name, si.supplied_parts, si.total_acctbal, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, 0 AS depth FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_comment LIKE '%supplier%') UNION ALL SELECT nh.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, nh.depth + 1 FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, 0 AS depth FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_comment LIKE '%supplier%') UNION ALL SELECT nh.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, nh.depth + 1 FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN nation_hierarchy nh ON nh.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE nh.depth < 3) nh ON nh.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE nh.depth < 3) nh JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) si ON nh.n_nationkey = si.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON si.s_suppkey = cos.c_custkey ORDER BY nh.depth, nh.region_name, si.total_acctbal DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, hcs.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank_within_nation <= 5) hcs ON l.l_suppkey = hcs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, hcs.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.l_partkey, SUM(od.l_quantity * od.l_extendedprice) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT od.s_name) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, ts.s_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.l_partkey HAVING SUM(od.l_quantity * od.l_extendedprice) > 10000 ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_orders, total_revenue, ROUND(total_revenue / total_orders, 2) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY revenue DESC, nation ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, tr.total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rev_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o) tr ON c.c_custkey IN ( SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o INNER JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as RankedOrders) ) WHERE tr.rev_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.c_name, rs.o_orderkey, rs.o_totalprice, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.total_customers, ns.total_sales, ns.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) rs JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON rs.c_name = ns.n_name WHERE rs.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ns.total_sales DESC, rs.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_balance, ro.total_revenue, ro.o_orderkey FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro ON ns.supplier_count > 10 AND ns.total_balance > 50000 ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, ro.total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.part_count, ts.total_avail_qty, ts.total_supply_cost, ROUND(ts.total_supply_cost / NULLIF(ts.total_avail_qty, 0), 2) AS avg_supply_cost_per_qty FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.part_count, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp) ts WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice, hs.s_suppkey, hs.s_name, hs.total_value, hs.parts_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') co JOIN lineitem li ON co.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_value, ss.parts_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_value > (SELECT AVG(total_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats)) hs ON ps.ps_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_returnflag = 'N' ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, hs.total_value DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(ns.nation_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(co.total_order_value) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(si.total_supply_cost) AS nation_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si ON n.n_nationkey = si.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ns.n_nationkey = (SELECT nation.n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE nation.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey) GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT R.r_name, R.avg_order_value, R.high_priority_orders, S.s_name AS supplier_name, S.supplied_parts, RO.line_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderpriority = 'HIGH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_priority_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) R LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) > 0) S ON R.high_priority_orders > 0 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority HAVING COUNT(l.l_linenumber) > 0) RO ON RO.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ORDER BY R.avg_order_value DESC, S.supplied_parts DESC, RO.line_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_available_qty, rp.avg_supply_cost, ts.region_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON rp.p_partkey % 5 = ts.s_suppkey % 5 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent > 50000 WHERE rp.total_available_qty > 100 ORDER BY rp.avg_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(l.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, tr.r_name AS top_region FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) sd ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = sd.ps_partkey) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY nation_count DESC LIMIT 5) tr GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, tr.r_name HAVING SUM(l.total_revenue) > 50000 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, AVG(ss.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(om.order_value) AS total_order_value, SUM(om.total_orders) AS total_orders_per_customer FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) om ON n.n_nationkey = om.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders_per_customer DESC, avg_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, psi.total_avail_qty, psi.avg_supply_cost, asi.total_sales, asi.total_tax, asi.order_count FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) psi ON p.p_partkey = psi.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t ON l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey) asi ON p.p_partkey = asi.l_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND psi.total_avail_qty > 0 ORDER BY asi.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.l_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, MAX(rs.total_cost) AS max_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc JOIN lineitem lo ON lo.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = hvc.c_custkey) LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p)) JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) fo ON fo.o_custkey = hvc.c_custkey GROUP BY hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, s.s_name AS SupplierName, p.p_name AS PartName, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantitySold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) as HighValueCustomers) AND s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE TotalCost > 50000) AND p.p_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY OrderCount DESC LIMIT 10) as PopularParts) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_name ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate < l.l_commitdate GROUP BY n.n_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, pd.p_name, pd.total_available, pd.avg_supply_cost, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.s_name, ', ') AS suppliers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pd JOIN partsupp ps ON pd.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE pd.total_available > 1000 AND co.total_spent > 5000 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, pd.p_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MIN(o.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.r_name AS region_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value, ts.s_acctbal, ts.supplier_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 10) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) ts ON ts.supplier_rank = 1 ORDER BY t.r_name, ts.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(si.TotalAvailableQty) AS TotalAvailableQty, SUM(si.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_custkey) AS TopCustomerCount FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si ON si.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.TotalRevenue) AS CustomerTotalRevenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY CustomerTotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON si.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 20)) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY TotalAvailableQty DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND r.r_name IN ('Europe', 'Asia') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation ASC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(s_name) AS top_suppliers_count, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_extended_price FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.total_revenue, CASE WHEN tp.part_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10' ELSE 'Others' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, pr.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pr.total_revenue DESC) AS part_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') ro WHERE ro.rn = 1) ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey) pr ON p.p_partkey = pr.l_partkey) tp ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(sh.s_acctbal) AS Total_Account_Balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN Customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN Customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE c.c_acctbal < 5000 AND sh.level < 3) sh ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE c.c_acctbal < 5000 AND sh.level < 3) sh JOIN supplier s ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY Total_Account_Balance DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MAX(rs.total_cost) AS top_supplier_cost FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT sr.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.s_nationkey ORDER BY sr.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sr) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, n.n_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, ts.c_name AS TopCustomer, ts.TotalSpent, rs.s_name AS BestSupplier, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01')) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000) ts ON rs.SupplierRank = 1 AND ts.TotalSpent >= 1000 WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, ts.TotalSpent DESC, rs.TotalSupplyCost DESC;
