SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.nation, io.total_price AS calculated_total_price, io.item_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, ro.nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5) hvo JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS item_count FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, ro.nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) io ON hvo.o_orderkey = io.l_orderkey WHERE hvo.o_totalprice > io.total_price ORDER BY hvo.nation, hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.total_revenue, a.avg_revenue, r.order_count, a.avg_orders, (r.total_revenue - a.avg_revenue) / a.avg_revenue * 100 AS revenue_variance_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) r, AverageSales a ORDER BY revenue_variance_percentage DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(order_value) AS avg_order_value, SUM(distinct_suppliers) AS total_distinct_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value, o.o_orderdate, ts.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.region_name) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice) AS total_spent, sc.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2 )) hvc JOIN orders o ON hvc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM lineitem l JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON li.l_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, sc.total_cost HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice) > (SELECT AVG(l_extendedprice) FROM lineitem) ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(tc.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM nation ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers)) hs ON ns.n_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5) tc ON tc.c_custkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey) GROUP BY ns.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hs.s_suppkey) > 0 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, tn.nation_revenue, r.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000) tn ON r.total_revenue > tn.nation_revenue WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.nation_name, t.total_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) t JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rn <= 3) ts ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_container = 'SMAN') ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_orderkey ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_revenue, unique_customers, average_quantity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, 1 AS level FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' UNION ALL SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, oh.level + 1 FROM orders o INNER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, 1 AS level FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' UNION ALL SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, oh.level + 1 FROM orders o INNER JOIN OrderHierarchy oh ON o.o_custkey = oh.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND oh.level < 5) oh ON o.o_custkey = oh.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND oh.level < 5) as OrderHierarchy) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity, r.r_name AS region_name FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, sr.s_name AS supplier_name, sr.total_supply_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) sr ON n.n_nationkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE sr.rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.r_name, sr.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT ts.o_orderkey, ts.total_sales, ts.c_name, ts.nation_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_sales, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.sales_rank <= 10) ts ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_sales_by_nation FROM nation ns JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer cs ON cs.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o WHERE sales_rank <= 10) ts ON ts.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_sales_by_nation DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.customer_name, ps.supplier_name, r.item_count, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, ps.total_sales, ps.total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate <= o.o_orderdate GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name) r JOIN (SELECT supplier_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate <= o.o_orderdate GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name) o GROUP BY supplier_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) ps ON r.supplier_name = ps.supplier_name ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC, r.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE'))) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank = 1 JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) WHERE total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) as RankedSuppliers);

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ts.p_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_cost) AS aggregate_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, p_brand, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_brand) WHERE rank <= 5) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.p_brand ORDER BY r.r_name, ts.p_brand;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, f.s_name AS supplier_name, f.nation_name, f.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) r WHERE total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as RankedSuppliers)) f ON ps.ps_suppkey = f.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 50 ORDER BY p.p_partkey, f.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(f.total_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue FROM (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RevenueBySupplier) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) f JOIN supplier s ON f.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_nation_revenue DESC;

SELECT TR.region_name, TR.total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) TR WHERE TR.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY TR.total_sales DESC;

SELECT revenue_tier, COUNT(nation_name) AS nation_count, AVG(total_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders_aggregated FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, total_orders, CASE WHEN total_revenue >= 1000000 THEN 'High' WHEN total_revenue >= 500000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_tier FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueData) GROUP BY revenue_tier ORDER BY revenue_tier DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.r_name AS region_name, t.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Asia%' ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.total_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_by_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rank_by_cost <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON od.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, od.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.customer_name, t.o_totalprice, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(sp.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM (SELECT o.order_rank, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.customer_name, o.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') o WHERE o.order_rank <= 10) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sp ON t.o_orderkey = sp.ps_partkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.customer_name, t.o_totalprice ORDER BY t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS number_of_customers, SUM(oli.total_order_value) AS total_value_of_orders, sd.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sd JOIN partsupp ps ON sd.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') co ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) oli ON co.o_orderkey = oli.o_orderkey GROUP BY sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.avg_supply_cost ORDER BY total_value_of_orders DESC, number_of_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tos.p_partkey, tos.p_name, tos.p_brand, tos.p_retailprice, tos.total_available_quantity, tos.supplier_count, cos.c_custkey, cos.c_name, cos.total_spent, cos.total_orders FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, rp.total_available_quantity, rp.supplier_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice) rp WHERE rp.rnk <= 5) tos JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON cos.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY tos.total_available_quantity DESC, cos.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, p.p_brand AS brand, MIN(l.l_shipdate) AS first_ship_date, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') GROUP BY c.c_name, n.n_name, s.s_name, p.p_name, p.p_brand HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, od.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey) od ON ts.s_suppkey = od.c_custkey WHERE ts.s_acctbal > 10000 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, od.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.regions_count, ns.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_regionkey) AS regions_count, SUM(ro.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) ro ON n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns WHERE ns.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.r_regionkey) AS regions_count, SUM(ro.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) ro ON n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) as NationSummary) ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, SUM(pd.p_retailprice * pd.ps_availqty) AS estimated_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_lines FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, CUME_DIST() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.price_rank <= 0.1) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) pd ON pd.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY h.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(pd.p_retailprice * pd.ps_availqty) > 10000 ORDER BY estimated_value DESC;

SELECT rs.r_name, rs.nation_count, ss.total_acctbal, ss.supplier_count, ss.avg_acctbal, os.total_order_value, os.order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON ss.s_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = rs.r_name ) ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = rs.r_name ) ) ) ORDER BY rs.r_name, ss.total_acctbal DESC;

SELECT cr.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(cr.total_sales) AS total_sales_amount, AVG(supplier_costs.total_supply_cost) AS average_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN oi.total_order_value IS NOT NULL THEN oi.total_order_value ELSE 0 END) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) oi ON c.c_custkey = oi.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, r.r_name) cr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) supplier_costs ON cr.region_name = ( SELECT r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE cr.c_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY cr.region_name ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'Asia') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_parts_available, r.total_supply_value, r.total_orders, r.total_spent, CASE WHEN r.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.total_spent / r.total_orders END AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(total_available_quantity) AS total_parts_available, SUM(total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value, SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(total_spent) AS total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.rank, rs.part_count, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) DESC, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs ON ts.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN region r ON ts.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) WHERE ts.rank <= 5 AND rs.total_supply_cost > 100000 ORDER BY r.r_name, ts.rank;

SELECT rs.r_name, rs.region_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ts.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr ON rs.region_revenue = sr.supplier_revenue GROUP BY rs.r_name, rs.region_revenue ORDER BY rs.region_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.s_name, r.nation_name, h.customer_name, h.o_orderkey, h.o_totalprice, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.ps_supplycost, mp.profit FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') h ON r.rank <= 5 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%metals%') sp ON r.s_suppkey = sp.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS profit FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) mp ON h.o_orderkey = mp.l_orderkey ORDER BY mp.profit DESC, h.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.c_name AS customer_name, tp.p_name AS top_part_name, tp.revenue AS part_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 200000) s JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2 WHERE c2.c_mktsegment = c.c_mktsegment ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ss ON ss.total_sales > 10000 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON tp.revenue > 5000 ORDER BY s.s_name, ss.sales_rank;

SELECT t.r_name AS region_name, t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.total_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Europe%') GROUP BY s.s_name, s.s_suppkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) t ORDER BY t.r_name, t.total_value DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name AS part_name, rp.p_brand AS part_brand, rp.p_retailprice AS retail_price, sc.total_supply_cost AS total_supply_cost, co.total_spent AS customer_total_spent, oli.order_value AS order_total_value FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) rp JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) rp ON ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON rp.p_partkey = sc.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer ORDER BY c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) oli ON oli.o_orderkey = (SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders ORDER BY o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE rp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT ps.part_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, ls.total_quantity, ss.total_inventory_value, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, p.p_partkey FROM part p) ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_inventory_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 100) ss ON ps.p_partkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) cs ON cs.total_spent > 10000 JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ls ON ps.p_partkey = ls.l_partkey ORDER BY ss.total_inventory_value DESC, cs.total_spent DESC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT fr.c_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(fr.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(fr.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_nationkey, r.total_revenue, n.n_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) fr JOIN nation n ON fr.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY fr.c_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ns.nation_total_sales) AS region_total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.region_total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rd.nation_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) rd JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_brand, p.p_type FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 50 AND 200) rp ON rd.s_suppkey = rp.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON rp.ps_partkey = rp.ps_partkey GROUP BY rd.nation_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(ps.ps_availqty, 0) as available_quantity, COALESCE(ps.ps_supplycost, 0) as supply_cost, t.total_sales FROM part p LEFT JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 10) t ON p.p_partkey = t.p_partkey ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT pi.o_orderkey, pi.o_custkey, pi.total_revenue, pi.c_mktsegment, pi.s_name FROM (SELECT co.o_orderkey, co.o_custkey, co.total_revenue, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) co JOIN customer c ON co.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT sp.ps_partkey, sp.ps_suppkey, sp.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey ORDER BY ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty > 0) sp WHERE sp.rn <= 3) ts ON ts.ps_partkey = (SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_suppkey = ts.ps_suppkey LIMIT 1) JOIN supplier s ON ts.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) pi WHERE pi.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) as CustomerOrders) ORDER BY pi.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name AS customer_name, t.supplier_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) * l.l_tax) AS total_tax_collected FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = 1997) o WHERE o.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.supplier_name ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, customer_count FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.customer_count, ns.total_supplier_balance, ps.total_retail_price, ps.unique_suppliers, oa.o_orderstatus, oa.total_order_value, oa.total_customers FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_brand, SUM(p.p_retailprice) AS total_retail_price, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_brand) ps ON ps.p_brand IN (SELECT DISTINCT p_brand FROM part) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS total_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus) oa ON oa.o_orderstatus = 'O' ORDER BY ns.customer_count DESC, ps.total_retail_price DESC, oa.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rc.c_name AS Customer_Name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, MAX(rc.rank_within_nation) AS Highest_Rank_Nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem li JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) rc ON o.o_custkey = rc.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND li.l_shipdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY rc.c_name, ts.s_name HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, tn.n_name AS top_nation, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) tn ON ro.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(nation_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TopNations) JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 GROUP BY s.s_name) ts ON ts.supplier_cost = (SELECT MAX(supplier_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 GROUP BY s.s_name) as TopSuppliers) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.p_partkey, t.p_name, t.total_sales, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT(o.o_orderkey)) AS number_of_orders FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) WHERE sales_rank <= 10) t JOIN partsupp ps ON t.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY t.p_partkey, t.p_name, t.total_sales, s.s_name ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.nation_name, cs.total_order_value, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(od.total_price) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON c.c_custkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON cs.total_order_value > ts.total_supply_value ORDER BY cs.total_order_value DESC, ts.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.total_nations, r.total_supplier_balance, s.total_parts, s.total_supply_cost, o.o_orderstatus, o.total_order_value, o.total_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) s ON s.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderstatus, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus) o ON o.o_orderstatus IN ( SELECT o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey AND c.c_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) ) ) ORDER BY r.r_regionkey, o.o_orderstatus;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_avail_qty, ts.total_supply_value, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sp.total_supply_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp) ts JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) tc ON o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 AND tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_value DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value, rs.rank, rg.r_name, rg.nation_count, rg.total_acct_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acct_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rg ON rg.nation_count > 5 WHERE rs.rank = 1 ORDER BY rg.total_acct_balance DESC, rs.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.r_regionkey, ts.r_name, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count, AVG(ts.total_cost) AS avg_total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts GROUP BY ts.r_regionkey, ts.r_name ORDER BY ts.r_regionkey;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT t.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(t.total_line_item_value) AS total_value, AVG(t.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.supplier_name, o.total_line_item_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_item_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS line_item_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name) o WHERE o.line_item_rank = 1) t JOIN supplier s ON t.supplier_name = s.s_name JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.region_name, rn.nation_name, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.o_orderkey, ls.total_revenue, ls.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rn JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) sp ON rn.n_nationkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_totalprice > 500) co ON co.c_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = rn.n_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON co.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey WHERE ls.total_revenue > 1000 ORDER BY rn.region_name, ls.total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nations_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost > 100000 GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) > 1 ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, ns.CustomerCount, ns.TotalSpentByNation, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.TotalCost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(c.c_custkey) AS CustomerCount, SUM(cs.TotalSpent) AS TotalSpentByNation FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE ns.TotalSpentByNation > 1000000 ORDER BY r.r_regionkey, ns.TotalSpentByNation DESC, rs.TotalCost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, MAX(l.l_quantity) AS max_line_item_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.o_orderkey, rn.o_orderdate, rn.o_totalprice, rn.c_name, tn.n_name, tn.TotalRetailValue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS Rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') rn JOIN customer c ON rn.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(r.RetailValue) AS TotalRetailValue FROM nation n JOIN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_retailprice AS RetailValue FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey ) r ON r.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) tn ON c.c_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey WHERE rn.Rank <= 10 ORDER BY tn.TotalRetailValue DESC, rn.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ts.region_total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rs.total_supplycost) AS region_total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.region_total_supplycost ORDER BY ts.region_total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value, n.n_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank <= 3 AND rs.n_regionkey = n.n_nationkey) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_discount > 0.05 ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC, ts.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'MAIL') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(r.customer_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as RankedOrders)) r JOIN supplier s ON r.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region rg ON n.n_regionkey = rg.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_name, rg.r_name ORDER BY total_customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_quantity, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.total_quantity, so.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY so.total_revenue DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ts.total_qty) AS total_supplied_qty, AVG(ts.avg_cost_per_supplier) AS average_supplier_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.c_nationkey) AS total_nations_involved FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, SUM(total_available) AS total_qty, AVG(avg_supply_cost) AS avg_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey) GROUP BY s_suppkey) ts ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_partkey IN (SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp)) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_supplied_qty DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, SUM(pt.total_sales) AS total_spent, st.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.order_count DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.order_count > 0) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) pt ON l.l_partkey = pt.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st ON l.l_suppkey = st.s_suppkey GROUP BY tc.c_name, st.total_cost HAVING SUM(pt.total_sales) > 10000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE')) r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON ns.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.p_brand, r.nation, r.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_brand, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_brand, n.n_name) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.p_brand, r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ss.supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ss.total_available_qty) AS total_supply, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_order_revenue, AVG(os.total_quantity) AS avg_order_quantity, MAX(os.o_totalprice) AS max_order_price FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_lineitems, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) os ON ss.supplier_nation = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT DISTINCT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) ) GROUP BY ss.supplier_nation ORDER BY total_order_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT ows.region_name, ows.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ows.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(ows.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(ows.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.supplier_name, ts.region_name, ts.nation_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ON l.l_suppkey = (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_name = ts.supplier_name LIMIT 1)) ows GROUP BY ows.region_name, ows.nation_name ORDER BY ows.region_name, order_count DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_available_quantity, rs.average_supply_cost, os.total_order_value, os.total_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON rs.nation_name = (SELECT n_name FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey) WHERE rs.total_available_quantity > 1000 ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.nation_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_quantity, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count, rs.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND s.s_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) as SupplierOrderDetails) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS regional_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) s JOIN region r ON s.regional_rank = 1) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.total_supply_cost, rc.c_custkey, rc.c_name, rc.total_orders_value FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, p_mfgr, p_brand, total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand) as RankedParts) tp JOIN (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, total_orders_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_orders_value DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders) rc ON rc.customer_rank <= 5 WHERE tp.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC, rc.total_orders_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, avg_quantity, CASE WHEN total_sales > (SELECT avg_total_sales FROM (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_total_sales FROM (SELECT r_name AS region_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r_name) as RegionalSales) as AvgSales) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS sales_performance FROM (SELECT r_name AS region_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;
