SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_value, ss.total_parts FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN lineitem l ON cs.c_custkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON l.l_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ss.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.p_partkey, f.p_name, f.p_brand, f.total_revenue, f.num_orders, f.top_supplier_name, f.top_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, COALESCE(a.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(a.num_orders, 0) AS num_orders, rs.s_name AS top_supplier_name, rs.s_acctbal AS top_supplier_acctbal FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS num_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) a ON p.p_partkey = a.l_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('Germany', 'France', 'USA')) rs ON rs.rank = 1 AND a.total_revenue > 0) f ORDER BY f.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.c_custkey, t.c_name, t.total_spent, ss.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.part_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_sales) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1998-01-01' AND DATE '1998-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 5) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.part_count >= (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) / 10 FROM partsupp ps) ORDER BY t.total_spent DESC, ss.total_cost ASC;

SELECT region_name, region_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name, c.c_nationkey) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 AND c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = RankedOrders.c_nationkey)) AS top_customers_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(RO.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name, c.c_nationkey) RO JOIN nation n ON RO.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE RO.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY region_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_phone, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(spl.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sc.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sc.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier_chain sc ON p.p_partkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 AND sc.level < 3) sc ON p.p_partkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 AND sc.level < 3) spl ON c.c_nationkey = spl.s_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_phone HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue FROM (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY os.c_mktsegment ORDER BY os.revenue DESC) AS rn, os.c_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment) os) ro JOIN nation ns ON ro.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10 ORDER BY ns.n_name, ro.revenue DESC;

SELECT fr.supplier_name, fr.total_available, fr.total_supply_cost, fr.total_spent FROM (SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_available, ts.total_supply_cost, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_available, sp.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sp.total_available > 1000) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent >= 10000) fr ORDER BY fr.total_supply_cost DESC, fr.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.c_name, rs.total_sales, rs.order_count, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT sd.c_custkey, sd.c_name, sd.nation_name, sd.total_sales, sd.order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.nation_name ORDER BY sd.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) sd) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.nation_name, rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.n_name, rs.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name, ts.total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1993-01-01' AND DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.c_nationkey) ns) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT rg.r_name AS region, SUM(r.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM ( SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey ) r JOIN region rg ON r.n_regionkey = rg.r_regionkey GROUP BY rg.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, ts.n_name AS nation_name, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem lo JOIN orders o ON lo.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ts ON t.nation_name = ts.n_name ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, t.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, rp.total_avail_qty, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.supplied_parts, co.total_spent, co.order_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) > 5) ts ON rp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey) WHERE rp.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rp.total_avail_qty DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT fr.c_name AS Customer_Name, fr.order_count AS Number_of_Orders, fr.total_spent AS Total_Spent, fr.top_supplier AS Top_Supplier, fr.total_cost AS Top_Supplier_Total_Cost FROM (SELECT cu.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, su.s_name AS top_supplier, su.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer cu ON co.c_custkey = cu.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) su ON su.total_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) as TopSuppliers)) fr WHERE fr.order_count > 5 ORDER BY fr.total_spent DESC;

SELECT hro.o_orderkey, hro.o_orderdate, hro.total_revenue, si.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN hro.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Revenue' ELSE 'Moderate Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) si ON si.ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = hro.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY hro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.o_orderkey, c.o_orderdate, c.o_totalprice, c.c_name, COALESCE(c.s_name, 'No Supplier') AS Supplier_Name, COALESCE(c.total_supplycost, 0) AS Total_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT R.o_orderkey, R.o_orderdate, R.o_totalprice, R.c_name, S.s_name, S.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') R LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) WHERE total_supplycost > 1000000) S ON R.o_orderkey = (SELECT MIN(o.o_orderkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_totalprice = R.o_totalprice) WHERE R.rn <= 10) c ORDER BY c.o_totalprice DESC, c.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT tn.n_name AS nation, tn.total_sales AS nation_total_sales, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost AS supplier_total_cost, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON ro.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND ro.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tn.total_sales DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, sh.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN supplier_hierarchy sh ON ps.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh ON ps.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh ON c.c_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON sh.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, sh.s_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-01-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS Top_Customers_Name, tp.s_name AS Top_Suppliers_Name, tc.total_spent AS Customer_Spent, tp.total_cost AS Supplier_Cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tp ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, tp.total_cost DESC;

SELECT has.s_name AS supplier_name, has.nation_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_available, rs.total_cost, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5) has JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON has.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY has.nation_name, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND r.r_name = 'Europe' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ro.total_revenue) DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_name = (SELECT c.c_name FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tc.rank <= 10 GROUP BY tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, r.r_name ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, supplier_count DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT nd.n_name AS Nation, sd.s_name AS Supplier, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS Total_Revenue, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS Total_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os JOIN customer c ON os.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON sd.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nd ON c.c_nationkey = nd.n_nationkey GROUP BY nd.n_name, sd.s_name ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC, Total_Supply_Cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.c_name, od.c_acctbal, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS order_total, SUM(od.l_tax) AS total_tax, AVG(od.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_tax, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) od ON ts.s_suppkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.c_name, od.c_acctbal ORDER BY order_total DESC, ts.s_name;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.order_count, tc.total_spent, tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, tp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) tc JOIN (SELECT p_name, p_brand, total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_brand ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) as ranked_parts) tp ON tc.order_count > 10 WHERE tc.rank <= 10 AND tp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, tp.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_mfgr, tp.p_brand, tp.p_type, tp.total_available_quantity, tp.total_supply_cost, ARRAY_AGG(rs.s_name) AS top_suppliers FROM (SELECT pd.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY pd.total_supply_cost DESC) AS part_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) pd WHERE pd.num_suppliers > 5) tp JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) rs ON tp.p_partkey = rs.ps_partkey AND rs.supplier_rank <= 3 WHERE tp.part_rank <= 10 GROUP BY tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_mfgr, tp.p_brand, tp.p_type, tp.total_available_quantity, tp.total_supply_cost ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.customer_count) AS average_customers_per_order FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(so.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM supplier so JOIN nation n ON so.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey HAVING SUM(so.s_acctbal) > 1000000) tr ON tr.n_regionkey IN ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) JOIN nation n ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.nation, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, os.c_custkey, os.c_name, os.total_order_value, os.total_orders, os.last_order_date FROM (SELECT nation, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE rank <= 3) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) os ON o.o_custkey = os.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' ORDER BY ts.nation, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_name, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats) ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey WHERE li.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' ) ) ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_totalprice, el.revenue, ts.total_cost, ro.order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) el ON ro.o_orderkey = el.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ts ON el.revenue > ts.total_cost WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rn.n_name as nation_name, rn.order_count, rn.total_sales FROM (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name, order_count, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) as nation_orders) rn JOIN nation n ON rn.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rn.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, rn.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ad.region, ad.nation, ad.total_revenue_fully_filled, ad.total_revenue_partially_filled, ad.total_orders_filled, sc.s_name AS supplier_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice END) AS total_revenue_fully_filled, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'P' THEN l.l_extendedprice END) AS total_revenue_partially_filled, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders_filled FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ad JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON ad.region = (SELECT r_name FROM region WHERE r_regionkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = ad.nation)) ORDER BY ad.region, ad.nation, sc.total_cost DESC;

SELECT cd.customer_name, cd.supplier_name, SUM(cd.total_order_value) AS total_value FROM (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, hvo.total_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) hvo JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 50000) hvc ON hvc.total_spent > 100000 JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) cd GROUP BY cd.customer_name, cd.supplier_name ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_orders, total_revenue, avg_order_value FROM (SELECT region_name, total_orders, total_revenue, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionOrders) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, ts.region_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') co JOIN (SELECT region_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RegionSupplier) ts ON co.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_extendedprice > 1000 ) WHERE ts.supplier_rank = 1 ORDER BY co.o_orderdate DESC, co.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ts.ps_suppkey, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY', 'USA') GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON li.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT sp.ps_suppkey, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY', 'USA') GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp GROUP BY sp.ps_suppkey ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON sp.ps_suppkey = ts.ps_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT cod.c_name, cod.o_orderkey, cod.o_totalprice, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, cod.total_line_items FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate) cod JOIN lineitem li ON cod.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE cod.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND cod.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' ORDER BY cod.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost = (SELECT MAX(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) as TopSuppliers) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.order_count = (SELECT MAX(order_count) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerStats) WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hs.s_name, c.c_custkey, c.total_orders, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost, sc.unique_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sc.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierCost)) hs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.order_value) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) c ON hs.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_mfgr = 'ManufacturerX' LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) WHERE c.total_spent > 10000 ORDER BY hs.total_cost DESC, c.total_spent DESC;

SELECT cos.c_name AS customer_name, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos JOIN (SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank_within_nation = 1) ts ON cos.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) GROUP BY l.l_orderkey HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 LIMIT 1)) ORDER BY cos.total_spent DESC, cos.total_orders DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, hp.ps_partkey AS part_key, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) hp ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = hp.ps_partkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 5000) cos ON rs.s_nationkey = cos.c_custkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3 ORDER BY n.n_name, rs.s_acctbal DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.p_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(rp.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(tr.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT sp.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.s_suppkey ORDER BY (sp.ps_availqty * sp.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank_avail_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp) rp JOIN (SELECT supplier.s_suppkey, supplier.s_name, SUM(tr.total_revenue) AS supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) tr ON sp.p_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name = 'SomePartName' LIMIT 1) JOIN supplier ON sp.s_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey GROUP BY supplier.s_suppkey, supplier.s_name) rs ON rp.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) tr ON rs.s_suppkey = rp.s_suppkey WHERE rp.rank_avail_cost = 1 GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, cr.total_revenue, CASE WHEN cr.total_revenue > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN cr.total_revenue BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr WHERE cr.c_custkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' ) ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey WHERE co.order_count > 1 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, customer_rank;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, sum(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, count(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, c.c_name AS customer_name FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc WHERE hvc.total_spent > 20000) c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT S.s_name AS supplier_name, S.nation_name, C.c_name AS customer_name, C.total_spent, S.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) S JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) C ON S.total_supply_cost > C.total_spent WHERE S.nation_name = 'USA' ORDER BY S.total_supply_cost DESC, C.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(co.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(rs.total_supply_cost) AS max_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') co ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F'))) WHERE rs.rank = 1 GROUP BY rs.nation_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(p.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank_supplier FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN nation n ON ts.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) p ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_mktsegment, hvo.p_name, hvo.total_supply_cost, hvo.supplier_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment, sp.p_name, sp.total_supply_cost, sp.supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.p_partkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 AND ro.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') hvo ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.total_nation_supply_cost, ns.total_unique_parts, ns.total_orders_per_nation FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_nation_supply_cost, SUM(ss.unique_parts_supplied) AS total_unique_parts, SUM(ss.total_orders) AS total_orders_per_nation FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.n_name;

SELECT rs.region_name, COALESCE(cs.customer_name, 'Total') AS customer_name, SUM(cs.total_sales) AS total_customer_sales, rs.total_sales AS region_total_sales, (SUM(cs.total_sales) / NULLIF(rs.total_sales, 0)) * 100 AS customer_sales_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name) cs ON cs.total_sales IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rs.region_name, cs.customer_name, rs.total_sales ORDER BY rs.region_name, total_customer_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_avail_qty, ts.total_supply_cost, op.total_revenue, op.line_item_count, op.first_ship_date FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count, MIN(l.l_shipdate) AS first_ship_date FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) op ON ts.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00 ) GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) WHERE ts.supply_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, op.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY ts.region_name, total_cost_of_top_suppliers DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp ps JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 300) JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sh.level < 5) sh ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 300) JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sh.level < 5) sh JOIN supplier s ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rb.p_brand, rb.brand_sales, rs.nation_name, rs.total_sales, (rb.brand_sales / NULLIF(rs.total_sales, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_of_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_brand, SUM(rs.total_sales) AS brand_sales FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_brand) rs JOIN part p ON rs.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY p.p_brand) rb JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) rs ON rb.p_brand = rs.nation_name ORDER BY percentage_of_sales DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.revenue, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.rn = 1 ORDER BY ro.revenue DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN orders o ON t.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY t.revenue DESC, t.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, od.o_orderdate, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') od ON cs.c_custkey = od.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.rank <= 10) ts ON od.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) GROUP BY cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_name, od.o_orderdate ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT ro.region_name, psi.total_available_qty, psi.avg_supply_cost, lia.total_quantity_sold, lia.total_sales, ro.total_orders, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ro JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) psi ON psi.p_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l) JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey) lia ON lia.l_partkey = psi.p_partkey ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, ro.region_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.supplier_nation, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rn <= 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT tro.o_orderkey, tro.o_orderdate, tro.total_revenue, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) tro JOIN customer c ON tro.c_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY tro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT CAST(o_orderdate AS VARCHAR) AS order_date, c_name AS customer_name, s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, r.rank, c.c_name, s.s_name, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE r.rank <= 10) GROUP BY o_orderdate, c_name, s_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, hvn.n_name, hvn.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY YEAR(o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, AVG(spp.total_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey) spp ON n.n_nationkey = spp.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING AVG(spp.total_supplycost) > 5000) hvn ON hvn.n_nationkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT ps_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey)) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tp.part_name, tp.supplier_name, tr.total_sales AS region_sales, tp.total_sales AS part_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN (SELECT part_name, supplier_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, s.s_name) as PartSupplierSales) tp ON tp.sales_rank <= 5 WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 3 ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC, tp.total_sales DESC;

SELECT nr.nation_name, nr.nation_total_revenue, nr.avg_orders_per_customer, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(cs.total_revenue) AS nation_total_revenue, AVG(cs.total_orders) AS avg_orders_per_customer FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nr JOIN region r ON nr.nation_name LIKE '%' || r.r_name || '%' ORDER BY nr.nation_total_revenue DESC, nr.nation_name LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_sales, rs.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(distinct o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1994-12-31' AND s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'Asia')) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN css.total_available_qty IS NOT NULL THEN css.total_supply_cost END) AS total_supplier_cost, SUM(CASE WHEN co.total_spent IS NOT NULL THEN co.total_spent END) AS total_customer_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT la.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(la.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) css ON s.s_suppkey = css.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) la ON co.c_custkey = la.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_name;

SELECT ns.n_name, r.r_name, cs.c_mktsegment, SUM(cs.segment_revenue) AS total_segment_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS segment_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment) cs JOIN nation ns ON cs.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23')) GROUP BY ns.n_name, r.r_name, cs.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_segment_revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent, co.order_count, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderstatus, ts.ps_suppkey, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(o.o_totalprice), 0) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') ro ON co.order_count > 3 AND ro.rn <= 5 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ro.o_totalprice > 500 AND ts.ps_suppkey = (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty > 50 LIMIT 1) WHERE co.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.c_name, od.l_partkey, od.p_name, od.p_brand, SUM(od.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(od.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM ( SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, details.l_partkey, details.p_name, details.p_brand, details.l_quantity, details.l_extendedprice FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) o)) details ON t.o_orderkey = details.l_orderkey ) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.c_name, od.l_partkey, od.p_name, od.p_brand ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ro.revenue_rank, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate > l.l_commitdate GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT sp.s_name, p.p_name, sp.ps_supplycost, sp.ps_availqty, ts.c_name, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co JOIN (SELECT ol.l_orderkey, ol.l_partkey, ol.l_quantity, ol.l_extendedprice, ol.l_discount, ol.l_tax FROM lineitem ol) ol ON co.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name) ts ON ts.c_custkey = ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN part p ON sp.p_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE sp.ps_availqty > 0 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, sp.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT scr.s_name, scr.c_name, scr.revenue FROM (SELECT hs.s_name, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE so.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierOrders)) hs JOIN partsupp ps ON hs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY hs.s_name, c.c_name) scr ORDER BY scr.revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.revenue, os.unique_parts, tr.nation_count FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ns.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs ON tr.nation_count > 5 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.revenue > 10000 WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3 ORDER BY tr.r_name, os.revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) AS total_high_value_customers, SUM(od.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(od.l_extendedprice) AS average_extended_price, AVG(od.l_discount) AS average_discount_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier rs ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) hvc ON hvc.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, li.l_partkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') od ON od.o_orderkey = rs.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, total_high_value_customers DESC;
