SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts_sold FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_parts_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r_name, n_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT rn.n_name, rn.r_name, stc.total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rn.r_name ORDER BY stc.total_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT s_nationkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_nationkey) stc JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rn ON stc.s_nationkey = rn.n_nationkey) WHERE cost_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) hvo JOIN nation n ON hvo.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON hvo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON l.l_partkey = ss.ps_partkey WHERE hvo.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC, hvo.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_total_cost, co.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(co.order_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ss.*, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) co ON ts.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') GROUP BY ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, co.c_name HAVING SUM(co.order_revenue) > 100000 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(t.total_per_status) AS total_high_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o_orderstatus, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_per_status FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) WHERE rank <= 5 GROUP BY o_orderstatus) t ON t.o_orderstatus = p.p_comment GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_high_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cr.r_name AS customer_region, COUNT(oo.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(oo.total_spent) AS spent_total, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_cost AS top_supplier_cost FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders GROUP BY o_custkey) oo ON c.c_custkey = oo.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) cr ON c.c_nationkey = cr.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sc.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps_suppkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.ps_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty > 0 ORDER BY ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1) WHERE oo.order_count > 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cr.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost HAVING SUM(oo.total_spent) > 5000 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, spent_total DESC;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_address AS supplier_address, COALESCE(sp.part_count, 0) AS number_of_parts, COALESCE(co.order_count, 0) AS number_of_orders, COALESCE(lir.total_revenue, 0.00) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) lir ON s.s_suppkey = lir.l_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, number_of_orders DESC, number_of_parts DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lo.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, cs.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer cs ON o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) lo ON ts.s_suppkey = lo.c_nationkey GROUP BY ts.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT si.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ci.c_name AS customer_name, ci.total_spent AS customer_spending, si.total_available_quantity AS supplier_availability, OLI.total_line_amount AS order_line_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si JOIN nation n ON si.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ci ON ci.total_spent > 1000 JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = ci.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_amount FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) OLI ON OLI.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE si.total_supply_cost < 20000 ORDER BY customer_spending DESC, supplier_availability DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sr.o_orderkey) AS orders_attached, SUM(sr.total_sales) AS total_revenue, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.c_name, r.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, MAX(o.o_orderdate) OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey) AS last_order_date FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) r) sr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON sr.sales_rank = ss.total_supply_cost GROUP BY ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sr.o_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation, os.total_revenue, os.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_mfgr = 'Manufacturer#1') LIMIT 1) ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region, nation, SUM(total_supply_value) AS total_high_value_supply FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank = 1 AND n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'Germany') JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) GROUP BY region, nation ORDER BY total_high_value_supply DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.RegionName, ts.NationName, ts.SupplierName, ts.TotalCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, n.n_name AS NationName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.Rank <= 5) ts ORDER BY ts.RegionName, ts.NationName, ts.TotalCost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_discounted_price FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tro.o_orderkey, tro.o_orderdate, tro.total_revenue, sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal, sd.ps_supplycost, sd.ps_availqty FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.rank <= 10) tro JOIN lineitem l ON tro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) sd ON l.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey ORDER BY tro.total_revenue DESC, sd.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, hvp.total_supply_cost, sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.n_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvp ON ro.o_orderkey = hvp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'ASIA')) sd ON hvp.ps_partkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE ro.rn = 1 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.r_name, sd.total_orders, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, tr.r_name, tr.total_orders, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON rs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 )) sd ORDER BY sd.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, sum(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, count(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, avg(l.l_extendedprice - l.l_discount) AS avg_price_after_discount, count(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, co.c_name, co.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) rp JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts ON rp.p_partkey = ts.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') co ON li.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5 AND rp.price_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, ts.s_acctbal DESC, co.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, AVG(order_value.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, MAX(supplier.supplier_rank) AS highest_supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) supplier JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) order_value ON supplier.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'Germany') JOIN region r ON supplier.s_nationkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT tr.region, tr.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN orders o ON tr.region IN ( SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey ) WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY tr.region, tr.total_sales ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, t.s_name, f.c_name, t.total_supply_value, f.order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY', 'USA')) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING MAX(s.rank) <= 3) t ON n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT s_nationkey FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey = t.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) f ON f.c_custkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < 50.00)) ORDER BY r.r_name, t.total_supply_value DESC, f.order_count DESC;

SELECT r_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(nr.total_revenue) AS total_nation_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT spi.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT spi.ps_partkey) AS distinct_parts, AVG(spi.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) nr ON n.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spi ON spi.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND spi.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_nation_revenue DESC, r.r_name ASC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, COUNT(*) AS top_suppliers_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank <= 3 AND rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) ts GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey) sh ON s.s_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(t.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT r.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, SUM(r.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) r ON c.c_custkey = r.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.rnk <= 5) t ON r.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey) ) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal ORDER BY total_cost DESC, orders_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(distinct o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, part_name;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.o_orderdate, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, hvo.c_custkey, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 50000) hvo JOIN lineitem li ON hvo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) as supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_supply_cost > 100000) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_returnflag = 'N' AND li.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, hvo.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_name, r.region_total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(RankedSuppliers.total_supply_cost) AS region_total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) JOIN nation n ON RankedSuppliers.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE RankedSuppliers.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name) r LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost > 1000) LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.region_name, r.region_total_supply_cost ORDER BY r.region_total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ls.revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(ls.total_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(sp.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(*) AS line_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS return_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON o.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON o.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#34' AND p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' ) WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.supplier_count, r.total_region_value, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, r.r_regionkey, COUNT(sf.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(sf.total_value) AS total_region_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) sf ON n.n_nationkey = sf.s_suppkey WHERE sf.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_regionkey) r JOIN partsupp ps ON r.supplier_count = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name, r.supplier_count, r.total_region_value ORDER BY r.total_region_value DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.total_avail_qty, rp.total_supply_cost, sn.nation_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON rp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sn ON l.l_suppkey = sn.s_suppkey WHERE rp.total_avail_qty > 1000 GROUP BY rp.p_name, rp.total_avail_qty, rp.total_supply_cost, sn.nation_name ORDER BY rp.total_supply_cost DESC, rp.total_avail_qty ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.r_name AS region_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, os.total_sales, os.order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey) WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON ts.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey ORDER BY ts.r_name, os.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.customer_count, n.total_sales, n.total_quantity, CASE WHEN sales_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top Nation' ELSE 'Other' END AS nation_category FROM (SELECT n_name, customer_count, total_sales, total_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as NationStats) n ORDER BY n.total_sales DESC, n.n_name;

SELECT hcs.region_name, hcs.s_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rank <= 5) hcs LEFT JOIN orders o ON hcs.s_name IN (SELECT s_name FROM supplier WHERE s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_supplycost > 100)) GROUP BY hcs.region_name, hcs.s_name ORDER BY hcs.region_name, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, sp.p_name, sp.s_name, sp.total_available, ol.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) ol ON t.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) sp ON ol.l_orderkey = sp.ps_partkey ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, os.o_orderpriority, ss.region_name, ss.supplier_count, ss.avg_acctbal, rs.p_name AS top_supplier_part, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.ps_availqty AS available_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderpriority, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority) os JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ss ON os.item_count = ss.supplier_count JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs ON os.o_orderkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rn = 1 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, ss.supplier_count ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT rsc.region_name, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue, rsc.total_supply_cost, (os.total_revenue - rsc.total_supply_cost) AS profit FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_nationkey) rsc JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1994-01-01' AND '1994-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON rsc.s_nationkey = os.c_nationkey JOIN region r ON rsc.region_name = r.r_name WHERE (os.total_revenue - rsc.total_supply_cost) > 0 ORDER BY profit DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_value, ts.total_parts, d.avg_price, d.order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation, s.total_parts, s.total_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON o.o_orderkey % 10 = ts.s_suppkey % 10 JOIN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey ) d ON o.o_orderkey = d.l_orderkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_value DESC, o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT ol.part_name, ol.supplier_name, SUM(ol.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, AVG(ol.l_discount) AS avg_discount, AVG(ol.l_tax) AS avg_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT ol.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MIN(ol.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(ol.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_tax, ps.p_name AS part_name, ps.supplier_name, o.o_totalprice FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) ol WHERE ol.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY ol.part_name, ol.supplier_name ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_customer_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tc.total_customer_revenue DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.total_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) lo ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc WHERE tc.total_customer_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY customer_rank;

SELECT tro.o_orderkey, tro.revenue, tro.c_name, tro.nation_name, tro.region_name, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.revenue, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10) tro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON tro.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey ORDER BY tro.revenue DESC, sp.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT cr.region_name, cr.nation_name, sp.s_name, SUM(os.total_order_value) AS total_sales_value, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS distinct_order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) cr JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON cr.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON sp.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' ) GROUP BY cr.region_name, cr.nation_name, sp.s_name ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC, distinct_order_count ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_name, SUM(oli.OrderValue) AS TotalOrderValue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, s.s_acctbal, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.Rank <= 10) ts JOIN (SELECT o.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS OrderValue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey) oli ON ts.s_suppkey = oli.c_custkey GROUP BY ts.s_name ORDER BY TotalOrderValue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE 'MANUFACTURED%' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.c_name, d.total_revenue, d.total_quantity FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) h JOIN (SELECT h.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY h.o_orderkey) d ON h.o_orderkey = d.o_orderkey ORDER BY d.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus) ho ON l.l_orderkey = ho.o_orderkey JOIN orders o ON ho.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS Supplier_Nation, tp.p_name AS Top_Part, ps.ps_supplycost AS Supplier_Cost, ns.s_acctbal AS Supplier_Balance FROM (SELECT n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) ns JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100) ps ON ns.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON ps.ps_partkey = tp.p_partkey ORDER BY ns.n_name, ps.ps_supplycost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'RAIL') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') AND p.p_type LIKE 'SMALL%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.nation_name AS supplier_nation, rs.total_supply_cost AS supplier_total_cost, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_orders AS customer_order_count, co.total_spent AS customer_total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_region FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.o_orderkey) DESC) AS order_rank FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON rs.rank_within_region <= 3 WHERE rs.total_supply_cost > 100000 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND p.p_container = 'MED BOX' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT TOC.c_name, TOC.total_spent, SO.p_name, SO.ps_supplycost, SO.ps_availqty FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) TOC LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100) SO ON TOC.c_custkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > DATE '1998-10-01' - INTERVAL '30' DAY ) WHERE TOC.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY TOC.total_spent DESC, SO.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT o.c_custkey, o.c_name, SUM(ls.total_line_cost) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_cost, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON o.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON sd.s_nationkey = ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.c_custkey ) ) GROUP BY o.c_custkey, o.c_name, sd.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, c.c_acctbal, t.o_orderkey, t.total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c1.c_acctbal) FROM customer c1) ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supply_rank = 1) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT s.region, s.total_sales, s.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) s WHERE s.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY s.sales_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_account_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate = o.o_orderdate GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cu.c_name, cu.order_count, cu.total_spent, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s) ts ON cu.total_spent > ts.total_cost WHERE cu.order_count > 5 ORDER BY cu.total_spent DESC, ts.total_cost ASC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_spent AS customer_spent, rs.total_revenue AS supplier_revenue, (cs.total_spent / NULLIF(rs.total_revenue, 0)) AS spending_to_revenue_ratio FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON rs.total_revenue > 0 ORDER BY spending_to_revenue_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, tc.order_count, tc.total_spent, ts.total_available, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders) ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_available, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sp.total_supply_cost < (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierParts) ORDER BY total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 5) ts WHERE tc.order_count > 2 AND ts.total_available > 100 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(sd.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT dli.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(dli.l_extendedprice * (1 - dli.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(dli.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, MAX(s.part_count) AS max_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) hvc JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 5) r ON hvc.c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, li.l_partkey, li.l_suppkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_tax, s.s_name, p.p_name FROM lineitem li JOIN supplier s ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND li.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey) dli ON hvc.c_custkey = dli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s ON dli.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, hv.o_orderkey, hv.o_totalprice, la.net_revenue, la.item_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 50000 AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') hv ON r.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = hv.o_orderkey)) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) la ON hv.o_orderkey = la.l_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 5 ORDER BY hv.o_totalprice DESC, la.net_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.revenue_rank <= 10 THEN rs.total_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS top_10_revenue_sum FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_spent, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(coalesce(os.total_revenue, 0)) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON cs.total_spent > ts.total_cost ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_sales, r.total_orders, r.sales_rank FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation_name, ss.total_sales, ss.total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.nation_name ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.nation_name, r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT two.o_orderkey, swp.s_name, swp.p_name, two.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) two JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) swp ON two.total_revenue BETWEEN swp.ps_supplycost AND (swp.ps_supplycost * 1.2) ORDER BY two.total_revenue DESC, swp.s_name;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, d.total_revenue, sp.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN sp.total_supply_cost < 5000 THEN 'Low Cost' WHEN sp.total_supply_cost BETWEEN 5000 AND 15000 THEN 'Medium Cost' ELSE 'High Cost' END AS supply_cost_category FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, MIN(l.l_shipdate) AS earliest_shipdate FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey) d JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON d.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) o ON d.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ORDER BY d.total_revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT f.o_orderkey, DATE_PART('month', f.o_orderdate) AS order_month, h.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(f.l_extendedprice * (1 - f.l_discount)) AS net_amount, COALESCE(r.s_name, 'Unknown Supplier') AS supplier_name, h.order_count, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_linenumber) AS line_num FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') f LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) h ON h.c_custkey = f.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) s ON s.rank = 1 LEFT JOIN supplier r ON s.s_suppkey = r.s_suppkey GROUP BY f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, h.c_name, r.s_name, h.order_count, s.total_supply_cost ORDER BY net_amount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, t.total_sales, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sales.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sales JOIN supplier s ON sales.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sales.total_sales = (SELECT MAX(total_sales) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierSales)) t JOIN nation n ON t.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT customer_name, nation_name, total_revenue, total_orders FROM (SELECT customer_name, nation_name, total_revenue, total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY customer_name, nation_name) as HistoricalData) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, ts.s_name, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ts.total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ts.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as TotalSales)) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name;

SELECT r.nation_name, r.total_supply_cost, ro.total_value, (SELECT SUM(total_value) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) as RecentOrders) AS overall_total_value, CASE WHEN r.rank <= 5 THEN 'Top Supplier' ELSE 'Regular Supplier' END AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON r.s_suppkey = ro.o_custkey ORDER BY r.total_supply_cost DESC, ro.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(lo.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o_orderdate AS order_date, o_orderkey, total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY o_orderdate, total_revenue DESC) lo JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey) JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lo.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(rp.total_supply_cost) AS total_parts_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp ON ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') co ON co.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.s_suppkey, rp.s_name, rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.ps_supplycost, rp.ps_availqty, rp.total_value FROM (SELECT spp.s_suppkey, spp.s_name, spp.p_partkey, spp.p_name, spp.ps_supplycost, spp.ps_availqty, spp.total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY spp.p_partkey ORDER BY spp.total_value DESC) AS rank_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, (ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) spp) rp WHERE rp.rank_value = 1 ORDER BY rp.p_partkey, rp.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, o.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) o) t WHERE t.rn <= 5 ORDER BY t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AFRICA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN tc.rank <= 10 THEN tc.custkey END) AS top_customer_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey AS custkey, c.c_name AS name, c.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) c) tc ON c.c_custkey = tc.custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rr.r_name, rr.TotalRevenue, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS NumberOfHighValueOrders FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(tn.TotalRevenue, 0) AS TotalRevenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) tn ON r.r_regionkey = tn.n_regionkey) rr LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) ro ON ro.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND ro.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 5 GROUP BY rr.r_name, rr.TotalRevenue ORDER BY rr.TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_extended_price FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, ps.total_quantity, cs.spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s2.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s2 WHERE s2.s_nationkey = s.s_nationkey )) rs JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, p.p_partkey) ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(ot.total_price) AS spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ot ON c.c_custkey = ot.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.c_custkey = ps.l_orderkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.s_acctbal DESC, cs.spent DESC;
