SELECT f.s_suppkey, f.s_name, f.region_name, COALESCE(f.order_count, 0) AS order_count FROM (SELECT h.s_suppkey, h.s_name, h.region_name, c.order_count FROM (SELECT si.s_suppkey, si.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) si JOIN nation n ON si.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE si.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierInfo )) h LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey) c ON h.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey) f ORDER BY f.region_name, f.order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.revenue, ts.total_avail_qty, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 10) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10 ) ) ORDER BY os.revenue DESC, ts.total_avail_qty ASC;

SELECT region, nation, customer_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.o_orderkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY customer_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.total_supply_cost, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.rank_within_nation <= 5 AND c.rank_within_nation <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, s.total_supply_cost DESC, c.total_spent DESC;

SELECT oo.o_orderkey, oo.o_orderdate, oo.o_totalprice, oo.o_orderstatus, SUM(ali.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31') oo JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ali ON oo.o_orderkey = ali.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE oo.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY oo.o_orderkey, oo.o_orderdate, oo.o_totalprice, oo.o_orderstatus ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.r_name, tr.customer_count, tr.total_revenue, sc.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = tr.n_regionkey ) ) ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rs.nation_name ORDER BY rs.total_supplycost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ts.rnk <= 3 GROUP BY ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supplycost ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT ca.s_suppkey, ca.total_available_qty, ca.total_costs, ca.total_lineitem_price, ca.total_discount, (ca.total_lineitem_price - ca.total_discount) AS net_revenue FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_costs, COALESCE(od.total_lineitem_price, 0) AS total_lineitem_price, COALESCE(od.total_discount, 0) AS total_discount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_costs FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_lineitem_price, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS total_lineitems FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) od ON ss.s_suppkey = od.o_orderkey) ca ORDER BY ca.total_costs DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, sn.s_name AS supplier_name, sn.n_name AS nation, rp.total_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) sn ON rp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = sn.s_suppkey ) ORDER BY rp.total_cost DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, sc.s_name, pd.p_name, os.order_count, os.total_spent, pd.total_quantity, ROUND(sc.total_cost, 2) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON c.c_nationkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pd ON ps.ps_partkey = pd.p_partkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND os.total_spent > 10000 AND pd.total_quantity >= 50 ORDER BY os.total_spent DESC, pd.total_quantity DESC FETCH FIRST 100 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, h.nation_name, s.total_availability, s.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.rank <= 10) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availability, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = s.ps_suppkey WHERE h.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY h.o_orderdate DESC, h.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, tp.total_available_qty, tp.total_supply_cost, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, sd.s_acctbal AS supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_available_qty, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS part_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp WHERE rp.part_rank <= 5) tp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON sd.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = tp.p_partkey ) ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, cs.total_spent, cs.total_orders, COALESCE(rs.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, (CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_orders, 0) > 0 THEN COALESCE(rs.total_revenue, 0) / cs.total_orders ELSE 0 END) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON rs.region_name = (SELECT r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey) ORDER BY rs.region_name, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_name, hvc.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(fli.Revenue) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(rs.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalSupplierCost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) hvc LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS RecentRank FROM orders o) ro ON hvc.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey AND ro.RecentRank <= 5 LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) fli ON ro.o_orderkey = fli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs ON hvc.c_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.Rank = 1 GROUP BY hvc.c_name, hvc.nation_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, COALESCE(previous_year_sales, 0) AS previous_year_sales, COALESCE(growth_percentage, 0) AS growth_percentage FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY region) AS previous_year_sales, (total_sales - LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY region)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_sales) OVER (ORDER BY region), 0) * 100 AS growth_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) ORDER BY region;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, cp.c_name AS customer_name, cp.total_orders, cp.total_spent, tp.p_name, tp.p_retailprice, ts.total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000.00 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp ON n.n_nationkey = cp.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) tp ON cp.c_custkey = tp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) > 5000.00) ts ON ts.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE tp.rank = 1 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, cp.total_spent DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_order_value AS customer_value, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.supplier_total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT cus.c_custkey, cus.c_name, cus.total_order_value, cus.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cus.total_order_value DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) cus) tc JOIN (SELECT spc.s_suppkey, spc.s_name, SUM(spc.total_cost) AS supplier_total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(spc.total_cost) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, (ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spc GROUP BY spc.s_suppkey, spc.s_name) ts ON tc.order_count > 0 WHERE tc.customer_rank <= 10 AND ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.total_order_value DESC, ts.supplier_total_cost DESC;

SELECT co.c_name, co.order_count, COALESCE(ls.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, sp.total_available FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON co.c_custkey = ls.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) sp ON sp.p_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE co.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY co.order_count DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cod.c_name, cod.c_address, cod.c_nationkey, tor.total_revenue, tor.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_nationkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) cod JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, r.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' - INTERVAL '1' YEAR GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) tor ON cod.o_orderkey = tor.o_orderkey ORDER BY tor.total_revenue DESC, cod.c_name;

SELECT rc.c_name, rc.total_spent, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, pp.p_name, pp.total_sold FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) rc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON rc.c_nationkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 10) pp ON pp.total_sold > 100 WHERE rc.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ps.p_name AS part_name, ps.price_rank, ss.total_available_qty, ss.average_supply_cost, os.total_price, os.total_line_items FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10) ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.p_partkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON s.s_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_custkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE ps.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_price DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats)) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent > ts.total_supply_cost ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_nation_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ns.total_nation_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS total_nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns WHERE ns.total_nation_sales > 1000000 ORDER BY ns.total_nation_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(os.total_order_value) AS total_sales, AVG(ss.total_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, SUM(ss.part_count) AS total_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type LIKE 'metal%') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_supplycost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(od.total_order_value) AS total_revenue, SUM(rs.total_available_quantity) AS total_parts_available, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_suppkey) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey) od ON rs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l) ) GROUP BY rs.region_name, rs.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, p.p_type AS part_type, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(rp.total_available_qty) AS avg_available_qty, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem li ON p.p_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp ON p.p_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, p.p_type, rp.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_cost HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 100 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_available_qty ASC;

SELECT region, nation, total_orders, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_orders DESC) AS rank_by_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY total_orders DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.total_value, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY h.total_value DESC, s.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers, ROUND(AVG(ps.ps_supplycost), 2) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(a.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_by_mode FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_shipmode, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey INNER JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31') r ON o.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 5 GROUP BY l.l_shipmode) a ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1) GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) > 1 ORDER BY total_revenue_by_mode DESC, avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, sr.s_name AS supplier_name, sr.total_supplier_cost, sr.region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplier_cost, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name) sr ON ro.o_orderkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE ro.rank_revenue = 1 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, sr.total_supplier_cost ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r_name, SUM(supplier_count) AS total_suppliers, SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(order_value) AS total_order_value, SUM(total_available) AS total_available_qty, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(ss.total_suppliers, 0) AS supplier_count, COALESCE(os.total_orders, 0) AS order_count, COALESCE(os.total_order_value, 0) AS order_value, COALESCE(ps.total_available, 0) AS total_available, COALESCE(ps.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(s_acctbal) AS total_balance FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey) ss ON r.r_regionkey = ss.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON r.r_regionkey = os.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ss.s_nationkey = ps.ps_partkey) GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, total_suppliers DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.total_orders, rs.total_value, CASE WHEN rs.total_value > 1000000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN rs.total_value BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS value_category FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(no.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(no.total_value) AS total_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) no ON n.n_name = no.n_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN region r ON rs.r_name = r.r_name ORDER BY rs.total_value DESC, rs.total_orders DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, os.total_orders, os.total_spent, lid.total_revenue, lid.avg_discount, lid.unique_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os ON ss.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty = ss.total_available_qty LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lid ON lid.l_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = os.c_custkey LIMIT 1) ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT tr.c_custkey, tr.c_name, tr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tr JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as TotalRevenue) ar ON tr.total_revenue > ar.avg_revenue) hvc JOIN orders o ON hvc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_revenue ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS supplier, hp.total_value AS high_value_part, pc.c_name AS popular_customer, pc.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_suppkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hp ON rs.s_suppkey = hp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) >= 5) pc ON pc.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, hp.total_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, hr.total_revenue, hr.total_supplier_cost, hr.profit_margin FROM (SELECT ts.l_partkey, ts.total_revenue, ss.total_supplier_cost, ts.total_revenue - ss.total_supplier_cost AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT l_partkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey) ts JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplier_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey) ss ON ts.l_partkey = ss.p_partkey WHERE ts.total_revenue > 1000000) hr JOIN part p ON hr.l_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY hr.profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, ol.total_revenue, ol.total_lines FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_cost, sp.part_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_lines, SUM(l.l_quantity * l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' ) ) ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, ol.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, r.supplier_name, SUM(r.total_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(r.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, n.n_name) as calculated) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.nation_name, r.supplier_name ORDER BY r.nation_name, total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, SUM(osc.total_cost) AS supplier_cost, os.total_revenue, os.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os JOIN lineitem l ON os.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) osc ON l.l_suppkey = osc.s_suppkey GROUP BY os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue, os.lineitem_count HAVING SUM(osc.total_cost) < os.total_revenue ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC, os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.r_name, tn.total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(RO.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) RO JOIN customer c ON RO.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE RO.rn <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_name) tn ON n.n_name = tn.n_name ORDER BY r.r_name, tn.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.c_mktsegment, r.nation_name, r.total_sales, r.order_count, r.line_item_count FROM (SELECT s.c_mktsegment, s.nation_name, s.total_sales, s.order_count, s.line_item_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.c_mktsegment ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_item_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment, n.n_name) s) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.c_mktsegment, r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_revenue, cos.c_name AS customer_name, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sr.total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr ON s.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) cos ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ts.total_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_acctbal, rb.total_revenue, (rb.total_revenue / ts.supply_count) AS avg_revenue_per_supply FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation_name, s.s_acctbal, s.supply_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supply_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.supply_count > ( SELECT AVG(supply_count) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supply_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) as SupplierInfo )) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT li.l_suppkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem li JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY li.l_suppkey) rb ON ts.s_suppkey = rb.l_suppkey) ORDER BY avg_revenue_per_supply DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.c_name AS customer_name, h.c_custkey AS customer_key, t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.s_suppkey AS supplier_key, t.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT cus.c_custkey, cus.c_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cus WHERE cus.total_order_value > (SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) h JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) t ON t.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_custkey = h.c_custkey ) ORDER BY h.c_name, t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_total_revenue, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rs.total_revenue) AS region_total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) rs ON c.c_custkey = rs.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) WHERE rnk <= 5) ts ON r.region_total_revenue > 500000 ORDER BY r.region_total_revenue DESC, ts.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT d.s_suppkey, d.s_name, d.nation_name, d.region_name, tc.total_supply_cost, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_customer_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) tc ON d.s_suppkey = tc.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON d.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') co ON l.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey GROUP BY d.s_suppkey, d.s_name, d.nation_name, d.region_name, tc.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_customer_spent DESC, d.s_suppkey;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderstatus, od.o_totalprice, od.o_orderdate, od.region_name, od.nation_name, od.c_mktsegment, COALESCE(r.total_revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) od LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) r ON od.o_orderkey = r.l_orderkey WHERE od.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY revenue DESC, od.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, s.s_name, s.total_supply_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_supply_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON t.total_revenue = s.total_supply_revenue ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, s.total_supply_revenue DESC;

SELECT s.region, s.total_sales, s.sales_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.region = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey LIMIT 1) JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.region, s.total_sales, s.sales_rank HAVING s.total_sales > 1000000.00 ORDER BY s.sales_rank;

SELECT r.r_name, ra.order_count, ra.total_sales, AVG(ra.total_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ra JOIN region r ON r.r_name = ra.r_name WHERE ra.total_sales > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name, ra.order_count, ra.total_sales ORDER BY ra.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.c_name, tr.revenue, COUNT(li.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(li.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) tr JOIN lineitem li ON tr.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.c_name, tr.revenue ORDER BY tr.revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, ts.s_name, ts.profit FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.profit FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, (SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) - SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty)) AS profit FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.profit DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY c.c_name, ts.s_name, ts.profit HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, ts.profit DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_address, hvo.c_phone, od.l_quantity, od.l_extendedprice, od.l_discount, od.l_tax, od.p_name, od.s_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) hvo JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, p.p_name, s.s_name FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) as high_value_orders)) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey ORDER BY hvo.o_orderdate DESC, hvo.o_orderkey;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, ts.total_sales, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT sh.s_suppkey, sh.s_name, sh.s_nationkey, sh.s_acctbal, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS hierarchy_level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sh.hierarchy_level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS hierarchy_level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sh.hierarchy_level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.hierarchy_level < 3) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.hierarchy_level < 3) sh JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) ts ON sh.s_suppkey = ts.l_suppkey ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ts.total_sales > 50000 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT os.c_custkey, os.c_name, os.total_spent, os.total_orders, os.avg_order_value, sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.parts_supplied, sp.total_supply_cost, rn.n_name, rn.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) os JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON os.total_orders > 10 JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) rn ON os.total_spent > 1000 AND rn.total_revenue > 5000 ORDER BY os.total_spent DESC, sp.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT co.c_name, co.total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') LIMIT 1) WHERE co.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, cr.revenue_rank, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ro.revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr JOIN orders o ON cr.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, cr.revenue_rank HAVING cr.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name AS CustomerName, cs.TotalSpent AS TotalSpent, ts.s_name AS TopSupplier, ts.TotalSupplyCost AS SupplierCost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.TotalOrderValue) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalOrderValue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON cs.TotalSpent > (SELECT AVG(TotalSupplyCost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) as TopSuppliers) ORDER BY cs.TotalSpent DESC, ts.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT cwd.c_custkey, cwd.c_name, COUNT(owd.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(owd.o_totalprice) AS grand_total, AVG(owd.l_discount) AS average_discount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000) cwd JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_tax, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank_within_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank_within_nation <= 5) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) owd ON cwd.c_custkey = owd.o_orderkey GROUP BY cwd.c_custkey, cwd.c_name ORDER BY grand_total DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.total_revenue, od.distinct_customers, od.total_lineitems, od.supplier_name, od.supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS distinct_customers, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_lineitems, t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.nation AS supplier_nation FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) t ON ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, t.s_name, t.nation) od WHERE od.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC, od.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cd.c_custkey, cd.c_name, cd.nation_name, COALESCE(cd.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(cd.order_count, 0) AS order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(os.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(os.order_count, 0) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) cs ON c.c_nationkey = cs.s_nationkey) cd WHERE cd.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY cd.total_revenue DESC, cd.order_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, unique_customers, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_revenue, r.order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name, total_revenue, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) r) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, COALESCE(pss.total_sales_for_part, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(pss.supplier_count, 0) AS supplier_count, rs.s_name AS top_supplier_name FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(sd.total_sales) AS total_sales_for_part, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l INNER JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) sd ON ps.ps_partkey = sd.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) pss ON p.p_partkey = pss.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) rs ON rs.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1) ORDER BY p.p_partkey;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_price, MIN(l.l_discount) AS min_discount FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rc.c_custkey, rp.l_partkey, rs.total_cost, rc.order_count, rc.total_spent, rp.total_sales FROM (SELECT sc.s_suppkey, sc.total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc) rs JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co) rc ON rc.rank <= 10 JOIN (SELECT ps.l_partkey, ps.total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ps) rp ON rp.rank <= 10 WHERE rs.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC, rc.total_spent DESC, rp.total_sales DESC;

SELECT nation_name, COUNT(c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_by_nation, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales_per_customer, MAX(order_count) AS max_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales_by_nation DESC;

SELECT sv.s_suppkey, sv.s_name, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(li.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, AVG(li.l_discount) AS avg_discount, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS order_count, r.r_name AS region FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sv JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_returnflag, l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > ( SELECT AVG(o1.o_totalprice) FROM orders o1 WHERE o1.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' )) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey) li ON sv.p_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN nation n ON sv.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > ( SELECT AVG(o1.o_totalprice) FROM orders o1 WHERE o1.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' )) hvo ON li.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey WHERE li.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY sv.s_suppkey, sv.s_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ts.s_name AS supplier, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_quantity, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, stats.total_available_quantity, stats.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY stats.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) stats JOIN supplier s ON stats.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 MONTH' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) ro ON ts.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT tp.s_name, cp.c_name, cp.order_count, tp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank_in_nation <= 3) tp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, oc.order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) oc ON c.c_custkey = oc.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) cp ON cp.order_count > 5 ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC, cp.order_count ASC;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_availqty, rp.avg_supplycost, rc.nation_count, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey) rc ON rc.nation_count > 5 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent > 10000 WHERE rp.avg_supplycost < 50.00 ORDER BY rp.total_availqty DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.total_available_qty, rp.total_supply_cost, rco.region_name, rco.order_count, rco.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name, c.c_custkey) rco ON rp.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty = rp.total_available_qty LIMIT 1) ORDER BY rco.total_spent DESC, rp.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 100) as PerformanceBenchmark;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * l.l_discount) AS total_discounted_sales FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank = 1 AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name ORDER BY total_discounted_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, SUM(trp.total_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost_per_customer FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, SUM(co.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey) co GROUP BY co.c_custkey ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tc JOIN (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp WHERE rp.rank <= 10) trp ON trp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps) GROUP BY tc.c_custkey ORDER BY avg_supply_cost_per_customer DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(od.revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_supply_value = (SELECT MAX(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as Supplier_Summary)) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cp.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp JOIN customer c ON cp.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE cp.total_spent = (SELECT MAX(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as Customer_Purchases)) tc JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON od.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey) GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.o_totalprice, COALESCE(hvl.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(hvl.total_items, 0) AS total_items FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) hvl ON r.o_orderkey = hvl.l_orderkey WHERE r.rn <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.revenue) AS average_order_value, tr.total_revenue AS region_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ro.o_orderdate IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) tr ON r.r_regionkey = tr.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, tr.total_revenue HAVING AVG(ro.revenue) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_revenue, ts.total_orders, ts.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.total_revenue, so.total_orders, so.avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY so.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;
