SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, s.s_name AS supplier_name, hvl.high_value AS order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS high_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 50000) hvl ON r.o_orderkey = hvl.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps) JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000000) hvs ON s.s_suppkey = hvs.ps_suppkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.s_name, os.total_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS ranking FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON rs.s_suppkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.ranking <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_name LIKE '%' || CAST(os.o_orderkey AS VARCHAR) || '%' ORDER BY ts.region_name, os.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT fr.customer_name, fr.o_orderkey, fr.revenue, fr.supplier_count FROM (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey, ls.revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON o.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00 UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sc.level + 1 FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00 UNION ALL SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sc.level + 1 FROM supplier_chain sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00) sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00) sc ON sc.level < 2 GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, ls.revenue HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sc.s_suppkey) > 3) fr ORDER BY fr.revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tn.n_name, sd.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(wo.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) wo JOIN nation n ON wo.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE wo.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON tn.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey ORDER BY tn.total_revenue DESC, sd.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, ts.total_sales AS Supplier_Total_Sales, co.c_name AS Customer_Name, co.total_orders AS Customer_Total_Orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ss.total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey WHERE ts.total_sales > 5000 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, co.total_orders DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'N%' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, s.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_revenue, ts.total_orders, ts.avg_quantity FROM (SELECT suss.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) suss) ts WHERE ts.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hs.c_name AS HighSpendingCustomer, hs.TotalSpent, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT cus.c_custkey, cus.c_name, cus.TotalSpent, cus.OrderCount, r.r_name AS Region FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cus JOIN nation n ON cus.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE cus.TotalSpent > (SELECT AVG(TotalSpent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderSummary)) hs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON hs.Region = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r WHERE r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = hs.c_custkey)) WHERE rs.Rank <= 3 ORDER BY hs.TotalSpent DESC, rs.TotalCost DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) os JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss WHERE ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10 )) ts ON os.total_quantity > 100 WHERE os.o_totalprice > 5000 ORDER BY os.o_orderdate DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT d.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(d.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 10000) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey) d ON ps.ps_partkey = d.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(pc.total_sales) AS total_sales_last_6_months, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pc ON l.l_partkey = pc.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE sc.total_cost > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_sales_last_6_months DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sr.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.region_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, h.s_name, h.nation_name FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, r.order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sd ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey) WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) h ORDER BY h.o_totalprice DESC, h.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT ts.RegionName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity, AVG(l.l_discount) AS AverageDiscount FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.SupplierRank <= 5 JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ts.RegionName ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, tn.nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name) os JOIN (SELECT nation_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name) GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON os.nation_name = tn.nation_name ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, os.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT hs.s_name AS supplier_name, hs.total_supply_cost, hc.c_name AS customer_name, hc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acct_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) hs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) hc ON hs.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acct_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats) ORDER BY hs.total_supply_cost DESC, hc.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation AS supplier_nation, COALESCE(SUM(lo.total_sales), 0) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(sd.total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) sd LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS total_lines, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lo ON sd.s_suppkey = lo.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON lo.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey WHERE sd.s_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.nation ORDER BY total_sales DESC, avg_supplier_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.customer_name, ro.nation_name, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.order_rank, od.total_revenue, od.item_count, spp.supplier_name, spp.price_difference FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) od ON ro.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_retailprice, (p.p_retailprice - ps.ps_supplycost) AS price_difference FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spp ON spp.ps_supplycost < 10.00 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, od.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, ts.s_name, r.r_name, SUM(r.total_sales) AS region_total_sales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) c JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSupplier )) ts ON c.c_custkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ON ts.s_suppkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY c.c_name, ts.s_name, r.r_name ORDER BY region_total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.nation_name, p.p_name AS top_part_name, os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) sd JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_available_qty DESC LIMIT 10) p ON sd.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey) ORDER BY sd.nation_name, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_discounted_price, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate > l.l_commitdate GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rc.c_name AS cust_name, rc.total_spent, r.r_name AS region FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(roi.total_revenue) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(roi.total_revenue) DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) roi ON o.o_orderkey = roi.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc JOIN supplier s ON rc.c_custkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rc.customer_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT supplier_name, nation_name, total_revenue, total_orders, avg_quantity_per_order, avg_revenue_per_order, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT RegionName, NationName, SupplierName, TotalCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, n.n_name AS NationName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank, p.p_partkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.Rank <= 5) ORDER BY RegionName, NationName, TotalCost DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, sp.p_name, sp.p_brand, sp.total_available FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) tc JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) > 10000) hvo ON tc.o_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_mfgr, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_mfgr) sp ON sp.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = tc.o_orderkey) WHERE sp.total_available > 50 ORDER BY tc.o_orderdate DESC, tc.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.revenue, ts.total_spent, rg.r_name, rg.nation_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ts ON ro.o_orderkey = ts.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rg ON ts.ps_suppkey = rg.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 AND ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.revenue DESC, ts.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tfr.o_orderkey, tfr.total_revenue, tfr.n_name, tfr.supplier_count, tfr.total_account_balance FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ns.n_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_account_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON ro.o_orderstatus = 'F' WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) tfr ORDER BY tfr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(rl.l_extendedprice * (1 - rl.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT rl.l_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) r JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.l_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_shipdate DESC) AS rank FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '30 days') rl ON r.s_suppkey = rl.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') c ON rl.l_orderkey = c.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 5 AND c.rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.n_name, r.s_name, c.c_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ps.p_name, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supply_cost, ns.total_spent_by_nation, ns.avg_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(c.total_spent) AS total_spent_by_nation, AVG(c.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_customer FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ps.total_quantity_ordered > 1000 ORDER BY ns.total_spent_by_nation DESC, ps.avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Germany', 'China') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT pc.p_partkey, pc.p_name, pc.p_retailprice, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, rp.total_avail_qty FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_brand) rp WHERE rp.rn <= 5) pc JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = pc.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) tc ON o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE tc.rn <= 10 ORDER BY pc.p_retailprice DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_available_qty, os.lineitem_count, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_address LIKE '%' || rs.nation_name || '%') WHERE rs.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.nation_count, r.total_supplier_balance, c.c_name AS top_customer_name, c.total_order_value, p.p_name AS part_name, p.avg_supply_cost, p.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 5) c CROSS JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) p WHERE r.nation_count > 5 AND c.total_order_value > 10000 ORDER BY r.region_name, c.total_order_value DESC, p.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT so.s_suppkey, so.s_name, so.total_revenue, so.total_orders, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, so.order_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE so.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY so.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ps.total_cost) AS total_parts_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') ro INNER JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name INNER JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey INNER JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey INNER JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey ) WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_parts_cost DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, t.nation_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(li.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem li ON t.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, t.nation_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.total_revenue, t.o_orderdate, n.n_name AS buyer_nation FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, r.o_orderdate, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.rn = 1) t JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT m.c_mktsegment, AVG(c.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(c.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered, SUM(c.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_mktsegment, s.s_name AS supplier_name, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM customer c) WHERE rnk <= 10) AND s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) as HighValueSuppliers)) c JOIN customer m ON c.customer_name = m.c_name GROUP BY m.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(SUM(st.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_order_value), 0) AS total_order_value, ns.supplier_count FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st ON n.n_nationkey = st.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, ns.supplier_count ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, total_order_value DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'AIR') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hc.nation_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT r.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 50000) hc ON os.o_custkey = hc.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r ON hc.nation_name = r.nation_name AND r.rank <= 5 GROUP BY hc.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, tp.total_supply_value, rs.r_name AS supplier_region, rs.total_available_qty, od.total_order_value, od.total_line_items FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_mfgr, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, rp.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp WHERE rp.rank <= 5) tp JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON tp.p_partkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_line_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) od ON od.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey)) ORDER BY tp.total_supply_value DESC, od.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, tr.n_name, tr.region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS region_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = tr.n_name ) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, tr.region_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY so.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ol.l_extendedprice * (1 - ol.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem ol ON ps.ps_partkey = ol.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON ol.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT psi.p_name, psi.supplier_count, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ts.supplier_count, p.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ts JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p_retailprice) FROM part)) hp ON ts.ps_partkey = hp.p_partkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = hp.p_partkey) psi JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') co ON psi.supplier_count > 5 ORDER BY psi.supplier_count DESC, co.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rhv.o_orderkey, rhv.o_orderdate, rhv.o_totalprice, rhv.c_name, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 AND ro.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) rhv JOIN lineitem li ON rhv.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd ON li.l_partkey = sd.ps_partkey ORDER BY rhv.o_orderdate DESC, rhv.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(tc.total_revenue) AS region_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_name) AS number_of_top_customers FROM (SELECT o.rn, o.c_name, r.r_name, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) o JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = o.c_name) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.rn <= 5 GROUP BY o.rn, o.c_name, r.r_name) tc JOIN region r ON tc.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, cov.c_name AS top_customer, cov.total_order_value FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE supplier_rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cov ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'BrandX' ) ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_value DESC, cov.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.rank, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.revenue DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE ss.revenue > 0) t WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.rank;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(cust_name) AS top_customer_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_sum FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rc.c_name AS cust_name, rc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) rc JOIN customer c ON rc.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rc.rank <= 10) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue_sum DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, tp.p_name, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.p_partkey, ps.p_name, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_available DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps) tp ON l.l_partkey = tp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT r.nation_name, r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND tp.rank <= 10 ORDER BY tp.total_available DESC, o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderdate, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE') GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ts.region_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey)) WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ts.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.nation_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name, ns.nation_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ns.nation_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON n.n_name = ns.n_name) n WHERE n.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY n.nation_sales DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, lis.total_revenue, lis.total_lines FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as ranking FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as total_revenue, COUNT(*) as total_lines FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON ro.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) sd ON sd.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) LIMIT 1) WHERE ro.ranking <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT psd.p_name, psd.s_name, psd.ps_availqty, psd.ps_supplycost, cod.c_name, cod.o_orderkey, cod.o_orderdate, la.total_sales, la.line_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) psd JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT lo.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) la ON psd.p_partkey = la.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) cod ON cod.o_orderkey = la.l_orderkey WHERE psd.p_retailprice > 50 AND cod.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY psd.p_name, la.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, customer_count, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(COALESCE(sos.total_revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name) sos ON sos.supplier_name IN ( SELECT s.s_name FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY region_name, revenue_rank;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.c_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) o WHERE revenue_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE t.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, t.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.total_parts_supplied, os.total_orders, os.total_order_value, ns.unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA')) LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ns.unique_suppliers > 0 ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT bo.o_orderkey, bo.o_orderdate, bo.c_name, spd.s_name AS supplier_name, spd.p_brand, spd.p_type, spd.p_retailprice, bo.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) bo JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spd ON bo.o_orderkey = spd.ps_partkey ORDER BY bo.total_revenue DESC, bo.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT t.r_name AS region, t.n_name AS nation, t.s_name AS supplier, t.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) t WHERE t.supplier_rank <= 3 ORDER BY t.r_name, t.n_name, t.supplier_rank;

SELECT region, nation, COUNT(customer_name) AS top_customers_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, o.c_name AS customer_name, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region, nation ORDER BY region, total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers, SUM(ts.total_available_qty) AS total_inventory, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_available_qty, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_inventory DESC, avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ss.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierSummary) ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-02-01' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name, rs.p_name, rs.p_brand, rs.p_size, rs.p_retailprice, rs.sales, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, ts.sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT l_partkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS sales FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.sales DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.total_revenue, ss.supplier_name, ss.supplied_parts, ss.total_supply_cost, pm.p_name, pm.supplier_count, pm.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) ss ON ts.nation_name = ss.supplier_name JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) pm ON ss.supplier_name = pm.p_name ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC, ss.total_supply_cost DESC, pm.supplier_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, nation_name, p_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, t.nation_name, p.p_name, p.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name) p ON t.o_orderkey = p.ps_partkey ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC) WHERE total_supply_cost > 1000 LIMIT 100;

SELECT fr.region_name, fr.order_count, fr.total_order_value, fr.supplier_count, fr.total_supply_cost, (fr.total_order_value / NULLIF(fr.order_count, 0)) AS avg_order_value, (fr.total_supply_cost / NULLIF(fr.supplier_count, 0)) AS avg_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT rs.region_name, cos.order_count, cos.total_order_value, rs.supplier_count, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cos ON rs.region_name = (SELECT r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = cos.c_nationkey)) fr ORDER BY fr.region_name;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON rs.nation_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n2.n_nationkey) FROM nation n2 WHERE n2.n_regionkey = (SELECT r2.r_regionkey FROM region r2 WHERE r2.r_name = rs.region_name)) ORDER BY rs.region_name;

SELECT r.r_name, r.revenue_sum, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.revenue_sum DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS revenue_sum FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank = 1 GROUP BY r.r_name) r ORDER BY revenue_rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT COALESCE(r.nation_name, 'N/A') AS supplier_nation, SUM(h.ps_supplycost * h.ps_availqty) AS total_cost_of_high_value_items, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.c_custkey) AS active_customers, AVG(ch.total_spent) AS avg_spent_per_customer FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier )) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty < 100) h ON r.s_suppkey = h.p_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) ch ON r.s_suppkey = ch.c_custkey WHERE r.rank = 1 GROUP BY r.nation_name ORDER BY total_cost_of_high_value_items DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.region_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY tr.region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ns.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON ns.nation_name = n.n_name GROUP BY r.r_name) tr WHERE tr.region_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY tr.region_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name AS customer_name, t.c_mktsegment, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.p_name AS part_name, s.ps_availqty, s.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') o WHERE o.rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey WHERE s.ps_supplycost < 100.00 ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT cs.nation_name, cs.order_count, cs.total_order_value, cs.supplier_count, cs.total_account_balance, cs.total_supply_cost, (CASE WHEN cs.total_order_value > 0 THEN (cs.total_supply_cost / cs.total_order_value) * 100 ELSE 0 END) AS supply_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT ns.nation_name, os.order_count, os.total_order_value, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_account_balance, ns.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON ns.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey)) cs WHERE cs.total_order_value > 50000 ORDER BY cs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, sac.total_sales, sac.total_supply_cost, sac.profit FROM (SELECT ts.l_partkey, ts.total_sales, sc.total_supply_cost, (ts.total_sales - sc.total_supply_cost) AS profit FROM (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r ON l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey) sc ON ts.l_partkey = sc.ps_partkey) sac JOIN part p ON sac.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE sac.profit > 0 ORDER BY sac.profit DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.total_revenue, pd.p_name, pd.supplier_count, pd.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueSummary) t JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) pd ON (t.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_extendedprice > 1000 LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1) LIMIT 1))) WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('Germany', 'France', 'United Kingdom') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
