SELECT ts.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers, SUM(ts.total_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_revenue, t.order_count, t.avg_order_value, t.total_quantity FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_revenue, order_count, avg_order_value, total_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) t WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_supplier_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name, r.r_regionkey, SUM(rs.total_value) AS total_supplier_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY sum(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank = 1 GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_regionkey) r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name, r.total_supplier_value ORDER BY r.total_supplier_value DESC;

SELECT rcs.region_name, rcs.total_customers, rcs.total_account_balance, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_value AS top_supplier_value, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, os.total_tax FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rcs CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' WHERE rcs.total_customers > 100 ORDER BY rcs.total_account_balance DESC, ts.total_value DESC, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.suppkey, t.name, t.acctbal, t.nation_name, t.region_name, t.total_available_quantity, t.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey AS suppkey, s.s_name AS name, s.s_acctbal AS acctbal, s.nation_name, s.region_name, s.total_available_quantity, s.total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name, r.r_name) s) t WHERE t.supply_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, CASE WHEN tr.sales_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top 5 Region' WHEN tr.sales_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10 Region' ELSE 'Below Top 10' END AS sales_category FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr ORDER BY tr.sales_rank;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT supplier_name) AS top_suppliers_count, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY total_cost_of_top_suppliers DESC, region_name, nation_name;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, sd.s_name, sd.part_count, os.o_clerk, os.avg_order_price, os.total_orders FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 5) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_clerk, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_clerk) os ON os.o_clerk = 'CLERK_1' WHERE rp.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, sd.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ts.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ts.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.l_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(od.revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(od.total_quantity) AS avg_quantity, MAX(od.max_shipmode) AS peak_shipmode FROM (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS revenue, SUM(lo.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, MAX(lo.l_shipmode) AS max_shipmode, MAX(lo.l_returnflag) AS return_flag FROM lineitem lo JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') ro ON lo.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE lo.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND lo.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) od JOIN supplier s ON od.l_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT od.l_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cos.c_name, cos.c_acctbal, cos.c_mktsegment, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, tc.c_mktsegment, os.order_count, os.total_spent, os.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT rc.c_custkey, rc.c_name, rc.c_acctbal, rc.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) rc WHERE rc.rnk <= 10) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON tc.c_custkey = os.o_custkey) cos JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50.00 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.total_sales, t.total_orders, (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') o WHERE rank <= 10 GROUP BY region_name) as TopOrders) AS avg_sales_per_region, (SELECT MAX(total_sales) FROM (SELECT region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') o WHERE rank <= 10 GROUP BY region_name) as TopOrders) AS max_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') o WHERE rank <= 10 GROUP BY region_name) t ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderstatus, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_acctbal, od.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rn <= 10) hvo LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rn <= 10) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey ORDER BY hvo.o_orderkey;

SELECT n.n_name, n.total_revenue, r.r_comment FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(RankedOrders.revenue) AS total_revenue, c.c_nationkey, -- added to GROUP BY n.n_nationkey -- added to GROUP BY FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = RankedOrders.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, c.c_nationkey, n.n_nationkey -- updated GROUP BY ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) n JOIN region r ON n.c_nationkey = r.r_regionkey -- fixed join condition WHERE r.r_name = 'Europe' ORDER BY n.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ps.p_name, COALESCE(ps.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(ss.total_supply_value, 0) AS total_supply_value, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ps.total_sales, 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(ss.total_supply_value, 0) / COALESCE(ps.total_sales, 1)) ELSE 0 END AS supply_to_sales_ratio FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ps.p_partkey = ss.s_suppkey ORDER BY supply_to_sales_ratio DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, avg_price, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, avg_price, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(ts.c_custkey) AS number_of_top_spenders, AVG(ts.total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, roi.c_custkey, roi.c_name, roi.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) roi JOIN supplier s ON roi.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE roi.rank_spending <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY ts.region_name, avg_spent DESC;

SELECT fr.c_name AS Customer_Name, COUNT(fr.o_orderkey) AS Number_of_Orders, AVG(fr.total_supply_cost) AS Average_Supply_Cost, MIN(fr.o_orderdate) AS First_Order_Date, MAX(fr.o_orderdate) AS Last_Order_Date FROM (SELECT co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, ps.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') co JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name) ps ON co.o_orderkey % 100 = ps.s_suppkey % 100) fr GROUP BY fr.c_name ORDER BY Number_of_Orders DESC, Average_Supply_Cost ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'FOB') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.NationName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, c.c_name AS CustomerName, cos.TotalOrders, cos.TotalSpent, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplyRank, n.n_name AS NationName FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation ro ON rs.NationName = ro.n_name JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = ro.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON c.c_custkey = cos.c_custkey WHERE rs.SupplyRank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.NationName, cos.TotalSpent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, MAX(s.total_supply_cost) AS highest_supplier_cost FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT NationName, SupplierName, CustomerName, TotalOrders, TotalSpent, TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT hcs.NationName, hcs.s_name AS SupplierName, co.c_name AS CustomerName, co.TotalOrders, co.TotalSpent, hcs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.Rank, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS NationName, s.TotalSupplyCost, s.s_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.Rank = 1) hcs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON hcs.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey) ORDER BY NationName, TotalSupplyCost DESC, TotalSpent DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.avg_supply_cost, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, stats.total_available_qty, stats.avg_supply_cost, stats.total_parts_supplied, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY stats.total_available_qty DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) stats ON s.s_suppkey = stats.s_suppkey) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey) tc ON tc.customer_rank <= 10 WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_available_qty DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ts.c_mktsegment, ts.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(r.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN customer c ON r.o_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LIMIT 1) WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) ts JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = ts.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY ts.c_mktsegment, ts.total_revenue, r.r_name ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cn.c_name, ts.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_value, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) co JOIN customer cn ON co.c_custkey = cn.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) > 5) ts ON cn.c_nationkey = ts.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON cn.c_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3 GROUP BY cn.c_name, ts.r_name, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s WHERE total_value > 100000) WHERE rank <= 5) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50 AND p.p_size < 20 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, p.p_retailprice DESC;

SELECT cr.c_name, tr.r_name, cr.total_order_value, tr.total_region_supply FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rs.total_supply_value) AS total_region_supply FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS region_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.region_rank WHERE rs.region_rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name) tr ON cr.c_custkey = ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'NATION_NAME' ) ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY cr.total_order_value DESC, tr.total_region_supply DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_supplier_balance, tr.total_nations, tr.total_parts, (SELECT AVG(total_supplier_balance) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_supplier_balance, total_nations, total_parts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supplier_balance DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSummary) as TopRegions) AS avg_supplier_balance, (SELECT MAX(total_parts) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_supplier_balance, total_nations, total_parts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supplier_balance DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSummary) as TopRegions) AS max_parts FROM (SELECT region_name, total_supplier_balance, total_nations, total_parts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supplier_balance DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSummary) tr WHERE tr.rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.rank;

SELECT tp.p_name, tp.p_retailprice, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT sp.ps_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.p_retailprice, sp.p_brand FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_brand, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_brand) sp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.nation_name = n.n_name WHERE s.rn <= 5) ts ON sp.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE sp.supplier_count > 1) tp JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = tp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.nation_name = n.n_name WHERE s.rn <= 5) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY tp.p_name, tp.p_retailprice ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, c_mktsegment, total_revenue FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, c_mktsegment, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, c.c_mktsegment, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate > o.o_orderdate GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_mktsegment, n.n_name, r.r_name) as OrderedItems) WHERE rank <= 10 ORDER BY c_mktsegment, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(rs.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(rs.total_sales) AS avg_sales, SUM(rs.total_sales) AS total_sales_value FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MIN(o.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) s) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC;

SELECT region, nation, supplier_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#11')) JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ORDER BY region, nation, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.nation, rs.total_revenue, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, MIN(s.s_acctbal) AS min_account_balance, MAX(s.s_acctbal) AS max_account_balance, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM (SELECT nation, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 year' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalSales) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23') JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY rs.nation, rs.total_revenue ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(tc.customer_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue, SUM(od.total_quantity) AS customer_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(od.total_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc JOIN supplier s ON tc.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tc.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.c_name AS customer_name, t.o_orderkey, t.o_totalprice, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_acctbal, s.p_name AS part_name, s.p_brand AS part_brand FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') r WHERE r.price_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s ON t.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey) ORDER BY t.o_totalprice DESC, s.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation ASC;

SELECT cust.c_name, cust.c_address, t.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN orders o ON t.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer cust ON o.o_custkey = cust.c_custkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tp.l_partkey, sp.p_name, sd.region_name, tp.total_quantity, tp.average_discount, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_partkey) tp JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, pr.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region pr ON n.n_regionkey = pr.r_regionkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, pr.r_name) sd ON tp.l_partkey = sd.p_partkey JOIN part sp ON tp.l_partkey = sp.p_partkey WHERE tp.total_quantity > 100 ORDER BY sd.total_supply_cost DESC, tp.total_quantity DESC;

SELECT r.p_partkey, r.p_name, r.p_retailprice, r.total_cost, s.s_name, s.num_parts, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON r.p_partkey = s.num_parts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON o.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as OrderSummary) ORDER BY r.total_cost DESC, o.total_revenue ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, tc.c_name AS customer_name, p.p_name AS part_name, p.supplier_name, p.ps_availqty, p.ps_supplycost, p.region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON ro.c_name = tc.c_name JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) p ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey) WHERE ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rd.r_name, rd.region_revenue, pp.p_name, pp.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(tp.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_partkey) tp ON ps.ps_partkey = tp.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rd JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_type, tp.total_revenue FROM part p JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_partkey) tp ON p.p_partkey = tp.l_partkey) pp ON rd.r_name = pp.p_type ORDER BY rd.region_revenue DESC, pp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(pc.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost, AVG(os.total_spent) AS average_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_size, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_size) pc ON pc.total_quantity > 100 JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) sc ON sc.total_cost < 100000 GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.total_supply_cost, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as SupplierSummary) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months') LIMIT 1) WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.region_name, n.total_supply_cost, n.total_orders, n.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COALESCE(SA.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(CA.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(CA.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_nationkey) SA ON n.n_nationkey = SA.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_nationkey) CA ON n.n_nationkey = CA.c_nationkey) n WHERE n.total_supply_cost > 0 AND n.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY n.total_revenue DESC, n.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, t.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.n_nationkey) AS unique_nations, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, MAX(o.rank) AS max_order_rank FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) t ON r.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n_r.n_regionkey FROM nation n_r WHERE n_r.n_nationkey = t.n_nationkey ) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) o ON t.total_revenue > 1000000 GROUP BY r.r_name, t.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o_orderdate, li.total_revenue, ts.total_cost FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) li ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) as top_suppliers) ts WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, unique_customers, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, unique_customers, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.p_brand, rs.p_name, rs.p_retailprice, ss.s_name, ss.total_parts, ss.total_supplycost, os.total_revenue, os.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part p) rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON rs.p_partkey = ss.total_parts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey = ss.s_suppkey WHERE rs.brand_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.p_retailprice DESC, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) tro ON tro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey ) JOIN customer c ON tro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY p.p_name ORDER BY total_available_qty DESC;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_sales, r.total_orders, r.sales_rank, r.total_sales / r.total_orders AS avg_sale_per_order FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA')) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.sales_rank;

SELECT sp.s_name AS supplier_name, cp.c_name AS customer_name, os.total_sales AS total_order_sales, os.line_count AS total_line_items, rs.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_count AS distinct_nations, CAST('1998-10-01' AS DATE) AS report_date FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') cp ON sp.ps_supplycost = cp.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) os ON cp.o_orderkey = os.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rs ON sp.s_suppkey = (SELECT MIN(s2.s_suppkey) FROM supplier s2) WHERE sp.ps_availqty > 0 ORDER BY sp.s_name, cp.c_name, os.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS top_customer_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_sum FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rc.c_name AS customer_name, rc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey) rc JOIN supplier s ON rc.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, order_count, customer_count FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, order_count, customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '2000-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '2001-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueSummary) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT h.l_orderkey) AS high_value_orders, SUM(h.total_value) AS total_high_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5 GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) h ON h.l_orderkey IN (SELECT l_orderkey FROM lineitem) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_high_value DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, COUNT(ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_per_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rank_cost <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY total_cost_per_region DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT supplier_region, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l_discount) AS average_discount, AVG(customer_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name AS customer_name, ro.c_acctbal AS customer_acctbal, rso.l_orderkey AS line_orderkey, rso.l_quantity, rso.l_extendedprice, rso.l_discount, rso.s_name AS supplier_name, rso.s_acctbal AS supplier_acctbal, rso.supplier_region FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS supplier_region FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01') rso ON ro.o_orderkey = rso.l_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) GROUP BY supplier_region ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.n_comment, COALESCE(sr.supplier_count, 0) AS supplier_count, COALESCE(sr.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(nr.nation_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) sr ON n.n_nationkey = sr.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ls.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro ON n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nr ON n.n_name = nr.n_name WHERE COALESCE(sr.supplier_count, 0) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ha.p_partkey, ha.p_name, ha.p_mfgr, ha.total_available, ha.avg_supplycost, co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_mfgr, rp.total_available, rp.avg_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.p_mfgr ORDER BY rp.total_available DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr) rp WHERE rp.total_available > 100) ha JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON ha.avg_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ha2.avg_supplycost) FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_mfgr, rp.total_available, rp.avg_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rp.p_mfgr ORDER BY rp.total_available DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr) rp WHERE rp.total_available > 100) ha2) WHERE ha.rank <= 5 ORDER BY ha.total_available DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT hc.c_custkey) AS high_value_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN rs.rnk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS top_suppliers, rc.nation_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) hc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) rs ON hc.c_custkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN region r ON rs.s_suppkey = (SELECT DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_container = 'SM CASE' LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rc ON r.r_name = rc.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name, rc.nation_count ORDER BY region;

SELECT region_name, nation_count, total_supplier_balance, supplier_name, total_supply_value, total_revenue, part_count FROM (SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, ts.supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value, os.total_revenue, os.part_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON rs.region_name = ( SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1 ) LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS part_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.o_orderkey = ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 1 )) ORDER BY total_supplier_balance DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size IN (1, 2, 3) GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_customers DESC;

SELECT fs.s_suppkey, fs.s_name, fs.nation, fs.unique_parts_count, fs.total_available_qty, fs.avg_supply_cost, ROUND(fs.total_available_qty * fs.avg_supply_cost, 2) AS total_value FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.p_name) AS unique_parts_count, rs.total_available_qty, rs.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation, rs.total_available_qty, rs.avg_supply_cost) fs WHERE fs.total_available_qty > 100 ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.total_available_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, od.total_lines, od.total_revenue, od.total_tax, sr.nation_name, sr.region_name, sr.total_acct_bal FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, COUNT(li.l_linenumber) AS total_lines, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(li.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM lineitem li JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND li.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) od ON ps.ps_partkey = od.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acct_bal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) sr ON ps.ps_partkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.total_available_qty DESC, od.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.c_mktsegment, rs.revenue, ts.order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) rs JOIN (SELECT c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c_mktsegment) ts ON rs.c_mktsegment = ts.c_mktsegment WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.order_count DESC, rs.revenue DESC;

SELECT reg.region_name, reg.nation_name, cust.total_orders, cust.total_spent, supp.total_available_quantity, supp.average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) reg JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cust ON reg.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = cust.c_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) supp ON supp.ps_partkey = (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%Widget%') WHERE reg.supplier_count > 5 AND cust.total_orders > 10 AND supp.total_available_quantity > 50 ORDER BY reg.region_name, reg.nation_name;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.order_value, hvo.s_name FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.order_value, ts.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) od JOIN lineitem l ON od.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) hvo ORDER BY hvo.order_value DESC;

SELECT f.s_suppkey, f.s_name, f.r_name, f.total_revenue, f.total_cost, f.revenue_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.r_name, ts.total_revenue, rs.total_cost, ts.total_revenue / rs.total_cost AS revenue_cost_ratio FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON ts.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) f ORDER BY f.revenue_cost_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.nation_name AS nation, r.total_revenue, CASE WHEN r.revenue_rank = 1 THEN 'Highest Revenue' WHEN r.revenue_rank <= 5 THEN 'Top 5 Revenues' ELSE 'Other Nations' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueByNation) r ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY p.p_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, p.p_name ASC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p_partkey FROM part WHERE p_size >= 10 ) ORDER BY rs.region_name ASC, ps.avg_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(s_name) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name, s.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) s JOIN nation n ON s.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.rn <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COALESCE(o.revenue, 0) AS revenue, COALESCE(fs.top_supplier, 'None') AS top_supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o LEFT JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) avg_cost)) ts ON ro.o_orderkey % ts.s_suppkey = 0) fs ON o.o_orderkey = fs.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT sin.n_name AS nation, COUNT(sin.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, ns.n_nationkey, ns.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name IN ('FRANCE', 'GERMANY', 'USA')) ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10) sin JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON sin.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY sin.n_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT hp.nation_name, hp.total_sales, p.p_mfgr, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5) hp JOIN supplier s ON hp.nation_name IN ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY hp.nation_name, hp.total_sales, p.p_mfgr, p.p_name ORDER BY hp.total_sales DESC, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT e.c_name, e.RevenueFromOrders, e.TotalSupplyValue, (e.RevenueFromOrders - e.TotalSupplyValue) AS ProfitMargin FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(ol.TotalRevenue) AS RevenueFromOrders, SUM(sp.SupplyValue) AS TotalSupplyValue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON co.o_orderkey = ol.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, (ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS SupplyValue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON ol.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) e WHERE e.RevenueFromOrders > e.TotalSupplyValue ORDER BY ProfitMargin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS UniqueCustomers, SUM(cs.TotalSpent) AS TotalRevenue, MAX(rs.TotalCost) AS MaxSupplierCost, MIN(rs.TotalCost) AS MinSupplierCost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.total_available_quantity, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, cos.c_custkey, cos.c_name, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON rp.total_supply_cost > 10000 AND ts.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON cos.total_spent > 5000 ORDER BY rp.total_available_quantity DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;
