SELECT R.r_name AS region_name, T.s_name AS supplier_name, T.total_supplier_cost, R.r_comment, COUNT(DISTINCT O.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(RO.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(sp.supplier_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 5) T JOIN supplier S ON T.s_name = S.s_name JOIN nation N ON S.s_nationkey = N.n_nationkey JOIN region R ON N.n_regionkey = R.r_regionkey JOIN orders O ON O.o_custkey = N.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) RO ON O.o_orderkey = RO.o_orderkey GROUP BY R.r_name, T.s_name, T.total_supplier_cost, R.r_comment ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, s.s_name, s.avg_supply_cost, n.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1993-01-01' AND DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, s.avg_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.order_count, r.total_revenue, r.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, o.order_count, o.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name) o JOIN region r ON o.r_name = r.r_name) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, hs.s_name, hs.total_cost FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.c_acctbal, cs.c_nationkey, cc.total_spent FROM customer cs JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) cc ON cs.c_custkey = cc.o_custkey WHERE cc.total_spent > 10000) tc JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 10) hs ON tc.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = tc.c_nationkey) ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, hs.total_cost DESC;

SELECT region.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS avg_top_supplier_cost FROM region LEFT JOIN nation n ON region.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON n.n_name = ts.nation_name GROUP BY region.r_name ORDER BY top_supplier_count DESC, avg_top_supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.n_name AS nation, ts.r_name AS region, aos.order_year, AVG(aos.net_revenue) AS avg_net_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) - SUM(l.l_discount) AS net_revenue, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS order_year FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) aos ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) = aos.order_year)) GROUP BY ts.s_name, ts.n_name, ts.r_name, aos.order_year ORDER BY ts.r_name, aos.order_year;

SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, t.s_name AS top_supplier_name, t.total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as RankedSuppliers) t ON ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey WHERE t.rank = 1 ORDER BY p.p_name, t.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT NationName, SupplierCount, RegionSupplyCost, TotalOrders, TotalOrderValue, (SELECT AVG(TotalSupplyCost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as SupplierDetails) AS AvgSupplierCost FROM (SELECT ns.n_name AS NationName, ns.SupplierCount, ns.RegionSupplyCost, cos.TotalOrders, cos.TotalOrderValue FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount, SUM(sd.TotalSupplyCost) AS RegionSupplyCost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON s.s_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cos ON ns.n_regionkey = (SELECT n_regionkey FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = cos.c_nationkey)) WHERE TotalOrderValue > (SELECT AVG(TotalOrderValue) FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) as CustomerOrderSummary) ORDER BY TotalOrderValue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(sh.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS depth FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00 UNION ALL SELECT sp.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sh.depth + 1 FROM partsupp sp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS depth FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000.00 UNION ALL SELECT sp.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, sh.depth + 1 FROM partsupp sp JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON sp.ps_partkey = ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 500.00 ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sh ON sp.ps_partkey = ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 500.00 ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sh JOIN nation n ON sh.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(sh.s_acctbal) > 50000.00 ORDER BY total_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, os.order_count, os.total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os ON rs.s_suppkey = os.c_custkey WHERE rs.rank_in_region <= 5 ORDER BY rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT s.c_name, s.total_orders, s.total_spent, s.avg_order_value, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(cs.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(cs.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) tc JOIN lineitem l ON tc.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_name = c.c_name GROUP BY c.c_name) s JOIN nation n ON s.c_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(cs.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(cs.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) tc JOIN lineitem l ON tc.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_name = c.c_name GROUP BY c.c_name) as SalesSummary) ORDER BY s.total_orders DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ts.r_name AS supplier_region, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT ra.r_name, sa.total_supply_cost, sa.supplier_count FROM (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) sa JOIN nation n ON sa.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region ra ON n.n_regionkey = ra.r_regionkey ORDER BY sa.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ro.o_orderkey % 5 = 0 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, co.c_name, ts.total_revenue, co.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) co ON ts.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC, co.order_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COALESCE(s.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost, COALESCE(s.supplier_count, 0) AS total_suppliers, COALESCE(o.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(o.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp JOIN supplier ON partsupp.ps_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey GROUP BY s_nationkey) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey GROUP BY c_nationkey) o ON n.n_nationkey = o.c_nationkey ORDER BY region_name;

SELECT tn.n_name, tn.total_top_price, ss.s_name, ss.parts_count, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.order_rank <= 10 THEN ro.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS total_top_price FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') ro ON n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) tn JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON tn.n_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'United States') ORDER BY tn.total_top_price DESC, ss.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_spent, ss.total_available, ss.average_supply_cost, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders AS o JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) AS ro JOIN orders AS o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) AS tc ON c.c_custkey = tc.c_custkey JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) AS ss ON ss.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp AS ps ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY region, total_spent DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.customer_revenue, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc JOIN nation n ON tc.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tc.customer_revenue = (SELECT MAX(customer_revenue) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as TopCustomers) ORDER BY tc.customer_revenue DESC;

SELECT td.o_orderkey, td.total_price_after_discount, pd.p_partkey, pd.p_name, pd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ti.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_price_after_discount FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-12-31') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5) ti JOIN lineitem li ON ti.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY ti.o_orderkey) td JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(si.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_nationkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) si ON p.p_partkey = si.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pd ON td.o_orderkey = pd.p_partkey WHERE td.total_price_after_discount > 1000 ORDER BY td.total_price_after_discount DESC, pd.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS average_quantity, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.total_order_value, od.total_line_items, od.s_name AS supplier_name, od.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS total_line_items, od.s_name, od.r_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, r.r_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) ts JOIN region r ON ts.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5) od ON l.l_suppkey = od.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, od.s_name, od.r_name) od WHERE od.total_order_value > 1000 ORDER BY od.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT s.nation_name, s.total_sales, r.sales_rank, (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalSales) AS avg_sales FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalSales) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) s ON s.nation_name = r.nation_name WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.sales_rank;

SELECT ts.s_name, hsc.c_name, ts.total_sales, hsc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) hsc ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) c)) ) ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, hsc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT spd.supplier_name) AS total_suppliers, AVG(spd.supplier_account_balance) AS avg_supplier_balance, SUM(spd.supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT spd.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY spd.ps_partkey ORDER BY spd.total_quantity_sold DESC) AS rank_within_part FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, ps.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost, (SELECT SUM(l.l_quantity) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) AS total_quantity_sold FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) spd) spd JOIN supplier s ON spd.supplier_name = s.s_name JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT spd.supplier_name) > 1 ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.total_cost, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_type) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey WHERE rp.rnk <= 5 ORDER BY rp.total_cost DESC, sd.nation_name ASC;

SELECT tr.r_name, tr.regional_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.regional_sales FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS regional_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.n_regionkey ORDER BY rs.regional_sales DESC LIMIT 5) tr JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = tr.r_name) GROUP BY tr.r_name, tr.regional_sales ORDER BY tr.regional_sales DESC;

SELECT pv.o_orderkey, pv.o_orderdate, pv.c_name, pv.o_totalprice, pv.ps_supplycost, pv.price_variance FROM (SELECT tp.o_orderkey, tp.o_orderdate, tp.o_totalprice, tp.c_name, sp.ps_supplycost, (tp.o_totalprice - sp.ps_supplycost) AS price_variance FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01') WHERE rn <= 10) tp JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_supplycost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_supplycost) sp ON tp.o_orderkey = sp.ps_partkey) pv WHERE pv.price_variance > 1000 ORDER BY pv.price_variance DESC;

SELECT r.p_partkey, r.p_name, r.p_brand, r.p_type, r.p_retailprice, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, os.total_order_amount, os.unique_customers FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rnk FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2)) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON r.rnk = 1 AND r.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey = r.p_partkey) WHERE r.p_retailprice < (SELECT MAX(p3.p_retailprice) FROM part p3) * 0.9 ORDER BY r.p_retailprice DESC, sd.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.r_name, rp.number_of_customers, rp.total_revenue_from_customers, rp.total_revenue_from_suppliers, (rp.total_revenue_from_customers + rp.total_revenue_from_suppliers) AS total_combined_revenue FROM (SELECT reg.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS number_of_customers, SUM(cs.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_customers, SUM(ss.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_suppliers FROM region reg JOIN nation n ON reg.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ss.total_orders > 0 GROUP BY reg.r_name) rp JOIN region r ON r.r_name = rp.r_name ORDER BY total_combined_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY ts.region_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM (SELECT order_rank, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31') WHERE order_rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.r_regionkey, t.r_name, t.RegionTotalCost, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS UniqueCustomers, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS AvgOrderValue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(rs.TotalCost) AS RegionTotalCost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) t JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = t.r_regionkey) JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY t.r_regionkey, t.r_name, t.RegionTotalCost ORDER BY t.RegionTotalCost DESC, AvgOrderValue;

SELECT bs.r_name AS region_name, bs.s_suppkey AS supplier_id, bs.s_name AS supplier_name, bs.total_value AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rank = 1 AND r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT MIN(s_nationkey) FROM supplier))) bs ORDER BY bs.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.c_name, r.o_orderstatus, CASE WHEN r.total_revenue < m.min_revenue THEN 'Low Revenue' WHEN r.total_revenue > m.max_revenue THEN 'High Revenue' ELSE 'Average Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus) r JOIN (SELECT MIN(total_revenue) AS min_revenue, MAX(total_revenue) AS max_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus) as RankedOrders) m ON 1 = 1 JOIN (SELECT total_revenue, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus) GROUP BY total_revenue) d ON r.total_revenue = d.total_revenue ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT *, CASE WHEN total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.o_totalprice, fr.c_name AS customer_name, fr.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT r.*, n.n_name, r.order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) fr JOIN lineitem l ON fr.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.o_totalprice, fr.c_name, fr.n_name) ORDER BY o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_spent, tr.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc ON rs.total_cost > hvc.total_spent * 0.1 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY nation_count DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = tr.r_regionkey) WHERE rs.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, AVG(sp.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey = 1) )) sp ON n.n_nationkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > ( SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier WHERE s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey = 1) )) sp ON ns.n_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = sp.s_suppkey) GROUP BY ns.n_name, ns.total_cost ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c_name, nation_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, AVG(TotalCost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT oi.o_orderkey, oi.o_orderdate, oi.o_totalprice, oi.c_name, oi.nation_name, li.l_quantity, li.l_discount, li.l_extendedprice, rs.s_name, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') oi JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, li.l_partkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_discount, li.l_extendedprice, p.p_type, p.p_brand FROM lineitem li JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01') li ON oi.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON li.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey)) GROUP BY c_name, nation_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c_name;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.total_supply_cost, tc.total_orders, tc.total_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_available_qty, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ts JOIN (SELECT o.c_custkey, o.c_name, o.total_orders, o.total_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o.total_order_value DESC) AS rank_customer FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) o) tc ON ts.rank_supplier <= 10 AND tc.rank_customer <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, tc.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rnk = 1 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(RO.o_orderkey, 0) AS TopOrderKey, COALESCE(RO.o_totalprice, 0) AS TopOrderPrice, TN.TotalRevenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 5) TN ON r.r_regionkey = TN.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') RO ON TN.n_nationkey = RO.o_orderkey WHERE RO.OrderRank = 1 ORDER BY TN.TotalRevenue DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, fs.s_name AS supplier_name, fs.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 10) fs ON l.l_suppkey = fs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND fs.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, fs.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) rp JOIN (SELECT sp.ps_partkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sp.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sp ON rp.p_partkey = sp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON sp.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) WHERE rp.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, rp.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count, AVG(ag.total_revenue) AS avg_order_revenue, MAX(s.s_acctbal) AS max_supplier_balance, MIN(s.s_acctbal) AS min_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 10000) hvo ON s.nation_name = hvo.nation_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ag ON hvo.o_orderkey = ag.l_orderkey GROUP BY s.nation_name) ORDER BY high_value_order_count DESC, avg_order_revenue DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_totalprice, od.l_quantity, od.l_extendedprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, s.s_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING') od JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.total_parts, s.total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s) ts ON od.s_name = ts.s_name WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY od.o_totalprice DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT od.nation, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(od.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(od.l_quantity) AS average_quantity_per_order FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.nation FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.nation FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s WHERE s.rnk <= 3) t ON ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') od GROUP BY od.nation ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.o_orderkey, rs.o_totalprice, rs.o_orderdate, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost > 10000 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.total_spent > 5000 WHERE rs.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.o_totalprice DESC, ts.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, COUNT(supplier_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(total_supply_value) AS total_value_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT tos.o_orderkey, tos.o_orderdate, tos.o_totalprice, tos.total_items, tos.unique_parts, ss.s_name, ss.revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice) tos JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON tos.unique_parts > (SELECT AVG(unique_parts) FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_items, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice) as TopOrderDetails) ORDER BY tos.o_totalprice DESC, ss.revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, tsc.total_cost, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 5) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) tsc ON ro.o_orderkey = tsc.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN part p ON tsc.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE tsc.total_cost IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(sp.total_available_qty, 0) AS total_available_qty, COALESCE(sp.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost, r.region_total_spent, r.customer_count FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(c.total_spent) AS region_total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, c.c_nationkey FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) c ON r.r_regionkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) sp ON r.r_regionkey = sp.s_nationkey ORDER BY r.r_name, sp.total_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, ts.supplier_name, ts.supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate > '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, ts.supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.part_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE r.rn <= 5 AND ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.nation_name, COUNT(tr.s_name) AS num_top_suppliers, AVG(tr.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) tr GROUP BY tr.nation_name ORDER BY num_top_suppliers DESC, avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n_name, total_sales, total_supply_cost, profit FROM (SELECT n.n_name, ns.total_sales, sc.total_supply_cost, ns.total_sales - sc.total_supply_cost AS profit FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ns JOIN nation n ON ns.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sc ON sc.ps_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 LIMIT 1) ORDER BY profit DESC) WHERE profit > 0 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r_name AS region, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey JOIN supplier ON c_nationkey = s_nationkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, r.region_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.region_supplycost DESC) as region_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(n.total_supplycost) AS region_supplycost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) n ON n.n_nationkey IN ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r) r WHERE r.region_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.region_supplycost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('Germany', 'United States') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, oi.l_partkey, oi.l_quantity, oi.l_extendedprice, bs.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem oi ON o.o_orderkey = oi.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS CostRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.CostRank <= 5) bs ON oi.l_suppkey = bs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND oi.l_quantity > 10 ORDER BY c.c_custkey, o.o_orderdate, oi.l_partkey;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name, region_name LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.c_name AS customer_name, rs.r_name AS region_name, rs.total_nations, tc.total_spent, ss.total_available, ss.avg_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ds.discounted_price) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS discounted_price FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate > DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l_orderkey) ds ON o.o_orderkey = ds.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = tc.c_custkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, AVG(s.avg_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.rank, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.nation, t.total_parts, t.total_supply_cost, t.total_available_qty FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) t WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.revenue_rank, r.p_name, r.p_brand, r.p_type, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ts.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA') AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts JOIN part p ON ts.p_partkey = p.p_partkey) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.revenue_rank;

SELECT nc.n_name, tc.c_name, rc.total_revenue, CAST(nc.n_nationkey AS VARCHAR) AS nation_key FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) tc JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA') nc ON tc.c_custkey IN (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rc ON tc.customer_revenue = rc.total_revenue ORDER BY rc.total_revenue DESC, nc.n_name;

SELECT ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(od.l_quantity * od.ps_supplycost * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(od.l_tax) AS average_tax FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, li.l_partkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_discount, li.l_tax, ps.ps_supplycost, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND li.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01') od JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON od.s_name = ts.s_name GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tn.n_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_rank_count, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS average_total_price FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 100) tn LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON tn.n_name IN ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n ) WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY tn.n_name ORDER BY average_total_price DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, ts.s_name, ts.total_qty_supplied FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, SUM(sp.total_available_qty) AS total_qty_supplied FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name) sp GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name ORDER BY total_qty_supplied DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_name LIKE '%Widget%' ) ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT TOP.o_orderdate AS OrderDate, TOP.c_name AS CustomerName, TOP.o_totalprice AS TotalOrderPrice, SP.s_name AS Supplier, SP.TotalSupplyCost, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = TOP.o_orderkey) AS LineItemCount FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') r JOIN customer c ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) WHERE r.OrderRank <= 10) TOP JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) SP ON SP.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = TOP.o_orderkey) ORDER BY TOP.o_orderdate DESC, SP.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, t.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN customer c ON t.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) WHERE total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) as FilteredSuppliers);

SELECT tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, si.s_name AS supplier_name, si.nation_name, tp.total_supply_cost, si.total_available_qty FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand) as RankedParts) tp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) si ON tp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'USA' ) ) WHERE tp.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC, si.total_available_qty DESC;

SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_value, pp.p_partkey, pp.p_name, pp.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) pp ON ss.total_available_qty > 1000 ORDER BY ss.total_supply_value DESC, pp.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT jd.c_custkey, jd.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT jd.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(jd.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, AVG(jd.l_discount) AS average_discount FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_cost, ss.unique_parts_supplied, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC) AS rank_by_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.unique_parts_supplied DESC) AS rank_by_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) jd GROUP BY jd.c_custkey, jd.c_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_extended_price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders WHERE o_custkey = c.c_custkey ) JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps_suppkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ) ) JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS spend_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs WHERE cs.total_spent > 10000) tc ON r.o_orderkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n_name, total_revenue, order_count, total_available_qty, min_supplier_balance, max_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT os.n_name, os.total_revenue, os.order_count, ps.total_available_qty, ps.min_supplier_balance, ps.max_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey, n.n_name) os JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, MIN(s.s_acctbal) AS min_supplier_balance, MAX(s.s_acctbal) AS max_supplier_balance FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' )) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.p_name AS part_name, s.p_retailprice, s.p_comment FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') WHERE price_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = s.ps_suppkey WHERE t.o_totalprice > 10000 ORDER BY t.o_totalprice DESC;
