SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvp.p_partkey) AS high_value_parts_count, SUM(ao.total_sales) AS total_sales_sum, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as rank_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS sup_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < 100.00 AND ps.ps_availqty > 50 GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty) hvp ON hvp.ps_supplycost < 50.00 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ao ON ao.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = s.s_suppkey) WHERE s.rank_acctbal <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales_sum DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size >= 10 AND p.p_retailprice > 1000.00) rs WHERE rs.rn <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON ts.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey WHERE os.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, supplier_count, total_account_balance, total_orders, total_revenue, available_parts FROM (SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_account_balance, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue, COUNT(pas.p_partkey) AS available_parts FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON ns.nation_name = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) pas ON pas.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp) GROUP BY ns.nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_account_balance, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, available_parts DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_mfgr, rp.p_brand, rp.p_size, rp.total_supply_cost, sd.s_name, sd.supplier_nation, sd.supplier_region, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue, os.avg_order_value, os.o_orderpriority FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.r_name AS supplier_region, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sd ON sd.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, o.o_orderpriority FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority) os ON os.o_orderpriority = CASE WHEN rp.total_supply_cost > 1000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN rp.total_supply_cost BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END WHERE rp.p_size > 20 ORDER BY rp.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_orders DESC;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost, rp.total_supply_cost, (rp.total_supply_cost - ts.total_cost) AS cost_difference FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts ON rp.rank = 1 WHERE rp.total_supply_cost > ts.total_cost ORDER BY rp.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.rn = 1 AND ns.n_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey) JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts WHERE ts.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) WHERE rn = 1 ) ORDER BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT t.r_name, t.total_revenue, t.order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, rt.total_revenue, rt.order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rt.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM region r JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rt ON r.r_regionkey = rt.r_regionkey) t WHERE t.rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, COALESCE(co.orders_count, 0) AS Orders_Count, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) AS Total_Spent, ts.total_cost AS Supplier_Total_Cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, st.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st JOIN supplier s ON st.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY st.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM ( SELECT SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS avg_spent)) co ON ts.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, COALESCE(co.total_spent, 0) DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey AS order_key, li.l_quantity AS quantity_ordered, ts.name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey AS suppkey, s.s_name AS name, s.nation_name, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.nation_name ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.suppkey WHERE ts.rank <= 3 AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' ORDER BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.sales_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN nation n ON tr.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r WHERE r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.sales_rank ORDER BY tr.sales_rank;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost, na.avg_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, AVG(sd.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) na ON n.n_nationkey = na.n_nationkey WHERE sd.total_supply_cost > na.avg_supply_cost GROUP BY r.r_name, na.avg_supply_cost ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON o.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#44' ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate < o.o_orderdate GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sr.r_regionkey, sr.r_name, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, r.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r) sr LEFT JOIN orders o ON sr.sales_rank <= 10 LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY sr.r_regionkey, sr.r_name, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank HAVING SUM(sr.total_sales) > 0 ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost, os.total_order_value, os.latest_ship_date FROM (SELECT sa.s_suppkey, sa.s_name, na.n_name AS nation_name, sa.total_supply_cost, sa.part_count, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY na.n_regionkey ORDER BY sa.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank_within_region FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sa JOIN nation na ON sa.s_nationkey = na.n_nationkey) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS latest_ship_date FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey WHERE ts.rank_within_region <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_revenue, order_count, customer_count FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_revenue, order_count, customer_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as Summary) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, sli.total_revenue, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) sli ON ro.o_orderkey = sli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate;

SELECT osd.o_orderkey, osd.total_revenue, osd.s_suppkey, osd.s_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE sc.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierCosts) ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) osd ORDER BY osd.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT hvo.customer_name, hvo.nation_name, pws.p_name, pws.p_brand, pws.total_quantity, pws.total_cost, hvo.total_spent FROM (SELECT ro.customer_name, ro.nation_name, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.customer_name, ro.nation_name) hvo JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.total_quantity, ps.total_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) pws ON hvo.nation_name = pws.p_brand ORDER BY hvo.total_spent DESC, pws.total_quantity DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.revenue, s.s_suppkey, s.total_cost, (r.revenue - s.total_cost) AS profit FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) r WHERE r.rank_order <= 10) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) s ON r.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY profit DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC, region_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvs.s_suppkey, hvs.s_name, hvs.nation_name, hvs.total_supply_cost, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_order_value FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sd WHERE sd.total_supply_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as SupplierDetails )) hvs JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_order_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co WHERE co.total_order_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_order_value) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders )) hvc ON hvc.total_order_value > 1000 ORDER BY hvs.total_supply_cost DESC, hvc.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(rb.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_shipdate, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) od JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rank <= 5) ts ON od.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name) rb JOIN supplier s ON rb.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT po.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(po.total_order_value) AS total_value, MAX(po.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderdate) po ON ts.s_suppkey = po.c_custkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ts.s_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.c_acctbal, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal AS supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(co.total_revenue) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON c.c_custkey = co.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(co.total_revenue) > 50000) tc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) rs ON rs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100 ) WHERE tc.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tc.c_custkey, rs.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.nation_name, cs.region_name, cs.total_spending, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, os.total_revenue, os.unique_customers FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spending FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, n.n_name, r.r_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON cs.total_spending > 100000 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.unique_customers > 10 WHERE rs.cost_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cs.total_spending DESC, rs.total_cost DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSupplyCost DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE TotalSupplyCost > ( SELECT AVG(TotalSupplyCost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers )) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#1' AND ps.ps_availqty > 10 )) ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC, o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s) ts ON cs.total_spent > ts.total_supplycost WHERE ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_line_price FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.total_sales, ps.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.supplier_nation, ps.total_received, CASE WHEN p.total_sales > ps.total_received THEN 'Sales exceed Supplies' ELSE 'Supplies exceed Sales' END AS SalesSupplyStatus FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) p LEFT JOIN (SELECT t.p_partkey, t.total_sales, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.supplier_nation, s.total_received FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_received FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s ON t.p_partkey = s.s_suppkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.p_partkey ORDER BY p.total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, market_segment, COALESCE(total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(segment_sales, 0) AS segment_sales FROM (SELECT rs.region_name, COALESCE(cs.market_segment, 'Unknown') AS market_segment, rs.total_sales, cs.segment_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS segment_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON rs.region_name = cs.market_segment) ORDER BY region_name, market_segment;

SELECT rd.nation_name, rd.total_revenue, rd.total_orders, sd.supplier_name, sd.part_name, sd.supply_cost, sd.available_quantity FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) rd JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost, ps.ps_availqty AS available_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000.00) sd ON rd.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE c.c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') LIMIT 1) ORDER BY rd.total_revenue DESC, sd.supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ns.n_name, tr.r_name, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ld.total_revenue, ld.last_ship_date FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ns.total_supply_cost) AS region_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON ns.total_supply_cost IN (SELECT region_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ns.total_supply_cost) AS region_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) as TopRegions) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) co ON ns.total_available_quantity > co.order_count JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ld ON ld.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey) ORDER BY ns.n_name, tr.r_name, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS AvgCustomerBalance FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.Rank <= 5) t JOIN orders o ON t.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY t.r_name ORDER BY Revenue DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, su.supplier_count, su.total_avail_qty, su.avg_supply_cost, n.n_name AS supplier_nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_nationkey) su ON su.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON su.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10) ORDER BY o_orderstatus, o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, ts.parts_count, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(p.ps_partkey) AS parts_count, SUM(p.ps_supplycost * p.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp p ON s.s_suppkey = p.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as RankedSuppliers) ts WHERE ts.rank = 1 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT cr.c_name, sr.nation_name, sr.region_name, rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, COALESCE(ld.total_revenue, 0) AS last_month_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') cr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sr ON cr.c_custkey % 100 = sr.s_suppkey % 100 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) rp ON sr.s_suppkey % 10 = rp.p_partkey % 10 LEFT JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem li WHERE li.l_shipdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) ld ON cr.o_orderkey = ld.l_orderkey WHERE rp.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY last_month_revenue DESC, rp.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_available_qty, ts.avg_supply_cost, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, ss.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(rn.total_revenue) AS region_revenue, nav.total_acctbal AS total_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rn JOIN orders o ON rn.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nav ON o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = nav.n_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ON nav.total_acctbal > 10000 JOIN nation n ON r.nation_count > 1 AND n.n_nationkey = nav.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, nav.total_acctbal ORDER BY region_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT ci.o_orderkey, ci.customer_name, ci.o_orderdate, ci.total_available, ci.average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_orderdate, ss.total_available, ss.average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON ss.ps_partkey = (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) ci WHERE ci.total_available > 1000 ORDER BY ci.o_orderdate DESC, ci.total_available DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, os.unique_customers, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.unique_suppliers, ps.p_partkey, ps.p_name, ps.total_sold_quantity, ps.avg_price_per_unit FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON os.total_quantity > 1000 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_sold_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price_per_unit FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON ps.total_sold_quantity > 5000 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, ss.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT part_name, supplier_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT part_name, supplier_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY part_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, s.s_name) as PartSupplierRevenue) WHERE revenue_rank = 1 ORDER BY part_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) JOIN nation n ON RankedSuppliers.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE RankedSuppliers.cost_rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name) ts WHERE ts.region_name = r.r_name) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, average_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.c_name, os.total_sales, os.distinct_parts, os.total_quantity, ps.total_available, ps.total_cost, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) os JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON os.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ps.ps_partkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE os.total_sales > 10000 ORDER BY os.total_sales DESC, os.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.customer_name) AS unique_customers, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(ro.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') ro JOIN nation n ON n.n_name = ro.nation_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SHIP') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, n.n_name ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(nr.total_revenue) AS market_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COALESCE(ts.revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM nation n LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.c_nationkey) nr JOIN nation n ON nr.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY market_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_sales, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_spent, tn.n_name AS top_nation, tn.supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = hvc.c_custkey) CROSS JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC LIMIT 5) tn WHERE ro.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_sales DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS average_lineitem_price, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'EUROPE%' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COALESCE(SUM(rs.total_supplycost), 0) AS total_supplycost, AVG(co.total_orders) AS avg_order_value FROM nation ns LEFT JOIN supplier s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey AND rs.rank <= 5 LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN customer cs ON cs.c_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC, total_customers DESC;

SELECT total_sales, COUNT(*) AS count_of_sales, AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY total_sales ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, ts.s_name AS TopSupplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal, r.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' ) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.SupplierRank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ts.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 50000 ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ns.total_supply_cost_by_region, ns.supplier_count, r.r_comment FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(hv.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_by_region, COUNT(DISTINCT hv.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.avg_account_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierStats)) hv JOIN nation n ON hv.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey ORDER BY ns.total_supply_cost_by_region DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, AVG(od.total_price) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY rs.s_name ORDER BY num_orders DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT rr.r_name, rr.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sos ON n.n_name = sos.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rr WHERE rr.total_revenue > 500000 ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, customer_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT customer_name, nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, n.n_name) as Revenue) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count FROM (SELECT soi.nation_name, soi.s_name, soi.total_revenue, soi.order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY soi.nation_name ORDER BY soi.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) soi) rs JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT n_name AS nation_name FROM nation) r ON rs.nation_name = r.nation_name WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.nation_name, rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, order_count, total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.c_name, h.o_totalprice, sp.ps_partkey, sp.total_available FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.rank, r.c_name, r.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) h JOIN lineitem l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name AS customer_name, t.supplier_name, t.p_name AS part_name FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, supplier_name, p_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') WHERE rank = 1) t ORDER BY t.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, hvo.customer_name, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) as rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s INNER JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) ts ON rp.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey LIMIT 1) JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 1000) hvo ON li.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey WHERE rp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, hvo.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, s.s_name, s.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON l.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey WHERE t.o_totalprice > 1000.00 ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT region, nation, supplier_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, ns.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 AND s.s_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_suppkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ORDER BY region, nation, total_cost DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, li.total_revenue, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') r WHERE r.rn <= 5) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey) li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.ps_suppkey WHERE ro.o_totalprice > 5000 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, li.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS Customer, tc.total_revenue AS Customer_Revenue, ts.s_name AS Supplier, ts.supplier_revenue AS Supplier_Revenue FROM (SELECT c_custkey, c_name, SUM(tr.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_orderkey) tr ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = tr.l_orderkey) GROUP BY c_custkey, c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem lp ON ps.ps_partkey = lp.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.supplier_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) ts ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC, ts.supplier_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation, total_sales, order_count, avg_order_value, avg_supplier_balance, sales_rank FROM (SELECT nation, total_sales, order_count, avg_order_value, avg_supplier_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MAX(os.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ts.s_name, od.total_revenue, od.lineitem_count, ns.customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 1000) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON od.o_orderkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ts.s_suppkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE od.total_revenue > 5000 ORDER BY ns.n_name, od.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, ts.total_value, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal, SUM(sd.ps_supplycost * sd.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) sd WHERE sd.rank <= 3 GROUP BY sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.total_value > 1000.00 ORDER BY ts.total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(cs.total_spent) AS avg_customer_spent FROM region r JOIN nation ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON ns.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name, s.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.r_regionkey, rs.r_name, rs.NationCount, rs.HighValueSupplierCount, hs.TotalSpent FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS NationCount, SUM(CASE WHEN s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) as HighValueCustomers) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS HighValueSupplierCount FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000) hs ON rs.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = hs.c_nationkey) ORDER BY rs.r_regionkey, hs.TotalSpent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'OCEAN') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 100000.00 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, od.total_order_value, od.unique_parts, rp.total_supply_cost, rp.supply_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND s.s_acctbal > 10000) ts ON rp.p_partkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON rp.p_partkey = od.o_orderkey WHERE rp.supply_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_brand, od.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost AS TotalCost, tc.c_name AS CustomerName, tc.OrderCount AS NumberOfOrders, tc.TotalSpent AS AmountSpent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, co.OrderCount, co.TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey WHERE co.TotalSpent > 10000 ORDER BY co.TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON rs.SupplierRank <= 3 ORDER BY rs.TotalCost DESC, tc.TotalSpent DESC;

SELECT rnk, p_name, s_name, ps_supplycost, ps_availqty, l_quantity, discounted_price, o_orderdate FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p_name ORDER BY discounted_price DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT p.p_name, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS discounted_price, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F') as SupplyDetails) WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY p_name, discounted_price DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_price_per_order, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, p.p_brand AS brand_name FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE 'SMALL%' GROUP BY n.n_name, p.p_brand ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, unique_customers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, ts.s_suppkey, ts.total_cost, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) as rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_spent, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs WHERE cs.order_count > 3) tc JOIN (SELECT st.s_suppkey, st.total_cost, st.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY st.total_cost DESC) as rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st WHERE st.part_count > 5) ts ON ts.rank = 1 WHERE ts.part_count = (SELECT MAX(part_count) FROM (SELECT st.s_suppkey, st.total_cost, st.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY st.total_cost DESC) as rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st WHERE st.part_count > 5) as TopSuppliers) ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT HV.c_custkey, HV.c_name, HV.total_spent, RS.s_name AS top_supplier, RS.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT C.c_custkey, C.c_name, C.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY C.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) C WHERE C.total_spent > 5000) HV JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) RS ON HV.c_custkey % 10 = RS.rn) ORDER BY total_spent DESC, total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(ns.NationRevenue) AS TotalNationRevenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(ss.TotalRevenue) AS NationRevenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY TotalNationRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, t.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sales.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sales JOIN supplier s ON sales.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sales.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;
