SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(lt.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated, SUM(cv.total_spent) AS total_customer_spending, SUM(hp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM region AS r JOIN nation AS n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier AS s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders AS o JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '5 YEAR' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) AS lt ON o.o_orderkey = lt.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) AS cv ON o.o_custkey = cv.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp AS ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 50000) AS hp ON ps.ps_partkey = hp.ps_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 YEAR' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_shippriority, s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_name AS customer_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_shippriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 50000) c ON r.o_orderkey = ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE r.rank = 1 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, tn.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 10) tn ON n.n_name = tn.n_name WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, tn.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.r_name ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, COUNT(t.o_orderkey) AS top_order_count, SUM(t.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(t.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(t.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') o JOIN nation n ON o.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 5) t GROUP BY t.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, top_order_count DESC;

SELECT t.nation, t.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region FROM (SELECT nation, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueByNation) t JOIN nation n ON t.nation = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.region, tc.nation, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, rc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) rc JOIN customer c ON rc.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rc.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) AS NationQuantities ON tc.nation = NationQuantities.n_name WHERE NationQuantities.total_quantity > 1000 ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs WHERE rs.rank = 1) ts ON c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = ts.nation_name) WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, ts.s_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier AS s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp AS ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.p_name, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_available, t.total_supply_cost, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.p_name, sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_available, sp.total_supply_cost, nri.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN partsupp ps ON sp.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part s ON ps.ps_partkey = s.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nri ON sp.s_suppkey = ( SELECT s2.s_suppkey FROM supplier s2 JOIN partsupp ps2 ON s2.s_suppkey = ps2.ps_suppkey WHERE ps2.ps_partkey = ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps2.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE sp.total_available > 0 ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) r ON t.r_name = r.r_name;

SELECT rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, SUM(rp.total_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, tr.total_revenue, sr.total_acctbal FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size) rp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) tr ON rp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost IN (SELECT MIN(ps2.ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp ps2 GROUP BY ps2.ps_partkey)) JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) sr ON sr.n_regionkey IN (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'ASIA') GROUP BY rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, tr.total_revenue, sr.total_acctbal ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, ps.s_name, ps.total_available_quantity, pi.p_name, pi.supplier_count, pi.avg_supply_cost, pi.max_avail_qty FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, MAX(ps.ps_availqty) AS max_avail_qty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pi ON l.l_partkey = pi.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ps ON l.l_suppkey = ps.s_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, bn.n_name AS best_nation, tc.c_name AS top_customer FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name) bn ON r.revenue_rank = 1 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY customer_spending DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON tc.customer_spending > r.total_revenue WHERE r.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, hvo.c_acctbal, od.total_sales, od.total_tax, od.total_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) od ON hvo.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey ORDER BY hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_orderkey;

SELECT n.n_name, count(distinct o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, avg(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance, max(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_lineprice, min(l.l_extendedprice) AS min_lineprice FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= '1997-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('USA', 'CANADA', 'MEXICO') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS monthly_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.monthly_rank <= 10) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c_acctbal) FROM customer) ORDER BY t.revenue DESC, c.c_name ASC;

SELECT t.nation_name, SUM(ol.TotalRevenue) AS TotalNationRevenue, AVG(ol.LineItemCount) AS AvgLineItemCount, MAX(ol.MaxDiscount) AS HighestRecordedDiscount, MIN(ol.MinDiscount) AS LowestRecordedDiscount FROM (SELECT t.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(l.l_partkey) AS LineItemCount, MAX(l.l_discount) AS MaxDiscount, MIN(l.l_discount) AS MinDiscount FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_shippriority, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.OrderRank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_shippriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') r JOIN customer c ON r.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.OrderRank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey) ol JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_shippriority, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.OrderRank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_shippriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') r JOIN customer c ON r.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.OrderRank <= 5) t ON ol.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY t.nation_name ORDER BY TotalNationRevenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND n.n_name IN (SELECT r_name FROM region WHERE r_regionkey = 1) GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT ts.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, co.c_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.total_supply_cost > co.total_spent ORDER BY ts.r_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, cs.c_name AS top_customer, cs.total_orders AS customer_orders, cs.total_spent AS customer_spending, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON n.total_orders = cs.total_orders JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey ) WHERE rs.rnk = 1 ORDER BY n.n_name, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, fs.total_quantity, fs.net_revenue, fs.supplier_count, fs.avg_supplier_balance, ROUND(fs.net_revenue / NULLIF(fs.total_quantity, 0), 2) AS revenue_per_unit FROM (SELECT qs.p_partkey, qs.total_quantity, qs.net_revenue, ss.supplier_count, ss.avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) qs JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON qs.p_partkey = ss.ps_partkey) fs JOIN part p ON fs.p_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY fs.net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, s.s_name, hvp.p_name, hvp.total_part_value, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_part_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvp ON s.s_suppkey = hvp.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_supply_value DESC, hvp.total_part_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, s.s_name, s.total_supply_value, li.total_line_value FROM (SELECT hv.o_orderkey, hv.o_totalprice, hv.c_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value, oli.total_line_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) hv JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON hv.o_orderkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) oli ON hv.o_orderkey = oli.l_orderkey) o JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON o.s_name = s.s_name JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE s.total_supply_value > 100000 ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, s.total_supply_value ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.total_cost, rs.nation_name, rs.region_name, rs.total_available FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) rs ON rs.region_name = (SELECT r_name FROM region ORDER BY r_regionkey LIMIT 1) WHERE rp.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) as RankedParts) ORDER BY rp.total_cost DESC, rs.total_available DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sp.s_name AS SupplierName, sp.TotalCost AS SupplierTotalCost, sp.UniquePartsSupplied AS SupplierUniqueParts, co.c_name AS CustomerName, co.TotalOrders AS CustomerTotalOrders, co.TotalSpent AS CustomerTotalSpent, ol.NetRevenue AS OrderNetRevenue, ol.TotalQuantity AS OrderTotalQuantity FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS TotalCost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS AverageSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON sp.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS NetRevenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON ol.o_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) WHERE sp.TotalCost > 50000 ORDER BY sp.TotalCost DESC, co.TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rws.r_name, rws.regional_revenue, rws.regional_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS regional_revenue, SUM(sos.total_orders) AS regional_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos JOIN supplier s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rws WHERE rws.regional_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(regional_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sos.total_revenue) AS regional_revenue, SUM(sos.total_orders) AS regional_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sos JOIN supplier s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) as RegionWiseSummary ) ORDER BY rws.regional_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, AVG(co.order_count) AS avg_order_count, MAX(rs.total_supplycost) AS max_supplier_supplycost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS partsup_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON c.c_nationkey = rs.s_suppkey%10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.p_brand, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT supplier_rank, s_suppkey, s_name, nation_name, p_brand, p_container, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container) WHERE supplier_rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.nation_name, ts.p_brand ORDER BY nation_name, avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, cs.c_mktsegment, SUM(cs.total_spent) AS total_customer_spent, COUNT(fo.o_orderkey) AS flagged_orders_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) cs ON rs.nation_name = cs.c_mktsegment LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, l.l_orderkey, l.l_returnflag, l.l_linestatus, l.l_discount, l.l_extendedprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'R' AND l.l_linestatus = 'O') fo ON fo.o_orderkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, cs.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_customer_spent DESC, flagged_orders_count DESC;

SELECT ts.Segment, ts.AvgRevenuePerOrder, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrdersInTopSegments, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenueFromTopSegments FROM (SELECT Segment, AvgRevenuePerOrder FROM (SELECT Segment, TotalOrders, TotalRevenue, TotalRevenue / NULLIF(TotalOrders, 0) AS AvgRevenuePerOrder FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment AS Segment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) as MarketShare) ORDER BY AvgRevenuePerOrder DESC LIMIT 5) ts JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderstatus = 'F' JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE ts.Segment = (SELECT c.c_mktsegment FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) GROUP BY ts.Segment, ts.AvgRevenuePerOrder ORDER BY TotalRevenueFromTopSegments DESC;

SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, co.total_spent, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.s_acctbal AS supplier_balance FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_cost > 10000) ts ON co.total_spent > 5000 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, ts.s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address, sc.total_cost, bs.revenue_generated FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT sc.s_suppkey, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS revenue_generated FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY sc.s_suppkey ORDER BY revenue_generated DESC LIMIT 10) bs ON s.s_suppkey = bs.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN (' AIR', 'REG AIR') GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_supplier_acctbal ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rr.nation_name, rr.total_revenue, rr.total_orders, rr.revenue_rank, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) AS num_customers, (SELECT AVG(s.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueData) rr JOIN nation n ON rr.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rr.revenue_rank;

SELECT hs.c_custkey, hs.c_name, rs.r_name, rs.TotalSales, rs.TotalSales / NULLIF(AVG(rs.TotalSales) OVER (), 0) AS SalesRatio, rs.TotalSales * 0.1 AS DiscountedSalesValue, rs.TotalSales * 0.1 / COUNT(rs.r_name) OVER () AS AverageDiscountedSalesValue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > ( SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus = 'O' )) hs JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ON hs.TotalSpent > rs.TotalSales ORDER BY hs.TotalSpent DESC, SalesRatio DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_quantity, ro.total_revenue, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sd.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 AND ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, ts.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(rc.total_spend) AS total_spend, AVG(rc.customer_count) AS avg_customer_count, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spend, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) rc ON r.r_regionkey = rc.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 500) ts ON TRUE GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_spend DESC, supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT so.o_orderkey, so.total_price, sr.s_name, sr.rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) so JOIN (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) r) sr ON so.total_price > 100000 WHERE sr.rank <= 10 ORDER BY so.total_price DESC, sr.rank;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, tc.c_name AS top_customer_name, ns.nation_name, ns.num_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) tc ON ro.o_orderkey = tc.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON tc.total_spent > 20000 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ps.p_type, ps.avg_purchase, ps.customer_count, r.r_name FROM (SELECT tp.p_type, AVG(cp.total_purchases) AS avg_purchase, COUNT(cp.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT p_type, p_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) WHERE rnk <= 10) tp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_purchases FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp ON tp.p_name = cp.c_name GROUP BY tp.p_type) ps JOIN nation n ON ps.customer_count > 10 JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Asia%' ORDER BY ps.avg_purchase DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, r.total_sales AS sales_amount, COALESCE(t.sales_rank, 0) AS rank_within_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT r_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) t ON r.r_name = t.r_name ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, t.total_sales, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10) t JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(ns.total_supplier_qty, 0) AS total_available_qty, COALESCE(nc.total_customer_spent, 0) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sa.total_available_qty) AS total_supplier_qty FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sa ON n.n_nationkey = sa.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ca.total_spent) AS total_customer_spent FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ca ON n.n_nationkey = ca.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc ON ns.n_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey ORDER BY ns.n_name, nc.n_name;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ts.nation AS supplier_nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT nation, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, ts.nation ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, supplier_nation;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent AS customer_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) cs) tc JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) ts ON tc.order_count > 5 AND ts.total_supply_cost > 10000 WHERE tc.spending_rank <= 5 AND ts.supply_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_available_quantity) AS total_supplies, AVG(ts.avg_supply_cost) AS avg_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_available_quantity, rs.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_supplies DESC, region;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.nation_name ORDER BY s.total_supply_value DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON ts.rn = 1 WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' ORDER BY c.c_custkey, o.o_orderdate;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, sr.total_supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as rnk FROM supplier s) rs WHERE rs.rnk <= 5) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS total_supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey) od JOIN partsupp ps ON od.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as rnk FROM supplier s) rs WHERE rs.rnk <= 5) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name) sr ON ts.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY ts.s_suppkey;

SELECT cu.c_name AS customer_name, cu.total_order_value, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu JOIN (SELECT supplier_nation, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) WHERE rank <= 3) ts ON cu.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = ts.supplier_nation) LIMIT 1) ORDER BY cu.total_order_value DESC, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.ps_supplycost, t.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.p_partkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_revenue, total_orders FROM (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, total_orders, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE')) GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hs.s_suppkey, hs.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) s WHERE s.rnk <= 5) hs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON tc.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(o.o_totalprice) FROM orders o) ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, nt.nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_name) nt ON n.n_name = nt.n_name ORDER BY nt.nation_revenue DESC;

SELECT fa.c_custkey, fa.c_name, fa.total_supply_cost, fa.total_parts_supplied, fa.customer_spending, fa.supply_cost_to_spend_ratio FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.ps_supplycost), 0) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(t.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_spent), 0) AS customer_spending, CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(co.total_spent), 0) > 0 THEN (COALESCE(SUM(t.ps_supplycost), 0) / COALESCE(SUM(co.total_spent), 0)) ELSE 0 END AS supply_cost_to_spend_ratio FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp WHERE sp.rn <= 3) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON t.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey LEFT JOIN customer cs ON co.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name) fa ORDER BY fa.supply_cost_to_spend_ratio DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rt.region_name, rt.nation_name, SUM(od.total_line_value) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(st.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) rt JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity * l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value, o.o_orderdate, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, s.s_name) od ON rt.nation_name = od.supplier_name JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st ON st.s_name = od.supplier_name GROUP BY rt.region_name, rt.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, ts.nation_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rank_in_region <= 3) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(co.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(l.total_line_price) AS total_line_item_value FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) sd LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_totalprice > 1000) co ON sd.s_name = ( SELECT s.s_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size < 20 ) LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_price FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_orders DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(SUM(sr.total_cost), 0) AS supplier_cost, COALESCE(SUM(nr.total_revenue), 0) AS nation_revenue FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sr ON n.n_nationkey = sr.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nr ON n.n_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_parts_available, r.total_orders, r.total_spent, CASE WHEN r.total_orders = 0 THEN 0 ELSE r.total_spent / r.total_orders END AS avg_spent_per_order FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sp.total_availability) AS total_parts_available, SUM(co.total_orders) AS total_orders, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availability, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey) sp ON n.n_nationkey = sp.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_nationkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.total_spent DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN hs.s_suppkey IS NOT NULL THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_quantity_from_high_cost_suppliers, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 5) hs ON l.l_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.nation_name, SUM(HVO.o_totalprice) AS total_high_value_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT R.c_custkey) AS distinct_high_value_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT S.s_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers, MAX(PA.ps_supplycost) AS max_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rank_per_nation FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) R LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2)) HVO ON HVO.nation_name = R.nation_name LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) S ON S.s_suppkey = R.c_custkey LEFT JOIN partsupp PA ON PA.ps_partkey = R.c_custkey WHERE R.rank_per_nation <= 5 GROUP BY r.nation_name ORDER BY total_high_value_orders DESC;

SELECT r.n_name AS region_name, r.supplier_count, r.regional_cost, sr.c_name AS top_customer, sr.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(stc.total_cost) AS regional_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) stc ON s.s_suppkey = stc.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, n.n_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) sr ON sr.sales_rank = 1;

SELECT region_name, total_revenue, customer_count FROM (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, customer_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionStats) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_container LIKE '%BOX%' AND p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, p.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT o.c_custkey, o.c_name, o.c_acctbal, ps.p_name, ps.nation_name, os.total_revenue FROM customer o JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON o.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_comment, rs.nation_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#25' AND p.p_size > 15 ) WHERE os.total_revenue > 1000000 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC, o.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sc.TotalCost, mc.MinCost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS TotalCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, n.n_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o JOIN nation n ON o.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.OrderRank <= 5) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT MIN(TotalCost) AS MinCost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS TotalCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, n.n_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o JOIN nation n ON o.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.OrderRank <= 5) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) as SupplierCosts) mc ON sc.TotalCost = mc.MinCost ORDER BY s.s_name;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.revenue) AS total_lineitem_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.total_available_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate < cast('1998-10-01' as date) GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON l.l_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey WHERE ro.rank = 1 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, sp.s_name, sp.total_available_qty, sp.total_supply_cost ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_order_value, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT n1.n_name FROM nation n1 WHERE n1.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA')) GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) r WHERE r.rank <= 3) ts ON co.total_order_value > 10000 JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) END) AS finalized_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sr.revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sr.revenue DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY t.s_suppkey, t.s_name ORDER BY finalized_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT supplier_rank, s_suppkey, s_name, s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_regionkey) WHERE supplier_rank <= 3) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT nation_name, order_count, avg_order_value FROM (SELECT hs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ho.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(ho.order_value) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) ho JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) hs ON ho.o_custkey = hs.s_suppkey GROUP BY hs.nation_name) WHERE order_count > 5 ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT fs.r_name, fs.order_count, fs.total_order_value, fs.total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN fs.total_supply_cost > 0 THEN (fs.total_order_value / fs.total_supply_cost) ELSE 0 END AS cost_to_order_ratio FROM (SELECT rs.r_name, os.order_count, os.total_order_value, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON rs.r_regionkey = os.c_nationkey) fs ORDER BY cost_to_order_ratio DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_value AS top_supplier_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank <= 5) ts ON c.total_spent >= ts.total_value * 0.5 ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, ts.total_value DESC;

SELECT rn.rank, rn.n_name, rn.total_sales, CASE WHEN rn.rank <= 5 THEN 'Top Nation' ELSE 'Other Nation' END AS classification FROM (SELECT n.n_name, n.total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY n.total_sales DESC) as rank FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) n) rn ORDER BY rn.rank;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.order_count, ts.total_revenue, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_type, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, order_count, total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC, p.p_name;

SELECT cp.c_name AS customer_name, cp.o_orderkey AS order_id, cp.o_orderdate AS order_date, lp.total_revenue AS total_order_revenue, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, sp.p_name AS part_name, sp.p_brand AS part_brand, sp.p_type AS part_type, sp.ps_availqty AS available_quantity, sp.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') cp JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lp ON cp.o_orderkey = lp.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON lp.l_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey WHERE cp.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND lp.total_revenue > 100.00 ORDER BY cp.o_orderdate DESC, lp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT TR.region_name, TR.total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) TR WHERE TR.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY TR.total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.order_count, c.total_spent, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) c JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) t ON c.order_count >= 5 WHERE c.total_spent > 1000.00 ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, t.s_name ASC LIMIT 10;
