SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(ts.top_supplier_count, 0) AS top_supplier_count FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = rs.nation_name) WHERE rs.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ts ON p.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = ts.r_regionkey) ORDER BY p.p_partkey;

SELECT tc.region_name, tc.nation_name, tc.total_spent, tc.order_count, sp.supplier_name, sp.part_name, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.OrderRank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) tc JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name, p.p_name) sp ON tc.region_name = 'ASIA' AND sp.total_supply_cost > 1000.00 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, sp.supplier_name;

SELECT region_name, total_customers, total_sales, avg_account_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, n.region_name, n.total_revenue, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, r.c_mktsegment AS region_name, SUM(r.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN customer c ON r.c_mktsegment = c.c_mktsegment JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.c_mktsegment) n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s ON n.n_name = (SELECT n2.n_name FROM nation n2 WHERE n2.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) ORDER BY n.total_revenue DESC, s.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sr.region_name, sr.total_sales, spr.s_name AS supplier_name, spr.total_supply_cost, sr.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) sr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) spr ON sr.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT t.region_name, COUNT(*) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(t.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 3) t GROUP BY t.region_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(hr.l_extendedprice * (1 - hr.l_discount)) AS TotalHighValueSales, COUNT(DISTINCT hr.l_orderkey) AS UniqueHighValueOrders, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.c_custkey) AS ActiveCustomers, AVG(cr.TotalRevenue) AS AvgCustomerRevenue FROM (SELECT li.l_orderkey, li.l_partkey, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_tax, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM lineitem li JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount) > 1000) hr JOIN supplier s ON hr.s_name = s.s_name JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem lo ON o.o_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON hr.l_orderkey = cr.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY TotalHighValueSales DESC;

SELECT tp.c_name, sp.p_name, SUM(sp.ps_availqty) AS Total_Available_Qty, AVG(sp.ps_supplycost) AS Avg_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(co.Total_Spent) AS Total_Amount FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Total_Spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY Total_Amount DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON tp.c_custkey = sp.s_suppkey GROUP BY tp.c_name, sp.p_name HAVING SUM(sp.ps_availqty) > 50 ORDER BY Avg_Supply_Cost DESC;

SELECT cs.s_suppkey, cs.s_name, cs.nation_name, cs.o_orderkey, cs.o_custkey, cs.total_order_value, cs.avg_line_quantity, cs.total_available_qty, cs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_custkey, os.total_order_value, os.avg_line_quantity, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.s_suppkey ORDER BY os.total_order_value DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_line_quantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON ss.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey) cs WHERE cs.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cs.total_order_value DESC, cs.s_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.r_name AS Region_Name, ts.s_name AS Supplier_Name, ts.TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS Total_Orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Total_Revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC LIMIT 5) tr JOIN nation n ON tr.n_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY tr.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.TotalSupplyCost ORDER BY Total_Revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_order_value, ls.total_lineitem_value, r.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) r JOIN partsupp ps ON r.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON l.l_orderkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON l.l_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey WHERE r.rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_availqty, ss.avg_supplycost, ns.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_mfgr ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rn FROM part p) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON rp.p_partkey = ss.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ss.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE rp.rn <= 5 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, ns.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ps.ps_partkey, pp.p_name, ps.total_available_quantity, ps.total_supply_cost, cp.c_custkey, cp.c_name, cp.total_orders, cp.total_spent FROM (SELECT rs.ps_partkey, rs.supplier_name, rs.total_available_quantity, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ps JOIN part pp ON ps.ps_partkey = pp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT lw.l_partkey, SUM(lw.total_quantity_ordered) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, li.l_partkey, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, li.l_partkey) lw GROUP BY lw.l_partkey ORDER BY total_quantity DESC LIMIT 10) pop ON ps.ps_partkey = pop.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cp ON cp.total_orders > 5 ORDER BY ps.total_available_quantity DESC, ps.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_revenue, total_orders, unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= date '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < date '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.r_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_acctbal, os.order_count, os.total_revenue, ps.total_availqty, ps.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT n_nationkey, n_name, r_name, ss.supplier_count, ss.total_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON ns.n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, SUM(ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp WHERE ps_supplycost > 1000) WHERE ns.total_acctbal > 50000 ORDER BY ns.n_name DESC, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, ns.customer_count, ns.total_revenue, sd.total_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(od.order_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderstatus) od ON c.c_custkey = od.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON ns.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC, sd.total_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc ON rs.s_acctbal < hvc.total_spent ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, tr.r_name AS region_name, sr.s_name AS supplier_name, sr.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1993-01-01' AND DATE '1993-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) t JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) > 1) tr ON t.o_orderkey % 10 = tr.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON sr.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierRevenue) WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, t.o_orderdate;

SELECT os.region_name, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_costs FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) o JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) os JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) p ON os.total_orders > 0 JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY os.region_name, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT od.c_name, od.n_name, od.total_avail_qty, od.order_rank FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, nos.n_name, nos.total_avail_qty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY co.c_custkey ORDER BY co.total_order_value DESC) AS order_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, sq.s_suppkey, sq.total_avail_qty FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sq ON s.s_suppkey = sq.s_suppkey) nos ON co.c_custkey = nos.s_suppkey) od WHERE od.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY od.c_name, od.n_name;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.region_name, s.total_sales, s.sales_rank, CASE WHEN sales_rank <= 3 THEN 'Top Region' WHEN sales_rank BETWEEN 4 AND 10 THEN 'Mid Tier Region' ELSE 'Lower Tier Region' END AS tier FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) s ORDER BY s.sales_rank;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.customer_count, ns.total_sales, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost AS top_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.total_cost > 10000) ts ON ns.customer_count > 10 WHERE ns.total_sales > 50000 ORDER BY ns.total_sales DESC, ns.n_name;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, COALESCE(tr.revenue, 0) AS revenue, r.total_cost, r.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) tr ON r.s_suppkey = tr.l_suppkey WHERE r.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.rank, revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r_name, n_name, total_orders, total_sales, total_available_qty, avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, ss.total_orders, ss.total_sales, rp.total_available_qty, rp.avg_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp ON n.n_nationkey IN ( SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p) )) WHERE total_orders IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_sales DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales, cs.customer_name, cs.sales_amount FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales_amount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_name, r.r_name) cs ON rs.region = cs.region ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, cs.sales_amount DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, t.nation_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, t.o_orderdate;

SELECT s.supplier_name, s.customer_name, s.total_spent, s.total_supply_cost, s.total_spent / NULLIF(s.total_supply_cost, 0) AS spent_to_supply_ratio FROM (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.total_spent, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) s CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 10) c) s ORDER BY spent_to_supply_ratio DESC;

SELECT sa.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sa.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(sa.total_available) AS overall_available, SUM(sa.total_cost) AS overall_cost, oa.total_spent, oa.total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000.00 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sa JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) oa ON sa.total_available > 500 GROUP BY sa.nation_name, oa.total_spent, oa.total_orders ORDER BY overall_cost DESC, overall_available DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE '%BRASS%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_name) AS top_customer_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_top_customers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_name;

SELECT r.p_name, r.total_revenue, r.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT ts.p_name, ts.total_revenue, ss.supplier_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.p_name ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS rank_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.s_name ORDER BY ss.supplier_revenue DESC) AS rank_supplier FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ts.total_revenue = ss.supplier_revenue) r WHERE r.rank_total = 1 AND r.rank_supplier = 1 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT h.nation_name, COUNT(h.s_name) AS top_suppliers_count, AVG(h.total_supply_cost) AS avg_top_supply_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, s.s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.supplier_rank <= 5) h GROUP BY h.nation_name ORDER BY top_suppliers_count DESC, avg_top_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.r_name AS region, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count, rs.nation_count, rs.region_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(ss.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss) ts ON rs.region_revenue > 0 AND ts.rank <= 5 GROUP BY rs.r_name, rs.nation_count, rs.region_revenue ORDER BY rs.r_name ASC;

SELECT DISTINCT su.s_name AS supplier_name, cu.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem li JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent > 10000) cu ON o.o_custkey = cu.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) su ON li.l_suppkey = su.s_suppkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND li.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY su.s_name, cu.c_name ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT hs.region_name, hs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS num_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) hs JOIN orders o ON hs.s_suppkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY hs.region_name, hs.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tn.n_name, ta.avg_price, cus.c_name, cus.order_count, cus.total_spent, lis.order_count AS part_order_count, lis.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acct_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_acct_balance DESC LIMIT 5) tn JOIN (SELECT p.p_type, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_price FROM part p GROUP BY p.p_type) ta ON ta.avg_price > 50 JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 2) cus ON tn.total_acct_balance > 50000 JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice) > 1000) lis ON tn.n_name LIKE CONCAT('%', lis.l_partkey, '%') ORDER BY tn.total_acct_balance DESC, cus.total_spent DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT si.s_suppkey, si.s_name, si.nation_name, si.region_name, ts.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY si.region_name ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) si JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) ts ON si.s_suppkey = ts.l_suppkey) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT pd.p_partkey, pd.p_name, pd.p_brand, pd.p_type, pd.p_size, pd.region_name, pd.total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, r.r_name AS region_name, sum(ts.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-12-31' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_brand LIKE 'Brand#%' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, r.r_name) pd WHERE pd.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, r.r_name AS region_name, sum(ts.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate > '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-12-31' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_brand LIKE 'Brand#%' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, r.r_name) as part_details) ORDER BY pd.region_name, pd.p_brand;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, ps.p_name, SUM(oli.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_per_customer_part, COUNT(*) AS num_suppliers FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(oli.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') co JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.o_orderkey) oli ON co.c_custkey = oli.c_custkey JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.o_orderkey) oli ON tc.c_custkey = oli.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) ps ON oli.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey) GROUP BY tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, ps.p_name ORDER BY total_revenue_per_customer_part DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Germany', 'Japan') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name as region_name, n.n_name as nation_name, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, SUM(t.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE t.rank = 1 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.n_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS HighValueOrderCount, SUM(rs.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalSupplierCost FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey, n.n_regionkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cr LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalPrice FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 50000) hvo ON cr.c_custkey = hvo.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) rs ON rs.s_suppkey = cr.c_custkey GROUP BY cr.n_regionkey ORDER BY HighValueOrderCount DESC, TotalSupplierCost DESC;

SELECT region_name, order_count, avg_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY avg_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(ro.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_custkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT r.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT r.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COALESCE(SUM(r.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, t.n_name, t.nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) t ON r.total_revenue = t.nation_revenue GROUP BY r.o_orderdate, t.n_name, t.nation_revenue ORDER BY r.o_orderdate ASC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, tr.r_name, tr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey) ts JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(od.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS line_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 10)) WHERE ts.rank = 1 ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC, ts.total_cost ASC;

SELECT ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, tp.total_revenue, ps.s_name, ps.total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) tp ON ro.o_orderkey = tp.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) ps ON tp.l_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = rs.supplier_nation LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN supplier_hierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey) sh ON ps.ps_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(t.national_sales) AS total_nation_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS national_sales, COUNT(ss.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as sales_summary) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name) t JOIN region r ON t.nation_name IN (SELECT n_name FROM nation WHERE n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_nation_sales DESC;

SELECT R.o_orderkey, R.o_orderdate, L.total_quantity, L.total_revenue, L.max_discount, SP.total_available, SP.avg_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) R JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, MAX(l.l_discount) AS max_discount FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey) L ON R.o_orderkey = L.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) SP ON L.l_partkey = SP.ps_partkey WHERE R.rnk = 1 AND R.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY R.o_orderdate DESC, L.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tso.s_name AS Supplier_Name, co.c_name AS Customer_Name, co.order_count AS Total_Orders, co.total_spent AS Total_Spent, tso.total_supply_cost AS Total_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 5) tso JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON tso.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) ORDER BY tso.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(nc.nation_supply_cost) AS region_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS nation_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN nation n ON sd.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc JOIN nation n ON nc.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) GROUP BY r.r_name, r.region_supply_cost ORDER BY r.region_supply_cost DESC, number_of_suppliers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.s_name, SUM(sd.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(sd.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(sd.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) as TopOrders)) sd GROUP BY sd.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, tc.c_name, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, AVG(li.l_tax) AS avg_tax, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_orderkey) AS total_lines FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rnk <= 5) tc JOIN lineitem li ON tc.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, tc.c_name ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.o_totalprice, fr.o_orderstatus, fr.c_name, fr.c_acctbal, fr.s_name, fr.total_cost, fr.supplier_nation FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, np.s_name, np.total_cost, np.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey IN (SELECT r_regionkey FROM region WHERE r_name = 'ASIA') GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) np ON ro.o_orderkey % 100 = np.s_suppkey % 100 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) fr ORDER BY fr.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, ps.p_name AS part_name, ps.total_quantity_sold, ps.total_revenue, ss.total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ss.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON ps.total_quantity_sold > 1000 ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC, cs.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority, COUNT(DISTINCT coi.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(spi.supplier_account_balance) AS avg_supplier_balance, SUM(spi.p_retailprice) AS total_retail_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) coi ON r.o_orderkey = coi.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spi ON spi.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < 100.00 ) WHERE r.rn <= 5 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, total_retail_price DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_name AS high_value_customer, hvc.total_spent AS spent_amount, hvc.order_count AS total_orders, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_value AS supplier_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent, co.order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as customer_orders)) hvc CROSS JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp WHERE sp.total_supply_value > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as supplier_parts)) ts ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.nation, ns.total_revenue, ns.customer_count, opn.order_count FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM ( SELECT SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey ) AS average_revenue)) ns JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) opn ON ns.nation = opn.nation ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC, opn.order_count DESC;

SELECT rp.s_suppkey, rp.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rp.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied, SUM(rl.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered, AVG(rl.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, SUM(rl.l_extendedprice * (1 - rl.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(rl.l_quantity * rp.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost, (SUM(rl.l_extendedprice * (1 - rl.l_discount)) - SUM(rl.l_quantity * rp.ps_supplycost)) AS profit FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_comment FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) rp JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, li.l_partkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_returnflag, li.l_linestatus FROM lineitem li JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') co ON li.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey) rl ON rp.p_partkey = rl.l_partkey GROUP BY rp.s_suppkey, rp.s_name ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_name, c.total_customer_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.total_customer_revenue ORDER BY c.total_customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS num_customers, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_discounted_price FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fr.p_name, fr.p_brand, fr.p_type, fr.p_size, fr.ps_availqty, fr.ps_supplycost, fr.customer_name, fr.o_totalprice, fr.line_item_count, fr.nation_name FROM (SELECT cp.p_name, cp.p_brand, cp.p_type, cp.p_size, cp.ps_availqty, cp.ps_supplycost, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.o_totalprice, co.line_item_count, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS RankByBalance FROM supplier s) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.RankByBalance <= 3) cp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_totalprice, COUNT(li.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_totalprice) co ON cp.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS RankByBalance FROM supplier s) s ) ) JOIN nation n ON cp.nation_name = n.n_name) fr ORDER BY fr.o_totalprice DESC, fr.line_item_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'MAIL') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.sales_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) rs JOIN orders o ON rs.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey) JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.sales_rank ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE n.n_name IN ('GERMANY', 'FRANCE') AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT sr.region_name, sr.total_suppliers, sr.total_customers, sr.total_spent_by_customers, rs.supply_rank, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_spent_by_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) sr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON sr.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r WHERE r.r_regionkey IN (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey))) WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sr.total_spent_by_customers DESC, rs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ts.o_orderkey, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) ts JOIN orders o ON ts.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierOrders) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation, total_sales, order_count, avg_order_value, sales_rank FROM (SELECT nation, total_sales, order_count, avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, n.unique_suppliers, n.total_supplier_cost, c.c_name AS top_customer_name, c.order_count, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM nation n LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) n JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT n2.n_nationkey FROM customer c2 JOIN nation n2 ON c2.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE c2.c_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY c2.c_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY n.total_supplier_cost DESC, c.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, ts.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pn.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation pn ON s.s_nationkey = pn.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, pn.n_nationkey) r JOIN supplier s ON r.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' ORDER BY c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT hro.o_orderkey, hro.o_orderdate, hro.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) hro JOIN lineitem l ON hro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON hro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE hro.total_revenue > 10000.00 ORDER BY hro.total_revenue DESC, hro.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, p.p_brand, p.p_name, MAX(ps.ps_supplycost) AS max_supply_cost, MIN(ps.ps_availqty) AS min_available_qty FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN partsupp ps ON tr.region_name = ( SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey ) JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, p.p_brand, p.p_name ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC, p.p_brand;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, hv.total_supply_cost, hv.num_suppliers, CASE WHEN hv.total_supply_cost IS NULL THEN 'No Supply' WHEN hv.num_suppliers >= 5 THEN 'Highly Supplied' ELSE 'Moderately Supplied' END AS supply_status FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) hv ON p.p_partkey = hv.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 1000 ORDER BY hv.total_supply_cost DESC NULLS LAST, p.p_name ASC LIMIT 20;
