SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND p.p_size = 15 AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ts.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.rank <= 3 AND r.r_regionkey = (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey LIMIT 1))) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, ts.region_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_sum, AVG(total_sales) AS average_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l_orderkey) AS total_orders, MAX(total_sales) AS max_sales_order FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) as sales_data) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales_sum DESC;

SELECT f.c_custkey, f.c_name, f.total_spend, f.order_count, f.top_supplier_count FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spend, co.order_count, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_order_value) AS total_spend, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) WHERE supply_rank <= 5) ts ON co.c_custkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_spend, co.order_count) f WHERE f.total_spend > (SELECT AVG(total_spend) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_order_value) AS total_spend, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderStats) ORDER BY f.total_spend DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, pr.p_name AS part_name, o.o_orderdate, tro.total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_item_count FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) tro JOIN orders o ON tro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part pr ON ps.ps_partkey = pr.p_partkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, s.s_name, pr.p_name, o.o_orderdate, tro.total_revenue ORDER BY tro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.order_count, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT coss.c_custkey, coss.c_name, coss.order_count, coss.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY coss.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(h.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(h.total_extended_price) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.price_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderstatus) h ON c.c_custkey = h.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) coss) tc WHERE tc.customer_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-02-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders ASC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ts.nation_name, ARRAY_AGG(ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_names, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) WHERE rnk <= 3) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.r_name AS region_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.total_supply_cost, co.total_orders, co.total_order_value FROM nation ns JOIN region rs ON ns.n_regionkey = rs.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss ON ns.n_nationkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ns.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > 1000 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, total_available_quantity ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, c.c_name, os.total_orders, os.total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS region_total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs ON ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ts ON r.r_regionkey = ts.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.total_supply_cost, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, rd.r_name AS region_name, rd.nation_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ss.s_suppkey = co.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON co.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rd ON n.n_regionkey = rd.r_regionkey WHERE ss.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, t.segment_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(total_revenue) AS segment_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) JOIN customer c ON RankedOrders.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) t JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_mktsegment = t.c_mktsegment LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey ORDER BY t.segment_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_name, lis.TotalRevenue, lis.TotalQuantity, lis.TotalLineItems FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS TotalLineItems FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON ro.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT ss.nation_name, ss.p_name, ss.total_sales_by_part FROM (SELECT rs.nation_name, p.p_name, SUM(ld.total_sales) AS total_sales_by_part FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ld ON p.p_partkey = ld.o_orderkey GROUP BY rs.nation_name, p.p_name) ss WHERE ss.total_sales_by_part > 5000.00 ORDER BY ss.nation_name, ss.total_sales_by_part DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, a.avg_value FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS brand_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_brand) rs WHERE rs.brand_rank <= 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(order_value) AS avg_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) as TotalOrderValue) a WHERE ts.total_cost > a.avg_value ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_orders, total_revenue, highest_supply_cost FROM (SELECT cn.nation_name, cn.total_orders, cn.total_revenue, MAX(ps.total_supply_cost) AS highest_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name) cn LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice = (SELECT MAX(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2) FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY ) GROUP BY cn.nation_name, cn.total_orders, cn.total_revenue) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT mp.p_partkey, mp.p_name, mp.total_revenue, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, sd.ps_availqty, sd.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ts.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT l_partkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey) mp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_partkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) sd ON mp.p_partkey = sd.ps_partkey WHERE mp.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY mp.total_revenue DESC, sd.s_name;

SELECT tr.o_orderdate, tr.o_orderkey, tr.total_revenue, ss.supplier_value, (tr.total_revenue / NULLIF(ss.supplier_value, 0)) AS revenue_per_supplier_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * p.p_retailprice) AS supplier_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name) ss ON ss.supplier_value > 0 ORDER BY tr.o_orderdate, tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.customer_name, hvo.customer_balance, sp.p_name, sp.p_brand, sp.p_retailprice, sp.supplier_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.customer_name, ro.customer_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_acctbal AS customer_balance, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo JOIN lineitem li ON hvo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sp ON li.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE hvo.o_totalprice > 500 ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, sp.p_name, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) as total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) as total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, p.p_name) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 AND sp.total_avail_qty > 100 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_order_value) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) > 100) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, s.s_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, s.s_name) o ON r.customer_count > 0 JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON s.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tn.nation_name, tn.total_nation_sales FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_nation_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_nation_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(so.total_sales) AS total_nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so ON s.s_suppkey = so.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as NationSales) tn WHERE tn.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tn.total_nation_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_customer_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT hs.ps_suppkey) AS high_spending_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank = 1 AND n.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) hs ON hs.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_customer_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name as nation_name, r.r_name as region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_lineitem_value FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND n.n_name IN (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_comment LIKE '%special%') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tn.region_name, tn.nation_name, COUNT(tn.s_suppkey) AS number_of_top_suppliers, SUM(tn.total_value) AS total_value_of_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) s JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 3) tn GROUP BY tn.region_name, tn.nation_name ORDER BY tn.region_name, total_value_of_suppliers DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND r.r_name = 'Asia' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, sn.supplier_nation, oo.total_price, COUNT(oo.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, n.n_name) sn ON rp.p_partkey = sn.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) oo ON rp.p_partkey = oo.o_orderkey WHERE rp.rank <= 10 GROUP BY rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, sn.supplier_nation, oo.total_price ORDER BY total_price DESC, rp.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_balance FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate > DATE '1998-10-01' - INTERVAL '1 year') ro ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_type = 'Widget' ) LIMIT 1 ) JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey ) JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE co.total_spent > ( SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate > DATE '1998-10-01' - INTERVAL '1 year') ro ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders ) ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.region_name, r.customer_count, r.total_revenue, r.total_supply_cost, (r.total_revenue / NULLIF(r.total_supply_cost, 0)) AS profitability_ratio FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_summary)) hr ON r.region_name = hr.region_name WHERE hr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT rs.nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON os.o_custkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, s.total_availqty, s.avg_supplycost, CASE WHEN t.o_totalprice > 1000 THEN 'High Value' WHEN t.o_totalprice BETWEEN 500 AND 1000 THEN 'Medium Value' ELSE 'Low Value' END AS order_value_category FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) s ON s.ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey ) ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, t.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.total_line_value) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lo ON ro.o_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON cs.total_spent > ts.total_supply_cost ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, SUM(LI.l_extendedprice * (1 - LI.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem LI JOIN orders O ON LI.l_orderkey = O.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_avail_qty, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ON LI.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE O.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sp.s_name, p.p_name, r.revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN part p ON sp.p_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT cp.c_custkey, cp.c_name, SUM(cp.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) cp GROUP BY cp.c_custkey, cp.c_name HAVING SUM(cp.total_revenue) > 10000) r ON sp.s_suppkey = r.c_custkey ORDER BY r.revenue DESC, sp.s_name ASC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue, s.s_name, s.supply_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supply_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 AND s.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC, s.supply_count DESC;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, p.p_name, rs.total_available_qty, rs.avg_supply_cost, rs.total_ordered_qty FROM (SELECT sps.s_suppkey, sps.s_name, sps.p_partkey, sps.total_available_qty, sps.avg_supply_cost, sps.total_ordered_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sps.p_partkey ORDER BY sps.total_ordered_qty DESC) AS rank_ordered_qty FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_ordered_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) sps) rs JOIN part p ON rs.p_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE rs.rank_ordered_qty = 1 ORDER BY rs.total_ordered_qty DESC, rs.s_suppkey;

SELECT rs.r_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = rs.r_name ) ) ORDER BY rs.r_name, ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.revenue, COUNT(ls.l_orderkey) AS total_lineitems FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE rank <= 5) o JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey) JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = (SELECT l_suppkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT l_partkey FROM lineitem WHERE l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN lineitem ls ON ls.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name, n.n_name, r.r_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.revenue ORDER BY o.revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, np.n_name AS nation_name, pd.p_name AS part_name, pd.total_revenue, ns.total_spent, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, cs.total_spent FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey) np ON np.total_spent > 100000 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) pd ON pd.total_revenue > 50000 JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ns.total_spent FROM (SELECT n.n_name, cs.total_spent FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey) ns WHERE ns.total_spent > 100000) ns ON true WHERE ts.total_cost < 1000 ORDER BY pd.total_revenue DESC, ns.total_spent DESC;

SELECT h.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.l_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(sh.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_ordered, SUM(sh.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT CONCAT(pd.p_name, ' (', pd.supplier_name, ')'), ', ') AS products_supplied FROM (SELECT rc.c_custkey, rc.c_name, rc.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc WHERE rc.rank <= 10) h JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) sh ON h.c_custkey = sh.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) pd ON sh.l_partkey = pd.p_partkey GROUP BY h.c_custkey, h.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT cr.c_name, cr.total_revenue AS customer_revenue, sr.s_name AS supplier_name, sr.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COALESCE(os.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, os.order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000.00) cr JOIN (SELECT pd.s_suppkey, pd.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)), 0) AS supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) pd JOIN partsupp ps ON pd.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY pd.s_suppkey, pd.s_name) sr ON cr.total_revenue < sr.supplier_revenue ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC, sr.supplier_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, rn.r_name, rn.n_name, ps.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ps ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) rn ON rn.n_nationkey IN (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, rn.r_name, ps.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND s.s_comment NOT LIKE '%special%' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.r_regionkey, t.r_name, t.total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r) t WHERE t.rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(cs.total_orders) AS total_orders_per_region, AVG(cs.total_spent) AS average_spent_per_customer FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.total_order_value) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_line_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_orders_per_region DESC, average_spent_per_customer DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cr.o_orderkey, cr.o_orderdate, cr.total_revenue, cr.supplier_name, cr.supplier_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) o JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) s ON o.o_orderkey = s.p_partkey) cr ORDER BY cr.total_revenue DESC, cr.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS Total_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s INNER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s INNER JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.level < 3) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.level < 3) s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN customer c ON l.l_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) > 1000000 ORDER BY Total_Supply_Cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ts.supplier_count, ts.total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey IN ( SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ) ) GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.supplier_count, ts.total_spent ORDER BY ts.total_spent DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_spent, cs.order_count, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_status FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey IN (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost > 1000 WHERE ro.rank_status <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.total_revenue, t.c_name, t.s_name, t.supplier_nation, t.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, c.c_name, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, SUM(rs.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN customer c ON rs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name JOIN nation n ON ts.n_name = n.n_name GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY r.r_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, ss.total_parts, ss.total_value, os.total_revenue, os.order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_name) ss ON ss.total_value > 100000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 5000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST, c.c_name ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_spent, hsp.p_partkey, hsp.p_name, hsp.p_brand, hsp.p_retailprice, hsp.total_avail_qty FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) hvc JOIN lineitem li ON hvc.c_custkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, rp.total_avail_qty FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank_by_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice) rp WHERE rp.rank_by_supplycost <= 5) hsp ON li.l_partkey = hsp.p_partkey ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC, hsp.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.nation_cost, od.order_total, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS nation_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON ns.n_nationkey = ( SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders) LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY ns.n_name, ns.nation_cost, od.order_total ORDER BY ns.nation_cost DESC, od.order_total DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT sos.s_name, sos.total_filled_orders, sos.total_open_orders, sos.avg_order_total, rns.region_name, rns.total_nations, rns.total_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_filled_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'O' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_open_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_total, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) sos JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rns ON sos.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000 ) ORDER BY sos.avg_order_total DESC, rns.total_nations ASC;

SELECT tp.p_brand, SUM(tp.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.*, brand_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA') AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) p WHERE brand_rank <= 10) tp GROUP BY tp.p_brand ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.TotalCost, ts.TotalOrders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.TotalCost, so.TotalOrders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY so.TotalCost DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS TotalCost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.SupplierRank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.TotalCost DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, revenue_rank FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name) as revenue_data) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ls.total_revenue, ls.total_items FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost IS NOT NULL WHERE ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, CASE WHEN total_sales > (SELECT average_sales FROM (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) as avg_sales) THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS sales_status FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, total_orders FROM (SELECT region_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_name) as RegionalSupplierSales) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS num_customers, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, region_name, nation_name, supplier_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ri.total_revenue) AS total_region_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ri.p_partkey) AS distinct_parts_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty) ri JOIN supplier s ON ri.ps_supplycost = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ri.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_region_revenue DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, ps.avg_acctbal, co.order_count, co.total_spent, rp.p_name AS top_product, rp.p_retailprice FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM supplier s GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ps ON n.n_nationkey = ps.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) co ON n.n_nationkey = co.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) rp ON n.n_nationkey = rp.p_partkey WHERE rp.price_rank = 1 ORDER BY region, nation) WHERE total_spent > 100000 ORDER BY region, nation, total_spent DESC;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, cs.total_orders, ss.s_name, ss.total_avail_qty, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_spent, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.total_spent > ss.total_supply_cost ORDER BY total_spent DESC, total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tn.n_name, tn.total_orders, tn.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, SUM(ca.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(ca.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) ca ON n.n_nationkey = ca.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, n.n_regionkey ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn JOIN region r ON tn.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_availqty > 0 JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY tn.n_name, tn.total_orders, tn.total_revenue, region_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment, pi.p_name, pi.p_brand, pi.p_retailprice, si.s_name AS top_supplier, si.s_acctbal AS top_supplier_acctbal, pi.total_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, p.p_container, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, p.p_container) pi ON l.l_partkey = pi.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) si ON pi.p_partkey = si.ps_partkey AND si.supplier_rank = 1 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 AND pi.total_suppliers > 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_account_balance, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_returnflag = 'R' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS total_returned_quantity, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_line_item_price FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate > '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size >= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, ro.unique_customers, ro.region, ro.nation FROM (SELECT os.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY os.region ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.r_name, n.n_name) os) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.region, ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts_shipped, SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_container = 'SM CASE' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS sm_case_total_quantity, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1993-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1994-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sr.total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr ON s.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) t LEFT JOIN orders o ON t.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_revenue ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_cost_of_top_suppliers DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.revenue, os.o_orderdate, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.n_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ts.n_name ORDER BY os.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderdate, ts.n_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name, rs.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.n_name) os JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name, rs.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON os.n_name = ts.n_name WHERE os.revenue > (SELECT AVG(revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderdate, ts.n_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, n.n_name, rs.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.n_name) as OrderSummary) ORDER BY ts.n_name, revenue_rank;

SELECT nation_name, customer_count, total_revenue, avg_part_price, total_quantity FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_part_price, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_part_price, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as summary) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.nation_name, r.total_revenue, r.order_count, r.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT supplier_data.s_suppkey, supplier_data.s_name, supplier_data.nation_name, supplier_data.total_revenue, supplier_data.order_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY supplier_data.nation_name ORDER BY supplier_data.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) supplier_data) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.nation_name, r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, t.total_revenue, CASE WHEN t.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Revenue' WHEN t.total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name) r WHERE r.rank = 1) t ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT RegionName, SupplierName, TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS RankInRegion FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.RankInRegion < 3) ORDER BY RegionName, TotalSupplyCost DESC;
