SELECT p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ss.total_available, ss.avg_supplier_balance FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM partsupp ps JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank, ps.ps_partkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) s ON ps.ps_partkey = s.ps_partkey WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ss ON p.p_partkey = ss.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 ) ORDER BY ss.total_available DESC, ss.avg_supplier_balance DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT national.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cust.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(ranked.r_total_price) AS avg_order_value, SUM(ranked.r_part_count) AS total_parts_ordered FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, CTE1.r_part_count, CTE1.r_total_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rnk, o.o_custkey -- Added to GROUP BY later FROM orders o JOIN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) as r_part_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) as r_total_price FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey ) AS CTE1 ON o.o_orderkey = CTE1.l_orderkey) ranked JOIN customer cust ON ranked.o_custkey = cust.c_custkey JOIN nation national ON cust.c_nationkey = national.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON national.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ranked.rnk <= 10 GROUP BY national.n_name, r.r_name, ranked.o_custkey -- Added o_custkey to GROUP BY ORDER BY customer_count DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acct_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT rs.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS UniqueCustomers, SUM(cs.TotalSpent) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.s_suppkey) AS UniqueSuppliers, AVG(cs.TotalOrders) AS AvgOrdersPerCustomer FROM region rs JOIN nation n ON rs.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.TotalOrderValue) AS TotalSpent, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS TotalLineItems FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyValue, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.TotalSupplyValue > 100000 GROUP BY rs.r_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(distinct o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'EUROPE' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, r.p_name, r.p_brand, r.p_type, r.revenue, pd.total_available FROM (SELECT tn.n_name, pd.p_name, pd.p_brand, pd.p_type, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) tn JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderstatus = 'F' JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) pd ON p.p_name = pd.p_name GROUP BY tn.n_name, pd.p_name, pd.p_brand, pd.p_type) r JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) pd ON r.p_name = pd.p_name JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY) n ON r.n_name = n.n_name ORDER BY r.revenue DESC, pd.total_available DESC;

SELECT fo.customer_name, fo.o_orderdate, SUM(fo.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(fo.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(fo.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.order_rank, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.customer_name, r.supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') r WHERE r.order_rank = 1) fo GROUP BY fo.customer_name, fo.o_orderdate HAVING SUM(fo.o_totalprice) > 50000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, t.r_name, t.s_name, t.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT r_name, s_suppkey, s_name, s_acctbal, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, r.r_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name, n.n_regionkey) WHERE rank = 1) t ON ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT cos.c_name AS customer_name, hr.nation AS supplier_nation, hr.region AS supplier_region, hr.total_supply_cost, cos.total_spent, cos.total_orders FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) WHERE supply_rank <= 3) hr JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON hr.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' ) LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY hr.total_supply_cost DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, sr.s_suppkey, sr.s_name, sr.total_supply_cost, sr.order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey ) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, sr.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT s.s_name, s.supplier_nation, COALESCE(SUM(sos.total_sales), 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(AVG(sos.average_order_value), 0) AS average_order_value, COALESCE(SUM(sos.total_orders), 0) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT si.s_suppkey, si.s_name, si.supplier_nation, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS total_sales, AVG(od.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) si JOIN partsupp ps ON si.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY si.s_suppkey, si.s_name, si.supplier_nation) sos ON s.s_suppkey = sos.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, s.supplier_nation ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT FR.s_suppkey, FR.s_name, FR.customer_order_value, FR.region_sales, FR.total_supply_cost, FR.profit FROM (SELECT RS.s_suppkey, RS.s_name, COALESCE(CO.total_order_value, 0) AS customer_order_value, COALESCE(RT.total_region_sales, 0) AS region_sales, RS.total_supply_cost, (COALESCE(CO.total_order_value, 0) - RS.total_supply_cost) AS profit FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) RS LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) CO ON RS.s_suppkey = CO.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_region_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) RT ON CO.c_custkey = RT.r_regionkey) FR WHERE FR.profit > 0 ORDER BY FR.profit DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC;

SELECT t.s_name AS supplier_name, t.part_count, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.order_count, c.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t.s_suppkey ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.part_count FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM partsupp ps INNER JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sp INNER JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.part_count DESC LIMIT 5) t CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY t.s_suppkey, c.total_spent DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenuePerNation) t JOIN partsupp ps ON t.nation_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY t.nation_name, t.total_revenue ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, cs.c_mktsegment, cs.order_count, cs.segment_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS segment_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON cs.segment_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, cs.order_count DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, bp.p_name, bp.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) bp ON ts.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC, bp.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT sp.s_name, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue, (sp.l_extendedprice * (1 - sp.l_discount)) AS revenue_per_item FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND s.s_acctbal > 1000.00) sp JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON sp.s_suppkey = os.o_custkey ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sr.region_name, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) sr WHERE sr.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT p_name, p_brand, s_name, s_acctbal, c_name, total_value FROM (SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal, co.c_name, co.total_value FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 30) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) co ON co.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey ) WHERE rp.rank <= 5 AND sd.supplier_rank <= 10) ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_suppliers, rs.total_supply_value, co.order_count, co.total_spent, lis.total_revenue, lis.avg_quantity FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON co.c_custkey = (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON lis.l_orderkey = (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o ORDER BY RANDOM() LIMIT 1) ORDER BY rs.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, r.r_name AS region_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ss.s_suppkey, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.c_custkey, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.orders_count > 5 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ss.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT region_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, total_revenue, (total_revenue - total_supply_cost) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT tr.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost, tr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(orders.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders ON c.c_custkey = orders.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON tr.r_regionkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, MAX(o.o_totalprice) AS max_order_price FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, average_customer_balance ASC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_sales, total_orders, total_customers FROM (SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_sales, total_orders, total_customers, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) as RegionalData) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, MAX(l.l_extendedprice) AS max_product_price FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.r_name = 'NORTH AMERICA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY nation_name, region_name;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.region_name, ns.total_revenue, ss.supplier_count, ss.average_balance FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_balance FROM supplier s GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON ns.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey WHERE ns.total_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY ns.total_revenue DESC, ss.average_balance ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance, MAX(l.l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'REG AIR') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_acctbal HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, tr.RegionCost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, SUM(sd.TotalCost) AS RegionCost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY RegionCost DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON r.r_regionkey = tr.n_regionkey ORDER BY tr.RegionCost DESC;

SELECT fr.r_name AS Region, fr.n_name AS Nation, fr.s_name AS Supplier, ROUND(fr.total_supplycost, 2) AS Total_Cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, ss.s_name, ss.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ns.total_nation_cost) AS total_region_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_supplycost) AS total_nation_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey WHERE li.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_supplycost) AS total_nation_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey WHERE li.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey WHERE li.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ns.n_nationkey = ss.s_suppkey) fr ORDER BY fr.total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_items, rs.total_supply_value, rs.supplier_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs ON l.l_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, rs.total_supply_value, rs.supplier_rank HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC, line_items DESC;

SELECT r_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT r_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS air_shipping_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_shipmode = 'GROUND' THEN l.l_extendedprice ELSE 0 END) AS ground_shipping_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, ro.total_orders, ro.total_revenue, (ro.total_revenue / ro.total_orders) AS avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, count(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ro JOIN region r ON r.r_name = ro.r_name WHERE ro.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT r.r_name, MAX(t.monthly_revenue) AS max_monthly_revenue, AVG(t.monthly_revenue) AS avg_monthly_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(oo.total_revenue) AS monthly_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS monthly_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) oo JOIN customer c ON oo.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE oo.monthly_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) t JOIN region r ON r.r_name = t.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY max_monthly_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, t.s_name AS supplier_name, rp.p_name AS part_name, rp.total_cost AS part_total_cost, hvo.o_orderkey AS order_key, hvo.o_totalprice AS high_value_order_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name ORDER BY supplier_cost DESC LIMIT 5) t JOIN region r ON t.n_name = r.r_name JOIN nation n ON t.n_name = n.n_name JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp ON t.s_suppkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 1000) hvo ON hvo.o_custkey = t.s_suppkey) ORDER BY region, nation, part_total_cost DESC;

SELECT r.s_name, r.p_name, r.total_quantity, r.revenue, r.total_orders FROM (SELECT spi.s_name, spi.p_name, SUM(od.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(od.l_extendedprice * (1 - od.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spi JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) od ON spi.p_partkey = od.l_partkey WHERE od.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND od.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY spi.s_name, spi.p_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, total_quantity DESC) r WHERE r.total_orders > 5 LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_revenue, r.unique_customers, r.avg_order_value_per_customer, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(co.avg_order_value) AS avg_order_value_per_customer FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN nation n ON sp.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) sp ON r.r_name = sp.r_name ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT Nation, TotalOrders, TotalRevenue, RevenueRank, OrderRank FROM (SELECT Nation, TotalOrders, TotalRevenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalOrders DESC) AS OrderRank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as CountryOrders) WHERE RevenueRank <= 5 AND OrderRank <= 5 ORDER BY RevenueRank, OrderRank;

SELECT r.r_name, r.top_supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal, SUM(s.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_per_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_suppkey AND s.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s ON r.top_supplier_count > 0 GROUP BY r.r_name, r.top_supplier_count ORDER BY total_cost_per_region DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(os.total_price) AS total_revenue, AVG(os.part_count) AS avg_parts_per_order, AVG(os.customer_count) AS avg_customers_per_order FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.nation = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS part_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON ts.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(order_total) DESC) AS rank FROM ( SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS customer_orders JOIN customer c ON customer_orders.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey) br WHERE br.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey AND br.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey AND br.rank = 1 ) ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_cost DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT p.p_name, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COALESCE(TR.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.order_rank = 1 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) TR ON TR.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY p.p_name, s.s_name, TR.total_revenue HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 5000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_cost ASC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_acctbal ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ps.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated, SUM(sp.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') o JOIN nation n ON o.c_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON o.o_orderkey = ps.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON sp.total_cost > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT hcs.region, hcs.num_high_cost_suppliers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(*) AS num_high_cost_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.nation = ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rs.total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) as RankedSuppliers) GROUP BY r.r_name) hcs JOIN orders o ON hcs.num_high_cost_suppliers > 0 GROUP BY hcs.region, hcs.num_high_cost_suppliers ORDER BY hcs.region;

SELECT rs.sales_rank, rs.revenue, si.s_name, si.supplier_nation FROM (SELECT ts.p_partkey, ts.revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.revenue DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name as supplier_nation FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) si ON ps.ps_suppkey = si.s_suppkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.revenue DESC, si.s_name ASC;

SELECT nation_name, customer_count, total_revenue, total_supply_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(ho.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(rv.total_value) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) ho JOIN customer c ON ho.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rv ON rv.s_suppkey = ho.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rr.o_orderkey, rr.o_orderdate, rr.c_name, rr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, c_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) as RankedOrders) rr WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_acctbal, ss.total_supplier_sales, tn.total_sales_by_nation FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_supplier_sales FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(r.total_sales) AS total_sales_by_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY total_sales_by_nation DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON s.s_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) ORDER BY tn.total_sales_by_nation DESC, ss.total_supplier_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, ts.s_name AS supplier, ts.parts_supplied, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as RankedSuppliers) ts JOIN nation n ON ts.n_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers, SUM(hp.total_supply_cost) AS total_part_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY nation_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s) rs ON ts.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey AND rs.rn <= 3 LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) hp ON hp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey) GROUP BY ts.n_nationkey, ts.n_name ORDER BY num_suppliers DESC, total_part_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT tr.c_custkey, tr.c_name AS customer_name, tr.customer_revenue, spr.s_suppkey, spr.s_name AS supplier_name, spr.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rnk FROM orders AS o JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) AS ro JOIN customer AS c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders AS o WHERE o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) AS tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier AS s JOIN partsupp AS ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) AS spr ON tr.customer_revenue > spr.supplier_revenue ORDER BY tr.customer_revenue DESC, spr.supplier_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, tor.revenue FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE order_rank <= 10) tor JOIN orders o ON tor.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY tor.revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.Region, tr.TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS AvgSupplierAcctBal FROM (SELECT Region, TotalSales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC) AS SalesRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_container = 'SM CASE') JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE tr.SalesRank <= 5 GROUP BY tr.Region, tr.TotalSales ORDER BY tr.TotalSales DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, lis.total_revenue, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') co JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) lis ON co.o_orderkey = lis.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey) sp ON sp.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0 LIMIT 1) WHERE co.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders) ORDER BY co.o_orderdate DESC, co.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tc.rank, tc.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS cumulative_revenue FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank, c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) as RankedOrders) tc JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) ro ON tc.c_name = ro.c_name GROUP BY tc.rank, tc.c_name ORDER BY cumulative_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT fr.rank, fr.n_name, fr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name, tn.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY tn.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ri.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ri JOIN customer c ON ri.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) tn JOIN nation n ON tn.n_name = n.n_name) fr WHERE fr.rank <= 10;

SELECT tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.c_name, tr.revenue, p.p_name, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE r.rn = 1) tr JOIN lineitem l ON tr.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY tr.o_orderkey, tr.o_orderdate, tr.c_name, tr.revenue, p.p_name, s.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 10 ORDER BY tr.revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_inventory_value, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) s) ts ON s.s_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey WHERE ts.rnk <= 5 GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.daily_rank AS order_rank, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS daily_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, sr.supplier_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sr.supplier_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts ON ts.revenue_rank <= 10 WHERE r.daily_rank <= 5 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate, ts.supplier_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT si.s_name AS supplier_name, si.nation_name, tp.ps_partkey, os.o_orderkey, os.total_order_value, tp.total_value AS part_total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier WHERE s_acctbal IS NOT NULL)) si JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON si.s_suppkey = tp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.total_order_value > tp.total_value WHERE si.nation_name = 'USA' ORDER BY os.total_order_value DESC, tp.total_value DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderstatus, t.o_totalprice, t.o_orderpriority, od.total_revenue, od.unique_parts, CASE WHEN od.total_revenue > 10000 THEN 'High Revenue' WHEN od.total_revenue BETWEEN 5000 AND 10000 THEN 'Medium Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority, r.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS total_price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.total_price_rank <= 10) t JOIN (SELECT t.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority, r.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS total_price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.total_price_rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey) od ON t.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC, t.o_orderkey;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_retailprice, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_spent, cs.total_orders, rp.price_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS supplier_part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) > 50) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE rp.price_rank <= 10 AND cs.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY rp.p_retailprice DESC, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(hsn.n_name) AS high_spender_count, SUM(hsn.total_spending) AS total_spending FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, n.n_regionkey, nws.total_spending FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_spending FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nws JOIN nation n ON n.n_name = nws.n_name WHERE nws.total_spending > ( SELECT AVG(nws2.total_spending) FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_spending FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nws2 )) hsn ON r.r_regionkey = hsn.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY high_spender_count DESC, total_spending DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, sh.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.order_count, ps.total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier sh ON n.n_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.order_count > 10 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ps ON sh.s_suppkey = ps.p_partkey WHERE ps.total_sales > 10000.00 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, cs.order_count DESC, ps.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_acctbal, ts.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY rs.total_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') WHERE rs.total_supplycost > (SELECT AVG(total_supplycost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as RankedSuppliers)) ts JOIN customer c ON ts.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.c_mktsegment, ts.s_name;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, customer_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, roc.c_name AS customer_name, roc.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_nationkey) roc JOIN customer c ON roc.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE roc.revenue_rank <= 10) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name, customer_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.Region, tr.TotalSales FROM (SELECT Region, TotalSales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC) AS SalesRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr WHERE tr.SalesRank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.TotalSales DESC;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, h.c_name, ld.total_sales, ld.number_of_suppliers FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 5) h JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS number_of_suppliers FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rank_order <= 5) h ON l.l_orderkey = h.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ld ON h.o_orderkey = ld.l_orderkey ORDER BY h.o_totalprice DESC, ld.total_sales DESC;

SELECT rc.o_orderkey, rc.o_orderdate, rc.c_name, rc.total_revenue, tc.annual_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) rc JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(rou.total_revenue) AS annual_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) rou JOIN customer c ON rou.c_name = c.c_name GROUP BY c.c_name) tc ON rc.c_name = tc.c_name WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.o_orderdate, rc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT *, (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) AS avg_sales_per_region FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_regionkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.total_sales, COALESCE(sc.supplier_count, 0) AS suppliers, CASE WHEN cs.total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High' WHEN cs.total_sales BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END AS sales_category FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(ts.sales) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1999-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ts ON o.o_orderkey = ts.l_orderkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cs LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l.l_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) sc ON cs.c_custkey = sc.l_partkey ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_top_suppliers, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_by_region FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost, n.n_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 3) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_cost_by_region DESC;

SELECT os.c_custkey, ts.nation_name, ts.supplier_id, ts.total_cost, os.total_order_value, os.number_of_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os JOIN (SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.supplier_id, ns.total_cost FROM (SELECT nation_name, supplier_id, total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_suppkey AS supplier_id, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_suppkey) as nation_supplier) ns WHERE ns.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON ts.nation_name IN ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = os.c_custkey) ) ORDER BY os.total_order_value DESC, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.c_acctbal, p.ps_partkey, p.total_value, s.s_name, s.s_phone, s.nation_name, s.parts_supplied FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rnk <= 5) o JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) p ON p.ps_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 10 ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_phone, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, s.s_phone, n.n_name) s ON s.parts_supplied > 5 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;
