SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance, AVG(CASE WHEN sh.level > 1 THEN s.s_acctbal END) AS avg_nested_account_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT sp.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT sp.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM partsupp sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN supplier_hierarchy sh ON sp.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh ON sp.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh JOIN supplier s ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_account_balance DESC, supplier_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT nation, COUNT(c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(total_sales) AS nation_sales, AVG(total_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_customer FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY nation ORDER BY nation_sales DESC;

SELECT s.o_orderkey, s.total_items, s.total_discounted_price, s.total_quantity, s.avg_supply_cost, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS total_items, SUM(od.discounted_price) AS total_discounted_price, SUM(od.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(od.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost, (l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS discounted_price FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey) s JOIN customer c ON s.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.total_discounted_price > 10000 ORDER BY s.total_discounted_price DESC;

SELECT rr.r_name AS region, rr.region_revenue, sr.s_name AS supplier, sr.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_by_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON rr.region_revenue = sr.supplier_revenue WHERE rr.region_revenue > (SELECT AVG(region_revenue) FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_by_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) as RegionRevenue) ORDER BY rr.region_revenue DESC, sr.supplier_revenue DESC;

SELECT region, nation, order_count, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) WHERE order_count > 5 ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT rr.nation, rr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT nation, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as Revenue) rr WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_cost DESC;

SELECT nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s_name) AS supplier_count, SUM(total_sales) AS total_sales_amount FROM (SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, st.nation_name, st.total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY st.nation_name ORDER BY st.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) st JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = st.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 5) GROUP BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales_amount DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.unique_parts, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.total_supply_value, ol.total_revenue, ol.unique_line_items FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_line_items FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ol ON ro.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey IN ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Canada') ) JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.unique_parts, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss WHERE ss.unique_parts > 5) ss ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ss.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, sr.supplier_revenue, nr.nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON ro.o_orderkey = sr.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nr ON sr.s_suppkey = nr.n_nationkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nr.n_name, nr.nation_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY nr.nation_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nr WHERE nr.nation_revenue > (SELECT AVG(nation_revenue) FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as NationsRevenue) ORDER BY nr.nation_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.nation_name, o.o_orderdate FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation_name, total_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY total_value DESC, o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_line_quantity FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, c_name, r_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.r_name, c.c_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1994-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT DISTINCT o_custkey FROM orders WHERE o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.sales_rank <= 10) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, co.customer_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_orderpriority, ol.order_value, ol.item_count, rs.total_value, rs.supplier_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(p.p_retailprice * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON co.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ol ON ol.o_orderkey = co.o_orderkey ORDER BY rs.region_name, co.o_orderdate DESC, ol.order_value DESC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.nation_name, r.order_count, r.total_price, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS regional_order_total, SUM(o.total_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY r.region_name) AS regional_revenue_total FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, s.s_name) o JOIN customer c ON o.customer_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, s.s_name) o ON r.order_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, s.s_name) WHERE o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey) ORDER BY r.region_name, r.nation_name;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.c_mktsegment, a.total_line_amount, a.avg_supplier_value FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS segment_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.segment_rank <= 10) h JOIN (SELECT hp.o_orderkey, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS total_line_amount, AVG(sp.total_supply_value) AS avg_supplier_value FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS segment_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.segment_rank <= 10) hp JOIN lineitem lp ON hp.o_orderkey = lp.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON lp.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey GROUP BY hp.o_orderkey) a ON h.o_orderkey = a.o_orderkey ORDER BY a.total_line_amount DESC, h.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.revenue, n.customer_count, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.s_acctbal AS top_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(cr.total_revenue) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey) cr JOIN nation n ON cr.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) n JOIN (SELECT r.nation, r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.rank = 1) ts ON n.n_name = ts.nation ORDER BY n.revenue DESC, n.customer_count DESC;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ls.l_extendedprice * (1 - ls.l_discount)) AS revenue, COALESCE(SP.total_cost, 0) AS supplier_cost, CS.total_spending, CASE WHEN CS.total_spending IS NOT NULL THEN (SUM(ls.l_extendedprice * (1 - ls.l_discount)) - COALESCE(SP.total_cost, 0)) / CS.total_spending * 100 ELSE 0 END AS profitability_ratio FROM lineitem ls JOIN part p ON ls.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON ls.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) SP ON p.p_partkey = SP.ps_partkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) CS ON c.c_custkey = CS.c_custkey WHERE ls.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, r.r_name, SP.total_cost, CS.total_spending ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.part_count > 1 AND s.s_acctbal > 500.00) hvs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_spent > 1000.00) hvc ON hvc.total_spent > 500 GROUP BY hvs.nation_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name AS top_customer, tc.total_spent AS customer_total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost AS supplier_total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, ts.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ts JOIN customer c ON ts.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) tc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sa.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sa.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa JOIN supplier s ON sa.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts ON tc.rank = 1 AND ts.rank = 1 WHERE tc.total_spent > 10000 AND ts.total_supply_cost < 50000 ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC, ts.total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT os.l_orderkey AS o_orderkey, os.total_revenue, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.nation, os.o_orderstatus, os.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation, ss.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss) rs ON os.o_orderdate = ( SELECT MAX(o_orderdate) FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o_orderdate <= os.o_orderdate ) WHERE rs.rank = 1 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, tn.n_name AS nation_name, tn.total_revenue, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue AS order_revenue, ro.revenue_rank FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tn ON n.n_name = tn.n_name JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON tn.total_revenue = ro.total_revenue WHERE tn.total_revenue > 1000000 ORDER BY r.r_name, tn.total_revenue DESC, ro.o_orderdate;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount, AVG(rs.TotalRevenue) AS AvgRevenue, SUM(rs.TotalOrders) AS TotalOrdersReceived FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.TotalRevenue, s.TotalOrders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) > 0 ORDER BY AvgRevenue DESC;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.c_name, fr.nation_name, fr.total_revenue, fr.supplier_value FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.nation_name, hvp.total_revenue, si.supplier_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000) hvp ON ro.o_orderkey = hvp.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) si ON hvp.l_partkey = si.ps_partkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 5) fr ORDER BY fr.o_orderdate DESC, fr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT hcp.s_name, hcp.p_name, hcp.p_brand, hcp.p_type, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT spc.s_name, spc.p_name, spc.p_brand, spc.p_type, spc.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) spc JOIN (SELECT p_brand, p_type, AVG(ps_supplycost) AS avg_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) GROUP BY p_brand, p_type) ac ON spc.p_brand = ac.p_brand AND spc.p_type = ac.p_type WHERE spc.ps_supplycost > ac.avg_cost) hcp JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co ON hcp.p_brand = SUBSTRING(CAST(co.o_orderdate AS TEXT), 1, 4) ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, hcp.ps_supplycost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, od.revenue, od.line_item_count, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(lo.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) od ON ro.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) rs ON rs.rank <= 10 ORDER BY od.revenue DESC, ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ms.top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, ARRAY_AGG(s.s_name) AS top_suppliers FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) s ON s.supplier_rank = 1 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ms JOIN region r ON ms.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ms.top_suppliers IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT tn.n_name, tn.nation_total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT n.n_name, n.n_nationkey, ns.nation_total_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS nation_total_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON n.n_name = ns.n_name ORDER BY ns.nation_total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) tn JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = tn.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY tn.n_name, tn.nation_total_cost ORDER BY tn.nation_total_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.order_count, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc WHERE tc.total_spent > 1000;

SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COALESCE(nr.nation_revenue, 0) AS nation_revenue, COALESCE(ss.total_cost, 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(ss.supplied_parts, 0) AS supplied_parts FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS nation_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN customer c ON os.unique_customers = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nr ON r.r_regionkey = nr.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ss ON ss.ps_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey ) ORDER BY r.r_regionkey, nr.nation_revenue DESC, ss.total_cost DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey) os JOIN lineitem l ON os.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(st.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) st JOIN supplier s ON st.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE os.line_count > 1 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, nr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(oli.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10) r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.o_orderkey) oli JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rn <= 10) r ON oli.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON r.n_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_name) nr JOIN nation n ON nr.n_name = n.n_name ORDER BY nr.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT bp.n_name AS BestNation, bp.TotalNationSupplyCost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, np.TotalNationSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY np.TotalNationSupplyCost DESC) AS Rank FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(sd.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalNationSupplyCost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON n.n_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) np ON n.n_nationkey = np.n_nationkey) bp WHERE bp.Rank = 1;

SELECT ns.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ns.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(hvp.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(hvp.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 50000) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(ps_supplycost) FROM partsupp)) hvp ON ns.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = hvp.p_partkey) GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, sr.supplier_region, sr.total_supplycost, r.price_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.r_name AS supplier_region, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) sr ON l.l_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE r.price_rank <= 5 AND sr.total_supplycost > 10000 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT nation, revenue FROM (SELECT nation, revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY nation ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, n_name AS nation, o_orderdate FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ON l_partkey = ps_partkey AND s_suppkey = ps_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n_name, o_orderdate) as TotalRevenue) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY nation, revenue DESC;

SELECT tp.o_orderkey, tp.o_orderdate, tp.c_name, tp.o_totalprice, sp.ps_partkey, sp.total_available_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rnk <= 10) tp JOIN lineitem l ON tp.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' ORDER BY tp.o_orderdate DESC, tp.o_totalprice ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tc.c_name AS TopCustomer, ts.s_name AS TopSupplier, tc.TotalSpent, ts.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT cust.c_custkey, cust.c_name, cust.OrderCount, cust.TotalSpent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cust ORDER BY cust.TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10) tc CROSS JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sa.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa JOIN supplier s ON sa.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sa.TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) ts WHERE tc.TotalSpent > 10000 AND ts.TotalSupplyCost > 50000 ORDER BY tc.TotalSpent DESC, ts.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT COALESCE(c.nation_name, 'Unknown') AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(co.total_quantity) AS total_items_sold, AVG(co.total_extended_price) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.p_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) co LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, c.c_comment FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) c ON co.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_comment FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal < 5000) sp ON sp.s_suppkey = (SELECT MIN(s_suppkey) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_comment FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal < 5000) as SupplierPartInfo) GROUP BY c.nation_name ORDER BY total_items_sold DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tn.nation_name, tn.total_sales, r.r_comment FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) as NationSales) tn JOIN nation n ON tn.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tn.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tn.total_sales DESC;

SELECT sr.s_name, sr.o_orderstatus, sr.revenue FROM (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, od.o_orderstatus, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#1' AND ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) od ON sp.p_partkey = (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey LIMIT 1) GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, od.o_orderstatus) sr WHERE sr.revenue > 10000 ORDER BY sr.revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.aggregate_cost FROM (SELECT sr.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(sr.total_cost) AS aggregate_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sr.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(sr.total_cost) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey) sr JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey GROUP BY sr.p_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.aggregate_cost DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.total_revenue, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.num_parts, s.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS num_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON s.total_supply_cost > 100000 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, s.num_parts DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(*) AS supplier_count, AVG(rs.total_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, SUM(ro.total_price) AS total_recent_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON s.s_suppkey = ro.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_supplycost DESC;

SELECT rr.nation_name, rr.revenue, ar.avg_revenue, CASE WHEN rr.revenue > ar.avg_revenue THEN 'Above Average' ELSE 'Below Average' END AS revenue_comparison FROM (SELECT nation_name, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, n_name AS nation_name FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey GROUP BY n_name) as TotalRevenue) rr JOIN (SELECT AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS revenue, n_name AS nation_name FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON lineitem.l_orderkey = orders.o_orderkey JOIN customer ON orders.o_custkey = customer.c_custkey JOIN supplier ON lineitem.l_suppkey = supplier.s_suppkey JOIN nation ON supplier.s_nationkey = nation.n_nationkey GROUP BY n_name) as TotalRevenue) ar ON 1=1 WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rr.revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue, c.c_address, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT ts.c_custkey, ts.c_name, ts.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ts) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) tc JOIN orders o ON tc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON tc.c_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue, c.c_address, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rv.nation, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.p_partkey) AS high_value_part_count, SUM(rv.total_supply_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rv JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_price FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000) hp ON rv.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = hp.p_partkey) WHERE rv.rnk <= 5 GROUP BY rv.nation ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT t.s_name AS SupplierName, h.c_name AS CustomerName, h.o_orderkey AS OrderKey, h.o_totalprice AS TotalPrice, h.o_orderdate AS OrderDate, l.Revenue AS RevenueGenerated FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY TotalCost DESC LIMIT 10) t JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 1000) h ON TRUE JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON h.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE h.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND t.TotalCost > 10000 ORDER BY t.TotalCost DESC, l.Revenue DESC;

SELECT t.customer_name, t.nation_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount FROM (SELECT customer_name, nation_name, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01') WHERE order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.customer_name, t.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND r.r_name IN ('ASIA', 'EUROPE') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hcs.s_name, hcs.nation_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.line_item_count, os.total_order_value FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) hcs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON hcs.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey ORDER BY hcs.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT tsi.s_suppkey, tsi.s_name, tsi.orders_count, si.region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(od.o_orderkey) > 10) tsi JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) si ON tsi.s_suppkey = si.s_suppkey ORDER BY tsi.orders_count DESC, si.region_name ASC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, avg_spent FROM (SELECT region_name, nation_name, AVG(total_spent) AS avg_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, cu.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') o JOIN customer cu ON o.o_orderkey = cu.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON cu.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, cu.c_name) GROUP BY region_name, nation_name) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name;

SELECT nation_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueData) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT si.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ao.o_orderkey) AS active_order_count, SUM(lis.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(si.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier)) si JOIN partsupp ps ON si.s_name = ps.ps_comment JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lis ON ps.ps_partkey = lis.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ao ON lis.l_orderkey = ao.o_orderkey GROUP BY si.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, active_order_count DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, r.r_regionkey) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT tr.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(os.total_sales) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC LIMIT 5) tr JOIN nation n ON tr.n_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON n.n_nationkey = os.o_orderkey -- corrected join clause JOIN RankedSuppliers rs ON rs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 ) GROUP BY tr.r_name) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT coi.c_name AS customer_name, coi.c_acctbal AS account_balance, coi.o_orderdate AS order_date, coi.revenue AS total_revenue, coi.revenue_rank AS rank_within_date FROM (SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue, ro.revenue_rank FROM Customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) coi WHERE coi.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY coi.o_orderdate, coi.revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.high_balance_suppliers, pp.p_name, pp.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.s_acctbal > 1000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_balance_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs CROSS JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) pp ORDER BY rs.region_name, pp.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ro.order_rank <= 10 JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON ts.total_supply_cost > 10000 WHERE cs.total_spent > 5000 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(tr.revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT tr.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, MIN(tr.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(tr.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rev_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE rev_rank <= 10) tr JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = tr.o_orderkey) GROUP BY c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tn.n_name, tn.region_name, tn.total_cost FROM (SELECT nd.n_name, nd.region_name, nd.total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nd.region_name ORDER BY nd.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(sd.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN nation n ON sd.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name) nd) tn WHERE tn.rank <= 3 ORDER BY tn.region_name, tn.total_cost DESC;

SELECT sr.s_suppkey, sr.s_name, sr.total_supply_cost, sr.total_parts, os.c_custkey, os.c_name, os.total_order_value, os.total_orders, rr.r_regionkey, rr.r_name, rr.total_nations, rr.total_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) os ON sr.total_parts > 5 AND os.total_orders > 10 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rr ON sr.total_available_qty > 1000 AND rr.total_nations > 3 ORDER BY sr.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_value AS supplier_total_value, cs.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, cs.customer_count, cs.total_revenue, cs.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(total_cost) AS total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, (ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON cs.c_mktsegment IN ('BUILDING', 'FURNITURE', 'HOUSEHOLD') ORDER BY ts.total_value DESC, cs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_name, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, OLD.revenue, NS.n_name AS supplier_nation FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem li JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') ro ON li.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE li.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) OLD ON ro.o_orderkey = OLD.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps_suppkey FROM (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) as TopSuppliers) JOIN nation NS ON NS.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT t_s.s_name AS supplier_name, t_c.c_name AS customer_name, t_s.total_supply_cost, t_c.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) t_s JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) t_c ON t_s.s_suppkey = t_c.c_custkey WHERE t_s.supplier_rank <= 10 AND t_c.customer_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t_s.total_supply_cost DESC, t_c.total_spent DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey AS order_key, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT top.s_name AS supplier_name, cust.c_name AS customer_name, cust.total_orders, top.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) top JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cust ON cust.total_orders > 10000 ORDER BY top.total_supply_value DESC, cust.total_orders DESC;

SELECT r.supplier_name, r.total_revenue, r.order_count, r.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT supplier_name, total_revenue, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name) as SupplierOrders) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.region_total, r.region_total / (SELECT SUM(total_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) as RankedSuppliers) * 100 AS percentage_of_total FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rs.total_value) AS region_total FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.region_total DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.customer_revenue, n.n_name AS customer_nation, r.r_name AS customer_region FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN nation n ON tc.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY tc.customer_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.region_name, ts.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ss.total_sales = (SELECT MAX(total_sales) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierSales)) ts ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, rs.r_name, ss.TotalSupplyCost, os.TotalRevenue, os.TotalLineItems, rs.TotalNations, rs.TotalSupplierBalance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS TotalPartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS TotalLineItems FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ss.s_suppkey = os.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS TotalNations, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS TotalSupplierBalance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs ON ss.s_name = rs.r_name ORDER BY ss.TotalSupplyCost DESC, os.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT ts.Region, ts.Supplier, ts.TotalCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, s.s_name AS Supplier, s.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.Rank <= 5) ts ORDER BY ts.Region, ts.TotalCost DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_nation_sales, AVG(ts.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ns.n_name ORDER BY total_nation_sales DESC;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, customer_count, total_revenue, total_quantity, total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) ORDER BY region_name, revenue_rank;

SELECT cb.c_custkey, cb.c_name, cb.o_orderkey, cb.o_orderdate, cb.o_totalprice, s.r_name AS supplier_region, cb.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, c.c_mktsegment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sd.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rnk <= 10) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd ON s.s_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey) cb JOIN nation n ON cb.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region s ON n.n_regionkey = s.r_regionkey WHERE cb.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY cb.o_totalprice DESC, cb.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT RegionName, TopSupplierCount, TotalCostInRegion FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, COUNT(rs.s_suppkey) AS TopSupplierCount, SUM(rs.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalCostInRegion FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.s_nationkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY TotalCostInRegion DESC;

SELECT sd.region_name, sd.nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, MAX(sd.total_supply_cost) AS highest_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) sd JOIN orders o ON sd.s_name = o.o_clerk GROUP BY sd.region_name, sd.nation_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, highest_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rc.c_name, rc.order_count, hvp.p_name, hvp.total_value, lia.avg_quantity FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(o.o_orderkey) DESC) AS rank_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) rc JOIN orders o ON rc.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS value_after_discount, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 500) lia ON o.o_orderkey = lia.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvp ON lia.l_partkey = hvp.p_partkey WHERE rc.rank_count <= 10 ORDER BY rc.order_count DESC, hvp.total_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(rb.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, SUM(la.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN lineitem l ON sd.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) la ON l.l_orderkey = la.l_orderkey GROUP BY sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name) rb JOIN nation n ON rb.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;
