SELECT revenue_rank, revenue, s_name, customer_name, c_acctbal, nation_name FROM (SELECT rs.revenue_rank, rs.revenue, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT ts.p_partkey, ts.revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ts) rs JOIN lineitem li ON rs.p_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON li.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10) ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT rc.region_name, rc.total_sales, rc.segment_sales, (rc.total_sales - rc.segment_sales) AS variance FROM (SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, COALESCE(cs.segment_sales, 0) AS segment_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs FULL OUTER JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS segment_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON rs.region_name = cs.c_mktsegment) rc ORDER BY rc.total_sales DESC, rc.segment_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.regional_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ns.nation_sales) AS regional_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ss.total_sales) AS nation_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON ns.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r ORDER BY r.regional_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, total_orders, cost_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, nation_name, supplier_name, total_supply_cost, total_orders, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * li.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON li.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name) as RegionalSupplierSales) WHERE cost_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, cost_rank;

SELECT fs.c_name AS customer_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(fli.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fli.l_orderkey) AS total_orders, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(fli.l_extendedprice) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) fs JOIN orders o ON fs.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N') fli ON o.o_orderkey = fli.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON fli.l_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 10 GROUP BY fs.c_name, rs.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.revenue, tn.n_name, tn.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS nation_rank FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) tn ON tn.nation_rank <= 5 WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.revenue DESC, tn.total_cost ASC;

SELECT so.o_orderkey, so.o_orderdate, so.o_totalprice, so.o_orderpriority, so.c_mktsegment, od.revenue, od.total_line_items FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 10) so JOIN (SELECT so.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS total_line_items FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 10) so JOIN lineitem l ON so.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY so.o_orderkey) od ON so.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey ORDER BY so.o_orderdate DESC, od.revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_name AS CustomerName, co.o_orderkey AS OrderID, co.o_totalprice AS TotalPrice, ts.s_name AS SupplierName, ts.s_acctbal AS SupplierAccountBalance FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s WHERE s.rn = 1) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE co.o_orderstatus = 'O' ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, ts.s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_available, sr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_available DESC LIMIT 5) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr ON ts.s_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE sr.total_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hvc.c_name, hvc.c_address, hvc.total_spent, tcp.p_name, tcp.total_cost, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, c.c_phone, cv.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cv JOIN customer c ON cv.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE cv.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) as CustomerOrders)) hvc JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) WHERE p_brand LIKE 'Brand#%') tcp ON hvc.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) WHERE p_brand LIKE 'Brand#%') as TopCostlyParts) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone) sd ON sd.total_supply_value > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone) as SupplierDetails) WHERE tcp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY hvc.total_spent DESC, tcp.total_cost DESC, sd.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT ts.sales_rank, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.total_orders, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_acctbal AS customer_acctbal FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sl.total_sales, sl.total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sl.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sl JOIN supplier s ON sl.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN orders o ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey)) JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.sales_rank;

SELECT tp.r_name AS region, SUM(tp.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ro.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10) tp GROUP BY tp.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT si.s_name, si.nation_name, si.region_name, pp.ps_partkey, pp.total_avail_qty, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.customer_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) si JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) pp ON si.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = pp.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN lineitem li ON pp.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 MONTH') ro ON li.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE li.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'MAIL') ORDER BY si.region_name, pp.total_avail_qty DESC, ro.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_supplycost, t.unique_parts, t.recent_quantity FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supplycost, ss.unique_parts, ss.recent_quantity, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.l_shipdate >= cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year' THEN l.l_quantity ELSE 0 END) AS recent_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) t WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, sc.supplier_name, sc.supplier_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) sc ON rs.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey WHERE n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = 'CustomerName')) ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, sc.supplier_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT td.o_orderkey, td.o_orderdate, td.total_revenue, cd.c_name, n.n_name AS customer_nation, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) td JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, CAST(SUBSTR(c.c_address, 1, POSITION(',' IN c.c_address) - 1) AS INTEGER) AS address_num FROM customer c) cd ON cd.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = td.o_orderkey) JOIN nation n ON cd.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY td.total_revenue DESC, td.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT tso.o_orderkey, tso.o_orderdate, tso.o_totalprice, tso.c_name, tsod.total_quantity, tsod.total_sales, psd.p_name, psd.p_brand, psd.total_available, psd.total_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.rank <= 5) tso JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey) tsod ON tso.o_orderkey = tsod.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) psd ON tsod.l_partkey = psd.ps_partkey WHERE tso.o_totalprice > 1000 ORDER BY tso.o_orderdate DESC, tso.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS associated_revenue, SUM(r.supplier_revenue) AS supplier_total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) s LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey AS orderkey, o.o_orderdate AS orderdate, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) o WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10) t ON t.orderkey = t.orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) r ON s.s_suppkey = r.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal ORDER BY associated_revenue DESC, supplier_total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT region_name, c_custkey, c_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, r.r_name) as Revenue) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT O.o_orderkey, O.o_orderdate, O.total_revenue, O.unique_suppliers, S.supplier_costs, S.supplied_parts, O.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, C.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer C ON o.o_custkey = C.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, C.c_mktsegment) O JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_costs, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS supplied_parts FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) S ON O.unique_suppliers = S.supplied_parts WHERE O.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, C.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer C ON o.o_custkey = C.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, C.c_mktsegment) as OrderSummary) ORDER BY O.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT fs.s_name, fs.nation_name, pr.p_name, pr.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.s_suppkey, r.s_name, r.nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.rank <= 5) fs JOIN partsupp ps ON fs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, COALESCE(ts.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM part p LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey) pr ON ps.ps_partkey = pr.p_partkey WHERE pr.total_revenue > 0 ORDER BY fs.nation_name, pr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT t.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ro.unique_customers, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) t GROUP BY t.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.TotalSales, t.OrderCount, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.TotalSales, ss.OrderCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.TotalSales DESC) AS SalesRank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) t ON s.s_suppkey = t.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') ro ON t.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey AND t.OrderCount > 5 WHERE t.SalesRank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, t.TotalSales DESC;

SELECT sd.p_partkey, sd.p_name, sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.ps_availqty, sd.ps_supplycost, rd.region_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, (ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, n.n_regionkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) cr ON r.r_regionkey = cr.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, o.o_orderstatus FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) os ON cr.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rd ON sd.s_suppkey = rd.r_regionkey WHERE sd.total_value > 10000 ORDER BY rd.region_revenue DESC, sd.ps_supplycost ASC;

SELECT r.region_name, r.nation_name, r.total_f_revenue, r.total_orders, a.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_f_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) r JOIN (SELECT r.region_name, AVG(total_f_revenue / NULLIF(total_orders, 0)) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_f_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) r GROUP BY r.region_name) a ON r.region_name = a.region_name ORDER BY r.total_f_revenue DESC, a.avg_order_value DESC;

SELECT J.r_name, J.n_name, J.c_name, J.revenue, R.rn FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, o.o_orderkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) J JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-12-31') R ON R.o_orderkey = J.o_orderkey ORDER BY J.revenue DESC, R.rn ASC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) tr JOIN orders o ON tr.total_sales = (SELECT SUM(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2 JOIN lineitem l2 ON o2.o_orderkey = l2.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps2 ON l2.l_partkey = ps2.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s2 ON ps2.ps_suppkey = s2.s_suppkey JOIN nation n2 ON s2.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey WHERE n2.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = tr.region_name)) JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.sales_rank HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 1000000 ORDER BY tr.sales_rank;

SELECT cs.c_name AS "Customer Name", cs.order_total AS "Total Order Amount", ss.s_name AS "Supplier Name", ss.total_sales AS "Supplier Total Sales", r.r_name AS "Region" FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) cs JOIN nation n ON cs.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.total_sales > 500000 ORDER BY cs.order_total DESC, ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.s_name AS Supplier_Name, rs.total_supply_cost, rc.c_name AS Customer_Name, rc.total_spent FROM (SELECT ss.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank_by_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) ss) rs INNER JOIN (SELECT co.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank_by_spending FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) rc ON rs.total_parts > 5 AND rc.total_orders > 5 WHERE rs.rank_by_cost <= 10 AND rc.rank_by_spending <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC, rc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.total_quantity, sr.nation_name, sr.region_name, sr.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus) o JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_suppkey) sr ON o.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = sr.nation_name)) ) WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY o.o_orderkey;

SELECT n.n_name, n.supplier_count, n.total_supply_cost, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_per_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey WHERE ts.rank_per_nation <= 3 GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) n JOIN orders o ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) GROUP BY n.n_name, n.supplier_count, n.total_supply_cost ORDER BY n.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT od.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, AVG(od.total_revenue) AS avg_order_revenue, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_per_region, MAX(rs.total_supply_cost) AS max_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON rs.s_nationkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY r.r_name ASC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, cs.c_name AS customer_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey)) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ro.o_orderkey = cs.total_orders WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT sd.s_name, nr.r_name, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, ls.total_price_after_discount, ls.avg_quantity, ls.item_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sd JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price_after_discount, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON sd.s_suppkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON ls.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON sd.s_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey WHERE sd.ps_supplycost < 100.00 ORDER BY ls.total_price_after_discount DESC, co.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE total_supply_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RankedSuppliers )) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_address, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.c_mktsegment, tl.total_revenue, tl.line_count, spi.total_availqty, spi.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rank_date, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) tl ON ro.o_orderkey = tl.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) spi ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#12' ) ) WHERE ro.rank_price <= 10 AND ro.rank_date <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rc.region_name, rc.high_cost_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') AS confirmed_orders FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS high_cost_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) s JOIN nation n ON s.nation = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name) rc ORDER BY rc.region_name;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_orders, t.total_revenue, t.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, so.total_orders, so.total_revenue, so.avg_order_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY so.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) t WHERE t.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, r.r_name, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, ro.order_count, ro.total_revenue, rs.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o_custkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o_custkey) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, s_nationkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_suppkey, s_name, s_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.s_nationkey AND rs.rank = 1 WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC NULLS LAST, rs.total_supply_cost DESC NULLS LAST;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rc.order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT hvc.c_custkey) AS high_value_customers_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey) rc ON r.r_regionkey = rc.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) as total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders)) hvc ON hvc.total_spent > 10000 LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON rs.rnk <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, rc.order_count ORDER BY rc.order_count DESC, total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT prs.p_partkey, prs.p_name, prs.p_brand, prs.total_available_qty, prs.total_supply_cost, prs.avg_supply_cost, cos.c_custkey, cos.c_name, cos.total_orders, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value, nrs.r_regionkey, nrs.r_name, nrs.total_nations, nrs.total_suppliers FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) prs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON prs.total_supply_cost > 1000 JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) nrs ON nrs.total_nations > 5 WHERE prs.total_available_qty > 500 ORDER BY prs.total_supply_cost DESC, cos.total_spent DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) s WHERE s.supplier_rank <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(rs.total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation r ON rs.s_nationkey = r.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro ON ro.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = r.n_nationkey) WHERE rs.rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.c_acctbal, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_retailprice, ps.total_avail_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_orderkey;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(RO.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_per_region FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) RO JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_name = RO.c_name LIMIT 1) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE RO.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_per_region DESC;

SELECT nation_name, s_name, high_value_order_count, total_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT ss.nation_name, ss.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.o_orderstatus, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate) os WHERE os.total_revenue > 10000) hvo ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) GROUP BY ss.nation_name, ss.s_name) ORDER BY total_supply_cost_per_supplier DESC, high_value_order_count DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, order_count FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_sales, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT r_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) r JOIN customer c ON r.sales_rank <= 10 AND c.c_nationkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) ) ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT sn.nation_name, ps.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'USA' UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'USA' UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name FROM supplier_nation sn JOIN supplier s ON sn.s_suppkey <> s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE sn.nation_name <> n.n_name) sn JOIN supplier s ON sn.s_suppkey <> s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE sn.nation_name <> n.n_name) sn JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) ps ON sn.s_suppkey = ps.p_partkey GROUP BY sn.nation_name, ps.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 100 ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS cust_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rank <= 3) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, ts.s_name ORDER BY cust_rank, revenue DESC;

SELECT rn.n_name AS Nation, ss.s_name AS Supplier, ss.total_supplycost AS TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(ro.revenue) > 1000000) rn JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC) ss ON rn.total_revenue > 500000 ORDER BY rn.total_revenue DESC, ss.total_supplycost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.nation, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT nation, total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' + INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY n.n_name) as Revenue) r WHERE r.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name, cs.c_name AS top_customer, cs.total_spent, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON rs.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > 50000 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_supply_value DESC, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as region_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, ts.part_count, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sp.total_cost, sp.part_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY sp.total_cost DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 20 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = (SELECT MIN(o.o_custkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = (SELECT MIN(l.l_orderkey) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_discount > 0.05))) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rn <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT n_name, COUNT(s_name) AS number_of_suppliers, SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(avg_order_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order, SUM(total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s_name, n_name, total_orders, total_revenue, avg_order_quantity, total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_order_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) as SupplierOrderStats) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, s_name, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) ORDER BY region_name, nation_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.customer_count, ns.total_supplier_balance, rs.total_revenue_year FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_year FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT DISTINCT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey)) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ON ns.n_name = 'Australia' ORDER BY ns.customer_count DESC, rs.total_revenue_year DESC;

SELECT tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.c_custkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') JOIN region r ON s.s_nationkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY tc.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND s.s_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, order_count, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS overall_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY overall_rank;

SELECT rc.s_name, rc.total_cost, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rc JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON rc.total_cost > tc.total_spent ORDER BY rc.total_cost DESC, tc.total_spent DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT cr.c_name, cr.total_spent, sr.r_name, sr.region_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cr JOIN (SELECT ns.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ts.total_supply_value) AS region_supply_value FROM (SELECT rs.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_supply_value DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs) ts JOIN nation ns ON ts.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY ns.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) sr ON cr.c_nationkey = sr.n_nationkey WHERE cr.order_count > 10 ORDER BY cr.total_spent DESC, sr.region_supply_value ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_acctbal, ps.p_name, ps.supplier_count, ps.avg_supplycost, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, lid.total_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) ps ON ns.n_name = SUBSTRING(ps.p_name FROM 1 FOR 25) JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_name) co ON co.order_count > 10 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lid ON lid.total_value > 1000 ORDER BY ns.total_acctbal DESC, co.total_spent DESC, ps.avg_supplycost ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, hvc.c_name AS customer_name, kp.p_name AS part_name, kp.total_quantity_sold, rs.total_supply_value, hvc.total_spent FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 5000) hvc ON hvc.total_spent > 5000 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) kp ON kp.total_quantity_sold > 1000 WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, rs.total_supply_value DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_sales, r.order_count, r.sales_rank FROM (SELECT r_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tos.region_name, tos.s_name, cos.c_name, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) tos JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON tos.total_cost < cos.total_spent ORDER BY tos.region_name, tos.total_cost DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.total_sales, os.o_orderdate, os.o_orderstatus, os.o_clerk, os.o_shippriority, ts.s_name AS top_supplier FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_clerk, o.o_shippriority) os JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS supplier_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_comment FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY supplier_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON os.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND os.o_shippriority >= 1 WHERE os.total_sales > 50000 ORDER BY os.total_sales DESC;

SELECT nrs.region_name, nrs.nation_name, nrs.total_suppliers, nrs.region_total_available_qty, nrs.region_total_supply_cost, CASE WHEN nrs.region_total_supply_cost > 1000000 THEN 'High Supply Cost' WHEN nrs.region_total_supply_cost BETWEEN 500000 AND 1000000 THEN 'Medium Supply Cost' ELSE 'Low Supply Cost' END AS supply_cost_category FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ps.total_available_qty) AS region_total_available_qty, SUM(ps.total_supply_cost) AS region_total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ps ON n.n_nationkey = ps.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) nrs WHERE nrs.total_suppliers > 10 ORDER BY nrs.region_total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales, ps.p_name, ps.supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) ps ON ps.supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(supply_cost) FROM (SELECT p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) as PartSuppliers) ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, ps.supply_cost ASC;

SELECT r.sales_rank, r.n_name, r.total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name, ns.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ns.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > ( SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM ( SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS avg_sales )) ns JOIN nation n ON ns.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r WHERE r.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.sales_rank;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ls.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem lo WHERE lo.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND lo.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) ls ON co.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ls.total_revenue > 0 GROUP BY c.c_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.s_acctbal, t.part_count, t.total_supply_cost, os.total_order_value, os.total_orders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.part_count, s.total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s) t JOIN customer c ON t.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC, os.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, ao.o_orderkey, ao.NetRevenue, ao.LineItemCount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 30 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS NetRevenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS LineItemCount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate) ao ON rs.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type = 'Metal' ) WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, ao.NetRevenue DESC;

SELECT tsp.p_partkey, tsp.p_name, tsp.total_revenue, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT p_partkey, p_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) WHERE revenue_rank <= 10) tsp JOIN partsupp ps ON tsp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ORDER BY tsp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation, COUNT(s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, MAX(total_supply_cost) AS highest_supply_cost, MIN(total_supply_cost) AS lowest_supply_cost, AVG(total_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode = 'AIR' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE rank <= 10 GROUP BY nation ORDER BY nation;

SELECT psi.p_partkey, psi.p_name, psi.supplier_name, oi.total_revenue, cr.customer_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY cr.c_custkey ORDER BY cr.customer_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) psi JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) oi ON psi.p_partkey = oi.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(oi.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) oi ON c.c_custkey = oi.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON oi.o_custkey = cr.c_custkey WHERE psi.ps_supplycost < 50 ORDER BY cr.customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT tm.order_month, cd.c_name, cd.total_spent, tm.order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cd JOIN (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate) AS order_month, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) WHERE rank <= 5 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate)) tm ON cd.c_custkey IN (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', o.o_orderdate) = tm.order_month) ORDER BY tm.order_month, cd.total_spent DESC;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(total_supply_value) AS total_value_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_name;
