SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderpriority, s.TotalSuppliedParts, s.TotalSupplyCost, l.TotalSales, l.TotalQuantity, l.TotalTax FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS TotalSuppliedParts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) s ON r.o_orderkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity, SUM(l.l_tax) AS TotalTax FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT tr.s_name AS supplier_name, cr.c_name AS customer_name, cr.order_count, cr.total_spent, tr.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, rs.total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_value DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_value > 1000000) tr JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON tr.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 100 OR p.p_size >= 10) ) ORDER BY tr.total_value DESC, cr.total_spent DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT sr.NationName, sr.RegionName, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS UniqueCustomers, AVG(co.TotalSpent) AS AvgCustomerSpent, SUM(sr.TotalSupplyValue) AS TotalSupplyValueForRegion FROM (SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, nr.n_name AS NationName, nr.r_name AS RegionName, sd.TotalSupplyValue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyValue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal) sd JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON sd.s_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey) sr JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON sr.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F')) GROUP BY sr.NationName, sr.RegionName ORDER BY TotalSupplyValueForRegion DESC, UniqueCustomers DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(co.order_count) AS total_orders, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue, SUM(ss.total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co ON c.c_custkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 20 ) GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.n_name, ts.total_supply_cost, ts.part_count FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, n.n_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ss.part_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS cost_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ss.part_count > 5) ts WHERE ts.cost_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, sr.supplier_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sr.supplier_revenue DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 20) tr ON l.l_orderkey = tr.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY supplier_rank;

SELECT t_sup.s_name AS supplier_name, t_cust.c_name AS customer_name, t_sup.total_sales AS supplier_sales, t_cust.total_spent AS customer_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC LIMIT 5) t_sup CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN customer c ON cs.c_custkey = c.c_custkey ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC LIMIT 5) t_cust ORDER BY t_sup.total_sales DESC, t_cust.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.region_name, ns.total_suppliers, ns.total_account_balance, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ss.total_suppliers, ss.total_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey) ns LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON ns.n_nationkey = os.o_custkey WHERE ns.total_suppliers > 5 AND os.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY ns.total_account_balance DESC, os.total_orders DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cs.c_name AS customer_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(oli.l_extendedprice * (1 - oli.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT oli.l_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax, l.l_shipdate FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) oli JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON oli.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = ts.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON c.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey) cs ON oli.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = cs.c_custkey) JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY nation_count DESC LIMIT 5) r ON cs.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) GROUP BY cs.c_name, ts.s_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(oli.l_extendedprice * (1 - oli.l_discount)) > 50000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.region_name, t.total_revenue, r.rank_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) t JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r ON t.total_revenue = r.revenue WHERE r.rank_revenue <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, t.nation_name, t.region_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, count(DISTINCT h.c_custkey) AS high_spending_cust_count, SUM(s.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_in_region, AVG(h.order_count) as avg_orders_per_customer FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_regionkey) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 50)) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT cust.c_custkey, cust.c_name, cust.total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) as order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cust JOIN orders o ON cust.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY cust.c_custkey, cust.c_name, cust.total_spent HAVING cust.total_spent > 1000) h ON n.n_nationkey = h.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost_in_region DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, fs.s_name, co.c_name, tr.r_name, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_container, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) as price_rank FROM part p) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) as part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) > 10) fs ON rp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = fs.s_suppkey ) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) as order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) as total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 5) co ON co.c_nationkey = fs.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) as customer_count FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 3) tr ON tr.n_regionkey = co.c_nationkey WHERE rp.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, rp.p_retailprice ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN ro.o_totalprice > 1000 THEN ro.o_totalprice ELSE 0 END) AS high_value_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count, SUM(s.total_available_qty) AS total_available_parts, AVG(s.avg_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost, SUM(ls.line_count) AS total_lines_in_orders, SUM(ls.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.o_orderkey % 25 = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON ro.o_orderkey % 10 = s.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY high_value_order_value DESC, total_available_parts DESC;

SELECT rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalSupplyCost, hvc.c_name AS HighValueCustomerName, hvc.OrderCount FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) hvc ON hvc.OrderCount > 5 WHERE rs.rnk <= 5 ORDER BY rs.TotalSupplyCost DESC, hvc.OrderCount DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, c.total_spent, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(r.total_revenue) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) r ON o.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c JOIN nation n ON c.c_custkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, tn.n_name, tn.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) tn ON TN.Cost_Rank <= 5 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, tn.total_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.r_name, ts.n_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, r.r_regionkey, n.n_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts WHERE ts.rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.r_regionkey, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT cs.region_name, cs.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS total_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(ss.average_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON cs.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON os.o_orderkey % ss.s_suppkey = 0 GROUP BY cs.region_name, cs.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name AS Top_Supplier, ts.total_cost AS Supplier_Cost, tc.c_name AS Top_Customer, tc.total_orders AS Customer_Orders FROM (SELECT s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, co.total_orders FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_name = c.c_name ORDER BY co.total_orders DESC LIMIT 10) tc WHERE ts.total_cost > 100000 ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC, tc.total_orders DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT region, revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(rd.l_extendedprice * (1 - rd.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT oo.o_orderkey, oo.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, p.p_name, p.p_brand, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) oo JOIN lineitem l ON oo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE oo.OrderRank = 1) rd JOIN nation n ON rd.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sos.NumberOfOrders, sos.TotalRevenueFromOrders FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS NumberOfOrders, SUM(od.TotalRevenue) AS TotalRevenueFromOrders FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) > 5) s WHERE s.Rank <= 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS TotalQuantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name) sos JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) > 5) s WHERE s.Rank <= 10) s ON sos.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sos.TotalRevenueFromOrders > 50000 ORDER BY sos.TotalRevenueFromOrders DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_orders, total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_spent DESC) AS spending_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ORDER BY spending_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_price_per_item, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE 'BRASS%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ps.p_name, ps.supplier_name, COUNT(co.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(co.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) ps LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 500.00 AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') co ON ps.p_partkey = co.o_orderkey GROUP BY ps.p_partkey, ps.p_name, ps.supplier_name HAVING COUNT(co.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, ps.p_name ASC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.total_revenue, t.unique_suppliers, CASE WHEN t.total_revenue > 100000 THEN 'High Revenue' WHEN t.total_revenue BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium Revenue' ELSE 'Low Revenue' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE r.rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue) t ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_name, hvo.nation_name, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(li.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, SUM(li.l_discount) AS total_discount FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01') ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10) hvo JOIN lineitem li ON hvo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.c_name, hvo.nation_name ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(RankedOrders.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, SUM(RankedOrders.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) JOIN customer c ON RankedOrders.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE RankedOrders.rank <= 5 GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY num_orders DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, np.n_name AS nation, rp.p_name AS part_name, rp.total_supply_cost, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation np ON s.s_nationkey = np.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON np.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.c_custkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rp.rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.r_name, np.n_name, rp.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_lineitem_value, MAX(s.s_acctbal) AS max_supplier_balance, MIN(s.s_acctbal) AS min_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.level < 5) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 AND sh.level < 5) sh JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC, total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, sc.order_count, SUM(sc.total_revenue) AS total_contribution FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, oss.total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) as rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) oss ON rs.s_suppkey = oss.o_orderkey GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey, oss.total_revenue) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, sc.order_count HAVING SUM(sc.total_revenue) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_contribution DESC;

SELECT nation, COUNT(*) AS number_of_orders, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.total_revenue, n.n_name AS nation, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderpriority) r JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = (SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderkey = r.o_orderkey) JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = r.o_orderkey LIMIT 1)) JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) GROUP BY nation ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT ns.n_name, rt.s_name, rt.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rt JOIN nation ns ON rt.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE rt.rank <= 5) ts JOIN nation ns ON ts.n_name = ns.n_name JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' ORDER BY ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT rod.c_name, COUNT(rod.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(rod.net_price) AS total_revenue, AVG(rod.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, MIN(rod.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(rod.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_name, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, li.l_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, li.l_quantity, (li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS net_price FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN part p ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ro.rn = 1) rod WHERE rod.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY rod.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS high_value_order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier WHERE s_acctbal IS NOT NULL)) sd JOIN partsupp ps ON sd.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_custkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice) od WHERE od.total_amount > 1000) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY sd.s_name, sd.nation_name ORDER BY high_value_order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.nation_name, tc.c_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, SUM(sd.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT rank, nation_name, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') WHERE rank <= 5) tc JOIN lineitem l ON tc.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd ON l.l_partkey = sd.ps_partkey GROUP BY tc.nation_name, tc.c_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice ORDER BY tc.nation_name, total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ns.nation_name, ns.total_acct_balance, ns.customer_count, ps.part_name, ps.total_available_qty, ps.avg_retail_price, os.order_status, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acct_balance, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns CROSS JOIN (SELECT p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(p.p_retailprice) AS avg_retail_price FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_name) ps CROSS JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderstatus AS order_status, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus) os WHERE ns.total_acct_balance > 10000.00 ORDER BY ns.total_acct_balance DESC, ps.avg_retail_price DESC, os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT nr.r_regionkey, SUM(od.total_price) AS total_order_value, SUM(sc.total_cost) AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON nr.n_nationkey = sc.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) od ON nr.n_nationkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY nr.r_regionkey ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, total_supplier_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, r.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(tr.Revenue) AS TotalRevenue, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS AvgOrderValue, MAX(ro.o_orderdate) AS LatestOrderDate FROM (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) tr JOIN orders ro ON tr.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tr.Revenue > 1000 GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, MAX(s.s_acctbal) AS max_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) asd ON l.l_partkey = asd.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = asd.ps_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND asd.total_avail_qty > 100 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_discount) > 0.1 * SUM(l.l_extendedprice) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT f.o_orderkey, f.o_orderdate, f.o_totalprice, f.o_orderstatus, f.c_name, f.nation_name, f.total_revenue, f.total_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_name, ro.nation_name, COALESCE(ls.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(ls.total_quantity, 0) AS total_quantity FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5) ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT lo.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem li JOIN orders lo ON li.l_orderkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY lo.o_orderkey) ls ON ro.o_orderkey = ls.o_orderkey) f ORDER BY f.o_orderdate DESC, f.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.region, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.cost_rank <= 3) ts GROUP BY ts.region ORDER BY top_supplier_count DESC, average_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales, order_count, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT qs.o_orderkey, qs.c_name, SUM(qs.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, COUNT(DISTINCT qs.l_linenumber) AS unique_line_items, AVG(qs.max_part_cost) AS average_max_part_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, l.l_linenumber, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, MAX(m.max_cost) AS max_part_cost FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, r.r_name AS region_name, MAX(t.total_cost) AS max_cost FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) t ON p.p_partkey = t.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey LIMIT 1) JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, r.r_name) m ON l.l_partkey = m.p_partkey WHERE l.l_quantity > 50 AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, l.l_linenumber, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice) qs GROUP BY qs.o_orderkey, qs.c_name ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.region, rv.total_value, pp.order_count FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000000) rv ON p.p_partkey = rv.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rs ON rs.rank_in_region = 1 JOIN (SELECT li.l_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM lineitem li GROUP BY li.l_partkey ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10) pp ON pp.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 500 ORDER BY rv.total_value DESC, pp.order_count DESC;

SELECT ns.n_name, pd.p_name, pd.total_sales, ns.total_supply_cost, pd.min_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_supplycost AS min_supply_cost, (SELECT SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' AND l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey) AS total_sales FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) pd ON ns.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_partkey = pd.p_partkey FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY) WHERE pd.total_sales IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ns.total_supply_cost DESC, pd.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(so.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT hs.s_suppkey, hs.s_name, os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.avg_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(avg_supplycost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) as RankedSuppliers)) hs JOIN lineitem l ON hs.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) so JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) s WHERE s.avg_supplycost < (SELECT AVG(avg_supplycost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) as RankedSuppliers)) s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, spc.part_count FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spc ON s.s_suppkey = spc.s_suppkey WHERE spc.part_count > 5 ORDER BY spc.part_count DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, coc.order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) coc ON c.c_custkey = coc.c_custkey WHERE coc.order_count > 3 ORDER BY coc.order_count DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, rn.region_total_value FROM region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, SUM(spv.total_value) AS region_total_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spv ON s.s_suppkey = spv.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey) rn ON r.r_regionkey = rn.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, rn.region_total_value ORDER BY rn.region_total_value DESC, nation_count DESC;

SELECT sc.nation_name, sc.region_name, sc.supplier_name, sc.part_name, sc.total_available, sc.total_supply_cost, od.customer_name, od.order_count, od.total_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE r.r_name LIKE 'Europe%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_name, p.p_name) sc JOIN (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON sc.nation_name = 'Germany' AND sc.total_supply_cost > 50000 ORDER BY sc.region_name, od.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.supplier_count, ns.total_supply_cost_per_nation, os.line_item_count, os.total_order_value, os.o_orderstatus FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost_per_nation FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey) ns JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_item_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_order_value, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_custkey) os ON ns.n_nationkey = (SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey) WHERE ns.total_supply_cost_per_nation > 10000 ORDER BY os.total_order_value DESC, ns.supplier_count ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(c.order_count, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(c.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(s.total_cost, 0) AS total_supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_nationkey, COUNT(o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer JOIN orders ON c_custkey = o_custkey GROUP BY c_nationkey) c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, SUM(ps_supplycost * ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON s_suppkey = ps_suppkey GROUP BY s_nationkey) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' ORDER BY total_orders DESC, total_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT s.s_name, COALESCE(tr.total_revenue, 0) AS revenue, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, SUM(oli.total_price) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM lineitem li JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-02-01') fo ON li.l_orderkey = fo.o_orderkey GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) oli ON li.l_orderkey = oli.l_orderkey GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name) tr ON rs.s_suppkey = tr.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY revenue DESC, rs.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name, COALESCE(ss.TotalSuppliers, 0) AS TotalSuppliers, COALESCE(cs.TotalCustomers, 0) AS TotalCustomers, COALESCE(cs.TotalOrders, 0) AS TotalOrders, COALESCE(cs.TotalOrderValue, 0) AS TotalOrderValue, SUM(pss.TotalAvailableQuantity) AS OverallAvailableQuantity, SUM(pss.TotalSupplyCost) AS OverallSupplyCost FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS TotalSuppliers, SUM(s_acctbal) AS TotalAccountBalance FROM supplier GROUP BY s_nationkey) ss ON r.r_regionkey = ss.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) AS TotalCustomers, SUM(o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c_nationkey) cs ON r.r_regionkey = cs.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQuantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) pss ON cs.c_nationkey = pss.ps_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ss.TotalSuppliers, cs.TotalCustomers, cs.TotalOrders, cs.TotalOrderValue ORDER BY TotalOrderValue DESC, TotalSuppliers DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, MAX(o.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value FROM lineitem AS l JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name IN (SELECT nation_name FROM (SELECT nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders AS o JOIN customer AS c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') AS o WHERE rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY nation_name) as TopNationSales) GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as region_sales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(os.total_order_value) AS avg_order_value, SUM(os.total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value, MAX(os.avg_account_balance) AS max_account_balance FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, os.total_order_value, os.item_count, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_value, ss.avg_account_balance FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN lineitem l ON ss.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) os JOIN supplier s ON os.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON os.total_order_value = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderstatus, od.revenue, od.line_count, od.supplier_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY od.o_orderstatus ORDER BY od.revenue DESC) as rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_linenumber) AS line_count, hs.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sc.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierCost)) hs ON l.l_suppkey = hs.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, hs.total_cost) od ORDER BY od.supplier_cost DESC, od.revenue DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.customer_name, od.o_orderdate, od.total_line_value, spl.supplier_name, spl.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name) od JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name) spl ON od.o_orderkey = (SELECT MAX(o.o_orderkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate <= od.o_orderdate) WHERE od.line_count > 5 ORDER BY od.o_orderdate DESC, od.total_line_value DESC) LIMIT 100;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.order_count, (rs.total_sales - avg.avg_sales) / NULLIF(avg.avg_sales, 0) * 100 AS sales_variance_percentage, (rs.order_count - avg.avg_order_count) / NULLIF(avg.avg_order_count, 0) * 100 AS order_count_variance_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS avg_sales, AVG(order_count) AS avg_order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) avg ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.s_name AS SupplierName, t.TotalSupplyCost AS SupplierTotalCost, h.c_name AS CustomerName, h.AvgOrderValue AS CustomerAvgOrderValue, h.OrderCount AS CustomerTotalOrders FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.TotalSupplyCost DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) t JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, c.AvgOrderValue, c.OrderCount, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.AvgOrderValue DESC) AS CustomerRank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS AvgOrderValue, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.OrderCount > 10) h ON t.SupplierRank = h.CustomerRank WHERE t.SupplierRank <= 10 ORDER BY t.TotalSupplyCost DESC, h.AvgOrderValue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM ( SELECT SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_custkey ) AS avg_total_spent)) co ON ts.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey) GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_quantity * ps.ps_supplycost) DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT tn.n_name, tn.supplier_count, tn.total_avail_qty, tn.avg_acctbal, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT n_name, supplier_count, total_avail_qty, avg_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_avail_qty DESC) AS rank_by_availability FROM (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) WHERE supplier_count > 5) tn LEFT JOIN supplier s ON tn.n_name = (SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n WHERE n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) LEFT JOIN customer c ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE (o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01') GROUP BY tn.n_name, tn.supplier_count, tn.total_avail_qty, tn.avg_acctbal, tn.rank_by_availability ORDER BY tn.rank_by_availability, total_sales DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.total_cost, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_orders, hvc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN partsupp ps ON ss.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrders)) hvc ON o.o_custkey = hvc.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ss.total_cost DESC, hvc.total_spent DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, spd.s_name AS supplier_name, spd.total_available, qp.p_name AS part_name, qp.p_brand, qp.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rnk FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_name) spd ON ro.o_orderkey = spd.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT pp.p_partkey, pp.p_name, pp.p_brand, pp.p_retailprice FROM ( SELECT p.* FROM part p WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2) ) pp) qp ON spd.ps_partkey = qp.p_partkey WHERE ro.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, spd.total_available DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation ASC;

SELECT rc.r_name, co.c_name, co.total_order_value, rc.total_region_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ns.total_supplier_cost) AS total_region_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplier_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_suppkey) ns ON ns.n_name = n.n_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rc JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON rc.total_region_cost > co.total_order_value WHERE co.total_order_value > 1000 ORDER BY rc.r_name, co.total_order_value DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o WHERE o.rank <= 10) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, s.total_cost ASC;

SELECT hac.customer_name, hac.total_spent, hac.order_count, hac.first_order_date, hac.last_order_date, ss.supplier_name, ss.parts_supplied, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT os.customer_name, os.total_spent, os.order_count, os.first_order_date, os.last_order_date FROM (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MIN(o.o_orderdate) AS first_order_date, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_name) os WHERE os.order_count > 10 AND os.total_spent > 1000) hac JOIN (SELECT sp.supplier_name, sp.parts_supplied, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) sp WHERE sp.total_supply_cost > 5000) ss ON hac.total_spent > 2000 ORDER BY hac.total_spent DESC, ss.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT national.nation_name, s.s_name, s.total_orders, s.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) s) s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT n.n_name AS nation_name FROM nation n) national ON s.nation_name = national.nation_name WHERE s.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY national.nation_name, s.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t_s.s_name AS supplier_name, t_s.nation_name AS supplier_nation, t_c.c_name AS customer_name, t_c.total_revenue, t_s.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.nation_name, total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) s) t_s JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(total_revenue) DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) c GROUP BY c.c_name) t_c ON t_s.rank = t_c.rank WHERE t_s.rank <= 10 AND t_c.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t_s.total_cost DESC, t_c.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, average_sales_per_order, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, total_sales / NULLIF(total_orders, 0) AS average_sales_per_order FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'EXPRESS') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('GROUND', 'AIR') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;
