SELECT rc.r_name AS region, nc.n_name AS nation, COUNT(tc.c_custkey) AS top_customer_count, SUM(tc.customer_revenue) AS total_customer_revenue FROM region rc JOIN nation nc ON rc.r_regionkey = nc.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = nc.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) lo ON lo.o_orderkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(lo.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) lo ON c.c_custkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(lo.total_revenue) > 100000) tc ON tc.c_custkey = lo.o_orderkey GROUP BY rc.r_name, nc.n_name ORDER BY total_customer_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ra.sales_rank, ra.total_sales, sa.s_name, sa.total_supply_cost, nc.customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) ra JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa ON ra.o_orderkey % 100 = sa.s_suppkey % 100 JOIN region r ON ra.o_orderstatus = 'F' JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) nc ON sa.s_suppkey % 5 = nc.n_nationkey % 5 WHERE ra.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, ra.total_sales DESC;

SELECT na.s_name AS supplier_name, rp.o_orderkey AS order_id, rp.total_value, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_discount BETWEEN 0.05 AND 0.10 GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rp JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp ON rp.o_orderkey = sp.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'North America') na ON sp.ps_suppkey = na.s_suppkey WHERE rp.rn = 1 ORDER BY rp.total_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.c_mktsegment, t.total_revenue, r.r_name FROM (SELECT m.c_mktsegment, SUM(r.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) r JOIN customer m ON r.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = m.c_mktsegment ) WHERE r.rank <= 10 GROUP BY m.c_mktsegment) t JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 20 ) LIMIT 1 ) JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ro.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.region, tr.total_sales FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, sum(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) tr WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT tr.r_regionkey, tr.r_name, COALESCE(t.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales, COALESCE(t.order_count, 0) AS order_count FROM region tr LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31') ro JOIN supplier s ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = 'Brand#1' ) AND ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ) JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) t ON tr.r_regionkey = t.r_regionkey ORDER BY tr.r_regionkey;

SELECT ms.sales_month, ms.total_sales, ms.unique_customers, tr.region_name, tr.region_supply_cost FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', o_orderdate) AS sales_month, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY sales_month) ms LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * pp.p_retailprice) AS region_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part pp ON ps.ps_partkey = pp.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON tr.region_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(region_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * pp.p_retailprice) AS region_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part pp ON ps.ps_partkey = pp.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) as TopRegions) ORDER BY ms.sales_month DESC, ms.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n_name, c_name, total_spent, total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ns.n_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ns.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey) ns JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_lineitem_price) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ns.n_nationkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE ns.total_supply_cost > 100000 ORDER BY total_spent DESC) LIMIT 50;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) rs WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, s.s_name AS supplier_name, COALESCE(st.total_supply_value, 0) AS total_supply_value, COALESCE(ct.total_order_value, 0) AS total_order_value, COALESCE(ls.revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, COALESCE(ls.total_quantity, 0) AS total_quantity, ls.avg_discount AS average_discount FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) st ON s.s_suppkey = st.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) ct ON s.s_suppkey = ct.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_discount) AS avg_discount FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_suppkey) ls ON s.s_suppkey = ls.l_suppkey ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_name) AS top_supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_type) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_suppkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) rs JOIN region r ON rs.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT cd.c_name, cd.nation_name, cd.c_acctbal, os.order_count, os.total_order_value, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000) cd JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM orders o GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON cd.c_custkey = os.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sa.total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sa ON s.s_suppkey = sa.s_suppkey WHERE sa.total_supply_value > ( SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) as SupplierAggregates )) ts ON cd.c_custkey IN ( SELECT o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_quantity > 100 ) ORDER BY cd.c_acctbal DESC, os.total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.total_spent, tc.nation_name, tc.region_name, ps.supplier_count, ps.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, rc.total_spent, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS rank_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) rc JOIN customer c ON rc.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rc.rank_spent <= 10) tc JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey = (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.region_name, c.c_name, c.total_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS overall_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) s JOIN region r ON (SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = s.nation_name) = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.rank = 1) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.total_value FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.total_value > 10000) c ON c.total_value > 5000 ORDER BY ts.overall_rank, c.total_value DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, ro.unique_customers, tr.r_name, tr.region_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS unique_customers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS region_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY region_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON ro.total_revenue > 100000 WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name) as SalesData) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS num_top_suppliers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT SupplierRank, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pt.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part pt ON ps.ps_partkey = pt.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, pt.p_type) sr JOIN supplier s ON sr.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE sr.SupplierRank = 1) ts JOIN orders o ON ts.s_suppkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, ps.TotalAvailableQuantity, ps.TotalSupplyCost, pr.Revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQuantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ps ON ro.o_orderkey = ps.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS Revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pr ON ro.o_orderkey = pr.p_partkey WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC, pr.Revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COALESCE(SUM(sc.total_supply_cost), 0) AS total_supplier_cost, COALESCE(SUM(os.total_price), 0) AS total_order_value, CS.c_mktsegment AS market_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT CS.order_count) AS distinct_order_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) sc ON n.n_nationkey = sc.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-02-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.total_price IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) CS ON cs.c_mktsegment IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, CS.c_mktsegment ORDER BY total_supplier_cost DESC, total_order_value DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.s_suppkey, t.s_name, t.total_supply_cost, t.total_parts_supplied, r.r_name AS supplier_region FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank_by_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) t JOIN supplier s ON t.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE t.rank_by_cost <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, p.p_name AS part_name, SUM(pl.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(pl.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.c_custkey) AS number_of_customers FROM (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, 1 AS level FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty > 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.ps_partkey, p.ps_suppkey, p.ps_availqty, p.ps_supplycost, pl.level + 1 FROM partsupp p JOIN (SELECT ps_partkey, ps_suppkey, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost, 1 AS level FROM partsupp WHERE ps_availqty > 0 UNION ALL SELECT p.ps_partkey, p.ps_suppkey, p.ps_availqty, p.ps_supplycost, pl.level + 1 FROM partsupp p JOIN part_supplier_list pl ON p.ps_partkey = pl.ps_partkey WHERE p.ps_supplycost < pl.ps_supplycost AND pl.level < 5) pl ON p.ps_partkey = pl.ps_partkey WHERE p.ps_supplycost < pl.ps_supplycost AND pl.level < 5) pl JOIN part p ON pl.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON pl.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON tc.c_custkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name, p.p_name HAVING SUM(pl.ps_availqty) > 100 ORDER BY total_availqty DESC, avg_supplycost DESC;

SELECT sp.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, AVG(hvo.TotalValue) AS AvgOrderValue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 0) sp JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalValue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01') r JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE r.OrderRank <= 10 GROUP BY r.o_orderkey) hvo ON sp.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000 ) GROUP BY sp.s_name ORDER BY OrderCount DESC, TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(ss.TotalSales) AS RegionTotalSales, SUM(cs.TotalRevenue) AS SegmentTotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT ro.o_orderkey) AS RecentOrderCount FROM Region r LEFT JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.ps_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON r.r_name = cs.c_mktsegment LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro ON s.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY RegionTotalSales DESC, SegmentTotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT fs.nation_name, fs.total_customers, fs.total_sales, fs.avg_order_value, fs.total_parts_available, fs.avg_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(ps.total_available) AS total_parts_available, AVG(ps.average_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) GROUP BY n.n_name) fs WHERE fs.total_sales > 1000000 ORDER BY fs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, r.total_unique_orders, r.total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.o_orderkey) AS total_unique_orders, SUM(so.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) so JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = so.o_orderkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE so.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(orders_count) AS total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(orders_count) DESC) AS nation_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) AS nation_orders JOIN nation n ON nation_orders.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) t ON r.r_name = t.n_name WHERE t.nation_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name, s.s_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count ASC;

SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, rs.SupplierCount, rs.TotalAvailability, rs.AverageCost, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, SUM(ro.o_totalprice) AS TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT sr.n_regionkey, COUNT(*) AS SupplierCount, SUM(ps.TotalAvailable) AS TotalAvailability, AVG(ps.AvgSupplyCost) AS AverageCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) sr JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailable, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS AvgSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps ON sr.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY sr.n_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro ON ro.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ) GROUP BY r.r_name, rs.SupplierCount, rs.TotalAvailability, rs.AverageCost ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ol.net_revenue, ol.total_quantity, ol.line_count, sd.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_custkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 MONTH') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS net_revenue, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS line_count FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ol ON ro.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON ol.net_revenue > sd.total_supply_cost WHERE ro.rn = 1) WHERE net_revenue IS NOT NULL ORDER BY o_orderdate DESC, price_rank;

SELECT tr.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sa.total_cost) AS region_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) sa ON n.n_nationkey = sa.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tr JOIN nation n ON tr.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY tr.r_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT cod.c_custkey, cod.c_name, SUM(cod.revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT cod.o_orderdate) AS order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, t.revenue, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.rank <= 10) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey) cod GROUP BY cod.c_custkey, cod.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#45' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT h.c_name, COUNT(h.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(h.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent, AVG(h.TotalAvailableQty) AS AvgQtyAvailable, AVG(h.AvgSupplyCost) AS AvgSupplyCost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, sd.TotalAvailableQty, sd.AvgSupplyCost, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalAvailableQty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS AvgSupplyCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = sd.ps_suppkey)) WHERE ro.OrderRank <= 5 AND ro.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2)) h GROUP BY h.c_name ORDER BY TotalSpent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.p_name, sp.s_name, sp.nation_name, os.o_orderkey, os.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000) pp JOIN partsupp ps ON pp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 50000) sp ON ps.ps_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate HAVING COUNT(l.l_orderkey) > 5) os ON os.o_orderkey = pp.p_partkey WHERE os.o_totalprice > 10000 ORDER BY os.o_orderdate DESC, pp.total_quantity DESC, sp.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.supplier_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey) JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 3) ts ORDER BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier, p.p_name AS part, p.p_brand, c.c_name AS customer, c.total_spent, s.total_supply_cost, p.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type HAVING COUNT(l.l_orderkey) > 100) p ON s.total_parts_supplied > 5 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c ON c.total_orders > 10 WHERE s.total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC, c.total_spent DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.unique_parts_supplied, ts.total_supply_value, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name AS customer_name, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.unique_parts_supplied, ss.total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts_supplied, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey) tc ON ts.supplier_rank <= 5 AND tc.customer_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_value DESC, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND n.n_name = 'USA' GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.p_brand, r.BrandTotalCost, ns.n_name, ns.SupplierCount, ns.TotalAccountBalance FROM (SELECT p_brand, SUM(TotalCost) AS BrandTotalCost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand) WHERE rnk <= 10 GROUP BY p_brand) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS TotalAccountBalance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON r.p_brand LIKE '%' || ns.n_name || '%' ORDER BY r.BrandTotalCost DESC, ns.SupplierCount DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.c_custkey, t.c_name, t.total_orders, t.total_spent, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.total_orders, c.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c WHERE c.total_orders > 0) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.part_supply_value) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS part_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s ON s.total_supply_value > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.part_supply_value) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS part_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails) WHERE t.rank <= 10 ORDER BY t.total_spent DESC, s.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT ts.region, ts.nation, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.supplier_name) AS number_of_top_suppliers, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_nation FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank_in_nation <= 3) ts GROUP BY ts.region, ts.nation ORDER BY ts.region, ts.nation;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_generated, COUNT(DISTINCT t.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(t.total_revenue) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 10) t JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = t.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue_generated DESC;

SELECT * FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, rs.s_name, tr.r_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON li.l_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY nation_count DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON c.c_nationkey = ( SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = tr.r_regionkey LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY ro.o_totalprice DESC) WHERE total_supply_cost > 10000 ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, AVG(ts.total_supply_cost) AS avg_total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = rs.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts GROUP BY ts.nation_name ORDER BY avg_total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT rs.s_name, rs.s_acctbal, ot.total_price, coc.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN partsupp ps ON rs.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_price FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) ot ON ps.ps_suppkey = ot.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) coc ON ot.o_custkey = coc.c_custkey WHERE rs.rn <= 5 AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND ot.total_price > 1000 ORDER BY rs.s_acctbal DESC, ot.total_price DESC;

SELECT R.Region, R.TotalSales, R.SalesRank FROM (SELECT Region, TotalSales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC) AS SalesRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) R WHERE R.SalesRank <= 5 ORDER BY R.TotalSales DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.region_total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.region_total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, sum(S.total_revenue) AS region_total_revenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, sum(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) S ON n.n_name = S.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rs ORDER BY rs.region_total_revenue DESC;

SELECT co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice, co.o_orderdate, li.revenue, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem lo GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) li ON co.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.s_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) DESC) as ranking FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp GROUP BY sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name) rs ON rs.ranking = 1 ORDER BY co.o_orderdate DESC, co.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fo.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(rs.total_cost) AS supplier_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) fo ON s.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o) ) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY order_count DESC, supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(p.total_value) AS total_part_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r JOIN customer c ON r.s_suppkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) p ON p.p_partkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.nation_name ORDER BY total_part_value DESC;

SELECT t.n_name AS nation, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT n.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.rank = 1 AND n.n_nationkey = rs.n_nationkey) t JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey IN (SELECT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = t.n_name)) JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, ss.s_name AS supplier_name, ss.nation AS supplier_nation, cs.total_orders, cs.total_revenue, ss.total_supplycost, ss.total_parts FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COALESCE(o.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders, COALESCE(o.total_revenue, 0) AS total_revenue FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_custkey) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss ON cs.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY cs.total_revenue DESC, ss.total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT supplier_name, nation_name, customer_name, c_mktsegment, o_orderkey, o_totalprice, o_orderdate, total_available_qty, avg_supply_cost, line_item_count FROM (SELECT sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.nation_name, od.customer_name, od.c_mktsegment, od.o_orderkey, od.o_totalprice, od.o_orderdate, ps.total_available_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, od.line_item_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) sd JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, c.c_mktsegment, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_item_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment) od ON sd.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 20 AND p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 100 AND 500 ) LIMIT 1 ) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%metal%' )) ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC, nation_name;

SELECT co.c_name AS customer_name, h.s_name AS supplier_name, co.total_spent AS total_customer_spent, sp.total_cost AS total_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE s.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierParts)) h JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON h.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 1000 GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON co.total_spent > sp.total_cost ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC, sp.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ts.top_supplier_count, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(rs.s_suppkey) AS top_supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_nationkey) rs ON n.n_nationkey = rs.n_nationkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) JOIN customer c ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ts.top_supplier_count ORDER BY total_account_balance DESC, region_name;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS customers_count, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, n.n_regionkey FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) co ON ro.o_custkey = co.c_custkey JOIN region r ON co.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_supplied FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 1000) ts ON ro.o_custkey = ts.ps_suppkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) tr JOIN nation n ON tr.region_name = (SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n2 ON r.r_regionkey = n2.n_regionkey WHERE n2.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY tr.region_name, tr.total_sales ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1994-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.nation_name, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.n_regionkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_regionkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.n_regionkey = ns.n_nationkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.total_supply_cost > co.total_spent ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, co.total_spent DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, MAX(os.customer_count) AS max_customers_per_order, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON tr.region_name IN ( SELECT n.n_name FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey ) JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = tr.region_name ) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_items_value FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ro.c_name) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank = 1) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_name, o.order_count ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, co.o_totalprice, ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') co JOIN lineitem l ON co.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_returnflag = 'N' AND l.l_linestatus = 'F' ORDER BY co.o_totalprice DESC, ts.total_supply_value ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT region, nation, COUNT(*) AS product_count, SUM(total_sales) AS region_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, rs.p_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.p_partkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10) GROUP BY region, nation ORDER BY region_sales DESC, region;

SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, rank_sales, rank_orders FROM (SELECT nation_name, total_sales, order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS rank_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS rank_orders FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, os.total_sales, os.order_count FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) os ON n.n_nationkey = os.c_nationkey) as NationSales) WHERE rank_sales <= 5 OR rank_orders <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT rp.region_name, rp.nation_name, cp.c_name AS customer_name, cp.o_orderkey, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT cp.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_suppkey FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON rp.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') cp ON sp.s_suppkey = cp.o_orderkey GROUP BY rp.region_name, rp.nation_name, cp.c_name, cp.o_orderkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS avg_extended_price, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS distinct_customers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'GROUND') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, avg_extended_price DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.s_acctbal, ts.region_name, co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.cost_rank <= 10) ts JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ON ts.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ) ) ORDER BY ts.s_acctbal DESC, co.total_spent DESC;

SELECT cs.s_name, cs.total_available, cs.total_cost, cr.c_name, cr.customer_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) cs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr ON cr.customer_revenue > 10000 WHERE cs.total_available > 5000 ORDER BY cr.customer_revenue DESC, cs.total_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, tc.c_name, ts.total_revenue FROM (SELECT t.c_custkey, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) t JOIN customer c ON t.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE t.total_revenue > 10000) tc JOIN supplier s ON tc.c_custkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) ts ON tc.c_custkey = ts.c_custkey WHERE tc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name, n.n_name, ts.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rc.customer_revenue, COALESCE(sd.supplier_value, 0) AS supplier_value, rc.c_name FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON o.o_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY customer_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) rc LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supplier_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON rc.c_custkey = sd.s_suppkey ORDER BY rc.customer_revenue DESC, supplier_value ASC;

SELECT ods.o_orderstatus, ods.orders_count, ods.avg_revenue, ods.total_customers, ROUND(ods.avg_revenue / ods.orders_count, 2) AS avg_revenue_per_order FROM (SELECT ts.o_orderstatus, COUNT(ts.total_revenue) AS orders_count, AVG(ts.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue, SUM(ts.customer_count) AS total_customers FROM (SELECT o_orderstatus, total_revenue, customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_custkey) AS customer_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) WHERE revenue_rank <= 5) ts GROUP BY ts.o_orderstatus) ods ORDER BY ods.avg_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(rs.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, avg_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_count, rs.total_supplier_balance, tp.p_name AS top_part_name, tp.total_supply_value, os.o_orderstatus, os.order_count, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON tp.total_supply_value > 0 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderstatus, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderstatus) os ON os.order_count > 0 ORDER BY rs.region_name, os.o_orderstatus;

SELECT TR.region_name, TR.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r_name AS region_name, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey = o_orderkey JOIN customer ON o_custkey = c_custkey JOIN supplier ON l_suppkey = s_suppkey JOIN nation ON s_nationkey = n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey = r_regionkey WHERE o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r_name) as RegionalSales) TR JOIN supplier s ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey AND p.p_container = 'MED BOX' ) JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = 'USA') WHERE TR.sales_rank <= 5 GROUP BY TR.region_name, TR.total_sales ORDER BY TR.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT r.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(Coalesce(cos.total_orders, 0)) AS total_orders, SUM(Coalesce(cos.total_spent, 0)) AS total_spent, SUM(COALESCE(lt.total_revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue, SUM(COALESCE(tp.total_available, 0)) AS total_parts_available FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cos ON r.s_suppkey = cos.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) lt ON r.s_suppkey = lt.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) tp ON r.s_suppkey = tp.ps_partkey GROUP BY r.nation_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT r.s_suppkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, ss.part_count, COALESCE(ols.revenue, 0) AS total_revenue, ss.total_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS line_item_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ols ON ols.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' ) ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT order_rank, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, supplier_name, region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O') WHERE order_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.order_count, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_supplycost, sp.ps_availqty FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY order_count DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT op.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) s JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_custkey) op ON s.s_suppkey = op.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT op.o_orderkey) > 5) as RankedSuppliers) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp ON ts.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.order_count DESC, sp.ps_supplycost ASC;

SELECT sc.s_name, sc.total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT hro.o_orderkey) AS high_revenue_orders_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN partsupp ps ON sc.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os WHERE os.total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) as OrderStats)) hro ON l.l_orderkey = hro.o_orderkey GROUP BY sc.s_suppkey, sc.s_name, sc.total_supply_cost ORDER BY sc.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tc.c_name, pr.p_name, sr.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20) pr ON l.l_partkey = pr.p_partkey AND pr.rank = 1 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) co JOIN customer c ON co.c_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE co.total_spent > 1000) tc ON o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name) sr ON l.l_suppkey = sr.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY tc.c_name, pr.p_name, sr.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, COUNT(os.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(os.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs WHERE rs.rank <= 10) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON os.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) GROUP BY ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name ORDER BY avg_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.r_name, ts.n_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_cost, os.revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, n.n_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_cost DESC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ts.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC LIMIT 1) WHERE ts.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ts.r_name, ts.total_cost DESC;
