SELECT nation, order_count, total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.n_name AS nation, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN nation c ON c.n_nationkey = ( SELECT n_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = ro.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) WHERE order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c.n_name) ORDER BY revenue_rank;

SELECT ts.s_name, ts.c_name, ts.o_orderdate, ts.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, d.c_name, d.o_orderdate, rs.TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.o_orderdate ORDER BY rs.TotalSupplyCost DESC) AS SupplyRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey ) d ON d.o_orderkey = ( SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice < 100 ) AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' ORDER BY l.l_extendedprice DESC LIMIT 1 )) ts WHERE ts.SupplyRank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.o_orderdate, ts.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.parts_count, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC) AS supply_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) as RankedSuppliers) ts WHERE ts.supply_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_supplycost DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.rnk <= 5) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00 ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, p.p_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, count_orders, total_region_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_region_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, ro.nation_name, COUNT(ro.o_orderkey) AS count_orders, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_region_revenue FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, n.n_regionkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rank_order FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN nation n ON ro.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ro.rank_order <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) ro JOIN region r ON ro.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, ro.nation_name) ORDER BY region_name, revenue_rank;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, total_orders DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.c_name, p.total_revenue, p.unique_products FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_products FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t ON l.l_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) p ON t.o_orderkey = p.l_orderkey ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, p.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_name, ro.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ro.o_orderkey = (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_suppkey = ts.ps_suppkey LIMIT 1) WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND r.r_name = 'Europe' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ns.n_name, ns.total_supplycost, ns.count_suppliers FROM (SELECT n.n_name, n.n_nationkey, COALESCE(ts.total_supplycost, 0) AS total_supplycost, COALESCE(s.count_suppliers, 0) AS count_suppliers FROM nation n LEFT JOIN ( SELECT n_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s_suppkey) AS count_suppliers FROM supplier GROUP BY n_nationkey ) s ON n.n_nationkey = s.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, SUM(sc.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY ps.ps_availqty DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE sc.rank <= 5 GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey) ns ORDER BY ns.total_supplycost DESC, ns.count_suppliers DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND p.p_size >= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name, s.s_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tc.region_name, tc.nation_name, COUNT(tc.customer_name) AS top_customer_count, SUM(tc.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(tc.o_totalprice) AS avg_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN customer co ON ro.c_nationkey = co.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON co.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) tc GROUP BY tc.region_name, tc.nation_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

SELECT tc.name, tc.total_spent, tc.order_count, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.supplier_count, SUM(sd.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey AS custkey, c.c_name AS name, c.total_spent, c.order_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) tc JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey) sd ON tc.custkey = sd.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON sd.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE tc.rank <= 10 GROUP BY tc.name, tc.total_spent, tc.order_count, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.supplier_count ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.region, rs.total_sales, cs.c_mktsegment, cs.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('TRUCK', 'SHIP') GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_mktsegment, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_mktsegment) cs ON cs.total_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY rs.total_sales DESC, cs.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.nation_name, COUNT(t.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(t.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(t.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.region_name, o.nation_name, o.customer_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, c.c_name AS customer_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') o WHERE o.rank <= 10) t GROUP BY t.region_name, t.nation_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT co.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(co.total_order_value) AS total_order_value, AVG(rs.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON s.s_nationkey = co.c_custkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT nation, region, COUNT(c_custkey) AS top_customer_count, SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_from_top_customers FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, r.r_comment, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, rs.total_revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN customer c ON c.c_custkey = rs.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.revenue_rank <= 5) GROUP BY nation, region ORDER BY total_revenue_from_top_customers DESC;

SELECT s.c_custkey AS cust_key, s.c_name, s.region_name, s.o_orderkey, s.o_orderdate, s.item_count, s.total_value FROM (SELECT b.c_custkey, b.c_name, r.region_name, r.regional_rank, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.item_count, o.total_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(o.o_totalprice) DESC) AS spending_rank FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 5000) b JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS regional_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) r ON r.regional_rank = 1 JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS item_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate > '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON b.c_custkey = o.o_orderkey) s WHERE s.total_value > 10000 ORDER BY s.o_orderdate DESC, s.total_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderpriority, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost, ols.total_line_value, ols.total_quantity FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) ss ON r.o_orderkey % 10 = ss.s_suppkey % 10 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ols ON r.o_orderkey = ols.l_orderkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT rs.region, cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, rs.total_sales, (cs.total_spent / NULLIF(rs.total_sales, 0)) * 100 AS customer_contribution_percentage FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cs ON rs.region = ( SELECT r.r_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey WHERE c.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey ) ORDER BY rs.region, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, cs.c_name, cs.total_spent, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.total_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS total_price_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) cs ON r.o_orderkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON r.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE r.total_price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate, cs.total_spent DESC;

SELECT ri.r_name, ri.total_revenue_per_region, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(sp.total_revenue) AS total_revenue_per_region FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) ri JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, c.c_nationkey, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro ON ri.n_nationkey = ro.c_nationkey WHERE ri.total_revenue_per_region > 10000 ORDER BY ri.total_revenue_per_region DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.region, r.total_sales, CASE WHEN r.total_sales > a.avg_sales THEN 'Above Average' WHEN r.total_sales < a.avg_sales THEN 'Below Average' ELSE 'Average' END AS sales_performance FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) r, AverageSales a ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.c_name, os.total_sales, os.distinct_parts FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, c_name, total_sales, distinct_parts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o_orderdate ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name) as RankedOrders) os WHERE os.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY os.o_orderdate, os.total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS unique_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT order_rank, o_orderkey, o_orderstatus, o_totalprice, o_orderdate, o_orderpriority, c_name, nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') WHERE order_rank <= 10) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, o.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name;

SELECT sp.s_name, cs.c_name, o.total_line_value, o.total_line_items, sp.total_parts, sp.total_supply_cost, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS total_parts, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value, COUNT(l.l_linenumber) AS total_line_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) o ON sp.s_suppkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON sp.s_suppkey = cs.c_custkey WHERE o.total_line_value > 1000 ORDER BY sp.total_supply_cost DESC, cs.total_spent ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.c_custkey, ts.c_name, ts.total_sales, ts.sales_rank, tps.s_suppkey, tps.s_name FROM (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, os.total_sales FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE c.c_acctbal > 0) cs) ts JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) s WHERE s.rank <= 5) tps ON ts.total_sales > 10000 ORDER BY ts.sales_rank, ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.supplier_count, t.total_supply_cost, ROUND(t.total_supply_cost / NULLIF(t.supplier_count, 0), 2) AS avg_supply_cost_per_supplier FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rs.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5 GROUP BY r.r_name) t ORDER BY t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.nation_name = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 3) ts ORDER BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s INNER JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey INNER JOIN supplier_hierarchy sh ON ps.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh ON ps.ps_partkey = sh.s_suppkey) sh ON l.l_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY c.c_name, r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 5000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT OD.c_name, OD.o_orderkey, OD.o_totalprice, LRD.revenue, PD.p_name, PD.p_brand, SD.nation_name, SD.s_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') OD JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) LRD ON OD.o_orderkey = LRD.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, ps.ps_supplycost, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty < 200) PD ON LRD.revenue > 0 JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) SD ON PD.ps_suppkey = SD.s_suppkey WHERE SD.nation_name = 'USA' ORDER BY OD.o_totalprice DESC, LRD.revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_supply_cost, unique_suppliers, avg_customer_balance FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) WHERE total_supply_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS avg_customer_balance FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as Summary) ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC, unique_suppliers ASC;

SELECT ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.order_value FROM (SELECT nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) WHERE supplier_rank <= 5) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000) hvo ON ts.total_cost > hvo.o_totalprice ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_cost DESC, hvo.order_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.total_revenue, p.p_name, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN orders o ON r.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.revenue_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s_acctbal) FROM supplier) ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC, t.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_acctbal FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND p.p_type LIKE '%plastic%' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, nation_name ASC, region_name ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS average_supplier_balance FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-02-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, o.o_orderkey, s.s_acctbal HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, AVG(tag_count) AS average_parts_per_supplier FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE' UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 1 AS level FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE n.n_name = 'FRANCE' UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps2 WHERE ps2.ps_availqty > 100 ORDER BY ps2.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1 )) sh ON ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps2 WHERE ps2.ps_availqty > 100 ORDER BY ps2.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1 )) s JOIN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, COUNT(*) AS tag_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_type LIKE '%plastic%' GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ) AS PartCount ON s.s_suppkey = PartCount.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY average_parts_per_supplier DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ro.revenue) DESC) AS nation_rank, SUM(ro.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, o.o_custkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_name) WHERE nation_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rc.c_custkey, rc.c_name AS CustomerName, rs.TotalSupplyValue, rc.TotalOrderValue FROM (SELECT s.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSupplyValue DESC) AS SupplyRank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyValue, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS PartCount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) rs JOIN (SELECT c.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalOrderValue DESC) AS OrderRank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= (cast('1998-10-01' as date) - INTERVAL '1 year') GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) c) rc ON rs.SupplyRank = rc.OrderRank WHERE rs.SupplyRank <= 10 AND rc.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.TotalSupplyValue DESC, rc.TotalOrderValue DESC;

SELECT tc.region_name, tc.nation_name, COUNT(*) AS top_customers_count, SUM(tc.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(tc.o_totalprice) AS avg_spent FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, ro.c_name AS customer_name, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN customer c ON ro.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ro.rn <= 5) tc GROUP BY tc.region_name, tc.nation_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC, top_customers_count DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, AVG(ts.region_total_cost) AS average_supply_cost, COUNT(ts.region_total_cost) AS supplier_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS region_total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name) ts GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY average_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.supplier_name, ts.total_supply_cost, os.total_orders, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supplier_rank, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.supplier_rank <= 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') os ORDER BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.region_name, t.total_revenue, t.total_orders FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_revenue, total_orders, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_returnflag = 'N' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as regional_spending) t WHERE t.rank <= 5 ORDER BY t.region_name, t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderstatus, r.o_totalprice, r.o_orderdate, r.o_orderpriority, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.total_supply_value > 1000000 JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON cs.total_spent > 50000 WHERE r.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY r.o_orderdate DESC, r.o_orderpriority;

SELECT ad.n_name, ad.p_name, ad.total_revenue, ad.order_count FROM (SELECT ns.n_name, pl.p_name, SUM(pl.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01') pl ON ns.s_suppkey = pl.l_orderkey GROUP BY ns.n_name, pl.p_name) ad WHERE ad.total_revenue > ( SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM (SELECT ns.n_name, pl.p_name, SUM(pl.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000) ns JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, l.l_orderkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01') pl ON ns.s_suppkey = pl.l_orderkey GROUP BY ns.n_name, pl.p_name) as aggregated_data ) ORDER BY ad.total_revenue DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_address, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.total_sales FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, hv.c_name AS high_value_customer, hv.c_acctbal AS high_value_customer_balance, sum.total_orders, sum.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ps_partkey ORDER BY ps_supplycost ASC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) s JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rnk FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) hv ON s.rnk = 1 JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) sum ON sum.nation = (SELECT n_name FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = (SELECT c_nationkey FROM customer WHERE c_custkey = hv.c_custkey)) WHERE s.s_acctbal >= 50000 ORDER BY sum.total_revenue DESC, s.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT nd.n_name AS NationName, nd.region_name, sd.s_name AS SupplierName, COUNT(DISTINCT co.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(co.OrderRevenue) AS TotalRevenue, MAX(sd.TotalSupplyCost) AS MaxSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nd ON sd.s_nationkey = nd.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS OrderRevenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey) co ON nd.n_nationkey = co.c_custkey GROUP BY nd.n_name, nd.region_name, sd.s_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC, OrderCount DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rc.revenue_rank, rc.p_name, rc.total_quantity, tc.customer_rank, tc.c_name, tc.total_orders, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT ad.p_partkey, ad.p_name, ad.total_quantity, ad.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ad.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) ad) rc JOIN (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.total_orders, co.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) tc ON rc.total_quantity > 100 WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 10 AND tc.customer_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rc.revenue_rank, tc.total_spent DESC;

SELECT sp.p_name, sp.p_brand, SUM(ss.sales_value) AS total_sales_value, SUM(sp.total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value, SUM(ss.sales_value) - SUM(sp.total_supply_value) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) WHERE rank <= 3) as TopSuppliers)) sp JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales_value FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, c.c_mktsegment) ss ON sp.ps_partkey = ss.l_orderkey GROUP BY sp.p_name, sp.p_brand ORDER BY profit_margin DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.s_name AS supplier_name, r.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance, hc.c_name AS high_value_customer, od.total_revenue AS customer_order_revenue, ss.total_available_qty AS supplier_total_available_qty, ss.avg_supply_cost AS supplier_average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE r.r_name IN ('NORTH AMERICA', 'EUROPE')) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) hc ON r.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 50)) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON od.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) ss ON ss.ps_suppkey = r.s_suppkey WHERE ss.avg_supply_cost < 20.00 ORDER BY od.total_revenue DESC, r.s_acctbal DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(c.c_acctbal) AS total_acctbal, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 ) )) sh ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > ( SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2 ) )) sh JOIN supplier s ON sh.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING AVG(o.o_totalprice) > (SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2) ORDER BY region, nation;

SELECT tb.p_brand, tb.avg_price, sn.nation_name, sn.supplier_count, cc.c_mktsegment, cc.customer_count FROM (SELECT rp.p_brand, AVG(rp.p_retailprice) AS avg_price, COUNT(rp.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, p.p_comment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 15 AND 25) rp WHERE rp.brand_rank <= 5 GROUP BY rp.p_brand) tb JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) sn ON tb.p_brand LIKE '%' || sn.nation_name || '%' JOIN (SELECT cm.c_mktsegment, COUNT(cm.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM customer cm GROUP BY cm.c_mktsegment) cc ON cc.customer_count > sn.supplier_count ORDER BY tb.avg_price DESC, sn.supplier_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.region_total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.region_total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ns.total_sales) AS region_total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name) ns ON n.n_name = ns.nation_name GROUP BY r.r_name) rs WHERE rs.region_total_sales > 100000 ORDER BY rs.region_total_sales DESC;

SELECT tp.p_name, tp.total_revenue, sc.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT pd.p_partkey, pd.p_name, pd.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pd.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size) pd WHERE pd.total_revenue > 10000) tp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON tp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_name = sc.s_name) ) WHERE tp.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC, sc.total_cost ASC;

SELECT Nation, TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT Nation, TotalRevenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as RevenueByNation) WHERE RevenueRank <= 5 ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderstatus, od.o_totalprice, od.o_orderdate, od.o_orderpriority, od.p_name, od.p_brand, od.p_type, od.total_quantity, od.total_extended_price, od.total_discount, od.total_tax FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discount, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) ro JOIN lineitem l ON ro.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ro.rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderpriority, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) od WHERE od.o_orderstatus = 'F' ORDER BY od.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container, p.p_retailprice, r.r_name AS region, SUM(rn.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000) hvps ON p.p_partkey = hvps.ps_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01') rn ON l.l_orderkey = rn.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND rn.rn <= 5 AND p.p_type IN (SELECT p_type FROM part WHERE p_size > 15) GROUP BY p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_container, p.p_retailprice, r.r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC;

SELECT cr.c_name, cr.customer_revenue, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_name, SUM(t.total_revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) t ON o.o_orderkey = t.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name) cr JOIN supplier s ON cr.c_name LIKE CONCAT('%', s.s_name, '%') JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY cr.c_name, cr.customer_revenue, r.r_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 10000 ORDER BY cr.customer_revenue DESC, total_supply_cost ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_ordered, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT region_name, COUNT(*) AS num_orders, AVG(o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_sales, MAX(o_totalprice) AS highest_order_value, MIN(o_totalprice) AS lowest_order_value FROM (SELECT order_rank, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) WHERE order_rank <= 5) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.o_orderpriority, fr.c_mktsegment, fr.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fr.c_mktsegment ORDER BY fr.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderpriority, ro.c_mktsegment, fli.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) fli ON ro.o_orderkey = fli.l_orderkey) fr ORDER BY fr.c_mktsegment, revenue_rank;

SELECT s_name, c_name, c_acctbal, total_parts, total_available_qty, total_supply_cost, total_ordered_qty, avg_order_price FROM (SELECT s.s_name, cs.c_name, cs.c_acctbal, ss.total_parts, ss.total_available_qty, ss.total_supply_cost, cs.total_ordered_qty, cs.avg_order_price FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COALESCE(o.total_ordered_qty, 0) AS total_ordered_qty, COALESCE(o.avg_order_price, 0) AS avg_order_price FROM customer c LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_ordered_qty, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_price, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_custkey) o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) cs ON cs.total_ordered_qty > 0) WHERE total_supply_cost > 1000.00 ORDER BY total_ordered_qty DESC, avg_order_price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.n_name AS nation, p.p_name AS part_name, sp.total_quantity, cs.cust_count, cs.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) p JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sp ON p.p_partkey = sp.o_orderkey JOIN nation rn ON sp.s_nationkey = rn.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS cust_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_nationkey) cs ON rn.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey WHERE p.price_rank <= 5 ORDER BY cs.total_sales DESC, sp.total_quantity ASC;

SELECT h.region_name, COUNT(h.supplier_name) AS number_of_suppliers, SUM(h.total_cost) AS total_high_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, s.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) s JOIN region r ON s.rank_in_region = 1 WHERE s.total_cost > ( SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank_in_region FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) as RankedSuppliers )) h GROUP BY h.region_name ORDER BY total_high_cost DESC;

SELECT fr.o_orderkey, fr.o_orderdate, fr.c_name, fr.o_totalprice, COALESCE(fr.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT tco.o_orderkey, tco.o_orderdate, tco.c_name, tco.o_totalprice, ps.total_sales FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 5) tco LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ps ON tco.o_orderkey = ps.l_orderkey) fr WHERE fr.total_sales > 5000 ORDER BY fr.o_totalprice DESC, fr.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_revenue, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.supplier_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sr.supplier_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS supplier_revenue FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) sr ON s.s_suppkey = sr.ps_suppkey ORDER BY sr.supplier_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON OS.supplier_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = os.o_orderkey) ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.c_name, t.s_name, p.p_name, p.total_quantity_sold, r.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) as order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') r LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) as total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 1000000) t ON r.o_orderkey = t.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) as total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 500) p ON r.o_orderkey = p.p_partkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC, r.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, old.total_revenue, old.item_count, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem li ON li.l_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE li.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey LIMIT 1 ) JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(li.l_linenumber) AS item_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10) hvo JOIN lineitem li ON hvo.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey GROUP BY hvo.o_orderkey) old ON hvo.o_orderkey = old.o_orderkey ORDER BY old.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, ls.total_revenue, ls.line_count, ls.avg_quantity FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON s.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey) co ON sp.p_partkey = co.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS line_count, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) ls ON co.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey WHERE r.r_name = 'Europe' AND co.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ls.total_revenue DESC, co.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT pd.s_name AS supplier_name, pd.nation_name, os.total_order_value, os.order_count, ps.total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) pd LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os ON pd.s_suppkey = os.c_custkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ps ON pd.s_suppkey = ps.l_partkey WHERE pd.total_supply_cost > 10000.00 ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, ps.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND p.p_brand = 'Brand#23' AND c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, ts.s_name, ts.n_name AS Supplier_Nation, ts.TotalCost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, n.n_name, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 3) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_retailprice BETWEEN 100.00 AND 500.00 ORDER BY ts.TotalCost DESC, p.p_name ASC FETCH FIRST 50 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.nation_name, rs.total_sales FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) as regional_sales) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.region_name, rs.total_sales DESC;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.total_quantity, r.distinct_parts, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1990-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1995-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus) r LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts ON r.o_orderkey = ts.ps_suppkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC, r.o_orderdate;

SELECT r.p_name, r.p_brand, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_sales, MAX(o.o_orderdate) AS last_order_date FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) r JOIN lineitem l ON r.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, tc.c_custkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_custkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months') ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 5000) tc ON ro.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE ro.o_totalprice > 10000) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE r.rank = 1 GROUP BY r.p_name, r.p_brand ORDER BY total_sales DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT co.c_name, co.total_spending, tp.o_orderkey, tp.o_orderdate, tp.o_totalprice, sp.s_name, sp.total_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 10) tp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem lo ON o.o_orderkey = lo.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) co ON tp.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey) JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = tp.o_orderkey AND l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey) WHERE co.total_spending > 10000 ORDER BY co.total_spending DESC, tp.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT ss.s_name, ss.nation, ss.total_supply_value, os.total_revenue, os.total_line_items FROM (SELECT s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ss.total_parts_supplied = os.total_line_items WHERE ss.total_supply_value > 1000000 ORDER BY os.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;
