SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ts.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(ts.sales_amount) AS total_sales, AVG(ts.order_count) AS avg_orders_per_supplier FROM (SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.sales_amount, ts.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.sales_amount DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS sales_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ts) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.region_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, COUNT(*) AS SupplierCount, SUM(ts.TotalSupplyCost) AS TotalCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rnk <= 3) ts JOIN region r ON ts.r_name = r.r_name GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY TotalCost DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, rs.region_sales, rs.region_customers, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, SUM(na.total_sales) AS region_sales, SUM(na.total_customers) AS region_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, SUM(ca.total_spent) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.c_custkey) AS total_customers FROM nation n JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) ca ON c.c_custkey = ca.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) na ON n.n_nationkey = na.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.r_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.region_sales DESC, rs.region_customers ASC;

SELECT ms.order_year, ms.order_month, ms.region_name, ms.total_sales FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o_orderdate) AS order_month, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, r_name AS region_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY order_year, order_month, region_name) ms JOIN (SELECT region_name, SUM(total_sales) AS region_sales FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o_orderdate) AS order_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o_orderdate) AS order_month, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, r_name AS region_name FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY order_year, order_month, region_name) GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY region_sales DESC LIMIT 5) tr ON ms.region_name = tr.region_name ORDER BY ms.order_year, ms.order_month, ms.region_name;

SELECT t.region_name, t.nation_name, t.supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rs.s_name AS supplier_name, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) t JOIN supplier s ON t.supplier_name = s.s_name JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY t.region_name, t.nation_name, t.supplier_name ORDER BY t.region_name, t.nation_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name, AVG(rq.average_price) AS avg_price_per_region, SUM(rq.total_quantity) AS total_quantity_per_region, COUNT(DISTINCT rq.p_partkey) AS unique_parts_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, AVG(l.l_extendedprice) AS average_price, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.region_rank, rs.s_suppkey FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS region_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON rs.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND rs.region_rank <= 5 GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, rs.total_supply_cost, rs.region_rank, rs.s_suppkey) rq JOIN supplier s ON rq.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_quantity_per_region DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS SupplierName, ts.TotalSupplyCost AS SupplierCost, tc.c_name AS CustomerName, tc.TotalOrderValue AS CustomerValue FROM (SELECT s.s_name, sp.TotalSupplyCost, sp.UniquePartsSupplied FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS UniquePartsSupplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sp.TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 5) ts CROSS JOIN (SELECT co.c_name, co.TotalOrderValue, co.TotalOrders FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalOrderValue, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co ORDER BY co.TotalOrderValue DESC LIMIT 5) tc ORDER BY ts.TotalSupplyCost DESC, tc.TotalOrderValue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name, SUM(ts.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ts.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, s_name, nation_name, p_name, ps_availqty, ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE p.p_size BETWEEN 10 AND 20 AND s.s_acctbal > 500.00) WHERE rnk = 1) ts JOIN customer c ON c.c_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = ts.nation_name) JOIN orders o ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ts.s_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, average_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, ro.c_acctbal, ps.total_available_qty, ps.avg_supply_cost, ts.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') ro JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON ro.o_orderkey IN (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON ts.s_suppkey IN (SELECT l.l_suppkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT n.nation_name, n.total_suppliers, n.total_account_balance, n.avg_account_balance, p.p_name AS high_value_part, p.p_retailprice, o.o_orderkey, o.total_revenue FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) n LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ps.ps_availqty FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p_retailprice) FROM part) AND ps.ps_availqty > 50) p ON n.nation_name LIKE '%' || p.p_name || '%' LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o ON o.total_revenue > 1000 ORDER BY n.total_suppliers DESC, o.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-12-31' AND n.n_name IN ('USA', 'Canada', 'Mexico') GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) ro JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10) tc ON ro.total_revenue > tc.total_spent WHERE ro.rank = 1 ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, tp.s_name, tp.nation_name, rp.total_sales FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, rs.nation_name, rs.rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) tp ON rp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 ) WHERE rp.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rp.total_sales DESC, tp.nation_name, tp.s_name;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, MAX(o.o_totalprice) AS max_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'SEA') AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS supplier_rank, s.s_name, s.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') o ON o.o_orderkey IN ( SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey ) GROUP BY s.s_name, s.total_revenue, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 5 ORDER BY supplier_rank;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_totalprice, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus IN ('F', 'P')) co JOIN (SELECT sp.s_suppkey, sp.s_name, sp.p_partkey, sp.p_name, sp.ps_availqty, sp.ps_supplycost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sp.p_partkey ORDER BY sp.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 0) sp) sp ON co.o_orderkey = sp.s_suppkey WHERE sp.rn = 1 ORDER BY co.o_orderdate DESC, co.o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.total_available, rp.total_supply_cost, sn.s_name, sn.nation_name, sn.total_acctbal FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN partsupp ps ON rp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sn ON ps.ps_suppkey = sn.s_suppkey WHERE rp.rank = 1 AND sn.total_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(s.s_acctbal) FROM supplier s) ORDER BY rp.total_available DESC, sn.total_acctbal DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.o_totalprice, hvo.total_lineitem_value, sd.s_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderpriority, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderpriority ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus) hvo JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON hvo.o_orderkey = (SELECT MAX(o.o_orderkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate = hvo.o_orderdate) ORDER BY hvo.o_totalprice DESC, sd.total_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 50;

SELECT r_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r_name) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT AVG(total_sales) FROM (SELECT r_name, SUM(o_totalprice) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r_name) as RegionSales)) ORDER BY sales_rank LIMIT 10;

SELECT nrd.region_name, cs.c_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, rs.s_name AS top_supplier, rs.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name AS region_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nrd ON cs.c_custkey = nrd.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) WHERE rank = 1) rs ON cs.total_spent > 1000 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, rs.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, rr.nation, rr.revenue, rr.revenue_rank FROM (SELECT nation, revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name) as TotalRevenue) rr JOIN nation n ON rr.nation = n.n_name JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rr.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.r_name ASC, rr.revenue DESC;

SELECT r.n_name AS nation, COALESCE(t.total_revenue, 0) AS revenue FROM nation r LEFT JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(r.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rnk, n.n_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, n.n_nationkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.rnk <= 3 GROUP BY n.n_name) t ON r.n_name = t.n_name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT ds.o_orderkey, ds.o_orderstatus, ds.total_sales, ds.lineitem_count, ds.supplier_name, ds.supplier_account_balance FROM (SELECT oi.o_orderkey, oi.o_orderstatus, oi.total_sales, oi.lineitem_count, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, ts.s_acctbal AS supplier_account_balance FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1995-01-01' AND DATE '1995-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus) oi JOIN (SELECT s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, spc.part_count FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spc ON s.s_suppkey = spc.s_suppkey ORDER BY spc.part_count DESC, s.s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON oi.lineitem_count > 5) ds WHERE ds.total_sales > 10000 ORDER BY ds.total_sales DESC, ds.lineitem_count DESC;

SELECT rws.r_regionkey, rws.r_name, rws.supplier_count, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rws LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON rws.r_regionkey = ( SELECT n.n_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p ORDER BY p.p_retailprice DESC LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 1 ) ) WHERE ro.order_rank = 1 ORDER BY rws.r_regionkey, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.r_name, ts.s_name, COALESCE(SUM(co.total_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_cost FROM region r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS region_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_regionkey) rs ON r.r_regionkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.region_rank <= 3) ts LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON ts.s_name = co.c_name GROUP BY ts.r_name, ts.s_name ORDER BY ts.r_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, c.c_name AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT rq.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(q.total_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, SUM(rq.total_extended_price) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_extended_price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rq JOIN customer c ON rq.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 1000) q ON c.c_nationkey = q.s_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, c.c_name HAVING SUM(rq.total_extended_price) > 50000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT fs.s_suppkey, fs.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT fs.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(fs.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, AVG(fs.total_revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM (SELECT cp.s_suppkey, cp.s_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, li.total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) cp JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') co ON cp.s_suppkey = co.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem lo WHERE lo.l_shipdate < '1997-01-01' GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) li ON co.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey) fs GROUP BY fs.s_suppkey, fs.s_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hvo.o_orderkey, hvo.o_orderdate, hvo.c_name, hvo.o_totalprice, s.total_availqty, s.avg_supplycost, so.total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') r WHERE r.price_rank <= 10) hvo LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice - (l.l_extendedprice * l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, r.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01') r WHERE r.price_rank <= 10) hvo ON l.l_orderkey = hvo.o_orderkey GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_suppkey) so ON hvo.o_orderkey = so.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) s ON so.l_partkey = s.ps_partkey AND so.l_suppkey = s.ps_suppkey ORDER BY hvo.o_orderdate DESC, hvo.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COALESCE(ts.number_of_top_suppliers, 0) AS number_of_top_suppliers, COALESCE(ts.total_cost_of_top_suppliers, 0) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey)) AS total_suppliers_in_region FROM region r LEFT JOIN (SELECT rs.nation_name, COUNT(*) AS number_of_top_suppliers, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost_of_top_suppliers FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS supply_rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_regionkey) rs WHERE rs.supply_rank <= 5 GROUP BY rs.nation_name) ts ON r.r_name = ts.nation_name ORDER BY r.r_name;

SELECT tc.c_name AS Top_Customer, sd.s_name AS Top_Supplier, ROUND(SUM(os.revenue), 2) AS Total_Revenue, ROUND(SUM(sd.total_supplycost), 2) AS Total_Supply_Cost, tc.total_revenue AS Customer_Revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.revenue) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON o.o_orderkey = os.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tc JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1994-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON tc.c_custkey = os.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON sd.total_supplycost = ( SELECT MAX(total_supplycost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierDetails ) GROUP BY tc.c_name, sd.s_name, tc.total_revenue;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) rs WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT sd.s_suppkey, sd.s_name, sd.nation_name, sd.region_name, sd.total_supply_value, os.total_orders_value, os.orders_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) sd LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders_value, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) os ON sd.s_suppkey = os.c_custkey WHERE sd.total_supply_value > 10000 ORDER BY sd.total_supply_value DESC, os.total_orders_value DESC;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, od.TotalRevenue, ts.s_name, ts.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od JOIN lineitem l ON od.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, si.TotalSupplyCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal) si JOIN supplier s ON si.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY si.TotalSupplyCost DESC LIMIT 10) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' ORDER BY od.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS Nation, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1996-01-01' AND r.r_name = 'ASIA' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT hr.s_name AS high_cost_supplier, nr.n_name AS supplier_nation, hr.total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON s.s_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey WHERE sc.total_cost > (SELECT AVG(total_cost) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierCosts)) hr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey) nr ON hr.s_suppkey = nr.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON nr.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY hr.s_name, nr.n_name, hr.total_cost ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(lp.l_extendedprice) AS average_extended_price, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem lp ON p.p_partkey = lp.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON lp.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND p.p_type LIKE '%green%' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, s.s_name ORDER BY total_available_quantity DESC, average_extended_price DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT pp.p_name AS part_name, sc.s_name AS supplier_name, sc.total_supply_cost, pp.total_quantity_sold FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity_sold FROM part p JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC LIMIT 10) pp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc ON pp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = sc.s_suppkey) ORDER BY sc.total_supply_cost DESC, pp.total_quantity_sold DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.total_quantity, o.total_revenue, ns.n_name AS supplier_nation, ps.p_name AS part_name, ps.total_available, ps.avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate) o JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON o.o_orderkey % 10 = ns.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name) ps ON o.o_orderkey % 5 = ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate, COUNT(DISTINCT od.l_partkey) AS distinct_parts, SUM(od.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, AVG(od.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost_per_order FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name, ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk, s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) ss JOIN nation n ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ss.rnk <= 5) ts ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey) od GROUP BY od.o_orderkey, od.o_orderdate ORDER BY total_extended_price DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS distinct_suppliers FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, n.n_name, r.order_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.order_rank <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.n_name ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ra.region_name, ra.nation_name, sa.s_name, sa.total_supply_cost, cos.order_count, cos.total_spent, cos.avg_order_value FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_parts FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) ra JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sa ON ra.nation_name IN (SELECT n_name FROM nation WHERE n_nationkey = sa.s_suppkey) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) cos ON cos.c_custkey IN (SELECT c_custkey FROM customer WHERE c_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = ra.nation_name)) ORDER BY ra.region_name, sa.total_supply_cost DESC, cos.total_spent DESC;

SELECT tr.NationName, tr.RegionName, rs.s_name AS TopSupplier, rs.TotalSupplyCost, rs.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS NationName, r.r_name AS RegionName, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS SupplierCount FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) > 5) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(p.ps_supplycost * p.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_name ORDER BY SUM(p.ps_supplycost * p.ps_availqty) DESC) AS SupplierRank, n.n_name AS NationName FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp p ON s.s_suppkey = p.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name) rs ON tr.NationName = rs.NationName WHERE rs.SupplierRank = 1 ORDER BY tr.RegionName, rs.TotalSupplyCost DESC;

SELECT h.customer_name, h.region_name, h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, h.total_revenue, h.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT R.o_orderkey, R.o_orderdate, R.o_totalprice, R.customer_name, R.region_name, SUM(L.l_extendedprice * (1 - L.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(L.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, C.c_name AS customer_name, R.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY C.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer C ON o.o_custkey = C.c_custkey JOIN nation N ON C.c_nationkey = N.n_nationkey JOIN region R ON N.n_regionkey = R.r_regionkey) R JOIN lineitem L ON R.o_orderkey = L.l_orderkey WHERE R.rank <= 5 GROUP BY R.o_orderkey, R.o_orderdate, R.o_totalprice, R.customer_name, R.region_name) h WHERE h.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY h.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT os.o_orderkey, os.o_orderdate, os.total_amount, sc.s_suppkey, sc.s_name, sc.nation_name, tc.total_supply_cost, sc.part_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) sc ON os.item_count = sc.part_count LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) tc ON sc.part_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partsupp WHERE ps_partkey = sc.s_suppkey) ORDER BY os.total_amount DESC, os.o_orderdate DESC FETCH FIRST 10 ROWS ONLY;

SELECT r.r_name, rp.TotalSalesByRegion, rp.AvgQuantityByRegion, rp.TotalOrdersByRegion FROM (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(so.TotalSales) AS TotalSalesByRegion, AVG(so.AvgQuantity) AS AvgQuantityByRegion, SUM(so.TotalOrders) AS TotalOrdersByRegion FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS AvgQuantity, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS DistinctOrderCount FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) so ON s.s_suppkey = so.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name) rp JOIN region r ON rp.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rp.TotalSalesByRegion DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, hl.total_value AS lineitem_value, si.s_name, si.total_available FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-09-30') ro JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem li JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-09-30') ro ON li.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE li.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY li.l_orderkey HAVING SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) > (SELECT AVG(total_value) FROM (SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_value FROM lineitem GROUP BY l_orderkey) AS avg_values)) hl ON ro.o_orderkey = hl.l_orderkey JOIN lineitem li ON hl.l_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 100) si ON li.l_partkey = si.ps_partkey AND li.l_suppkey = si.ps_suppkey ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, hl.total_value DESC;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, COALESCE(sp.order_count, 0) AS supplier_order_count, COALESCE(hv.total_cost, 0) AS high_value_part_cost, cs.order_count AS customer_order_count, cs.total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs LEFT JOIN (SELECT sh.s_suppkey, sh.s_name, p.p_name, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey WHERE sh.level < 3) sh ON s.s_suppkey = sh.s_suppkey WHERE sh.level < 3) sh JOIN partsupp ps ON sh.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY sh.s_suppkey, sh.s_name, p.p_name) sp ON cs.c_custkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 50000) hv ON sp.p_name = hv.p_name WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000 AND cs.order_count > 5 ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC, cs.order_count DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, hcp.p_name AS part_name, SUM(lp.l_extendedprice * (1 - lp.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name, np.n_name, rp.p_name, rp.total_cost, rp.p_partkey FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_type ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS cost_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_type) rp JOIN supplier s ON rp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) JOIN nation np ON s.s_nationkey = np.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON np.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rp.cost_rank <= 10) hcp JOIN lineitem lp ON lp.l_partkey = hcp.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON lp.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, hcp.p_name ORDER BY revenue DESC, region, nation, part_name;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(oss.total_sales) as total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT hc.c_custkey) as high_value_customers, AVG(sp.avg_supplier_acctbal) as avg_supplier_acctbal FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) as total_sales, AVG(l.l_discount) as avg_discount FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) oss ON ps.ps_partkey = oss.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.c_acctbal DESC) as rank FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 50000) hc ON oss.total_sales > 1000000 JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) as num_suppliers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) as avg_supplier_acctbal FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON ps.ps_partkey = sp.ps_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 100000 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_revenue, rs.unique_customers, rs.total_orders, op.o_orderpriority, op.order_count FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) rs JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderpriority, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderpriority) op ON rs.total_orders > 0 ORDER BY rs.total_revenue DESC, op.order_count DESC;

SELECT cr.c_custkey, cr.c_name, sr.n_name AS supplier_nation, cr.total_orders, cr.total_spent, sr.total_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cr JOIN (SELECT ns.n_nationkey, ns.n_name, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_nationkey, n.n_name FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey) ns ON rs.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY ns.n_nationkey, ns.n_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC) sr ON cr.c_nationkey = sr.n_nationkey WHERE cr.total_orders > 5 AND sr.total_cost > 100000 ORDER BY cr.total_spent DESC, sr.total_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, pd.p_name, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.order_rank <= 5) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN part pd ON l.l_partkey = pd.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) sd ON pd.p_partkey = sd.ps_partkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ts.total_supply_cost) AS total_top_supplier_cost, AVG(ts.s_acctbal) AS average_account_balance FROM nation n JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, rs.total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey WHERE rs.rank <= 5) ts ON n.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_top_supplier_cost DESC;

SELECT Region, Nation, SupplierName, TotalCost FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, ns.n_name AS Nation, rs.s_name AS SupplierName, rs.TotalCost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalCost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS Rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.Rank = 1 AND rs.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ORDER BY Region, Nation, TotalCost DESC;

SELECT tp.s_suppkey, tp.s_name, tp.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT rsp.s_suppkey, rsp.s_name, rsp.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rsp.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rsp) tp JOIN supplier s ON tp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE tp.revenue_rank <= 10 ORDER BY tp.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS unique_customers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'GROUND') GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ts.s_name, cr.c_name, cr.total_orders, cr.total_spent, ts.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, st.total_avail_qty, st.avg_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) st JOIN supplier s ON s.s_suppkey = st.s_suppkey ORDER BY st.total_avail_qty DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN (SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_orders, cs.total_spent, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_spent DESC) AS customer_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs) cr ON ts.total_avail_qty > cr.total_orders ORDER BY ts.avg_supply_cost DESC, cr.total_spent DESC;

SELECT s.r_regionkey, s.region_sales, s.supplier_count, s.avg_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s.region_sales DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, SUM(ro.total_sales) AS region_sales, sa.supplier_count, sa.avg_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_acctbal FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_nationkey) sa ON n.n_nationkey = sa.s_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, sa.supplier_count, sa.avg_acctbal) s WHERE s.region_sales > 10000 ORDER BY s.region_sales DESC, s.supplier_count DESC;

SELECT r.p_name, r.total_revenue, CASE WHEN r.revenue_rank <= 10 THEN 'Top 10' WHEN r.revenue_rank <= 30 THEN 'Top 30' ELSE 'Others' END AS revenue_category FROM (SELECT p.p_name, r.total_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) r ON p.p_partkey = r.ps_partkey) r WHERE r.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT rn.o_orderkey, tn.n_name, tn.nation_revenue, rn.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) rn JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS nation_revenue FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY nation_revenue DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON rn.total_revenue > tn.nation_revenue WHERE rn.revenue_rank = 1 ORDER BY rn.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales, tr.sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.sales_rank;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, sp.s_name AS supplier_name, hp.p_name AS part_name, hp.p_retailprice, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1997-12-31') r JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, p.p_mfgr, ps.ps_availqty, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE (p.p_retailprice < 100 OR p.p_size > 50) AND s.s_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_regionkey = (SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'))) hp ON hp.p_partkey = (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 50 ORDER BY ps.ps_availqty DESC LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON hp.s_suppkey = sp.s_suppkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rp ON rp.total_supply_cost > 5000 WHERE r.order_rank = 1 ORDER BY r.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_mfgr, tp.p_type, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_mfgr, rp.p_type, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_type) rp) tp LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON tp.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE tp.rank <= 10 GROUP BY tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.p_mfgr, tp.p_type ORDER BY revenue DESC;

SELECT rsi.s_suppkey, rsi.s_name, rsi.total_supply_value, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.c_acctbal, ro.total_order_value FROM (SELECT rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) AND s.s_acctbal > 5000) rs JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey GROUP BY rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name) rsi JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > 10000) hvc ON rsi.total_supply_value > hvc.c_acctbal JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON hvc.c_custkey = ro.o_custkey WHERE rsi.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rn FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size IN (10, 20, 30) AND s.s_acctbal > 5000) WHERE rn = 1) ORDER BY ro.total_order_value DESC, rsi.total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT s.s_name, COUNT(DISTINCT so.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(so.order_value) AS total_order_value FROM (SELECT sr.s_suppkey, sr.s_name, od.o_orderkey, od.order_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sum(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_revenue FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sr JOIN partsupp ps ON sr.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS order_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON l.l_orderkey = od.o_orderkey) so JOIN supplier s ON so.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.*, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name, SUM(oli.l_extendedprice - (oli.l_extendedprice * oli.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT oli.l_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') ro JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, li.l_partkey, li.l_quantity, li.l_extendedprice, li.l_discount, li.l_tax FROM lineitem li JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months') ro ON li.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey) oli ON ro.o_orderkey = oli.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON oli.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM partsupp ps GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) hvs ON ps.ps_suppkey = hvs.ps_suppkey GROUP BY ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_name) o JOIN customer c ON o.c_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.revenue > 5000 ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.revenue DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.total_revenue, s.s_name, r.r_name, n.n_name FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.total_revenue, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) ro JOIN orders o ON ro.o_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ro.total_revenue > 10000) o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ts.s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 5) ts) ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC, o.o_orderkey ASC;

SELECT tco.o_orderkey, tco.o_totalprice, tco.o_orderdate, tco.c_mktsegment, old.revenue, old.avg_tax FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderdate, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 5) tco JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)) AS revenue, AVG(lo.l_tax) AS avg_tax FROM lineitem lo WHERE lo.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND lo.l_shipdate <= DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY lo.l_orderkey) old ON tco.o_orderkey = old.l_orderkey ORDER BY tco.o_totalprice DESC, tco.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_available_quantity, ts.total_supply_cost, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN partsupp ps ON ts.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE ts.rank <= 10 AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_sales, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS average_order_value, SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_extended_price, SUM(l.l_discount) AS total_discount, SUM(l.l_tax) AS total_tax FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < '1998-01-01' AND l.l_returnflag = 'R' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC, total_customers ASC;

SELECT sd.p_name, sd.total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT tc.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT rc.o_orderkey, rc.o_orderdate, rc.o_totalprice, rc.c_name, rc.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') rc WHERE rc.rank <= 10) tc ON l.l_orderkey = tc.o_orderkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) sd JOIN (SELECT rc.o_orderkey, rc.o_orderdate, rc.o_totalprice, rc.c_name, rc.c_acctbal FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') rc WHERE rc.rank <= 10) tc ON sd.total_sales > 1000 GROUP BY sd.p_name, sd.total_sales ORDER BY sd.total_sales DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, total_orders, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1993-01-01' AND DATE '1993-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sales_rank;

SELECT tp.p_name, tp.p_brand, tp.total_supply_cost, sd.s_name, sd.s_acctbal, cod.c_name, cod.o_orderdate, cod.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_type, rp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_brand ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS brand_rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type) rp WHERE rp.brand_rank <= 5) tp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_comment FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000) sd ON tp.p_partkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey IN (SELECT s.s_suppkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000)) JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_mktsegment, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') cod ON tp.p_partkey IN (SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_totalprice > cod.o_totalprice) ORDER BY tp.total_supply_cost DESC, sd.s_acctbal DESC, cod.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation, r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipmode IN ('AIR', 'TRUCK') GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, order_count DESC;

SELECT t.region_name, t.nation_name, t.total_spent, t.order_count, sp.supplier_name, sp.part_name, sp.ps_supplycost, sp.ps_availqty FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name) t JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, p.p_name AS part_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp ON t.region_name = 'AMERICA' WHERE t.total_spent > 1000000 ORDER BY t.total_spent DESC, sp.ps_supplycost ASC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rd.o_orderkey, rd.o_orderdate, rd.o_totalprice, sd.s_name AS SupplierName, ad.Region, ad.NationCount, ad.TotalOrders, ad.TotalRevenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') rd JOIN lineitem li ON rd.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON li.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier sd ON ps.ps_suppkey = sd.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS NationCount, SUM(cd.OrderCount) AS TotalOrders, SUM(cd.TotalSpent) AS TotalRevenue FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS OrderCount, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS TotalSpent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cd ON c.c_custkey = cd.c_custkey GROUP BY r.r_name) ad ON 1=1 WHERE rd.OrderRank <= 10 ORDER BY rd.o_totalprice DESC, ad.TotalRevenue DESC;

SELECT Region, TotalSales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalSales DESC) AS SalesRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS Region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE TotalSales > 10000 ORDER BY SalesRank;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.c_mktsegment, oi.revenue, oi.unique_suppliers, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) o JOIN (SELECT hlo.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_mktsegment, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro WHERE ro.price_rank <= 10) hlo JOIN lineitem l ON hlo.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY hlo.o_orderkey) oi ON o.o_orderkey = oi.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.ps_supplycost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) ps ON ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ) JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, oi.revenue DESC;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT hvs.s_suppkey, hvs.s_name, hvc.c_custkey, hvc.c_name, hvc.total_orders, hvc.order_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_supply_value, ss.part_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE ss.total_supply_value > 100000) hvs JOIN (SELECT cu.c_custkey, cu.c_name, cu.total_orders, cu.order_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cu WHERE cu.total_orders > 50000) hvc ON hvc.order_count > 5 ORDER BY hvs.total_supply_value DESC, hvc.total_orders DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, r.r_name AS region_name, MAX(sup.total_cost) AS max_supplier_cost, AVG(sup.total_cost) AS avg_supplier_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part p LEFT JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey LEFT JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey LEFT JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_name) AS supplier_count FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey) sup ON p.p_partkey = sup.ps_partkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1998-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, r.r_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 10 AND SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC, customer_count DESC;
