SELECT rs.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cs.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(cs.total_order_value) AS total_order_value, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(CASE WHEN c.c_acctbal > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_positive_customers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) cs ON n.n_nationkey = cs.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) ss ON n.n_nationkey = ss.s_nationkey GROUP BY rs.r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC, customer_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, cod.c_custkey, cod.c_name, cod.o_orderkey, cod.o_totalprice, cod.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY rs.total_supply_cost DESC) AS supplier_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_supply_cost > 1000) ts JOIN lineitem l ON ts.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O') cod ON l.l_orderkey = cod.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY ts.s_suppkey, cod.o_orderdate DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_price_after_discount FROM customer AS c JOIN nation AS n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) > 10 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, t.s_name, t.total_supply_cost FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.nation_name, s.region_name, s.total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.region_name ORDER BY s.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) s) t ON l.l_suppkey = t.s_suppkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE t.rank <= 5 AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31' ORDER BY t.region_name, t.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.o_orderkey, co.o_orderdate, ol.l_quantity, ol.l_extendedprice, ol.l_discount, ol.l_tax, ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, ts.ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') co JOIN (SELECT lo.l_orderkey, lo.l_quantity, lo.l_extendedprice, lo.l_discount, lo.l_tax, lo.l_shipdate, lo.l_returnflag, lo.l_linestatus FROM lineitem lo JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1996-01-01' AND '1996-12-31') co ON lo.l_orderkey = co.o_orderkey) ol ON co.o_orderkey = ol.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT rnk, s_suppkey, s_name, p_partkey, p_name, ps_supplycost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY ps.ps_supplycost ASC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) WHERE rnk = 1) ts ON ol.l_orderkey = ts.p_partkey WHERE ol.l_returnflag = 'R' AND ol.l_linestatus = 'O' ORDER BY co.c_custkey, co.o_orderdate DESC, ol.l_quantity DESC;

SELECT hcss.s_name, ro.total_revenue, ro.o_orderdate FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, sc.total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sc JOIN supplier s ON sc.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey ORDER BY sc.total_cost DESC LIMIT 1) hcss JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate) ro ON hcss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT l.l_partkey FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' ) ) ORDER BY ro.total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.c_name, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.o_totalprice, ts.s_name AS top_supplier, ts.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderstatus, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderpriority, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderstatus ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro JOIN lineitem li ON ro.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ts.total_supply_value, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_supply_value DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 GROUP BY ps.ps_suppkey) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.ps_suppkey) ts ON li.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ro.price_rank <= 5 AND ts.rank <= 10 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_orderkey;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS num_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT sr.region_name, sr.total_sales, sr.sales_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) as sales_ranking) AS total_regions FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) sr WHERE sr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY sr.sales_rank;

SELECT tp.p_partkey, tp.p_name, tp.available_quantity, tp.average_supply_cost, tp.nation_name FROM (SELECT pp.p_partkey, pp.p_name, pp.available_quantity, pp.average_supply_cost, rs.nation_name FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) pp JOIN (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_account_balance FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_name) rs ON pp.available_quantity > 100 ORDER BY pp.available_quantity DESC LIMIT 10) tp WHERE tp.average_supply_cost < (SELECT AVG(average_supply_cost) FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) as PartSupplied) ORDER BY tp.available_quantity DESC;

SELECT rh.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ch.c_custkey) AS num_customers, AVG(cs.total_spent) AS avg_spent, COUNT(DISTINCT sh.s_suppkey) AS num_suppliers FROM region rh JOIN nation n ON rh.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN customer ch ON n.n_nationkey = ch.c_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(od.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_lineitem_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs ON ch.c_custkey = cs.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, 0 AS level FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_acctbal > 10000 UNION ALL SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, sh.level + 1 FROM supplier s JOIN SupplierHierarchy sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000 AND sh.level < 5) sh ON s.s_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000 AND sh.level < 5) sh ON n.n_nationkey = sh.s_nationkey WHERE cs.total_spent > 1000 GROUP BY rh.r_name ORDER BY avg_spent DESC;

SELECT cr.c_name AS customer_name, cr.order_count, cr.total_spent, trs.r_name AS region_name, iss.p_name AS part_name, iss.total_availqty, iss.avg_supply_cost, rs.total_cost AS supplier_cost FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cr JOIN (SELECT n.n_regionkey, r.r_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS region_total FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY region_total DESC LIMIT 5) trs ON cr.total_spent > trs.region_total * 0.1 JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_availqty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 0) iss ON cr.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderSummary) JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) rs ON rs.total_cost < cr.total_spent * 0.5 ORDER BY cr.total_spent DESC, rs.total_cost ASC;

SELECT hp.p_partkey, hp.p_name, hp.p_brand, hp.p_retailprice, n.n_name AS nation_name, nsc.total_suppliers FROM (SELECT rp.p_partkey, rp.p_name, rp.p_brand, rp.p_retailprice, rp.total_supply_cost, rp.supplier_count FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_retailprice) rp WHERE rp.total_supply_cost > 10000) hp JOIN partsupp ps ON hp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey) nsc ON n.n_nationkey = nsc.n_nationkey WHERE hp.supplier_count > 5 ORDER BY hp.total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT RegionName, TotalRevenue, TotalOrders, TotalCustomers, RevenueRank FROM (SELECT RegionName, TotalRevenue, TotalOrders, TotalCustomers, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TotalRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS RegionName, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalRevenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS TotalOrders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS TotalCustomers FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-04-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalStats) WHERE TotalOrders > 0 ORDER BY RevenueRank;

SELECT c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, ts.s_name, ts.total_supply_cost FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT rt.s_suppkey, rt.s_name, rt.total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY rt.s_nationkey ORDER BY rt.total_supply_cost DESC) AS rnk FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rt) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE ts.rnk <= 5 AND l.l_shipdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' ORDER BY ts.total_supply_cost DESC, c.c_name;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, s.s_name AS SupplierName, sp.p_name AS PartName, r.r_name AS RegionName FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS TotalSupplyCost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 100000) sp ON l.l_partkey = sp.p_partkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_regionkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS SupplierRank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.SupplierRank <= 5 AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' ORDER BY c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, l.l_linenumber;

SELECT r.r_name AS Region, ns.n_name AS Nation, COUNT(rs.s_name) AS Top_Supplier_Count, SUM(rs.total_supply_cost) AS Total_Supply_Cost FROM (SELECT r.r_name, ns.n_name, rs.s_name, rs.total_supply_cost, ns.n_nationkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank, n.n_nationkey FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_nationkey) rs JOIN nation ns ON rs.rank = 1 AND ns.n_nationkey = rs.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON ns.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) rs JOIN region r ON rs.r_name = r.r_name JOIN nation ns ON rs.n_name = ns.n_name GROUP BY r.r_name, ns.n_name ORDER BY r.r_name, Total_Supply_Cost DESC;

SELECT t.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT hvo.o_orderkey) AS num_high_value_orders, SUM(hvo.o_totalprice) AS total_high_value_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT fp.p_partkey) AS num_famous_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_cost DESC LIMIT 10) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice FROM orders o WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2)) hvo ON t.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem li ON ps.ps_partkey = li.l_partkey WHERE li.l_orderkey IN (SELECT o_orderkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_totalprice FROM orders o WHERE o.o_totalprice > (SELECT AVG(o2.o_totalprice) FROM orders o2)) as high_value_orders) ) LEFT JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p2.p_retailprice) FROM part p2)) fp ON fp.p_partkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_partkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_suppkey = t.s_suppkey ) GROUP BY t.s_name ORDER BY total_high_value_revenue DESC;

SELECT t.o_orderkey, t.o_orderdate, t.o_totalprice, t.c_name, t.nation_name, tp.p_name, tp.total_sales FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS OrderRank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) r JOIN nation n ON r.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE r.OrderRank <= 5) t JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ps.total_sales FROM part p JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey ORDER BY ps.total_sales DESC LIMIT 10) tp ON t.o_orderkey = (SELECT l.l_orderkey FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_brand = tp.p_brand) LIMIT 1) ORDER BY t.o_orderdate DESC, tp.total_sales DESC;

SELECT ts.region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, STRING_AGG(ts.s_name, ', ') AS top_suppliers FROM (SELECT region_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_available_qty, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_available_qty DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY r.r_name, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as RegionSupplier) ts JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE ts.rank <= 5 GROUP BY ts.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, total_cost, total_revenue, (total_revenue - total_cost) AS profit, CASE WHEN total_revenue > total_cost THEN 'Profitable' ELSE 'Not Profitable' END AS profitability_status FROM (SELECT np.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(sp.ps_supplycost * sp.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, SUM(co.total_spent) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ps.ps_availqty, ps.ps_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation np ON s.s_nationkey = np.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) co ON co.total_spent >= 10000 GROUP BY np.n_name) ORDER BY profit DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.total_sales, tc.c_custkey, tc.c_name, tc.customer_spending FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS sales_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS customer_spending FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000) tc ON r.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o WHERE o.o_custkey = tc.c_custkey) WHERE r.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY r.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders FROM customer AS c JOIN orders AS o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem AS l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier AS s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation AS n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region AS r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_brand, p.p_type, SUM(lineitem.l_extendedprice * (1 - lineitem.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem ON p.p_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON lineitem.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY p.p_brand, p.p_type ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rp.region_name, rp.total_freight_revenue, rp.total_fulfilled_orders, rp.avg_order_value, am.avg_revenue_per_region, am.total_orders, am.distinct_regions FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.o_orderstatus = 'F' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS total_freight_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_fulfilled_orders, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY r.r_name) rp, AggregateMetrics am ORDER BY rp.total_freight_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, ts.order_count, ts.sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, ss.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM supplier s JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey) ts WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, tr.total_revenue, c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 year' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) ro WHERE ro.revenue_rank <= 10) tr ON o.o_orderkey = tr.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 1000 ORDER BY tr.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT td.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(td.total_spent) AS total_spending, AVG(sd.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost, MAX(sd.ps_availqty) AS max_avail_qty FROM (SELECT c.c_nationkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey) o JOIN customer c ON o.o_orderkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY c.c_nationkey, c.c_name) td JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, p.p_name, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty, s.s_nationkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey) sd ON td.c_nationkey = sd.s_nationkey GROUP BY td.c_name ORDER BY total_spending DESC, avg_supply_cost ASC LIMIT 20;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(ss.total_supply_cost) AS average_supplier_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank, c.c_nationkey, o.o_custkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1996-12-31') o JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = ( SELECT c.c_nationkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey ) JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON ss.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey ) WHERE o.order_rank <= 3 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.r_name;

SELECT rp.p_name, tn.n_name, rp.total_supply_cost, tn.total_orders FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.p_partkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) rp JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_orders FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN customer c ON s.s_suppkey = c.c_custkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name ORDER BY total_orders DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON tn.n_nationkey = (SELECT s.s_nationkey FROM supplier s WHERE s.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey LIMIT 1)) WHERE rp.rank = 1 ORDER BY rp.total_supply_cost DESC, tn.total_orders DESC;

SELECT customer_name, nation_name, total_sales, order_count, avg_sale_amount, sales_rank FROM (SELECT customer_name, nation_name, total_sales, order_count, avg_sale_amount, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY nation_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS avg_sale_amount FROM customer c JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-10-01' GROUP BY c.c_name, n.n_name) as SalesSummary) WHERE sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY nation_name, sales_rank;

SELECT o.o_orderdate, COUNT(*) AS total_orders, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_revenue, AVG(o.o_totalprice) AS avg_order_value, STRING_AGG(CONCAT(o.c_name, ': ', o.o_totalprice), ', ') AS order_details FROM (SELECT order_rank, o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_name, region_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, rn.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region rn ON n.n_regionkey = rn.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F') WHERE order_rank <= 5) o GROUP BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, od.l_partkey, od.l_quantity, od.l_extendedprice, sp.total_available_quantity, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) o JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, l.l_quantity, l.l_extendedprice, l.l_discount, l.l_tax FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.o_totalprice, r.c_name FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') r WHERE r.rank <= 5) o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey) od ON o.o_orderkey = od.l_orderkey JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey) sp ON od.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderkey, sp.total_available_quantity DESC;

SELECT t.s_name, t.r_name, SUM(sd.total_sales) AS total_sales FROM (SELECT s.s_nationkey, s.s_name, r.r_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) rs JOIN supplier s ON rs.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE rs.total_supply_cost IN (SELECT DISTINCT total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC) ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10)) t JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) sd ON t.s_nationkey = (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey WHERE s.s_name = t.s_name) GROUP BY t.s_name, t.r_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT t.nation_name, t.region_name, t.total_sales, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) ORDER BY total_sales DESC LIMIT 5) t JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_supplycost IN ( SELECT SUM(l.l_quantity) FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l.l_partkey ) JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey WHERE t.total_sales > 100000 ORDER BY t.total_sales DESC, p.p_retailprice ASC;

SELECT n.n_name, n.total_revenue, n.total_supply_cost, (n.total_revenue - n.total_supply_cost) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT n.n_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_nationkey) ss ON ss.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_suppkey) AS unique_suppliers FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.unique_suppliers = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_name) n WHERE n.total_revenue > 100000 ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;

SELECT region, total_sales FROM (SELECT region, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipmode = 'TRUCK' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT rp.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT tp.p_partkey) AS number_of_parts, SUM(tp.total_sales) AS total_sales_value FROM region rp JOIN nation n ON rp.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_retailprice, ts.total_sales FROM part p JOIN (SELECT l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01') ro ON l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey WHERE ro.order_rank <= 10 GROUP BY l.l_partkey) ts ON p.p_partkey = ts.l_partkey WHERE p.p_retailprice > 100.00) tp ON ps.ps_partkey = tp.p_partkey GROUP BY rp.r_name ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC;

SELECT sb.region_name, SUM(sb.total_sales) AS total_revenue, AVG(sb.num_parts) AS avg_parts, COUNT(DISTINCT sb.region_name) AS unique_regions FROM (SELECT ts.region_name, ps2.total_sales, COUNT(*) AS num_parts FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.region_name FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, r.r_name AS region_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_name ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) s WHERE s.rank <= 5) ts JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN part p ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey) ps2 ON ps2.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY ts.region_name, ps2.total_sales) sb GROUP BY sb.region_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT region_name, total_sales, CASE WHEN total_sales > 100000 THEN 'High Sales' WHEN total_sales BETWEEN 50000 AND 100000 THEN 'Medium Sales' ELSE 'Low Sales' END AS sales_category, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) WHERE total_sales > (SELECT average_sales FROM (SELECT AVG(total_sales) AS average_sales FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) as avg_sales)) ORDER BY total_sales DESC;

SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, tli.total_items, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ro LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, COUNT(*) AS total_items FROM lineitem l GROUP BY l.l_orderkey) tli ON ro.o_orderkey = tli.l_orderkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey) sp ON EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM lineitem l WHERE l.l_orderkey = ro.o_orderkey AND l.l_partkey = sp.ps_partkey ) WHERE ro.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ro.o_orderdate DESC, ro.o_orderkey;

SELECT fo.c_name, fo.order_count, fo.total_spent, fo.supplier_name, COALESCE(fo.total_supply_cost, 0) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT tc.c_name, tc.order_count, tc.total_spent, sd.s_name AS supplier_name, sd.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ra.c_name, COUNT(ra.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ra.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') ra WHERE ra.order_rank <= 5 GROUP BY ra.c_name ORDER BY total_spent DESC) tc LEFT JOIN (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) sd ON tc.c_name = sd.s_name) fo ORDER BY fo.total_spent DESC, fo.order_count DESC;

SELECT ts.s_suppkey, ts.s_name, ts.total_sales, n.n_name AS supplier_nation, r.r_name AS supplier_region FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, ss.total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss JOIN supplier s ON ss.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE ts.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY ts.total_sales DESC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, AVG(c.c_acctbal) AS average_customer_balance FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT CO.c_custkey, CO.c_name, HVS.s_suppkey, HVS.s_name, CLI.l_orderkey, CLI.l_partkey, CLI.revenue FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name HAVING SUM(o.o_totalprice) > 10000) CO JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) > 500000) HVS ON CO.total_spent > 20000 JOIN (SELECT l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY l.l_orderkey, l.l_partkey HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000) CLI ON CO.c_custkey IN ( SELECT DISTINCT c.c_custkey FROM customer c WHERE c.c_nationkey IN ( SELECT r.r_regionkey FROM region r WHERE r.r_name = 'Europe' ) ) WHERE CLI.revenue > 15000 ORDER BY CO.total_spent DESC, CLI.revenue DESC;

SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales FROM (SELECT nation_name, region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name) as RegionalSales) WHERE sales_rank <= 3 ORDER BY region_name, total_sales DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, sp.s_name, sp.total_avail_qty, sp.avg_supply_cost, o.revenue FROM (SELECT r.o_orderkey, r.o_orderdate, r.revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r WHERE r.order_rank <= 10) o JOIN (SELECT p.p_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN supplier s ON ps.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, s.s_name) sp ON o.o_orderkey = sp.ps_suppkey ORDER BY o.revenue DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, AVG(l.l_quantity) AS avg_quantity_per_order FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate > l.l_commitdate GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS total_customers, AVG(s.s_acctbal) AS avg_supplier_balance FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-10-01' AND l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-10-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT tr.region, tr.sales_rank, ss.supplier_name, ss.part_count, ss.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT region, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr JOIN (SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_name) ss ON ss.part_count > 10 WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.sales_rank, ss.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, o.c_mktsegment, lis.total_lineitem_value, lis.average_discount, lis.lineitem_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 5) o JOIN (SELECT t.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_lineitem_value, AVG(l.l_discount) AS average_discount, COUNT(l.l_orderkey) AS lineitem_count FROM (SELECT ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice, ro.o_orderstatus, ro.c_mktsegment FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, o.o_orderstatus, c.c_mktsegment, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_mktsegment ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS rn FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.rn <= 5) t JOIN lineitem l ON t.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY t.o_orderkey) lis ON o.o_orderkey = lis.o_orderkey ORDER BY o.o_orderdate DESC, o.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tr.s_name AS supplier_name, co.c_name AS customer_name, nr.n_name AS nation_name, COALESCE(SUM(lo.l_extendedprice * (1 - lo.l_discount)), 0) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 10) tr JOIN partsupp ps ON tr.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem lo ON ps.ps_partkey = lo.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON lo.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer co ON o.o_custkey = co.c_custkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_name FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nr ON co.c_nationkey = nr.n_nationkey WHERE lo.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F' GROUP BY tr.s_name, co.c_name, nr.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ts.s_name AS top_supplier_name, tc.c_name AS top_customer_name, SUM(tp.total_line_value) AS total_value FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY rs.total_supply_value DESC) AS supplier_rank, rs.s_suppkey, rs.s_name, r.r_regionkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation n ON rs.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) ts JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_line_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate <= DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) tp ON ts.s_suppkey = tp.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_purchase_value FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) tc ON tp.o_orderkey = tc.c_custkey WHERE ts.supplier_rank <= 10 GROUP BY ts.s_name, tc.c_name ORDER BY total_value DESC;

SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, ts.nation_name, ts.total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey JOIN (SELECT nation_name, s_suppkey, s_name, total_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY n.n_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, n.n_nationkey) WHERE rank <= 5) ts ON ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE p.p_size > 10 ORDER BY ts.nation_name, ts.total_cost DESC;

SELECT region_name, nation_name, total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ro.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.r_regionkey ORDER BY SUM(ro.total_revenue) DESC) AS region_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name AS customer_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, c.c_name, c.c_nationkey) ro JOIN customer c ON ro.customer_name = c.c_name JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, n.n_name) WHERE region_rank <= 5 ORDER BY region_name, total_revenue DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, rp.p_name AS part_name, ts.s_name AS supplier_name, rp.p_retailprice, rp.supplier_count, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS total_orders, SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice, COUNT(ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_count FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_mfgr, p.p_brand, p.p_type, p.p_size, p.p_retailprice) rp JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, s.s_nationkey, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY s.s_acctbal DESC) AS rank FROM supplier s) ts ON ts.rank <= 5 JOIN nation n ON n.n_nationkey = ts.s_nationkey JOIN region r ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON ps.ps_partkey = rp.p_partkey AND ps.ps_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_partkey = rp.p_partkey JOIN orders o ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE rp.p_retailprice > 100.00 GROUP BY r.r_name, n.n_name, rp.p_name, ts.s_name, rp.p_retailprice, rp.supplier_count ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, r.r_name, n.n_name, rp.p_name;

SELECT h.o_orderkey, h.o_orderdate, h.o_totalprice, a.s_suppkey, a.s_name, a.part_count, a.total_available_qty, a.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT o_orderkey, o_orderdate, o_totalprice, c_nationkey FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_nationkey, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS order_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01') WHERE order_rank <= 10) h JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, COUNT(distinct sp.ps_partkey) AS part_count, SUM(sp.total_available_qty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(sp.total_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_brand, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM partsupp ps JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY ps.ps_partkey, ps.ps_suppkey, p.p_brand) sp JOIN supplier s ON sp.ps_suppkey = s.s_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) a ON h.o_orderkey = (SELECT MAX(o.o_orderkey) FROM orders o WHERE o.o_orderdate = h.o_orderdate) WHERE a.total_supply_cost > 100000 ORDER BY h.o_totalprice DESC, a.total_available_qty ASC LIMIT 100;

SELECT r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS nation_count, SUM(tv.total_value) AS total_order_value, SUM(s.s_acctbal) AS total_supplier_balance FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, COUNT(ps.ps_partkey) AS parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal ORDER BY parts_supplied DESC LIMIT 10) rs ON s.s_suppkey = rs.s_suppkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal FROM customer c WHERE c.c_acctbal > (SELECT AVG(c2.c_acctbal) FROM customer c2)) hvc ON rs.s_suppkey = (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_retailprice > 5000) LIMIT 1) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_value FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) tv ON tv.total_value > 10000 GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_order_value DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT r.r_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS orders_count, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customers_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS suppliers_count FROM lineitem l JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_custkey, c.c_name FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01') o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND s.s_suppkey IN (SELECT s_suppkey FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC LIMIT 5) as TopSuppliers) GROUP BY r.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

SELECT cs.c_custkey, cs.c_name, cs.total_revenue, cs.order_count, ss.total_available_quantity, ss.average_supply_cost, ss.part_count FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(os.total_revenue) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT os.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_partkey) AS item_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' AND l.l_shipdate >= '1997-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey) os ON c.c_custkey = os.o_custkey WHERE c.c_mktsegment = 'BUILDING' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cs JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_quantity, AVG(ps.ps_supplycost) AS average_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS part_count FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON cs.total_revenue > 10000 ORDER BY cs.total_revenue DESC, ss.part_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT rc.rank, rc.c_name, rc.order_count, rc.total_spent FROM (SELECT co.c_custkey, co.c_name, co.order_count, co.total_spent, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY co.total_spent DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(ts.total_sales) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN (SELECT l_orderkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_sales, MAX(l_shipdate) AS last_ship_date FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY l_orderkey) ts ON o.o_orderkey = ts.l_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) co) rc WHERE rc.rank <= 10 ORDER BY rc.rank;

SELECT r.r_name, r.customer_count, r.total_revenue, AVG(sd.ps_supplycost) AS avg_supplycost FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(cd.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_custkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_orderstatus) cd ON c.c_custkey = cd.o_custkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, ps.ps_supplycost, ps.ps_availqty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey) sd ON sd.s_nationkey = r.r_regionkey GROUP BY r.r_name, r.customer_count, r.total_revenue ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC, r.customer_count DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT p.p_name, p.p_brand, p.p_type, rs.total_revenue, rs.order_count, rs.sales_rank FROM (SELECT ts.p_partkey, ts.total_revenue, ts.order_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ts.total_revenue DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM part AS p JOIN lineitem AS l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders AS o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey WHERE l.l_shipdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND l.l_shipdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY p.p_partkey) AS ts) AS rs JOIN part AS p ON rs.p_partkey = p.p_partkey WHERE rs.sales_rank <= 10 ORDER BY rs.sales_rank;

SELECT t.nation, t.num_customers, t.total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name FROM (SELECT n.n_name AS nation, COUNT(rc.c_custkey) AS num_customers, SUM(rc.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT r.c_custkey, r.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY r.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-12-31' GROUP BY c.c_custkey) r) rc JOIN customer c ON rc.c_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE rc.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY n.n_name) t JOIN region r ON t.nation = r.r_name ORDER BY t.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT ns.s_name AS supplier_name, ns.n_name AS nation_name, ns.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, r.r_name) ns JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_available_qty FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE ps.ps_availqty > 100 GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(ps.ps_availqty) > 500) ts ON ns.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON l.l_suppkey = ns.s_suppkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderstatus = 'O' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal HAVING COUNT(o.o_orderkey) > 10) hv ON o.o_custkey = hv.c_custkey GROUP BY ns.s_name, ns.n_name, ns.r_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue, ns.n_name AS nation FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation ns ON s.s_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_supplycost DESC) AS rank FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supplycost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s) ts ON s.s_suppkey = ts.s_suppkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' AND l.l_shipdate < o.o_orderdate GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, o.o_orderkey, o.o_totalprice, ns.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 10000 ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 20;

SELECT f.nation_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, SUM(f.total_supply_value) AS total_supply_value, AVG(f.total_order_value) AS average_order_value FROM (SELECT ss.s_suppkey, ss.s_name, ss.nation_name, ss.total_supply_value, ss.unique_parts, os.total_order_value, os.order_line_count FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_value, COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_partkey) AS unique_parts FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, n.n_name) ss LEFT JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_order_value, COUNT(DISTINCT l.l_orderkey) AS order_line_count FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) os ON ss.s_suppkey = ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN ( SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 30 ) LIMIT 1 )) f GROUP BY f.nation_name ORDER BY supplier_count DESC, total_supply_value DESC;

SELECT r.n_name AS r_name, rs.s_name, cos.c_name, cos.total_spent, cos.order_count, rs.total_supply_cost FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.s_nationkey ORDER BY SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) DESC) AS rnk FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rs JOIN nation r ON rs.s_nationkey = r.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) cos ON cos.total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= '1997-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name) as CustomerOrderSummary) WHERE rs.rnk <= 10 ORDER BY r.n_name, rs.total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank, COUNT(DISTINCT o.o_orderkey) AS number_of_orders, SUM(o.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY o.total_revenue DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) o) o WHERE o.revenue_rank <= 10 GROUP BY o.o_orderdate, o.total_revenue ORDER BY o.o_orderdate;

SELECT n.n_name AS nation_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, r.r_name AS region_name FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY n.n_name, r.r_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10;

SELECT rn.o_orderkey, rn.o_orderdate, rn.total_revenue, tn.n_name, tn.customer_count FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY o.o_orderdate ORDER BY SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) DESC) AS rank FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1996-01-01' AND DATE '1996-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) rn JOIN (SELECT n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey GROUP BY n.n_name ORDER BY customer_count DESC LIMIT 5) tn ON rn.o_orderkey IN (SELECT o.o_orderkey FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE c.c_nationkey IN (SELECT n.n_nationkey FROM nation n WHERE n.n_name = tn.n_name));

SELECT r.p_partkey, r.p_name, r.total_avail_qty, r.total_cost, h.s_name AS high_value_supplier, os.total_line_items, os.total_revenue FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty) AS total_avail_qty, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM part p JOIN partsupp ps ON p.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name) r JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_acctbal, n.n_name AS nation_name FROM supplier s JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey WHERE s.s_acctbal > 5000) h ON h.s_suppkey IN ( SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey = r.p_partkey ) JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, COUNT(li.l_orderkey) AS total_line_items, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem li ON o.o_orderkey = li.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey) os ON os.total_line_items > 10 ORDER BY r.total_cost DESC, os.total_revenue DESC;

SELECT tr.region_name, tr.total_sales FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey JOIN lineitem l ON p.p_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey GROUP BY r.r_name) as RegionalSales) tr WHERE tr.sales_rank <= 5 ORDER BY tr.total_sales DESC;

SELECT c.c_name AS customer_name, s.s_name AS supplier_name, c.total_spent, s.total_supply_value FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, total_spent FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) c WHERE total_spent > (SELECT AVG(total_spent) FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_spent FROM customer c JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal) as CustomerOrders)) c JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, total_supply_value FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) s WHERE total_supply_value > (SELECT AVG(total_supply_value) FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_availqty * ps.ps_supplycost) AS total_supply_value FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) as SupplierParts)) s ON c.c_custkey % 10 = s.s_suppkey % 10 ORDER BY c.total_spent DESC, s.total_supply_value DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT rs.region_name, rs.total_sales, spc.total_supply_cost, (rs.total_sales - COALESCE(spc.total_supply_cost, 0)) AS profit_margin FROM (SELECT region_name, total_sales, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) AS sales_rank FROM (SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_sales FROM lineitem l JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY r.r_name) as regional_sales) rs LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey) spc ON rs.sales_rank = spc.s_suppkey WHERE rs.total_sales > 1000000 ORDER BY profit_margin DESC;

SELECT r.r_name AS region_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(ns.national_supply_cost) AS total_supply_cost, AVG(ns.total_suppliers) AS avg_suppliers_per_nation FROM (SELECT r.r_regionkey, r.r_name, COUNT(DISTINCT n.n_nationkey) AS total_nations, SUM(ns.national_supply_cost) AS region_supply_cost FROM region r JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS national_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name) r JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.s_suppkey) AS total_suppliers, SUM(ss.total_supply_cost) AS national_supply_cost FROM nation n JOIN supplier s ON n.n_nationkey = s.s_nationkey JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost, COUNT(DISTINCT p.p_partkey) AS total_parts_supplied FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name) ss ON s.s_suppkey = ss.s_suppkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON r.r_regionkey = ns.n_nationkey JOIN nation n ON ns.n_nationkey = n.n_nationkey GROUP BY r.r_regionkey, r.r_name ORDER BY total_supply_cost DESC;

SELECT AVG(avg_supply_cost) AS average_supplier_cost, SUM(total_order_value) AS total_sales_value FROM (SELECT p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, MAX(r.r_name) AS region_name, AVG(rn.total_supply_cost) AS avg_supply_cost, ns.customer_count, ns.total_order_value FROM part p JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_supply_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) rn ON rn.total_supply_cost > 10000 JOIN supplier s ON p.p_partkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, COUNT(DISTINCT c.c_custkey) AS customer_count, SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_value FROM nation n LEFT JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY n.n_nationkey, n.n_name) ns ON n.n_nationkey = ns.n_nationkey GROUP BY p.p_partkey, p.p_name, p.p_brand, ns.customer_count, ns.total_order_value) WHERE region_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY region_name ORDER BY total_sales_value DESC;

SELECT s.s_name AS supplier_name, r.r_name AS region, n.n_name AS nation, SUM(COALESCE(ol.order_count, 0)) AS total_orders FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, total_revenue FROM (SELECT s_suppkey, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM supplier JOIN partsupp ON supplier.s_suppkey = partsupp.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem ON partsupp.ps_partkey = lineitem.l_partkey GROUP BY s_suppkey) ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10) ts JOIN supplier s ON ts.s_suppkey = s.s_suppkey JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey LEFT JOIN (SELECT c.c_custkey, COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count FROM customer c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey) ol ON c.c_custkey = ol.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31' GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, r.r_name, n.n_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 100000 ORDER BY total_orders DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name, tc.o_orderkey, tc.o_orderdate, tc.o_totalprice, ls.total_revenue, ls.total_quantity, ls.unique_lineitems FROM (SELECT ro.c_name, ro.o_orderkey, ro.o_orderdate, ro.o_totalprice FROM (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice, c.c_name, c.c_acctbal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.c_nationkey ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC) AS total_price_rank FROM orders o JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey WHERE o.o_orderdate BETWEEN DATE '1997-01-01' AND DATE '1997-12-31') ro WHERE ro.total_price_rank <= 5) tc JOIN (SELECT li.l_orderkey, SUM(li.l_extendedprice * (1 - li.l_discount)) AS total_revenue, SUM(li.l_quantity) AS total_quantity, COUNT(DISTINCT li.l_linenumber) AS unique_lineitems FROM lineitem li GROUP BY li.l_orderkey) ls ON tc.o_orderkey = ls.l_orderkey ORDER BY tc.o_orderdate DESC, tc.o_totalprice DESC;

SELECT tc.c_name AS TopCustomer, ss.s_name AS SupplierName, tc.CustomerTotalSales, ss.SupplierTotalSales FROM (SELECT c.c_custkey, c.c_name, SUM(r.TotalSales) AS CustomerTotalSales FROM customer c JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS TotalSales FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) r ON c.c_custkey = r.o_orderkey GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_name ORDER BY CustomerTotalSales DESC LIMIT 10) tc JOIN (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS SupplierTotalSales FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name HAVING SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) > 1000000) ss ON tc.CustomerTotalSales > ss.SupplierTotalSales ORDER BY tc.CustomerTotalSales DESC, ss.SupplierTotalSales DESC;

SELECT nd.n_name, COUNT(sd.s_suppkey) AS supplier_count, COUNT(od.o_orderkey) AS order_count, SUM(sd.total_cost) AS supplier_total_cost, SUM(od.total_revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey, SUM(ps.ps_supplycost * ps.ps_availqty) AS total_cost FROM supplier s JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_nationkey) sd JOIN (SELECT n.n_nationkey, n.n_name, r.r_regionkey FROM nation n JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey) nd ON sd.s_nationkey = nd.n_nationkey JOIN (SELECT o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey WHERE o.o_orderdate >= DATE '1995-01-01' AND o.o_orderdate < DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate) od ON sd.s_suppkey IN (SELECT ps.ps_suppkey FROM partsupp ps WHERE ps.ps_partkey IN (SELECT p.p_partkey FROM part p WHERE p.p_size > 20)) GROUP BY nd.n_name ORDER BY total_revenue DESC, supplier_total_cost DESC;
